original: atrāpyanyayā buddhyā kathanamarthāntarād idi netyāha guṇo nāma sa iti na yuktaṃ dravyasya nirdeśāt / naiṣa doṣaḥ / ubhayavacanāt / śuklādayo dravyavat prāgupanyastāḥ / saṃprati guṇaparo nirdeśa iti / yattarhi bhinne vabhinnamityekatvaṃ kathayati / chinneṣvacchinnam iti nityatvaṃ jāterāha / sāmānyabhūtam iti / bhūtaśabda upamāvācī /

original: tatra yeṣāmarthāntarabhūtā jātih, teṣāṃ viśiṣṭeṣu gopiṇḍeṣu anuvartamānaṃ gotvaṃ teṣāṃ sāmānyaṃ nāśvādīnāṃ sarveṣām iti tadapekṣa upamāsaṃbandhaḥ / yeṣāṃ tat dravyāṇi ca teṣām api yebhyo 'bhedo nopapadyate teṣāṃ parityāgādyasmāc ca śakyābhedapratītiḥ tasya copādānāt sāmānyaguṇatvam ityuktam / netyāha / ākṛtirnāma sā /

original: ākṛtir iti [na] tat saṃsthānam / kiṃ tarhi ? jātir eva / yathākṛtyabhivyañjakā [?] vājapyāyana iti / ākriyate 'nayeti ākṛtiḥ / ākriyante iti bhidyante padārthāntarebhya ityākṛtiḥ [?] / ākriyete buddhiśabdāvasthā iti ākṛtiḥ / saṃprati dravyādiṣu nirasteṣu dvayam api sthitaṃ samudāyo vā kaścit pāribhāṣiko [vā] /

original: tatra samudāyo 'pi dravyādivatsamudāya iti prasiddhaḥ / anyaś ca pāribhāṣiko nāsti / prasiddhasya copādāne vaiyarthyam ityataḥ pṛcchati -- kas tarhi śabda iti / yenoccāriteneti / atrānekaṃ darśanam / kecin manyante / yo vāyam uccāryate kramavān avaraḥ / kaścid anyaḥ akramaḥ śabdātmā buddhistho vigāhate / tasmādarthapratipattiḥ / kutaḥ /

original: yāni tvānityāni karmāṇi tadyathā kāmyāni putrakāmo yajeteti annādyakāmo yajeteti teṣāmakaraṇe nāsti pratyavāyaḥ / arthitve sati pravṛtteḥ / idaṃ tu vyākaraṇādhyayanaṃ nityaṃ karmāvaśyakartavyamupanayanādivat ityetat pradarśyate /

original: [3.4] brāhmaṇena śabdā jñeyāḥ / adhyāpanaṃ brāhmaṇaya vṛttiḥ / apaśabdajñaśca viśliṣṭavāktve sati agṛhītavākyatvānnopagamyata iti śabdā jñātavyāḥ / teṣāṃ ca jñāne vyākaraṇādanyo laghurupāyo nāsti / upāyo nāma kāryanirvṛttiṃ prati yaḥ kāraṇānāṃ vinyāsaviśeṣaḥ / tasmād vyākaraṇaṃ laghurupāyaḥ śabdajñānaṃ prati / anya upāya eva na sambhavati /
analyzed: brāhmaṇena śabdāḥ jñeyāḥ adhyāpanam vṛttiḥ apaśabda jñaḥ ca viśliṣṭa vāktve sati agṛhīta vākya tvāt na upagamyate iti śabdāḥ jñātavyāḥ teṣām ca jñāne vyākaraṇāt anyaḥ laghuḥ upāyaḥ na asti upāyaḥ nāma kārya nirvṛttim prati yaḥ kāraṇānām vinyāsa viśeṣaḥ tasmāt vyākaraṇam laghuḥ upāyaḥ śabda jñānam prati anyaḥ upāyaḥ eva na sambhavati

original: ktamāmantritavibhaktyā bhavitavyam iti / yo 'rthaḥ svena dharmeṇa prasiddho dharmāntarasaṃbandhaṃ prati abhimukhīkriyate tatrāmantritavibhaktiḥ / yathā devadattaṃ dharmāntarasaṃbandhaṃ pratyabhimukhīkaroti devadattādhīṣva bhuṅkṣveti / yasya cādhīyamāna evāsau dharmastasya kuta āmantritavibhaktiḥ /
analyzed: ktam āmantrita vibhaktyā bhavitavyam iti yaḥ rthaḥ svena dharmeṇa prasiddhaḥ dharma antara saṃbandham prati abhimukhīkriyate tatra āmantrita vibhaktiḥ yathā devadattam dharma antara saṃbandham pratyabhimukhīkaroti devadatta adhīṣva bhuṅkṣva iti yasya ca adhīyamānaḥ eva asau dharmaḥ tasya kutas āmantrita vibhaktiḥ

original: tadyathā rājā bhava yudhyasva puruṣo bhaveti rājatvamevādhīyamānaṃ puruṣatvaṃ ceti nāstyāmantritavibhaktiḥ / evamihāpīndraśatrutvamevādhīyamānamityadoṣaḥ / tatra pūrvasmin varṇadoṣaḥ pradarśito he 'layo he 'laya iti / saṃprati svaradoṣaḥ //
analyzed: tat yathā rājā bhava yudhyasva puruṣaḥ bhava iti rāja tvam eva ādhīyamānam puruṣa tvam ca iti na asti āmantrita vibhaktiḥ evam iha api indra śatru tvam eva ādhīyamānam iti adoṣaḥ tatra pūrvasmin varṇa doṣaḥ pradarśitaḥ he layaḥ he layaḥ iti saṃprati svara doṣaḥ

original: [4.3]	 yadadhītamavijñātaṃ nigadenaiva śabdyata iti / anenaitadākhyāyate / ya evāsau vedastasyaiva vyākaraṇānugatasya yadi saṃśabdanamapyetadabhyudayāyeti / tatra niruktakāro 'vijñātārtham iti varṇayati / iha tu svaravarṇasaṃskārāvijñātamavijñātam iti parigṛhyate / yaccaivaṃbhūtaṃ tannigadenaiva śabdyate / ācāryopadeśenaiva kevalenetyarthaḥ /
analyzed: yat adhītam avijñātam nigadena eva śabdyate iti anena etat ākhyāyate yaḥ eva asau vedaḥ tasya eva vyākaraṇa anugatasya yadi saṃśabdanam api etat abhyudayāya iti tatra nirukta kāraḥ vijñāta artham iti varṇayati iha tu svara varṇa saṃskāra avijñātam avijñātam iti parigṛhyate yat ca evaṃbhūtam tat nigadena eva śabdyate ācārya upadeśena eva kevalena iti arthaḥ

original: anagnāviva śuṣkaidhaḥ / yathā jvalanasamarthamapi sat kāṣṭhamagninānupagṛhītaṃ na jvalanasamarthaṃ niṣprayojanamevamadhītam api śāstraṃ vyākaraṇenānupagṛhītamasamarthaṃ phalaniṣpattiṃ prati / tasmādanarthakaṃ mādhigīṣmahīti niṣprayojanaṃ mādhigīṣmahītyarthaḥ /
analyzed: anagnau iva śuṣka edhaḥ yathā jvalana samartham api sat kāṣṭham agninā an upagṛhītam na jvalana samartham niṣprayojanam evam adhītam api śāstram vyākaraṇena an upagṛhītam asamartham phala niṣpattim prati tasmāt anarthakam mā adhigīṣmahi iti niṣprayojanam mā adhigīṣmahi iti arthaḥ

original: [4.4] yastu prayuṅkte iti // vyākaraṇāt pratyavāyenāyoga iṣṭena ca phalena saṃbandhaḥ ity etadākhyāyate / prayuṅkte prerayati / kuśalo vidvān / viśeṣe / sa eva śabdo 'rthaviśeṣe kasmiṃścitsādhuḥ kasmiṃścidasādhurityetadākhyāyate / yathā goṇīśabdaḥ sāsnādimatyasādhuḥ / tathāśvaśabdaḥ kesarādimati sādhurna niḥsva iti /
analyzed: yaḥ tu prayuṅkte iti vyākaraṇāt pratyavāyena ayogaḥ iṣṭena ca phalena saṃbandhaḥ iti etat ākhyāyate prayuṅkte prerayati kuśalaḥ vidvān viśeṣe saḥ eva śabdaḥ rtha viśeṣe kasmiṃścid sādhuḥ kasmiṃścid asādhuḥ iti etat ākhyāyate yathā goṇī śabdaḥ sāsnādimati asādhuḥ tathā aśva śabdaḥ kesara ādimati sādhuḥ na niḥsvaḥ iti

original: asva iti nirdhane sādhurnaikaśaphādilakṣaṇe / yadi tu goṇīśabdo 'pi nimittāntarāt sāsnādimiti prayujyeta goṇīva goṇīti sādhureva syāt / aśve vā asvaśabdaṃ dhanābhāvadvārakaṃ prayuñjīta sa sādhureva / atha vā kuśalo 'viśeṣe iti / aviśeṣe 'pi śāstrasya tata āgata iti tena khanatīti sādhureva viṣeṣa eva prayujyate na sarvatra /
analyzed: asvaḥ iti nirdhane sādhuḥ na ekaśapha ādi lakṣaṇe yadi tu nimitta antarāt sāsnā ādim iti prayujyeta goṇī iva goṇī iti sādhuḥ eva syāt aśve vā asva śabdam dhana abhāva dvārakam prayuñjīta sa sādhuḥ eva atha vā kuśalaḥ viśeṣe iti aviśeṣe pi śāstrasya tatas āgataḥ iti tena khanati iti sādhuḥ eva viṣeṣaḥ eva prayujyate na sarvatra

original: vṛkṣamūlādāgataḥ aṅgulyā khanatīti / anyeṣāṃ granthaḥ / kuśalo viśeṣair iti / viśeṣaiḥ śāstrapratipāditairityarthaḥ / yathā tadadhīte tadvedetyanena / vyavahāro vṛttiḥ śiṣṭavyavahāro yājyaiva karmavidhiḥ / kaḥ? vāgyogavideva / anyasyāśrutatvādāha kaḥ ? vāgyogavideveti / evaṃ manyate / yasminnarthe āsevyamāne dharmaḥ /
analyzed: vṛkṣa mūlāt āgataḥ aṅgulyā khanati iti anyeṣām granthaḥ kuśalaḥ viśeṣaiḥ iti viśeṣaiḥ śāstra pratipāditaiḥ iti arthaḥ yathā tat adhīte tat veda iti anena vyavahāraḥ vṛttiḥ śiṣṭa vyavahāraḥ yājyā eva karma vidhiḥ kaḥ vāc yoga vid eva anyasya aśruta tvāt āha kaḥ vāc yoga vid eva iti evam manyate yasmin arthe āsevyamāne dharmaḥ

original: tasmādyo viparītaḥ tadāsevāyāṃ tadviparītena phalena bhavitavyam / yathā brāhmaṇasya sukhaṃ kṛtvā dharmaḥ duḥkhaṃ kṛtvā adharmaḥ / evaṃ vāgyogavidyasmācchabdāñjānāti tasmād dharmaḥ / śabdajñānaṃ cāpaśabdajñānānuṣaktamevetyāha yo hi śabdān jānāti / arthopapattimāśrityaivaṃ codyate na śabdavyāpāram / bhūyāṃso hyapaśabdāḥ alpīyāṃsaḥ śabdā iti /
analyzed: tasmāt yaḥ viparītaḥ tad āsevāyām tad viparītena phalena bhavitavyam yathā brāhmaṇasya sukham kṛtvā dharmaḥ duḥkham kṛtvā adharmaḥ evam vāc yoga vid yasmāt śabdān jānāti tasmāt dharmaḥ śabda jñānam ca apaśabda jñāna anuṣaktam eva iti āha yaḥ hi śabdān jānāti artha upapattim āśritya evam codyate na śabda vyāpāram bhūyāṃsaḥ hi apaśabdāḥ alpīyāṃsaḥ śabdāḥ iti

original: kathaṃ prakarṣapratyayaḥ? ucyate / paramatāpekṣayā parikalpyaṃ samānaguṇatvam / katham? evaṃ tvaṃ manyethāḥ / yady api vāgyogavidubhayaṃ jānāti tathāpi bahavaḥ śabdās teṣāṃ bahutvāt alpā apaśabdāḥ tadalpatvād alpaḥ pratyavāya iti / etac cāpi na / alpīyāṃsaḥ śabdā iti / apabhraṃśā ye [te] tv apy apratyāyakā bhavanti /
analyzed: katham prakarṣa pratyayaḥ ucyate paramatā apekṣayā parikalpyam samāna guṇa tvam katham evam tvam manyethāḥ yadi api vāc yoga vid ubhayam jānāti tathā api bahavaḥ śabdāḥ teṣām bahu tvāt alpāḥ apaśabdāḥ tad alpa tvāt alpaḥ pratyavāyaḥ iti etat ca api na alpīyāṃsaḥ śabdāḥ iti apabhraṃśāḥ ye te tu api a pratyāyakāḥ bhavanti

original: eṣa eva pakṣo naite 'rthaṃ pratyāyayantīti / ajñānaṃ tasya śaraṇam / kāmam asau dharmeṇa na yujyeta pratyavāyena tu tasyāyogaḥ / tathā tiryagādayaḥ ajñānāt pravartamānā na pratyavāyena yujyante / idaṃ sarvam evam upanyastaṃ jñāne dharmaḥ / prayogas tu jñānasyaivānumānam iti / nātyantāyājñānaṃ śraṇaṃ bhavitum arhati /
analyzed: eṣaḥ eva pakṣaḥ na ete ṛtham pratyāyayanti iti ajñānam tasya śaraṇam kāmam asau dharmeṇa na yujyeta pratyavāyena tu tasya ayogaḥ tathā tiryak ādayaḥ ajñānāt pravartamānāḥ na pratyavāyena yujyante idam sarvam evam upanyastam jñāne dharmaḥ prayogaḥ tu jñānasya eva anumānam iti na atyantāya ajñānam bhavitum arhati

original: na hy ajñānādviṣayaṃ bhakṣitaṃ maraṇāya na prakalpate / tiryagādiṣv evājñānaṃ śaraṇam / na mlecchādīnāṃ brahmahatyādiṣu pravartamānānām iti / evaṃ tarhīti / etad ācaṣṭe / pratyāsatteḥ sāmarthyaṃ balavad iti avāgyogavid abhisaṃbadhyate / tatra vāgyogavit śabdāpaśabdajñaḥ śabdān prayokṣyate nāpaśabdān /
analyzed: na hi ajñānāt viṣayam bhakṣitam maraṇāya na prakalpate tiryak ādiṣu eva ajñānam śaraṇam na mleccha ādīnām brahmahatyā ādiṣu pravartamānānām iti evam tarhi iti etat ācaṣṭe pratyāsatteḥ sāmarthyam balavat iti avāk yoga vid abhisaṃbadhyate tatra vāgyoga vid śabda apaśabda jñaḥ śabdān prayokṣyate na apaśabdān

original: prayogāccābhyudayaḥ pratyavāyo vā, na jñānād iti ayaṃ na śrutāvupanibaddho nāpi smṛtāv ity āha -- kva punar idaṃ paṭhitam iti / bhrājā nāma ślokāḥ / asyābhiprāyaḥ / yo vārthaḥ sa smṛtāv āmnātaḥ tataḥ pramāṇaṃ bhavitum arhatīti / kiṃ ca bhoḥ ślokā api vai pramāṇam / nāyam ekāntena ślokānāmapramāṇyam ācaṣṭe /
analyzed: prayogāt ca abhyudayaḥ pratyavāyaḥ vā na jñānāt iti ayam na śrutau upanibaddhaḥ na api smṛtau iti āha kva punar idam paṭhitam iti bhrājāḥ nāma ślokāḥ asya abhiprāyaḥ yaḥ vā arthaḥ sa smṛtau āmnātaḥ tatas pramāṇam bhavitum arhati iti kim ca bhoḥ ślokāḥ api vai pramāṇam na ayam ekāntena ślokānām apramāṇyam ācaṣṭe

original: bhavanti hi ślokāḥ smṛtyupanibaddhāḥ pramāṇam / evaṃ bhūtās tv apramāṇam / evaṃbhūtānāṃ prāmāṇye sati yaḥ kaścit pramāṇaṃ bhavitum arhati -- yadudumbaravarṇānām iti / ayaṃ hi ślokaḥ sautrāmaṇyā asāmarthyamācaṣṭe / tasmāt sautrāmaṇīṃ hitvā pānāgāraśālāyām eva madyaṃ pātavyam / pramattagīta eṣa tatrabhavataḥ asamāhitacetasa ity arthaḥ /
analyzed: bhavanti hi ślokāḥ smṛti upanibaddhāḥ pramāṇam evam bhūtāḥ tu apramāṇam evaṃbhūtānām prāmāṇye sati yaḥ kaścid pramāṇam bhavitum arhati yat udumbara varṇānām iti ayam hi ślokaḥ sautrāmaṇyāḥ asāmarthyam ācaṣṭe tasmāt sautrāmaṇīm hitvā pāna āgāra śālāyām eva madyam pātavyam pramatta gītaḥ eṣa tatrabhavataḥ asamāhita cetasaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: kathaṃ jñāyate / śrutismṛtivipratiṣedhāt / ayaṃ tvapramattagītaḥ / asti hi smṛtiḥ ekaḥ śabdaḥ samyagjñātaḥ suprayuktaḥ śāstrānvitaḥ svarge loke kāmadhugbhavatīti /
analyzed: katham jñāyate śruti smṛti vipratiṣedhāt ayam tu apramatta gītaḥ asti hi smṛtiḥ ekaḥ śabdaḥ samyak jñātaḥ su prayuktaḥ śāstra anvitaḥ svarge loke kāmadhuk bhavati iti

original: [4.5]	 avidvāṃsaḥ pratyabhivāde ity anenaitat kathayati / vyākaraṇam antareṇa śiṣṭebhyaḥ pṛthakkṛtāḥ strīpakṣe bhavanti na cābhivādayitāraṃ śaknuvantyanugrahītum / pratyabhivādena hy asau saṃskṛto dharmabhāgbhavati svayaṃ cābhyudayena yujyate /
analyzed: a vidvāṃsaḥ pratyabhivāde iti anena etat kathayati vyākaraṇam antareṇa śiṣṭebhyaḥ pṛthakkṛtāḥ strī pakṣe bhavanti na ca abhivādayitāram śaknuvanti anugrahītum pratyabhivādena hi asau saṃskṛtaḥ dharma bhāj bhavati svayam ca abhyudayena yujyate

original: [4.6] prayājāḥ savibhaktikā iti / prayājamantrā ity arthaḥ / yāstāvat prayājaśabdeṣu pratipadaṃ vibhaktayo na tābhiḥ savibhaktikś ity ucyante, nityaṃ saṃnidhānāttāsām / tasmādāmnātādanyacchabdarūpaṃ prajājeṣūpādīyate / kevalāyāśca vibhakter aprayogāt prātipadikaṃ prakṛtir arthagṛhītā /
analyzed: prayājāḥ savibhaktikāḥ iti prayāja mantrāḥ iti arthaḥ yāḥ tāvat prayāja śabdeṣu pratipadam vibhaktayaḥ na tābhiḥ iti ucyante nityam saṃnidhānāt tāsām tasmāt āmnātāt anyat śabda rūpam prajājeṣu upādīyate kevalāyāḥ ca vibhakteḥ a prayogāt prātipadikam prakṛtiḥ artha gṛhītā

original: tatrāpi tvamagne prayājānuyājānāṃ purastāt tvaṃ paścād iti darśanād arthāntaravṛtti śrutyantaraṃ nopādīyate / vibhaktīnām api sarvāsāṃ prayoge prāpte yā dvyakṣarā vā satyaścaturakṣarā vā bhavantīti vacanād agnināgnineti na prayujyate / tathā na śabdajāmi kuryāt / śabdajāmi hi tad bhavati yat pañcamyantam /
analyzed: tatra api tvam agne prayāja anuyājānām purastāt tvam paścāt iti darśanāt artha antara vṛtti śruti antaram na upādīyate vibhaktīnām api sarvāsām prayoge prāpte yāḥ dvi akṣarāḥ vā satyaḥ catur akṣarāḥ vā bhavanti iti vacanāt agninā agninā iti na prayujyate tathā na śabda jāmi kuryāt śabda jāmi hi tat bhavati yat pañcamī antam

original: tasmādagneragner ity anena rūpeṇa ṣaṣṭhyantaṃ prayujyate / punarādheye prayājānuyājānāṃ purastādvopariṣṭād [vā] vibhaktīḥ kuryāt / narāṃśaso agnimagnim iti vā ubhayathā dṛṣṭatvāt / samidhaḥ samidho 'gne 'gna iti saṃdhirdṛṣṭaḥ / il@o agnināgna iti vivṛttir dṛṣṭeti bahvṛcasūtrabhāṣye /
analyzed: tasmāt agneḥ agneḥ iti anena rūpeṇa ṣaṣṭhī antam prayujyate punarādheye prayāja anuyājānām purastāt vā upariṣṭāt vā vibhaktīḥ kuryāt nara aṃśasaḥ agnim agnim iti vai ubhayathā dṛṣṭa tvāt samidhaḥ samidhaḥ gne gne iti saṃdhiḥ dṛṣṭaḥ ilaḥ agninā agne iti vivṛttiḥ dṛṣṭā iti bahvṛca sūtra bhāṣye

original: āśvalāyanasūtre ye yajāmahe samidhaḥ samidho agnim agna ājyasya hiviṣo vetu / il@o 'gnināgna ājyasya hiviṣo vyantu / bahirragniragna ājyasya haviṣo vetu / āpastambasūtre agnāgne 'gnāv agne 'gnināgne 'gnim agna iti caturṣu prayājeṣv iti vibhaktaya uktāḥ / agnā iti yathāmnāt yathāmnāt uttamaḥ prayājaḥ / tasyopariṣṭāt [na] kriyate vibhaktiḥ /
analyzed: āśvalāyana sūtre ye yajāmahe samidhaḥ samidhaḥ agnim agne ājyasya hiviṣaḥ vetu ilaḥ gninā agne ājyasya hiviṣaḥ vyantu bahir agniḥ agne ājyasya haviṣaḥ vetu āpastamba sūtre agnā agne gnau agne gninā agne gnim agne iti caturṣu prayājeṣu iti vibhaktayaḥ uktāḥ agne iti yathāmnāt yathāmnāt uttamaḥ prayājaḥ tasya upariṣṭāt na kriyate vibhaktiḥ

original: vikṛtāvapyavibhaktiḥ kriyate tadā / tadyathā / ye yajāmahe svāhāgniṃ svāhā somam / agnihotraṃ svāhā agnīṣomau svāhā devā ājyapā juṣaṇā agna ājyasya haviṣo vyantu iti / eteṣu prayājeṣu savibhaktikeṣu kartavyeṣu vaiyākaraṇo vibhaktyantān samyaguccārayet / tasmādevamarthamadhyeyaṃ vyākaraṇam //
analyzed: vikṛtau api avibhaktiḥ kriyate tadā tat yathā ye yajāmahe svāhā agnim svāhā somam agnihotram svāhā agnīṣomau svāhā devāḥ ājya pāḥ juṣaṇāḥ agne ājyasya haviṣaḥ vyantu iti eteṣu prayājeṣu savibhaktikeṣu kartavyeṣu vaiyākaraṇaḥ vibhakti antān samyak uccārayet tasmāt evam artham adhyeyam vyākaraṇam

original: [4.7]	 sa ārtvijīna iti / yaśca ṛtvijamarhati yaś ca ṛtvikkarmobhāvapyārtvijīnau vidvāneva yājayatīti / [na] avidvāṃso 'nadhikārāt / brāhmaṇasya vyākaraṇamantareṇa yajamānatvaṃ yājakatvaṃ vā na saṃbhavatīti protsāhyate //
analyzed: saḥ ārtvijīnaḥ iti yaḥ ca ṛtvijam arhati yaḥ ca ṛtvij karma ubhau api ārtvijīnau vidvān eva yājayati iti na a vidvāṃsaḥ nadhikārāt brāhmaṇasya vyākaraṇam antareṇa yajamāna tvam yājaka tvam vā na saṃbhavati iti protsāhyate

original: [4.8.1] catvāri padajātāni yāni tāni asya śṛṅgāṇīva / karmapravacanīyā nipāteṣv antarbhūtā iti catvāry ucyante / anyeṣāṃ dve padajāte nāmākhyātaṃ ca / trayaḥ kālāḥ abhidhāyāḥ śabdasya prayujyate prayokṣyate prāyojīti / abhidhānasya vā bhavati bhaviṣyati abhūd iti / dvau śabdātmanau nityaḥ kāryaśceti /
analyzed: catvāri pada jātāni yāni tāni asya śṛṅgāṇi iva karmapravacanīyāḥ nipāteṣu antarbhūtāḥ iti catvāri ucyante anyeṣām dve pada jāte nāma ākhyātam ca trayaḥ kālāḥ abhidhāyāḥ śabdasya prayujyate prayokṣyate prāyoji iti abhidhānasya vā bhavati bhaviṣyati abhūt iti dvau śabda ātmanau nityaḥ kāryaḥ ca iti

original: kaiścinnityo 'yam iti dṛṣṭaḥ kaiścidanitya iti / atha vā jātir vyaktiśceti / atha vā sphoṭo dhvaniśca / saptavibhaktayaḥ svādayaḥ / atha vā saha śeṣeṇa kārakāṇi sapta vibhaktayo na tu kārakaḥ śeṣe 'py aṣṭamaḥ saṃbhavati /
analyzed: kaiścid nityaḥ yam iti dṛṣṭaḥ kaiścid anityaḥ iti atha vā jātiḥ vyaktiḥ ca iti atha vā sphoṭaḥ dhvaniḥ ca sapta vibhaktayaḥ su ādayaḥ atha vā saha śeṣeṇa kārakāṇi sapta vibhaktayaḥ na tu kārakaḥ śeṣe pi aṣṭamaḥ saṃbhavati

original: [4.8.2] na iṅgayantīti / na duryanti / na nimiṣanti na ceṣṭanta iti / sāyujyādimabhedenopādānam / manīṣiṇo ye taiḥ saha sāmyaṃ gacchemeti / te 'pi hi śāstrādevemāṃ kāṣṭhāṃ prāptāḥ //
analyzed: na iṅgayanti iti na nimiṣanti na ceṣṭante iti sāyujya ādima bhedena upādānam manīṣiṇaḥ ye taiḥ saha sāmyam gacchema iti te hi śāstrāt eva imām kāṣṭhām prāptāḥ

original: [5] kiṃ punar idam iti / nātra śiṣyācāryācāryadeśīyāḥ pratipattavyāḥ / granthakāra evemaṃ granthaṃ vibhajate na punaranyad api kiṃcit / sati hi prayojanākhyāne evaṃ pratipadyeta protsāhye 'ham anena prakāreṇa / naitāni santi prayojanāni / atha vā vyākhyāyate kim iti niṣprayojanaṃ śramakaramadhyeṣye iti naivādhīyīta / om ity uktvā /

original: etadācaṣṭe / yasyām avasthāyām asau vyākaraṇamadhyāpyate tasmām asau paripraśnāsamartha eva bhavati / kutaḥ prayojanāni pravakṣyati / tatra sthānakaraṇānupradānajñebhya iti / purākalpe sthānakaraṇādīn vyākaraṇād eva pratipadyate / tato vaidikāḥ śabdā upadiśyante / tatra vedādhyayane prayojanapraśnaḥ syāt /
analyzed: etat ācaṣṭe yasyām avasthāyām asau vyākaraṇam adhyāpyate tasmām asau paripraśna asamarthaḥ eva bhavati kutas prayojanāni pravakṣyati tatra sthāna karaṇa anupradāna jñebhyaḥ iti purākalpe sthāna karaṇa ādīn vyākaraṇāt eva pratipadyate tatas vaidikāḥ śabdāḥ upadiśyante tatra veda adhyayane prayojana praśnaḥ syāt

original: tasyāpi prayojanamākhyāyate, vedāṅgam api vyākaraṇamavaśyamadhyetavyam iti / tadadyatve na tathā /  adyatva iti nipāto 'smin kāla ity anena samānārthaḥ adyatve hi bālā evānadhigatavyākaraṇā vedamadhyāpyante / vedo avijñātasthānakaraṇānupradāna eva / vedam adhītya tvaritā vaktāro bhavanti / tvaritā iti /
analyzed: tasya api prayojanam ākhyāyate vedāṅgam api vyākaraṇam avaśyam adhyetavyam iti tat adyatve na tathā adyatve iti nipātaḥ smin kāle iti anena samāna arthaḥ adyatve hi bālāḥ eva anadhigata vyākaraṇāḥ vedam adhyāpyante vedaḥ avijñāta sthāna karaṇa anupradānaḥ eva vedam adhītya tvaritāḥ vaktāraḥ bhavanti tvaritāḥ iti

original: dhanopādāne vā turitā bhavanti bhogopabhoge vā / atha vā punaradhyāyāntare pāratantryakaraṇo niyogo mā bhūd iti tvaritā idam āhur vedādhyayanasamakālameveti //
analyzed: dhana upādāne vā turitāḥ bhavanti bhoga upabhoge vā atha vā punar adhyāya antare pāratantrya karaṇaḥ niyogaḥ mā bhūt iti tvaritāḥ idam āhuḥ veda adhyayana sama kālam eva iti

original: [6.1]	 uktaḥ śabdaḥ / svabhāvo 'py asya vyākhyātaḥ dhavaniḥ śabda iti / rakṣādīny api prayojanānyuktāni / śabdānuśāsanam idānīṃ kartavyam ākhyātavyaṃ prastotavyam ity arthaḥ / tat kathaṃ kartavyam ityākhyātavyaṃ nirdarśayati / ya ācaṣṭe tena kathaṃ kartavyam iti / kiṃ śabdopadeśo 'paśabdopadeśa ubhayaśabdopadeśa iti /
analyzed: uktaḥ śabdaḥ svabhāvaḥ api asya vyākhyātaḥ dhavaniḥ śabdaḥ iti rakṣā ādīni api prayojanāni uktāni śabda anuśāsanam idānīm kartavyam ākhyātavyam prastotavyam iti arthaḥ tat katham kartavyam iti ākhyātavyam nirdarśayati yaḥ ācaṣṭe tena katham kartavyam iti kim śabda upadeśaḥ upaśabda upadeśaḥ ubhaya śabda upadeśaḥ iti

original: svalakṣaṇena paralakṣaṇābhāvena yadākhyāyate tadvispaṣṭataraṃ bhavatīty ubhayopadeśakaraṇasyopādānam / yady api vispaṣṭataraṃ bhavati atigauravaṃ tu śāstrasyeti svalakṣaṇenaivānuśāsanaṃ parigṛhṇāti / anyataropādānena kṛtī śabdāpaśabdayor ity arthaḥ / yadi hy ubhayopadeśo 'pi parigṛhītaḥ syāt tamameva kuryāt anyatamopadeśeneti / tadyathā /
analyzed: sva lakṣaṇena para lakṣaṇa abhāvena yat ākhyāyate tat vispaṣṭataram bhavati iti ubhaya upadeśa karaṇasya upādānam yadi api vispaṣṭataram bhavati ati gauravam tu śāstrasya iti sva lakṣaṇena eva anuśāsanam parigṛhṇāti anyatara upādānena kṛtī śabda apaśabdayoḥ iti arthaḥ yadi hi parigṛhītaḥ syāt tamam eva kuryāt anyatama upadeśena iti tat yathā

original: bhakṣyaniyamenābhakṣyapratiṣedho gamyate / bhakṣyābhakṣyaprakaraṇe idaṃ śrūyate pañca pañcanakhā bhakṣyā iti / prakaraṇād anyasya pañcanakhasya nivṛttiḥ / atha vārthitvād bubhukṣāprayuktaṃ bhakṣaṇaṃ sarvaviṣayam aśabdakaṃ pravṛttam / tatredaṃ vacanaṃ pañca pañcanakhā bhakṣyā iti /
analyzed: bhakṣya niyamena abhakṣya pratiṣedhaḥ gamyate bhakṣya abhakṣya prakaraṇe idam śrūyate pañca pañcanakhāḥ bhakṣyāḥ iti prakaraṇāt anyasya pañcanakhasya nivṛttiḥ atha vā arthi tvāt bubhukṣā prayuktam bhakṣaṇam sarva viṣayam aśabdakam pravṛttam tatra idam vacanam pañca pañcanakhāḥ bhakṣyāḥ iti

original: tadyadyanena pañca pañcanakhā bhakṣyā ity etat pratipādyeta yadahareva na bhakṣayati tadaharevāyaṃ vihitākaraṇāt pratyaveyāt / ye ca śalyakādibhyo 'nye pañcanakhāsteṣāṃ ca bhakṣaṇaṃ hyanimittaprayuktam avyāvṛttam eva syāt / tad eva bhakṣaṇaṃ paurastyam arthitve sati pravṛttaṃ tadeva pañcasu pañcanakheṣūpadiśyate /
analyzed: tat yadi anena pañca pañcanakhāḥ bhakṣyāḥ iti etat pratipādyeta yat ahar eva na bhakṣayati tat ahar eva ayam vihita akaraṇāt pratyaveyāt ye ca śalyaka ādibhyaḥ nye pañcanakhāḥ teṣām ca bhakṣaṇam hi animitta prayuktam a vyāvṛttam eva syāt tat eva bhakṣaṇam paurastyam arthi tve sati pravṛttam tat eva pañcasu pañcanakheṣu upadiśyate

original: kṣutpratīghāta etair eva kartavyo nānyair iti / iyati śabdavyāpāre pañcanakhāntarāṇāṃ nivṛttiḥ / asau na śabdavatī / kiṃ tarhi ? sāmarthyalakṣaṇā /
analyzed: kṣudh pratīghātaḥ etaiḥ eva kartavyaḥ na anyaiḥ iti iyati śabda vyāpāre pañcanakha antarāṇām nivṛttiḥ asau na śabdavatī kim tarhi sāmarthya lakṣaṇā

original: evaṃ ca sati vrata ityetasmin sūtre aśrāddhabhojītyatra yaducyate yadi yo 'śrāddhaṃ bhuṅkte 'sāvaśrāddhabhojī yadaharevāsāvaśrāddhaṃ na bhuṅkte tadāsya vratalopa it atrāpi śrāddhabhojanam arthāt prasaktam / tata idam ucyate śrāddhaṃ na bhoktavyam iti / paurastyasyaiva śrāddhabhojanasyārthāt prasaktasya nivṛttiḥ kriyate /
analyzed: evam ca sati vrate iti etasmin sūtre aśrāddha bhojī iti atra yat ucyate yadi śrāddham bhuṅkte saḥ aśrāddha bhojī yat ahar eva asau aśrāddham na bhuṅkte tadā asya vrata lopaḥ atra api śrāddha bhojanam arthāt prasaktam tatas idam ucyate śrāddham na bhoktavyam iti paurastyasya eva śrāddha bhojanasya arthāt prasaktasya nivṛttiḥ kriyate

original: bhuñjānaḥ śrāddhaṃ mā bhuṅkṣveti / paurastyasyaiva śrāddhabhojanasya vidhānasāmarthyāt vinivartamānaṃ śrāddhabhojanam iti kuto vratalopaḥ / evamarthapratyāyanaṃ prati śabdāpaśabdayoḥ pravṛttau satyāṃ śabdopadeśenāpaśabdanivṛttir iti vyaktam / abhakṣyapratiṣedhena vā bhakṣyaniyamaḥ / abhakṣyo grāmyakukkuṭaḥ ityarthamukhyaḥ pratiṣedha iti /
analyzed: bhuñjānaḥ śrāddham mā bhuṅkṣva iti paurastyasya eva śrāddha bhojanasya vidhāna sāmarthyāt vinivartamānam śrāddha bhojanam iti kutas vrata lopaḥ evam artha pratyāyanam prati śabda apaśabdayoḥ pravṛttau satyām śabda upadeśena apaśabda nivṛttiḥ iti vyaktam abhakṣya pratiṣedhena vā bhakṣya niyamaḥ abhakṣyaḥ grāmya kukkuṭaḥ iti artha mukhyaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ iti

original: na hy atra prāptyanumānabādhā / kiṃ tarhi ? bādhaiveyam / evam ihāpy apaśabdopadeśena gāvyādibhyaścānyaḥ śabdo gaur iti pratipadyate / kiṃ punar atra jyāyaḥ / ubhayopadeśāt guror laghutvāt praśasyatvam anubhūya mithaḥspardhāyāṃ prakarṣapratyayena saṃbadhyate / iṣṭānvākhyānaṃ khalv api bhavati / kathaṃ śabdopadeśa iṣṭānvākhyānam / ucyate /
analyzed: na hi atra prāpti anumāna bādhā kim tarhi bādhā eva iyam evam iha api apaśabda upadeśena gāvī ādibhyaḥ ca anyaḥ śabdaḥ gauḥ iti pratipadyate kim punar atra jyāyaḥ ubhaya upadeśāt guroḥ laghu tvāt praśasya tvam anubhūya mithas spardhāyām prakarṣa pratyayena saṃbadhyate iṣṭa anvākhyānam khalu api bhavati katham śabda upadeśaḥ iṣṭa anvākhyānam ucyate

original: yathāmnāye śabdānām sa dharma evam eṣām api dharmārthatvād idam ucyata iṣṭānvākhyānam iti / atha vāpaśabdeṣūpadiśyamāneṣu ānumānikī pratipattir ayaṃ śabdas te ityānumānikyāṃ ca pratipattau parikalpasyānantyāt kiṃ gaur ity eṣa gāvyādibhyo 'nyaḥ śabdaḥ āhosvid anya ity etat durjñānam eva bhavatīti naivedam anvākhyānaṃ syād iti /
analyzed: yathāmnāye śabdānām sa dharmaḥ evam eṣām api dharma artha tvāt idam ucyate iṣṭa anvākhyānam iti atha vāpa śabdeṣu upadiśyamāneṣu ānumānikī pratipattiḥ ayam śabdaḥ te iti ānumānikyām ca pratipattau parikalpasya ānantyāt kim gauḥ iti eṣa gāvī ādibhyaḥ nyaḥ śabdaḥ āhosvit anyaḥ iti etat durjñānam eva bhavati iti na eva idam anvākhyānam syāt iti

original: [6.2] athaitasmin śabdopadeśe sati / asmin kāle pratipadapāṭham eva sukaraṃ manyante / na hy atra kiṃcit smartavyaṃ lakṣaṇam / kevalaṃ śabdā evoccārayitavyāḥ / prakṛtyādyupadeśe hi sati cirakālasaṃpratipattir iti / pratipadapāṭha iti / svarūpeṇa yaduccāraṇaṃ sa pratipadapāṭhaḥ / yenārthaḥ paricchidyate tat padam / anabhyupāya iti /
analyzed: atha etasmin śabda upadeśe sati asmin kāle pratipad pāṭham eva sukaram manyante na hi atra kiṃcid smartavyam lakṣaṇam kevalam śabdāḥ eva uccārayitavyāḥ prakṛti ādi upadeśe hi sati cira kāla saṃpratipattiḥ iti pratipad pāṭhaḥ iti svarūpeṇa yat uccāraṇam sa pratipad pāṭhaḥ yena arthaḥ paricchidyate tat padam anabhyupāyaḥ iti

original: upāyaśabdaparyāyavācyevāyam abhyupāyaśabdaḥ / evaṃ hi śrūyate / bṛhaspatir indrāyeti / arthavādo 'yaṃ pratipadapāṭhasya nivṛttaye upādīyate / īdṛśo vaktā īdṛśaḥ śrotā iyatā kālena nāntaṃ gataḥ / kiṃ punaradyatva iti / śabdānāṃ śabdapārāyaṇam iti / rūḍhiśabdo 'yaṃ kasyacit granthasya vācakaḥ / yathā śirorogaḥ kukṣiṃ bādhate iti /
analyzed: upāya śabda paryāya vācī iva ayam abhyupāya śabdaḥ evam hi śrūyate bṛhaspatiḥ indrāya iti arthavādaḥ yam pratipada pāṭhasya nivṛttaye upādīyate īdṛśaḥ vaktā īdṛśaḥ śrotā iyatā kālena na antam gataḥ kim punar adya tve iti śabdānām śabda pārāyaṇam iti rūḍhi śabdaḥ yam kasyacid granthasya vācakaḥ yathā śiraḥ rogaḥ kukṣim bādhate iti

original: śirorogaśabdaḥ kukṣirogasya vyādhiviśeṣasya rūḍhiḥ / sa śiraḥ kṛtsnaṃ ca kukṣiṃ bādhata iti / evaṃ śabdapārāyaṇaṃ nāma granthaḥ / śabdānāṃ provāceti / caturbhiś ca prakārair vidyopayuktopayuktā bhavati / ardhopayuktāpi satyanupayuktā bhavati niṣphalatvāt / atha vā loke ekadeśopayogād apy upayuktam iti gamyate / tadyathopayuktaṃ ghṛtam iti /
analyzed: śiraḥ roga śabdaḥ kukṣi rogasya vyādhi viśeṣasya rūḍhiḥ sa śiraḥ kṛtsnam ca kukṣim bādhate iti evam śabdapārāyaṇam nāma granthaḥ śabdānām provāca iti caturbhiḥ ca prakāraiḥ vidyā upayuktā upayuktā bhavati ardha upayuktā api satī anupayuktā bhavati niṣphala tvāt atha vā loke eka deśa upayogāt api upayuktam iti gamyate tat yathā upayuktam ghṛtam iti

original: evam idaṃ naikadeśopayogād upayuktam iti / kiṃ tarhi ? samudāyopayogād upayuktam ity eva kathayati / āgamakālo grahaṇakālaḥ / svādhyāyakālaḥ kālo 'bhyāsasya / pravacanakālaḥ śiṣyebhyaḥ saṃpradātavyaḥ / vyavahārakālo yājñe karmaṇi viniyogaḥ śiṣṭamadhye vā yo viniścayaḥ / kiṃcit sāmānyaviśeṣabat lakṣaṇaṃ pravartyam /
analyzed: evam idam na eka deśa upayogāt upayuktam iti kim tarhi samudāya upayogāt upayuktam iti eva kathayati āgama kālaḥ grahaṇa kālaḥ svādhyāya kālaḥ kālaḥ bhyāsasya pravacana kālaḥ śiṣyebhyaḥ saṃpradātavyaḥ vyavahāra kālaḥ yājñe karmaṇi viniyogaḥ śiṣṭa madhye vā yaḥ viniścayaḥ kiṃcid sāmānya viśeṣa bat lakṣaṇam pravartyam

original: sāmānyaviśeṣau yasmiṃstat sāmānyaviśeṣavat / yathā karmaṇy aṇ iti / dhātor ity etat sāmānyam asmin lakṣaṇe 'sti / āto 'nupasarge ka ity asmiṃś cāta iti viśeṣo 'sti / anena cālpena yatnena mahato mahataḥ śabdaughān pratipadyate / kumbhakāraḥ kāṇḍalāva ityevamādi / evaṃ pārṣṇitro goda ityevamādīn / evaṃ sarvatra yojyam /
analyzed: sāmānya viśeṣau yasmin tat sāmānya viśeṣavat yathā karmaṇi aṇ iti dhātoḥ iti etat sāmānyam asmin lakṣaṇe sti ā taḥ n upasarge kaḥ iti asmin ca a taḥ iti viśeṣaḥ sti anena ca alpena yatnena mahataḥ mahataḥ śabda oghān pratipadyate kumbhakāraḥ kāṇḍalāvaḥ iti evamādi evam pārṣṇitraḥ godaḥ iti evamādīn evam sarvatra yojyam

original: evaṃ pacatiśabde yā adhiśrayaṇādikriyās tāsāṃ yāni pratyarthaniyatāni sāmānyānyadhiśrayaṇādīni taiḥ sahaikārthasamavāyiyat sarvaviṣayaṃ sāmānyam abhivyajyate tat pacatiśabdavācyam / yathā bhramaṇatvam anekakarmaviṣayaṃ bhramaṇam ity ucyate / evaṃ ḍitthe 'pi yadutpattiprabhṛtyā vināśāt eva tad bhavaty ayaṃ ḍittho 'yaṃ ḍittha iti /

original: bālyakaumārayauvanasthāvireṣv abhinnaḥ sa evāyam iti saṃpratyayaḥ sā ākṛtiḥ śabdavācyā / mugdhe 'pi ca saṃpratyayo bhavati ḍittho 'yaṃ likhyata iti / tasmāt sāmānyam atrāpy asti / yo vā saṃniveśaviśeṣaḥ saṃyogaviśeṣaṇaṃ ca hastyādiṣv iva sākṛtir eva / asya tu dravyābhidhānaṃ guṇakalpanayā jātitvam āpāditasya tacchabdenābhidhānāt /

original: dravyapadārthikasya tu dravyam ucyate / jātyādayas tu bhedakā dravyasya sattvaṃ vaktum / upādhibhūtās te śabdasyeti / tatraikeṣāṃ mādhuryādayo 'tyantamanabhidhīyamānā guḍādibhiḥ śabdaiḥ tānarthān [sajante] iti / evaṃ gotvādayo 'pi / asyāpi jātyabhidhānaṃ gauṇam / dravyatāmāpāditā jātistacchabdenābhidhīyate / tatra vājapyāyanadarśanam /
analyzed: dravya padārthikasya tu dravyam ucyate jāti ādayaḥ tu bhedakāḥ dravyasya sattvam vaktum upādhi bhūtāḥ te śabdasya iti tatra ekeṣām mādhurya ādayaḥ tyantam anabhidhīyamānāḥ guḍa ādibhiḥ śabdaiḥ tān arthān sajante iti evam go tva ādayaḥ asya api jāti abhidhānam gauṇam dravya tām āpāditā jātiḥ tad śabdena abhidhīyate tatra vājapyāyana darśanam

original: pāṇineḥ sarvatrākṛter bhāvāt sakṛd gatau vipratiṣedhabādhanaṃ śabdāntaraprāptiś ca nopapadyate / atha dravyam eva padārthaḥ, evam api sarvāsāṃ vyaktīnāṃ sarvābhiścodanābhir aṅgīkaraṇād utsargāpavādā na prakalpante / vyavasthitavibhāṣāś ca na prakalpante / ubhayam ity āha / vyaktirākṛtiś ca padārthaparair laukikaiḥ prayujyete /
analyzed: pāṇineḥ sarvatra ākṛteḥ bhāvāt sakṛt gatau vipratiṣedha bādhanam śabda antara prāptiḥ ca na upapadyate atha dravyam eva padārthaḥ evam api sarvāsām vyaktīnām sarvābhiḥ codanābhiḥ aṅgīkaraṇāt utsarga apavādāḥ na prakalpante vyavasthita vibhāṣāḥ ca na prakalpante ubhayam iti āha vyaktiḥ ākṛtiḥ ca padārtha paraiḥ laukikaiḥ prayujyete

original: ye ca śāstre upadeśaśabdās teṣu kaścijjātim abhidadhāti kaścid dravyam / evaṃ ca sati na kaścid gauṇaḥ padārtho 'sya / yo jātiśabdas tasya jātir evārtho yo dravyaśabdas tasya dravyam evārtha iti / upadeśaśabdeṣv api lakṣyavaśād icchātaḥ padārthāśrayaṇe sarve śāstre prakriyābhedā darśanabhedāś copapadyante / ubhayathā ācāryeṇa iti / atra codyate /
analyzed: ye ca śāstre upadeśa śabdāḥ teṣu kaścid jātim abhidadhāti kaścid dravyam evam ca sati na kaścid gauṇaḥ yaḥ jāti śabdaḥ tasya jātiḥ eva arthaḥ yaḥ dravya śabdaḥ tasya dravyam eva arthaḥ iti upadeśa śabdeṣu api lakṣya vaśāt icchātaḥ padārtha āśrayaṇe sarve śāstre prakriyā bhedāḥ darśana bhedāḥ ca upapadyante ubhayathā ācāryeṇa iti atra codyate

original: nanu ubhayapadārthikasya dravye padārthe bahuṣu bahuvacanaṃ siddham / ekenānekābhidhānaṃ jātau padārthe / satyam evaṃ matam / yadā tu kasyāścit kriyāyā upadeśe vā pratiṣedhe vā jātir eva prakaraṇe vā jāteḥ śabda upādīyate tadā tasyā ekatvād aprāptaṃ bahuṣu bahuvacanamārabhyate /
analyzed: nanu ubhaya padārthikasya dravye padārthe bahuṣu bahuvacanam siddham ekena aneka abhidhānam jātau padārthe satyam evam matam yadā tu kasyāścid kriyāyāḥ upadeśe vā pratiṣedhe vā jātiḥ eva prakaraṇe vā jāteḥ śabdaḥ upādīyate tadā tasyāḥ eka tvāt aprāptam bahuṣu bahuvacanam ārabhyate

original: evaṃ yadā dravyavivakṣā bhavati tasya ca prakaraṇaṃ tadā vākya iva sarupāṇāṃ plakṣanyagrodhadhavakhadirapalāśā ityanekaśabdatve prasakte vṛkṣavṛkṣavṛkṣa ityekaśabdatvāya yatnaḥ kriyate / aparaḥ prakāro 'tra vakṣyate / iha śuklavāsāḥ kriyatām ity atra śuklavāsastvam eva kriyamāṇaṃ dravyam [akriyamāṇam /

original: śuklavāsasamānayety atra kriyamāṇaṃ dravyam] akriyamāṇas tu tadā saṃbandhaḥ / iha tu śuklavāsaḥ śuklavāsasamānayetyupalakṣaṇam api kriyāyām antarbhavati / parigṛhītopalakṣaṇo hi vyāpriyate tadvattvāt / iha tu yaḥ śuklavāsā dṛṣṭaḥ sa ānīyatām iti tadvataḥ kevalaṃ bhedake vāsasī na tu tayos tatra kriyāyām antarbhāvaḥ /

original: [8.1]	 kiṃ punar niryaḥ śabda āhosvit kārya iti / atrāpi vipratipattiḥ / vedavidāṃ nityo 'nyeṣām anityaḥ / atha vāyam arthaḥ / nityā eva te śabdā gaurīty evamādayaḥ / yeṣāṃ tu ākṛtir lakṣaṇam utpādyavastv evedam / samayo 'yaṃ vācikair vṛtaḥ / kecid evaṃ manyante / ya evaite prākṛtāḥ śabdāḥ ta evaite nityāḥ / prakṛtau bhavāḥ prākṛtāḥ /
analyzed: kim punar niryaḥ śabdaḥ āhosvit kāryaḥ iti atra api vipratipattiḥ veda vidām nityaḥ nyeṣām anityaḥ atha vā ayam arthaḥ nityāḥ eva te śabdāḥ gaurī iti evamādayaḥ yeṣām tu ākṛtiḥ lakṣaṇam utpādya vastu eva idam samayaḥ yam vācikaiḥ vṛtaḥ kecid evam manyante ye eva ete prākṛtāḥ śabdāḥ te eva ete nityāḥ prakṛtau bhavāḥ prākṛtāḥ

original: varāho himavān varāhaḥ pāriyātra iti / tatra yataiva varāhaśabdaḥ paryāyaḥ san śabdāntaropasaṃhitaḥ prayujyate viśeṣapratipattyartham evaṃ nityaviśeṣapratipattyarthaṃ pṛthivyādīnām upādānam iti na virudhyate paryāyaśabdatvam / śuklaśabdas tu paryāyo bhūtvā pravartate śuklavastram iti / siddhā dyauḥ siddhā pṛthivī siddham ākāśam iti /
analyzed: varāhaḥ himavān varāhaḥ pāriyātraḥ iti tatra yatā eva varāha śabdaḥ paryāyaḥ san śabda antara upasaṃhitaḥ prayujyate viśeṣa pratipatti artham evam nitya viśeṣa pratipatti artham pṛthivī ādīnām upādānam iti na virudhyate paryāya śabda tvam śukla śabdaḥ tu paryāyaḥ bhūtvā pravartate śukla vastram iti siddhā dyauḥ siddhā pṛthivī siddham ākāśam iti

original: tatra kiṃ vā tanniṣpattirūpam āśritya siddhaśabdo nityeṣu upasaṃhriyate / yadi niṣpattirūpam āśrīyate kāryeṣv api niṣpattirūpam astīti nāsti siddhaśabdāt nirṇayaḥ / prathamato manyase saty api niṣpattirūpe tad āśrīyate / kiṃ tarhi / rūḍhir eva / tad yathā gaṅgā hi rūpeṇāśritā tannāmikāṇam utpādayati gāṅga iti /

original: kāryaśabdasaṃnidhāne prayogāt siddhaśabdo nityasyārthavṛttiḥ / tathā na / kiṃ tarhi / kāryo na kāryaḥ siddha iti / kāryatvapratiṣedhāt siddhatvāpratiṣedhāc ca niścitaṃ saṃgrahe nityaparyāyavācinaḥ (°num) / ihāpi tad eva / kutaḥ / saṃgraho 'py asyaiva śāstrasyaikadeśaḥ tatraikatantratvād vyāḍeś ca prāmāṇyād ihāpi tathaiva siddhaśabda upāttaḥ /

original: tau cānupalabhya smartur bhagavato 'sya pāṇiner ubhayaṃ padārtha ity eṣa siddhāntaḥ / tatrobhayasmin api padārthe arthasya nityatā na vyāvartata iti na śakyate 'syā bhāvābhāvau kalpayitum / evaṃ pradhānātmany avasthitam asaṃvedyaṃ nāstitvāt pracyavate / dravyāntarasthopalabhyate / dravyāntarasthābhivyajyate /
analyzed: tau ca an upalabhya smartuḥ bhagavataḥ sya pāṇineḥ ubhayam padārthaḥ iti eṣa siddhāntaḥ tatra ubhayasmin api padārthe arthasya nitya tā na vyāvartate iti na śakyate syāḥ bhāva abhāvau kalpayitum evam pradhāna ātmani avasthitam asaṃvedyam nāstitvāt pracyavate dravya antara sthā upalabhyate dravya antara sthā abhivyajyate

original: tatra tattvānyatvaprakhyayor avikalayor ekasmin āśraye virodhādākṛter ekatvam avināśo 'sti ity avakalpante / athāpi yathopanyas taṃ darśanam / atrāpy ananyatvāt yākṛtir iti tad eva dravyam ucyate bhavatā / naivam / yadi dravyaṃ nityaṃ ākṛtir api nityā / atha vedam api darśanam / ekam api tāvad virūpaṃ sarvam /
analyzed: tatra tattva anyatva prakhyayoḥ avikalayoḥ ekasmin āśraye virodhāt ākṛteḥ ekatvam sti iti avakalpante atha api darśanam atra api ananyatvāt yā ākṛtiḥ iti tat eva dravyam ucyate bhavatā na evam yadi dravyam nityam ākṛtiḥ api nityā atha vā idam api darśanam ekam api tāvat virūpam sarvam

original: śaktīnāṃ samudāye kācit tu śaktiḥ kadācit tirobhavati kadācit āvirbhavatīti / tathā śabdaḥ pravartate /
analyzed: śaktīnām samudāye kācid tu śaktiḥ kadācid tirobhavati kadācid āvirbhavati iti tathā śabdaḥ pravartate

original: [9.4]	 atha vā nedam eva nityalakṣaṇaṃ dhruvaṃ kūṭastham avicālīti / anena granthena trividhām anityatām āha / trividhā hy anityatā / saṃsargānityatā vipariṇām anityatā vastuvināśānityatā ca / ato viparyayeṇa nityatā /
analyzed: atha vā na idam eva nitya lakṣaṇam dhruvam kūṭastham avicāli iti anena granthena trividhām anitya tām āha trividhā hi anitya tā saṃsarga anitya tā vipariṇām anitya tā vastu vināśa anitya tā ca atas viparyayeṇa nitya tā

original: saṃsargānityatā yathā sphaṭikasyopāśrayaviśeṣaiḥ saṃsargibhir dravyāntaraiḥ pracchāditaṃ svarūpaṃ nopalabhyate svataḥ sac ca tad api / tathā vipariṇāmānityatā yathā badarasya śyāmatātirobhāve raktatāprādurbhāvena / vastuvināśānityatā yaḥ sarveṇa sarvapradhvaṃso nirūpākhye / tadā naitat pratipattavyaṃ yadaivaite dharmā na santi / tan nityam iti /
analyzed: saṃsarga anitya tā yathā sphaṭikasya upāśraya viśeṣaiḥ saṃsargibhiḥ dravya antaraiḥ pracchāditam sva rūpam na upalabhyate svatas sat ca tat api tathā vipariṇāma anitya tā yathā badarasya śyāma tā tirobhāve rakta tā prādurbhāvena vastu vināśa anitya tā yaḥ sarveṇa sarva pradhvaṃsaḥ nirūpākhye tadā na etat pratipattavyam yadā eva ete dharmāḥ na santi tat nityam iti

original: evaṃ hi parikalpyamāne sāṃkhyasyaiva ātmāvikāritvanityaḥ syāt / pradhānaṃ tu vikāradharmi ity anityatvaprasaṅgaḥ / tasmād idam api nityalakṣaṇaṃ yasmiṃs tattvaṃ na vihanyate tan nityam iti / sa evāyam iti tulyabuddhihetutvam / sa evāyam ātmā / vastunā avinaṣṭaṃ cātmavastu ghaṭatvādi / atha vā sa evāyaṃ sa tayāvasthayocyate / atha vā kiṃ na etena /
analyzed: evam hi parikalpyamāne sāṃkhyasya eva ātmā avikāri tva nityaḥ syāt pradhānam tu vikāra dharmi iti anitya tva prasaṅgaḥ tasmāt idam api nitya lakṣaṇam yasmin tattvam na vihanyate tat nityam iti saḥ eva ayam iti tulya buddhi hetutvam saḥ eva ayam ātmā vastunā avinaṣṭam ca ātma vastu ghaṭa tva ādi atha vā saḥ eva ayam sa tayā avasthayā ucyate atha vā kim naḥ etena

original: nahīdaṃ śāstraṃ kasyacid ekasya sahāyabhūtaṃ sarvasādhāraṇam / yathaiva sāṃkhyādīnāṃ dravyād eva pratipattiḥ rūpādisamavāyo ghaṭo 'rthāntarabhūto veti yasya yo ghaṭas tasmin ghaṭaśabdaṃ prayuṅkte / evaṃ yasya yādṛśī nityatābhipretā tāṃ nityatām āśrityārthasyāyaṃ vigrahaḥ kriyate / tatra kṣaṇikavādinām avicchedena pravṛttir yā sā nityatā /
analyzed: nahi idam śāstram kasyacid ekasya sahāya bhūtam sarva sādhāraṇam yathā eva sāṃkhya ādīnām dravyāt eva pratipattiḥ rūpa ādi samavāyaḥ ghaṭaḥ rtha antara bhūtaḥ vā iti yasya yaḥ ghaṭaḥ tasmin ghaṭa śabdam prayuṅkte evam yasya yādṛśī nityatā abhipretā tām nityatām āśritya arthasya ayam vigrahaḥ kriyate tatra kṣaṇika vādinām avicchedena pravṛttiḥ yā sā nityatā

original: itareṣāṃ pradhānavyavasthānadarśanena nityatā / atha vedaṃ pratipādayati tatra kiṃ na etenedaṃ nityam idam anityam iti / kim asmākaṃ vastugatena vicāreṇa / yad asmākaṃ nityaṃ taṃ padārthaṃ matvaiṣa vigrahaḥ kriyate / arthaś cāsmākaṃ yaḥ śabdenābhidhīyate /
analyzed: itareṣām pradhāna vyavasthāna darśanena nitya tā atha vā idam pratipādayati tatra kim naḥ etena idam nityam idam anityam iti kim asmākam vastugatena vicāreṇa yat asmākam nityam tam padārtham matvā eṣa vigrahaḥ kriyate arthaḥ ca asmākam yaḥ śabdena abhidhīyate

original: tatra vastu yadi nityaṃ yady anityaṃ śabdas tu na kadācid abhideyaś cānitya iti śabdo nārthāpravṛttapūrvaḥ / tatra nityakālaṃ svarūpeṇa vyāveśādyaś ca ghaṭaśabdo yaś ca śaśaviṣāṇaśabdo sarva ete sarvakālam arthair aśūnyā vyāviṣṭā evārtharūpeṇety evaṃbhūte padārthe yukta evaiṣa vigrahaḥ / siddhe śabde arthe saṃbandhe ceti //
analyzed: tatra vastu yadi nityam yadi anityam śabdaḥ tu na kadācid abhideyaḥ ca anityaḥ iti śabdaḥ na artha apravṛtta pūrvaḥ tatra nitya kālam sva rūpeṇa vyāveśāt yaḥ ca ghaṭa śabdaḥ yaḥ ca śaśaviṣāṇa śabdo sarve ete sarvakālam arthaiḥ a śūnyāḥ vyāviṣṭāḥ eva artha rūpeṇa iti evaṃbhūte padārthe yuktaḥ eva eṣa vigrahaḥ siddhe śabde arthe saṃbandhe ca iti

original: [10.1] kathaṃ punaḥ prastūyate / upapattiṃ pṛcchati / lokataḥ / lokād dhi prasiddham idaṃ nityam idam anityam iti / yādṛśī lokapravṛttiḥ kāryeṣu bhāveṣu tādṛśī na śabdeṣu / ye laukikāḥ arthāḥ śikṣāpūrvakāḥ te na śikṣāmantareṇa nirvartayituṃ śakyante / tad yathā /
analyzed: katham punar prastūyate upapattim pṛcchati lokataḥ lokāt hi prasiddham idam nityam idam anityam iti yādṛśī loka pravṛttiḥ kāryeṣu bhāveṣu tādṛśī na śabdeṣu ye laukikāḥ arthāḥ śikṣā pūrvakāḥ te na śikṣām antareṇa nirvartayitum śakyante tat yathā

original: ghaṭenārthī na ca śikṣitaḥ ghaṭakaraṇe tu kuśalaṃ kartāram upaiti kumbhakāraṃ kuru ghaṭaṃ kāryam anena kariṣyāmi iti evam / yadi śabdāḥ gaur ity evamādayaḥpāṇiniprabhṛtibhir eva śārakrīḍāvat vyavahārārtheṣūtpāditāḥ syuḥ tatrāśikṣitaḥ puruṣaḥ kuśalān prayojyatve vaiyākaraṇānupeyāt / na copaiti / tāvaty evārtham artham upādāya śabdān prayuṅkte /
analyzed: ghaṭena arthī na ca śikṣitaḥ ghaṭa karaṇe tu kuśalam kartāram upaiti kumbhakāram kuru ghaṭam kāryam anena kariṣyāmi iti evam yadi śabdāḥ gauḥ iti evamādayaḥ pāṇini prabhṛtibhiḥ eva śāra krīḍā vat vyavahāra artheṣu utpāditāḥ syuḥ tatra aśikṣitaḥ puruṣaḥ kuśalān prayojya tve vaiyākaraṇān upeyāt na ca upaiti tāvati eva artham artham upādāya śabdān prayuṅkte

original: buddhau samīkṣyārthaṃ prayuṅkta eva tasmād etad avaseyam / avasthitā eva amī śabdārthasaṃbandhā iti /
analyzed: buddhau samīkṣya artham prayuṅkte eva tasmāt etat avaseyam avasthitāḥ eva amī śabda artha saṃbandhāḥ iti

original: anye varṇayanti / saumasaurakrīḍāvad utpāditāḥ / yathā śabdān pṛcchati evam arthān pṛcchati / asya śabdasya ko 'arthaḥ / evaṃ saṃbandham api karoti / na hi śabdam avasthāpyārthaṃ ca tāv ubhāvupaśleṣayati / tasmād etad avaseyam / vyavasthitā evāmī śabdārthasaṃbandhāḥ / yata ekasminn eva kāle buddhyā nirūpyanta iti /
analyzed: anye varṇayanti sauma saura krīḍā vat utpāditāḥ yathā śabdān pṛcchati evam arthān pṛcchati asya śabdasya kaḥ arthaḥ evam saṃbandham api karoti na hi śabdam avasthāpya artham ca tau ubhau upaśleṣayati tasmāt etat avaseyam vyavasthitāḥ eva amī śabda artha saṃbandhāḥ yatas ekasmin eva kāle buddhyā nirūpyante iti

original: anye varṇayanti / yat tad uktaṃ darśanasya parārthatvāt viprapravṛttatvād iti tad evānena bhāṣyeṇoktam iti / kāryāṇām eva viniyogād apy anyaddarśanam asti utpattiṃ prati / asya tu yaddarśanaṃ yopalabdhiḥ yā niṣpattiḥ sā parārtharūpā eva / na hi aparārthatāśūnyaḥ kālaḥ kvacid asti / tasmād etat pratipattavyam /
analyzed: anye varṇayanti yat tat uktam darśanasya parārtha tvāt viprapravṛtta tvāt iti tat eva anena bhāṣyeṇa uktam iti kāryāṇām eva viniyogāt api anyat darśanam asti utpattim prati asya tu yat darśanam yā upalabdhiḥ yā niṣpattiḥ sā parārtha rūpā eva na hi aparārtha tā śūnyaḥ kālaḥ kvacid asti tasmāt etat pratipattavyam

original: avasthita evāsau prayoktṛkaraṇādisaṃnipātena abhivyajyata iti / asyāṃ kalpanāyāṃ dvayaṃ na saṃbadhyate / yadi tarhi lokaḥ śabdeṣu pramāṇam iti / lokato 'rthaprayukte śabdaprayoge śāstreṇa dharmaniyamaḥ / lokāt lokataḥ / arthena prerite arthaprayukte / yasmāl lokādayaṃ śikṣate sa lokaḥ sāparādhaḥ / sādhūnasādhūṃś ca śikṣayati /
analyzed: avasthitaḥ eva asau prayoktṛ karaṇa ādi saṃnipātena abhivyajyate iti asyām kalpanāyām dvayam na saṃbadhyate yadi tarhi lokaḥ śabdeṣu pramāṇam iti lokataḥ rtha prayukte śabda prayoge śāstreṇa dharma niyamaḥ lokāt lokataḥ arthena prerite artha prayukte yasmāt lokāt ayam śikṣate sa lokaḥ sa aparādhaḥ sādhūn asādhūn ca śikṣayati

original: yaś cātmapratyāyane 'rthaḥ prerayitā saḥ / yathaiva gaur ity etaṃ prerayaty evaṃ gāvyādīn api / ataḥ śāstrapravṛttiḥ evam arthā katham asādhavo nivarterann iti / atha śabdaprayoga iti prayogahagraṇaṃ kim artham / etāvad vaktavyaṃ lokato 'rthaprayukta śabda iti / ucyate / arthapratyāyanaṃ bodhaḥ / tatra pratyāyyo 'rthaḥ / pratyāyanaṃ phalam /
analyzed: yaḥ ca ātma pratyāyane rthaḥ prerayitā saḥ yathā eva gauḥ iti etam prerayati evam gāvī ādīn api atas śāstra pravṛttiḥ evam arthā katham asādhavaḥ nivarteran iti atha śabda prayogaḥ iti kim artham etāvat vaktavyam lokataḥ rtha prayukta śabdaḥ iti ucyate artha pratyāyanam bodhaḥ tatra pratyāyyaḥ rthaḥ pratyāyanam phalam

original: śabdaḥ karaṇam / śabdārthayoḥ karmakaraṇayoḥ asati kriyārthe saṃbandhābhāvāt kriyābhyupagantavyā / yathā ca dhānyānāṃ vrīhīṇām avahanane muśalodyamananipātanābhyāṃ vyavahitena saṃbandho bhavati tataś ca kaṇamokṣatuṣavipramokṣaḥ phalaṃ nirvartate / evam ihāpi śabdo dravyabhūtaḥ karaṇam / arthaḥ karma pratyāyyate / tad avabodhaḥ phalam /
analyzed: śabdaḥ karaṇam śabda arthayoḥ karma karaṇayoḥ asati kriyā arthe saṃbandha abhāvāt kriyā abhyupagantavyā yathā ca dhānyānām vrīhīṇām avahanane muśala udyamana nipātanābhyām vyavahitena saṃbandhaḥ bhavati tatas ca kaṇa mokṣa tuṣa vipramokṣaḥ phalam nirvartate evam iha api śabdaḥ dravya bhūtaḥ karaṇam arthaḥ karma pratyāyyate tat avabodhaḥ phalam

original: tat phalaṃ kriyāyāḥ / kā punaḥ sā kriyā / ucyate / praṇidhiḥ prayoktuḥ śabdān prerayatas tadviṣayaḥ / praṇidhiś cetaso vṛttir ayaṃ yogya etam arthaṃ prayāyayitum iti / sā kriyā / evaṃ hy uktam / ātmā buddhyā samarthyārthān mano yuṅkte vivakṣayeti /
analyzed: tat phalam kriyāyāḥ kā punar sā kriyā ucyate praṇidhiḥ prayoktuḥ śabdān prerayataḥ tad viṣayaḥ praṇidhiḥ cetasaḥ vṛttiḥ ayam yogyaḥ etam artham prayāyayitum iti sā kriyā evam hi uktam ātmā buddhyā samarthya arthān manaḥ yuṅkte vivakṣayā iti

original: yathā saty eva cakṣuṣi sati ca rūpe na cakṣurapraṇihitamanadhiṣṭhitaṃ manasā viṣayālocane samarthaṃ bhavaty evaṃ śabdo vyavasthito 'rthe 'pi prayoktuḥ praṇidhānamantareṇa pratyāyane asamarthaḥ ity etat prayogagrahaṇenācaṣṭe / anyeṣāṃ darśanam / śabdasyāneko dharmaḥ /
analyzed: yathā sati eva cakṣuṣi sati ca rūpe na cakṣuḥ apraṇihitam anadhiṣṭhitam manasā viṣaya ālocane samartham bhavati evam śabdaḥ vyavasthitaḥ rthe prayoktuḥ praṇidhānam antareṇa pratyāyane asamarthaḥ iti etat prayoga grahaṇena ācaṣṭe anyeṣām darśanam śabdasya anekaḥ dharmaḥ

original: yatheṇ gatāv ity ayaṃ yadānvayavyatirekābhyām arthavān iti samadhigamyate tadārthavattvād dhātutvaṃ pratipadyate / ayam eva tu yadārthaparityāge ekāco dve iti varṇatvenāśrīyate tadā tasyārthapadārthakasyāyam ekaḥ ajiti vyatireke asyeti saṃbandham upanīyate /
analyzed: yathā iṭ gatau iti ayam yadā anvaya vyatirekābhyām arthavān iti samadhigamyate tadā arthavat tvāt dhātu tvam pratipadyate ayam eva tu yadā artha parityāge eka a caḥ dve iti varṇa tvena āśrīyate tadā tasya artha pada arthakasya ayam ekaḥ a c iti vyatireke asya iti saṃbandham upanīyate

original: tathā brāhmaṇaśabdā abhyāsakāle 'narthakāḥ parapratipādane svarūpapadārthakāḥ evaṃ paṭhaivaṃ paṭheti / viniyogakāle 'rthavantaḥ / tatra yāsau viniyogakāle parigrhītārthavato 'rtheṣu prapattiḥ sa saṃbandhaḥ / yac copalakṣyate pāratantryaṃ sa śabdasyātmīyo dharmaḥ / nityaḥ śabdātmā / sa prayogaśabdenopasaṃgṛhyate /
analyzed: tathā brāhmaṇa śabdāḥ abhyāsa kāle narthakāḥ para pratipādane svarūpa pada arthakāḥ evam paṭha evam paṭha iti viniyoga kāle rthavantaḥ tatra yā asau viniyoga kāle parigrhīta arthavataḥ rtheṣu prapattiḥ sa saṃbandhaḥ yat ca upalakṣyate pāratantryam sa śabdasya ātmīyaḥ dharmaḥ nityaḥ śabda ātmā sa prayoga śabdena upasaṃgṛhyate

original: evaṃbhūtaḥ śabdo 'rthena preryate na sarva iti /
analyzed: evaṃbhūtaḥ śabdaḥ rthena preryate na sarvaḥ iti

original: anye varṇayanti / prayujyata iti prayogaḥ / śabdaś cāsau prayogaś ca śabdaprayogaḥ / na śabdamātre dharmaniyamaḥ / kiṃ tarhi / prayogārthe śabda iti /
analyzed: anye varṇayanti prayujyate iti prayogaḥ śabdaḥ ca asau prayogaḥ ca śabda prayogaḥ na śabda mātre dharma niyamaḥ kim tarhi prayoga arthe śabdaḥ iti

original: anye varṇayanti / kaścicchabdaḥ prayujyate kaścin na prayujyate / guhā trīṇi nihitā neṅgayanti / na ceṣṭante ity ete na prayujyante / turīyaṃ vāco manuṣyā vadantīti turīyo bhāgaḥ prayujyate / ye prayujyante teṣāṃ niyamaḥ / tasmāt ya utkṛṣṭo dharmaḥ tasmāt teṣāṃ trayāṇāṃ jñānam iti / dharmāya niyamo dharmaniyamaḥ / dharmaniyamo nāma rūḍhaḥ kaścit /
analyzed: anye varṇayanti kaścid śabdaḥ prayujyate kaścid na prayujyate guhā trīṇi nihitā na iṅgayanti na ceṣṭante iti ete na prayujyante turīyam vācaḥ manuṣyāḥ vadanti iti turīyaḥ bhāgaḥ prayujyate ye prayujyante teṣām niyamaḥ tasmāt yaḥ utkṛṣṭaḥ dharmaḥ tasmāt teṣām trayāṇām jñānam iti dharmāya niyamaḥ dharma niyamaḥ dharma niyamaḥ nāma rūḍhaḥ kaścid

original: tasya tu niyataṃ tādarthyam iti caturthyā vigrahe darśyate / ṣaṣṭhyā samāso hy ayaṃ yathāśvaghāso nāma kaścit iṣīkādayas teṣām eva rūḍhaḥ / niyatatvāt tādarthyasya caturthyā vigṛhyate aśvebhyo ghāsa iti / ṣaṣṭhīsamāsa evāyam / tathā coktam / aśvaghāsādayaḥ ṣaṣṭhīsamāsā bhavantīti /
analyzed: tasya tu niyatam tādarthyam iti caturthyā vigrahe darśyate ṣaṣṭhyā samāsaḥ hi ayam yathā aśva ghāsaḥ nāma kaścid iṣīkā ādayaḥ teṣām eva rūḍhaḥ niyata tvāt tādarthyasya caturthyā vigṛhyate aśvebhyaḥ ghāsaḥ iti ṣaṣṭhī samāsaḥ eva ayam tathā ca uktam aśva ghāsa ādayaḥ ṣaṣṭhī samāsāḥ bhavanti iti

original: dharmārtho vā niyamo dharmaniyama iti śākapārthivāditvād uttarapadalopaḥ / dharmārthatvād ayam eva niyamo dharma ity āsannaṃ kāraṇaṃ dharmaṃ prati vyapadiśyate / dharmaprayojano vā iti mīmāṃsakadarśanam / avasthita eva dharmaḥ / sa tv agnihotrādibhir abhivyajyate / tatpreritas tu phalado bhavati /
analyzed: dharma arthaḥ vā niyamaḥ dharma niyamaḥ iti śāka pārthiva ādi tvāt uttara pada lopaḥ dharma artha tvāt ayam eva niyamaḥ dharmaḥ iti āsannam kāraṇam dharmam prati vyapadiśyate dharma prayojanaḥ vā iti mīmāṃsaka darśanam avasthitaḥ eva dharmaḥ sa tu agnihotra ādibhiḥ abhivyajyate tad preritaḥ tu phala daḥ bhavati

original: yathā svāmī bhṛtyaiḥ sevāyāṃ preryate phalaṃ pratyevam ayaṃ niyamo dharmasya phalanirvṛttiṃ prati prayojaka iti //

original: [10.2] yathā laukikavaidikeṣu / priyatāddhitā dākṣiṇātyāḥ / atha kiṃ priyataddhitatvād apaśabdo 'yam iti pratipattavyam / nety āha / atra hi ye te 'vayavā loke bhavā vede vā śakyās te taddhitamantareṇopasaṃgrahītuṃ samudāyaśabdena loka iti vā veda iti vā / ayaṃ tv ācāryaś cānavayavabhūtān pṛthakkṛtya lokavedayoś cādhāratvaṃ nirdiśati /
analyzed: yathā laukika vaidikeṣu priya tāddhitāḥ dākṣiṇātyāḥ atha kim priya taddhita tvāt apaśabdaḥ yam iti pratipattavyam na iti āha atra hi ye te vayavāḥ loke bhavāḥ vede vā śakyāḥ te taddhitam antareṇa upasaṃgrahītum samudāya śabdena lokaḥ iti vā vedaḥ iti vā ayam tu ācāryaḥ ca an avayava bhūtān pṛthakkṛtya loka vedayoḥ ca ādhāra tvam nirdiśati

original: tatra kim anyat priyataddhitatvāt / yathā kaścid vanas pataya iti bhedena bravīti kaścit samūharūpeṇa vānaspatyam iti / atha vā yuktaḥ evātra taddhitārthaḥ / nātrāvayavāvayavibhāvaḥ / kiṃ tarhi / vākya evānekadeśabhūto 'rtho 'bhipreto lokavedābhyām / kaḥ punar asau / kṛtāntaḥ siddhāntaḥ samayagranthasaṃdarbhaḥ / etad uktaṃ bhavati /
analyzed: tatra kim anyat priya taddhita tvāt yathā kaścid vanaḥ pataye iti bhedena bravīti kaścid samūha rūpeṇa vānaspatyam iti atha vā yuktaḥ eva atra taddhita arthaḥ na atra avayava avayavi bhāvaḥ kim tarhi vākye eva aneka deśa bhūtaḥ rthaḥ bhipretaḥ loka vedābhyām kaḥ punar asau kṛtāntaḥ siddhāntaḥ samaya grantha saṃdarbhaḥ etat uktam bhavati

original: yathaivānye granthasaṃdarbhā dharmaniyamārthā evam ayam api kasmāt gṛhyate dharmaniyamārtha iti /
analyzed: yathā eva anye grantha saṃdarbhāḥ dharma niyama arthāḥ evam ayam api kasmāt gṛhyate dharma niyama arthaḥ iti

original: loke tāvad abhakṣyo grāmyakukkuṭa iti naiṣa sādharmyeṇa dṛṣṭāntaḥ / kiṃ tarhi / pakṣe / pakṣe na yo bhakṣya iti dharmaniyama iti / asmāt sāmānyād iha upāttamarthitvād bhakṣaṇaṃ prasaktam evam aitannopadeśāt / tatra niyamaḥ kriyate etena kṣut pratihantavyā nānyeneti / atra keṣāṃcid darśanam /
analyzed: loke tāvat abhakṣyaḥ grāmya kukkuṭaḥ iti na eṣa sādharmyeṇa dṛṣṭāntaḥ kim tarhi pakṣe pakṣe na yaḥ bhakṣyaḥ iti dharma niyamaḥ iti asmāt sāmānyāt iha upāttam arthi tvāt bhakṣaṇam prasaktam evam tatra niyamaḥ kriyate etena kṣudh pratihantavyā na anyena iti atra keṣāṃcid darśanam

original: yadi tadvacanam abhakṣyo grāmyaḥ kukkuṭa ity asyānupādānāt dharma iti / anye manyante / yathaiva viṣabhakṣaṇāt dhruvo mṛtyur iti viṣaṃ na bhakṣyata evam upapātakam iti svabhāvāt tasmāt tatparityāgāt dharma iti / evam arthāvaboddhaṃ prati sarvo 'rthaḥ śabdam apaśabdaṃ ca prayuṅkte / tatra śabdenāsau pratyāyyo netareṇeti niyamaḥ kriyate /
analyzed: yadi tad vacanam abhakṣyaḥ grāmyaḥ kukkuṭaḥ iti asya anupādānāt dharmaḥ iti anye manyante yathā eva viṣa bhakṣaṇāt dhruvaḥ mṛtyuḥ iti viṣam na bhakṣyate evam upapātakam iti svabhāvāt tasmāt tad parityāgāt dharmaḥ iti evam artha avaboddham prati sarvaḥ rthaḥ śabdam apaśabdam ca prayuṅkte tatra śabdena asau pratyāyyaḥ na itareṇa iti niyamaḥ kriyate

original: nanu ca kṣuddvitīyasyākaraṇāt kṛtyaḥ kṣudhi karmaṇy utpannaḥ tatraivaṃ bhavitavyaṃ śakyā cāneneti / naiṣa doṣaḥ / sāmānyenopakramo viśeṣeṇābhidhānam / iha śakeḥ kṛtyaḥ sāmānyadravyaviṣaye karmārthe pravṛttaḥ / sa prāptaliṅga evājahalliṅgatāviśeṣeṇa bhidyate / tatra viśeṣe yaḥ karmabhāvaḥ sa upayuktaḥ kṛtyeneti prathamā /
analyzed: nanu ca kṣudh dvitīyasya akaraṇāt kṛtyaḥ kṣudhi karmaṇi utpannaḥ tatra evam bhavitavyam śakyā ca anena iti na eṣa doṣaḥ sāmānyena upakramaḥ viśeṣeṇa abhidhānam iha śakeḥ kṛtyaḥ sāmānya dravya viṣaye karma arthe pravṛttaḥ sa prāpta liṅgaḥ eva a jahat liṅga tā viśeṣeṇa bhidyate tatra viśeṣe yaḥ karma bhāvaḥ saḥ upayuktaḥ kṛtyena iti prathamā

original: yathoktaṃ mukhanāsikā vacanam asya / nocyate mukhanāsikā vacanī yasyeti / tathā khedāt / khedo nāma yad indriyasyātmaviṣaye pravartamānasya nigrahaṃ pratyasāmarthyam / atha vā khedayatīti khedaḥ rāga evocyate / rāgāt khalu strīṣu pravṛttir iti atha vā dainyaṃ khedaḥ /
analyzed: yathā uktam mukha nāsikāḥ vacanam asya nā ucyate mukha nāsikāḥ vacanī yasya iti tathā khedāt khedaḥ nāma yat indriyasya ātma viṣaye pravartamānasya nigraham prati asāmarthyam atha vā khedayati iti khedaḥ rāgaḥ eva ucyate rāgāt khalu strīṣu pravṛttiḥ iti atha vā dainyam khedaḥ

original: evaṃ tāvat pauruṣeyābhimataṃ smṛtiśāstraṃ smṛtvopanibaddhaṃ vede tad api pradarśayati -- vede khalv api payovrato brāhmaṇa iti / atha kiṃ payovratatvaṃ kratvartham / nety āha / yadi kratvarthaṃ syāt yathānyeṣu avadānaprāśanādiṣv avaśyaṃ pravṛttir evam atrāpi syāt / na cāvaśyaṃ dīkṣitaḥ payo vratayati / arthitve hi sati /
analyzed: evam tāvat pauruṣeya abhimatam smṛti śāstram smṛtvā upanibaddham vede tat api pradarśayati vede khalu api payaḥ vrataḥ brāhmaṇaḥ iti atha kim payaḥ vrata tvam kratu artham na iti āha yadi kratu artham syāt yathā anyeṣu avadāna prāśana ādiṣu avaśyam pravṛttiḥ evam atra api syāt na ca avaśyam dīkṣitaḥ payaḥ vratayati arthi tve hi sati

original: yathā kṛṣṇaviṣāṇayā kaṇḍūyatīti prakṛtam eva kaṇḍūyanam upajātāyāṃ kaṇḍvāṃ kṛṣṇaviṣāṇayā kriyate / yadi ca ktarvartham abhyupagamyate / yat prakṛtabhojanaṃ pratiṣiddham anyasmin loke sa cāsmin arthitve pravartate / yathājyamavekṣata iti kratvartham avekṣaṇam iti na dravyāntarāṇām avekṣaṇaṃ pratiṣidhyate / baulvaḥ khādiro yūpaḥ syād iti /
analyzed: yathā kṛṣṇaviṣāṇayā kaṇḍūyati iti prakṛtam eva kaṇḍūyanam upajātāyām kaṇḍvām kṛṣṇaviṣāṇayā kriyate yadi ca ktaru artham abhyupagamyate yat prakṛta bhojanam pratiṣiddham anyasmin loke sa ca asmin arthi tve pravartate yathā ājyam avekṣate iti kratu artham avekṣaṇam iti na dravya antarāṇām avekṣaṇam pratiṣidhyate baulvaḥ khādiraḥ yūpaḥ syāt iti

original: paśor asvatantrīkaraṇārthaṃ yūpa upādīyate / tatra hy asvatantrīkaraṇaṃ yad dṛṣṭaṃ phalaṃ niṣpadyate yadi śiṣṭe kṛtacaṣāle 'ṣṭāśrau kāṣṭhe paśvanubandhaḥ kriyate / yathāgnau kapālāni ity atrāpi puroḍāśānāṃ pāko dṛṣṭaṃ phalam / na cānena mantreṇa kaṃcit pākaviśeṣam upalabhāmahe / tataś cādṛṣṭam atrāsti phalam iti etad anena pratipādayati /
analyzed: paśoḥ a svatantrīkaraṇa artham yūpaḥ upādīyate tatra hi a svatantrīkaraṇam yat dṛṣṭam phalam niṣpadyate yadi śiṣṭe kṛta caṣāle ṣṭa aśrau kāṣṭhe paśu anubandhaḥ kriyate yathā agnau kapālāni iti atra api puroḍāśānām pākaḥ dṛṣṭam phalam na ca anena mantreṇa kaṃcid pāka viśeṣam upalabhāmahe tatas ca adṛṣṭam atra asti phalam iti etat anena pratipādayati

original: yady apy eṣa pakṣa syāt sādhuvad apaśabdā api vācakāḥ ity evam api dṛṣṭaṃ phalaṃ tulyam arthāvabodhaḥ / iha tu adṛṣṭaṃ phalam asty abhyudaya iti / ata āha -- evam ihāpi samānāyām arthāvagatau śabdena ca iti / abhyudayakāri ca bhavati iti ca bruvatā idam abhyupagataṃ bhavati avihitaparityāgād adharmo naśyata iti / anye manyante /
analyzed: yadi api eṣa pakṣa syāt sādhu vat apaśabdāḥ api vācakāḥ iti evam api dṛṣṭam phalam tulyam artha avabodhaḥ iha tu adṛṣṭam phalam asti abhyudayaḥ iti atas āha evam iha api samānāyām artha avagatau śabdena ca iti abhyudaya kāri ca bhavati iti ca bruvatā idam abhyupagatam bhavati avihita parityāgāt adharmaḥ naśyate iti anye manyante

original: tatparityāgāt adharmaḥ kevalaṃ na bhavati / ayam eva cābhyudayo yad atra enasā na yujyata iti /
analyzed: tad parityāgāt adharmaḥ kevalam na bhavati ayam eva ca abhyudayaḥ yat atra enasā na yujyate iti

original: [11.1] asty aprayuktaḥ / etat pratigṛhītaṃ prayujyamānānāṃ vyākhyānam iti / ete coṣādayo na prayuktā koke vyākaraṇāya grantheṣu ca likhitā na vā / sā kataragranthe nītir upapadyate / pūrvapakṣadvāreṇaitat pratipādayitukāmo yad etad aprayuktatvaṃ śabdānāṃ naitad yasya kasyacit vacanād eva tiṣṭhate /
analyzed: asti a prayuktaḥ etat pratigṛhītam prayujyamānānām vyākhyānam iti ete coṣa ādayaḥ na prayuktā koke vyākaraṇāya grantheṣu ca likhitā na vā sā katara granthe nītiḥ upapadyate pūrvapakṣa dvāreṇa etat pratipādayitu kāmaḥ yat etat a prayukta tvam śabdānām na etat yasya kasyacid vacanāt eva tiṣṭhate

original: ya eva bahuśrutāḥ śiṣṭāḥ saṃmatāḥ śabdavyavahāreṣūparatāḥ svatantrās teṣām eva vacanād iti /

original: idaṃ vipratiṣiddham / ayam abhiprāyaḥ / ye'rthā arthakriyām antareṇa prasiddhās teṣv iyaṃ vācoyuktir upapadyate / yathā ghaṭo 'ntareṇa svām arthakriyām abādyāharaṇādikāṃ prasiddhaḥ siddhaḥ / śabdaḥ tv ayaṃ svām arthakriyām antareṇa na jātu prasiddhaḥ siddhaḥ / prayogād eva hy ayam astirūpaṃ pratipadyate /

original: tatra yathaiva kaścid brūyād aprayogād iti tathājātīyakam idam / prayuñjāna eva khalv api bhavān iti anuparatakaraṇavyāpāra evāhāprayukta iti / aciranirvṛttaṃ prayogam ācaṣṭe / saṃpraty eva hy ayaṃ prayukta iti / yathā kaścid brūyād yāvaj jīvaṃ me maunamato na brabīmīti tahtaivedaṃ bhavatā /
analyzed: tatra yathā eva kaścid brūyāt aprayogāt iti tathājātīyakam idam prayuñjānaḥ eva khalu api bhavān iti anuparata karaṇa vyāpāraḥ eva āha aprayuktaḥ iti acira nirvṛttam prayogam ācaṣṭe saṃprati eva hi ayam prayuktaḥ iti yathā kaścid brūyāt yāvat jīvam me maunam atas na brabīmi iti tahtā eva idam bhavatā

original: tatra yadi aprayogo 'numanyate tvayāprayukta iti prayogān manyeta / atha manyase ahaṃ prayuñje na tv anye iti anyenāprayogādasattvam eṣām iti / etad apy asat / śabdā hy ete 'nyair noccāryeran na caitāvataiva na syuḥ / bahavo hi śabdāḥ strībhir noccāryante / athaiṣā bhavato buddhiḥ kiṃ mamoccārayataḥ anāpto 'ham itīdam āha protsāhanārtham /
analyzed: tatra yadi aprayogaḥ numanyate tvayā a prayuktaḥ iti prayogān manyeta atha manyase aham prayuñje na tu anye iti anyena a prayogāt asattvam eṣām iti etat api asat śabdāḥ hi ete nyaiḥ na uccāryeran na ca etāvatā eva na syuḥ bahavaḥ hi śabdāḥ strībhiḥ na uccāryante atha eṣā bhavataḥ buddhiḥ kim mama uccārayataḥ anāptaḥ ham iti idam āha protsāhana artham

original: mā avamaṃsthā ātmānam āpto bhavān iti / kaś cedānīm anyo bhavajjātīyakaḥ / ko 'nyo bhavato vidvattara iti /
analyzed: mā avamaṃsthāḥ ātmānam āptaḥ bhavān iti kaḥ ca idānīm anyaḥ bhavat jātīyakaḥ kaḥ nyaḥ bhavataḥ vidvattaraḥ iti

original: naitad vipratiṣiddham iti / etad āha / dvidhā sattā pratyakṣānumānikī ceti / tatra pratyakṣā dādharti dardhartīti / ānumānikī prakṛtipratyayopadeśena kartavyā / tatroṣety evamādīnāṃ prakṛtīnāṃ pratyayānāṃ copadeśāt / dhṛṅaḥ śluḥ śapaś caiṣāṃ niyataviṣayatvānnoktam / grantheṣu ca likhitatvād idam avastitaṃ santy eta iti /
analyzed: na etat vipratiṣiddham iti etat āha dvidhā sattā pratyakṣa ānumānikī ca iti tatra pratyakṣā dādharti dardharti iti ānumānikī prakṛti pratyaya upadeśena kartavyā tatra ūṣā iti evamādīnām prakṛtīnām pratyayānām ca upadeśāt dhṛṅaḥ śluḥ śapaḥ ca eṣām niyata viṣaya tvāt na uktam grantheṣu ca likhita tvāt idam santi ete iti

original: atha loke na prayujyante iti idaṃ brūmo 'rayukta iti / bruvāṇaś cāhaṃ kathaṃ brūyām aprayukta ity āha -- na brūmo 'smābhir aprayuktā iti / abhyantaro 'haṃ loke na tv ahaṃ loka iti etad uktaṃ bhavati / yathā lokaḥ śabdān prayuṅkte naivam aham etānūṣādīn prayuñje iti //
analyzed: atha loke na prayujyante iti idam brūmaḥ iti bruvāṇaḥ ca aham katham brūyām aprayuktaḥ iti āha na brūmaḥ smābhiḥ aprayuktāḥ iti abhyantaraḥ ham loke na tu aham loke iti etat uktam bhavati yathā lokaḥ śabdān prayuṅkte na evam aham etān ūṣa ādīn prayuñje iti

original: [11.2] nārthe śabdaprayogāt / arthā hi kālapuruṣādayaḥ santi / śabdasya cārthāntareṣu guṇabhāvāt pradhānasaṃnihitena śabdena bhavitavyam / atha vārthopalabdhiḥ śabdāstitvānumānam / na hi kaś cid artho 'śabdo 'sti /
analyzed: na arthe śabda prayogāt arthāḥ hi kāla puruṣa ādayaḥ santi śabdasya ca artha antareṣu guṇa bhāvāt pradhāna saṃnihitena śabdena bhavitavyam atha vā artha upalabdhiḥ śabda astitva anumānam na hi kaḥ cit sti

original: tatra yathaiva svargāpūrvadevatāśabdā upalabhyamānā atyantāparidṛṣṭānām arthānām astitvānumānam evaṃ kiṃ na gṛhyate 'rtha upalabhyamānaḥ śabdāstitvasyānumānam iti /
analyzed: tatra yathā eva svarga apūrva devatā śabdāḥ upalabhyamānāḥ atyanta aparidṛṣṭānām arthānām astitva anumānam evam kim na gṛhyate rthaḥ upalabhyamānaḥ śabda astitvasya anumānam iti

original: [11.3] aprayogaḥ prayogānyatvāt / yo 'yaṃ śabdāstitve hetur upadiṣṭaḥ aśabdakasyārthasya rūpād iti / atra brūmo yady eṣām arthānāṃ vācakā na syuḥ pratipadyemahy eṣām astitvam / yatas tu santi tasmād ahetur ayam / nanu cocetyasya uṣitā iti samānārtho na bhavati puruṣasya parokṣatāyāś cābhidhānāt / naiṣa doṣaḥ /
analyzed: aprayogaḥ prayoga anyatvāt yaḥ yam śabda astitve hetuḥ upadiṣṭaḥ aśabdakasya arthasya rūpāt iti atra brūmaḥ yadi eṣām arthānām vācakāḥ na syuḥ pratipadyemahi eṣām astitvam yatas tu santi tasmāt ahetuḥ ayam nanu uṣitāḥ iti samāna arthaḥ na bhavati puruṣasya parokṣa tāyāḥ ca abhidhānāt na eṣa doṣaḥ

original: vākyaṃ tathābhūtaṃ prayoktavyaṃ yataḥ sarvārthābhivyaktir bhavati /

original: [11.4] aprayukte dīrghasattravat / ādyena samayena pratipādayaty astitvam / yathā pūrvakālaṃ prayuktāni dīrghasatrāṇi idānīm aprayujyamānāny api dadhimadhvādayo dharma iti karmatādiviṣayaḥ sidhyata evam anyaiḥ prayuktānāṃ sarvakālam idānīm aprayujyamānānām apy anuvidhānaṃ yuktam /

original: [12.1] kiṃ punaḥ śabdasya jñāne dharmaḥ āhosvit prayoga iti / etāvad ucyate śāstreṇa dharmaniyama iti / sa dharmaniyamaḥ kiṃ jñānād atha prayogād iti / abhijñ eva pṛcchati kātra smṛtir iti / atha vā smṛtijña eva pṛcchati / sā tu smṛtiḥ kvacit śrutyā virudhyate / yathāṣṭācatvāriṃśād varṣāṇi vedabrahmacaryaṃ caritavyam iti /

original: iyaṃ śrutivirodhinī smṛtiḥ / śrutau hy uktaṃ kṛṣṇakeśaḥ pitā putraṃ yojayed iti / tatrānumānapakṣe smṛtiḥ nityapramāṇaṃ bhavati / kiṃ cādṛṣṭārthā smṛtir apramāṇam / yathā haṃsaḥ kaiścid bhakṣya ity abhyupagatam / kaiścin mātṛyonibaddhānām udvāhaḥ / tatra laulyāt rāgād vedaṃ pravartitam / tatra pūrvaṃ dharmaṃ matvā śiṣṭā ācaranti adyatve /

original: smṛtir ekaḥ śabdaḥ samyak jñātaḥ śāstrānvitaḥ suprayuktaḥ svarge loke kāmadhug bhavatīti / kiṃ cedam / prayukta evāsau samyak jñāto bhavati / yadi samyak prayujyate jñānād eva tu dharmaḥ / athaivaṃ prayuktaḥ samyak jñāto bhavatīti / samyak prayogas tu samyagjñāte sati bhavatīti / tatra pṛcchāmaḥ / kā upapattiyuktā smṛtiḥ /
analyzed: smṛtiḥ ekaḥ śabdaḥ samyak jñātaḥ śāstra anvitaḥ su prayuktaḥ svarge loke kāmadhuk bhavati iti kim ca idam prayuktaḥ eva asau samyak jñātaḥ bhavati yadi samyak prayujyate jñānāt eva tu dharmaḥ atha evam prayuktaḥ samyak jñātaḥ bhavati iti samyak prayogaḥ tu samyak jñāte sati bhavati iti tatra pṛcchāmaḥ kā upapatti yuktā smṛtiḥ

original: kasyāḥ śruteḥ anuvādinīti /
analyzed: kasyāḥ śruteḥ anuvādinī iti

original: [12.2] jñāne dharma iti cet tadvad adharmaḥ / pṛthak kṛtvedam ucyate / yadi śabdajñāne dharma evaṃ sati apaśabdajñānād adharmaḥ / etasminn arthe etat saṃbhaved brāhmaṇavadhādadharmo jīvanāt tu dharma iti / na tv etac chakyate vaktuṃ brāhmaṇavadhādadharma iti śūdravadhād dharma iti /
analyzed: jñāne dharmaḥ iti ced tadvat adharmaḥ pṛthak kṛtvā idam ucyate yadi śabda jñāne dharmaḥ evam sati apaśabda jñānāt adharmaḥ etasmin arthe etat saṃbhavet brāhmaṇa vadhāt adharmaḥ jīvanāt tu dharmaḥ iti na tu etat śakyate vaktum brāhmaṇa vadhāt adharmaḥ iti śūdra vadhāt dharmaḥ iti

original: atra hīdaṃ yujyeta śabdajñānād yadi dharmaḥ śabdasyaivājñānād adharmaḥ prāpnotīti / ucyate / dṛṣṭārthayā smṛtyā tulyatvam asyāḥ smṛter āha / dṛṣṭārthāyāṃ hi smṛtau vaidyake yat śleṣmaṇaḥ prakopanaṃ tadviparītaṃ rūkṣaṃ vāyoḥ / evaṃ śabdajñānān na dharmo nāpy adharmaḥ apaśabdajñānāt tv adharma iti anye manyante /
analyzed: atra hi idam yujyeta śabda jñānāt yadi dharmaḥ śabdasya eva ajñānāt adharmaḥ prāpnoti iti ucyate dṛṣṭārthayā smṛtyā tulya tvam asyāḥ smṛteḥ āha dṛṣṭārthāyām hi smṛtau vaidyake yat śleṣmaṇaḥ prakopanam tad viparītam rūkṣam vāyoḥ evam śabda jñānāt na dharmaḥ na api adharmaḥ apaśabda jñānāt tu adharmaḥ iti anye manyante

original: śabdajñānād dharmo na tv apaśabdajñānād adharma iti / yathottaratra vakṣyati śabdapramāṇakā vayam iti / kecin manyante / śabdāpaśabdajñānābhyāṃ dharmādharmau pravartete / adharmasya tu dharmeṇābhibhavaḥ / yathā kūpakhānakam upādāsyate / tatrāpaśabdajñānād adharma ity etat pradarśayati / vyākaraṇādhyayanād anartha āgataḥ /
analyzed: śabda jñānāt dharmaḥ na tu apaśabda jñānāt adharmaḥ iti yathā uttaratra vakṣyati śabda pramāṇakāḥ vayam iti kecid manyante śabda apaśabda jñānābhyām dharma adharmau pravartete adharmasya tu dharmeṇa abhibhavaḥ yathā kūpa khānakam upādāsyate tatra apaśabda jñānāt adharmaḥ iti etat pradarśayati vyākaraṇa adhyayanāt anarthaḥ āgataḥ

original: tasmān na kiṃcid etat na cāntareṇa vyākaraṇaṃ śabdāḥ śakyā jñātum iti /
analyzed: tasmāt na kiṃcid etat na ca antareṇa vyākaraṇam śabdāḥ śakyāḥ jñātum iti

original: athaitat syāt / bhūyān dharmo 'lpīyānadharma iti / etac cāsat / bhūyas tvād apaśabdānāṃ phalenāpi bhūyasā bhavitavyam ity adharma eva bhūyān prāpnoti /
analyzed: atha etat syāt bhūyān dharmaḥ lpīyān adharmaḥ iti etat ca asat bhūyaḥ tvāt apaśabdānām phalena api bhūyasā bhavitavyam iti adharmaḥ eva bhūyān prāpnoti

original: [12.3] ācāre niyamaḥ / evaṃ tāvad uktaviruddheyaṃ smṛtiḥ / śrutiś caināṃ nānuvadati / ato 'py apramāṇam / ācāre prayoge ṛṣir mantraḥ te 'surā iti pradarśayaty etad ayaṃ tv ācāraḥ / tasmān na mlecchitavai nāpabhāṣitavai iti ca / iyaṃ smṛtir evam āha mlecchanam apabhāṣaṇaṃ na kartavyam iti / na punar evam āha mlecchanam apabhāṣaṇaṃ na jñātavyam iti /
analyzed: ācāre niyamaḥ evam tāvat ukta viruddhā iyam smṛtiḥ śrutiḥ ca enām na anuvadati atas api apramāṇam ācāre prayoge ṛṣiḥ mantraḥ te surāḥ iti pradarśayati etat ayam tu ācāraḥ tasmāt na mlecchitavai na apabhāṣitavai iti ca iyam smṛtiḥ evam āha mlecchanam apabhāṣaṇam na kartavyam iti na punar evam āha mlecchanam apabhāṣaṇam na jñātavyam iti

original: nanu cātraitāvad ucyate ayam apaśabdo na prayoktavya iti evaṃ tu naivāsti śabdasya prayogād dharma iti / naiṣa doṣaḥ / apabhāṣaṇe pratiṣiddhe kiṃ tūṣṇīṃbhūtenāsitavyam / tatrānugṛhīto 'pi vyāhāraḥ sa sādhakaḥ kartavyaḥ ity etad vijñāyate //
analyzed: nanu ca atra etāvat ucyate ayam apaśabdaḥ na prayoktavyaḥ iti evam tu na eva asti śabdasya prayogāt dharmaḥ iti na eṣa doṣaḥ apabhāṣaṇe pratiṣiddhe kim tūṣṇīṃbhūtena āsitavyam tatra anugṛhītaḥ api vyāhāraḥ sa sādhakaḥ kartavyaḥ iti etat vijñāyate

original: [12.4] prayoge sarvalokasya / śāstrasyopādānam anarthakam ity abhiprāyaḥ / antareṇāpi vyākaraṇaṃ prayogadarśanāt /
analyzed: prayoge sarva lokasya śāstrasya upādānam anarthakam iti abhiprāyaḥ antareṇa api vyākaraṇam prayoga darśanāt

original: atra codyate / yady apy antareṇa śāstram api prayogaḥ tathāpi na yatnānarthakyam / yathā saty api svabhāvārogatve keṣāṃcit vaidyopadeśaṃ pratyākhyāya pravṛttā iti api na vaidyakaṃ praṇīyante / kecid vyādhitās tena cikitsyanta eva / tathā vyākaraṇam api pravartayitavyamadhyetavyaṃ ca /
analyzed: atra codyate yadi api antareṇa śāstram api prayogaḥ tathā api na yatna ānarthakyam yathā sati api svabhāva aroga tve keṣāṃcid vaidya upadeśam pratyākhyāya pravṛttāḥ iti api na vaidyakam praṇīyante kecid vyādhitāḥ tena cikitsyantaḥ eva tathā vyākaraṇam api pravartayitavyam adhyetavyam ca

original: yasmāc chabdān prayoktum icchan adhyāpyate tad arthaṃ ca praṇetavyam iti /
analyzed: yasmāt śabdān prayoktum icchan adhyāpyate tat artham ca praṇetavyam iti

original: ucyate / satyam evam / teṣāṃ tu tatraivoktam /
analyzed: ucyate satyam evam teṣām tu tatra eva uktam

original: dīptāgnayaḥ kharāhārāḥ karmaniṣṭhā mahodarāḥ /
analyzed: dīpta agnayaḥ khara āhārāḥ karma niṣṭhāḥ mahā udarāḥ

original: ye narāḥ prati tāṃś cintyaṃ nāvaśyaṃ gurulāghavam //
analyzed: ye narāḥ prati tān cintyam na avaśyam gurulāghavam

original: iti / iha tu na kiṃcid evaṃbhūtam asti / etāvad ucyate na cāntareṇa vyākaraṇaṃ śabdāḥ śakyā jñātum iti //
analyzed: iti iha tu na kiṃcid evaṃbhūtam asti etāvat ucyate na ca antareṇa vyākaraṇam śabdāḥ śakyāḥ jñātum iti

original: [12.5] śāstrapūrve prayoge 'bhyudayaḥ / śāstrahetuke jñāne sati yaḥ prayogaḥ tasmāt abhyudayaḥ / yaḥ śāstrapūrvakaṃ jñātvā śabdān prayuṅkte so 'bhyudayena yujyate / tasmād asau smṛtir ekaḥ śabdaḥ samyak jñāta iti / tattulyaṃ vedaśabdena / vedaśabdito yo 'rthas tena tulyam / vedaśabdena yo 'gniṣṭomena yajate ya u cainam evaṃ veda /
analyzed: śāstra pūrve prayoge bhyudayaḥ śāstra hetuke jñāne sati yaḥ prayogaḥ tasmāt abhyudayaḥ yaḥ śāstra pūrvakam jñātvā śabdān prayuṅkte saḥ bhyudayena yujyate tasmāt asau smṛtiḥ ekaḥ śabdaḥ samyak jñātaḥ iti tat tulyam veda śabdena veda śabditaḥ yaḥ rthaḥ tena tulyam veda śabdena yaḥ agniṣṭomena yajate yaḥ u ca enam evam veda

original: sa vedaśabda etad artham abhidadhāti / yo'gniṣṭomaṃ vidvāṃs tu prayuṅkte so 'bhyudayena yujyate viduṣaḥ karmaṇyadhikārāt / apara āha / saṃprati vedavākyānyevodāharaṇāni / yathā tāni brahmacaryādibhir niyamair adhītāni dharmasādhanam evaṃ prayogasya dharmasādhanatve śāstrapūrvakaṃ jñānam iti viśiṣṭāt prayogād abhyudaya iti vyavasthitam /
analyzed: sa veda śabdaḥ etat artham abhidadhāti yaḥ agniṣṭomam vidvān tu prayuṅkte saḥ abhyudayena yujyate viduṣaḥ karmaṇi adhikārāt aparaḥ āha saṃprati veda vākyāni eva udāharaṇāni yathā tāni brahmacarya ādibhiḥ niyamaiḥ adhītāni dharma sādhanam evam prayogasya dharma sādhana tve śāstra pūrvakam jñānam iti viśiṣṭāt prayogāt abhyudayaḥ iti vyavasthitam

original: atha vā punar astu jñāna eva / neyaṃ smṛtir dṛṣṭārthayā tulyā / tatra pāramparyeṇāvicchinnam idaṃ smaryate jñānād dharma iti / tatrāgamaprāmāṇyād yad vihitaṃ pratiṣiddhaṃ vā tad eva kriyate varjyate vā / nanv idaṃ vacanam apaśabdajñānād adharma iti vā dharmo vā na bhavaty apaśabdajñānād iti /
analyzed: atha vā punar astu jñāne eva na iyam smṛtiḥ dṛṣṭārthayā tulyā tatra pāramparyeṇa avicchinnam idam smaryate jñānāt dharmaḥ iti tatra āgama prāmāṇyāt yat vihitam pratiṣiddham vā tat eva kriyate varjyate vā nanu idam vacanam apaśabda jñānāt adharmaḥ iti vā dharmaḥ vā na bhavati apaśabda jñānāt iti

original: yac ca na vihitaṃ na ca pratiṣiddhaṃ na tatra karaṇe varjane vā guṇadoṣāv iti / atha vābhyupāya evāpaśabdajñānaṃ śabdajñānasya / yaś ca yasyābhyupāyaḥ tam antareṇa tasyāpravṛttir eva iti tad api tasyāṅgam eva bhavati / yathā kaścit manyeta kṣitigataṃ śauklyaṃ tasya darśanād dharma iti / asau kṛṣṇā / sa paśyan na tatra śaknoti śuklaṃ draṣṭum /
analyzed: yat ca na vihitam na ca pratiṣiddham na tatra karaṇe varjane vā guṇa doṣau iti atha vā abhyupāyaḥ eva apaśabdajñānam śabda jñānasya yaḥ ca yasya abhyupāyaḥ tam antareṇa tasya apravṛttiḥ eva iti tat api tasya aṅgam eva bhavati yathā kaścid manyeta kṣiti gatam śauklyam tasya darśanāt dharmaḥ iti asau kṛṣṇā sa paśyan na tatra śaknoti śuklam draṣṭum

original: ata upāya evāsau śukladarśanasya / yathāśvamedhādiṣv abhyupāya eva hiṃsā dharmasya / evam idam apaśabdajñānānuṣaktam eva śabdajñānam iti / nāsyādharmeṇa saṃbandhaḥ / evaṃ smṛtiḥ samarthitā bhavati / evam ānarthakyaṃ na bhavati smṛteḥ /
analyzed: atas upāyaḥ eva asau śukla darśanasya yathā aśvamedha ādiṣu abhyupāyaḥ eva hiṃsā dharmasya evam idam apaśabda jñāna anuṣaktam eva śabda jñānam iti na asya adharmeṇa saṃbandhaḥ evam smṛtiḥ samarthitā bhavati evam ānarthakyam na bhavati smṛteḥ

original: atha vā kūpakhānakavad iti / iyam upapattiḥ / yady apy apaśabdajñānād adharmaḥ syāt tathāpy alpīyān / śabdajñānād eva tūtkṛṣṭo dharmo bhūyāṃś ceti pravartata evādhyayane vidyamāne 'pi doṣe / tat tu smṛtipraṇayanasāmarthyād evāvagamyate śabdajñānāt prakṛṣṭo dharma iti / tasyodāharaṇaṃ kūpakhānakaḥ /
analyzed: atha vā kūpa khānaka vat iti iyam upapattiḥ yadi api apaśabda jñānāt adharmaḥ syāt tathā api alpīyān śabda jñānāt eva tu utkṛṣṭaḥ dharmaḥ bhūyān ca iti pravartate eva adhyayane vidyamāne doṣe tat tu smṛti praṇayana sāmarthyāt eva avagamyate śabda jñānāt prakṛṣṭaḥ dharmaḥ iti tasya udāharaṇam kūpa khānakaḥ

original: [13.1] atha vyākaraṇam ity asya śabdasya kaḥ padārtha iti / kim anenābhidhīyate kvārtharūḍha iti padārthagrahaṇenaitat pṛcchati / śabdo hi kaścit tulyarūpaḥ pravartamāno bhinnārtho bhinnanimittaḥ parasparama apekṣamāṇaḥ pravartate / yathāśvaśabdaḥ subantastiṅntaś ca / kaścit tu nimittasya tulyatvāt pravartate /

original: yathā apśabdaḥ samudre bindau ca jātinimittaḥ / kaścij jātibhede 'pi rūḍhiviṣayaḥ kriyā tulyeti pravartate / yathā sarvaḥ aśnoterakṣaḥ padyateḥ pādaḥ mimītermāṣa iti / tatra kriyāsāmānyāt siddham iti / kaścit tadbhāvāpādanena vādhyāropeṇa vā yathā vāhīke gośabdo rajjudravye ca sarpaśabdaḥ / tatrāyaṃ vyākaraṇaśabdaḥ kiṃbhūta āśrīyate iti /
analyzed: yathā ap śabdaḥ samudre bindau ca jāti nimittaḥ kaścid jāti bhede pi rūḍhi viṣayaḥ kriyā tulyā iti pravartate yathā sarvaḥ aśnoteḥ akṣaḥ padyateḥ pādaḥ mimīteḥ māṣaḥ iti tatra kriyā sāmānyāt siddham iti kaścid tad bhāva āpādanena vā adhyāropeṇa vā yathā go śabdaḥ rajju dravye ca sarpa śabdaḥ tatra ayam vyākaraṇa śabdaḥ kiṃbhūtaḥ āśrīyate iti

original: anena dvāreṇa śabdapravṛttinimittamācikhyāsannupanyāsaṃ karoti / idaṃ punaḥ punar uktaṃna cāntareṇa vyākaraṇaṃ tannāvaiyākaraṇa iti tatrāsya padārtham ācaṣṭāṃ bhavān iti / sūtram / sūtrasamudāyo 'ṣṭādhyāyyām asyārthaḥ iti / ṣaṣṭhyartho 'nupapannaḥ / nanu ca sūtraśabdaprayogo 'py anupapannaḥ / ucyate / sāmānyopakrame 'bhidhāne sūtram /
analyzed: anena dvāreṇa śabda pravṛtti nimittam ācikhyāsan upanyāsam karoti idam punar punar uktam na ca antareṇa vyākaraṇam tat na avaiyākaraṇaḥ iti tatra asya padārtham ācaṣṭām bhavān iti sūtram sūtra samudāyaḥ uṣṭa adhyāyyām asya arthaḥ iti ṣaṣṭhī arthaḥ nupapannaḥ nanu ca sūtra śabda prayogaḥ api anupapannaḥ ucyate sāmānya upakrame bhidhāne sūtram

original: kiṃ sūtram iti vyākaraṇam iti viśeṣo yuktaḥ / vṛkṣaḥ śiṃśapeti yathā / śabdārthas tu bhedābhāvād aprayuktaḥ / yadā tu vyākaraṇaśabdaḥ samudāyavṛttiḥ sūtraśabdaḥ kasmiṃś cid avayave vṛtta upādīyate vṛddhirādaijityevamādau tadā ṣaṣṭhyartho 'py upapannaḥ / yadā tu dvāv api samudāyaśabdau tadā ṣaṣṭhyarthābhāva iti codyate /

original: [13.2] śabdāpratipattiḥ / na hi vṛddhirādaijityetasmāc chabdān pratipadyāmahe / kiṃ tarhi / vyākhyānataḥ / udāharaṇād vayaṃ samānajātīyān śabdān pratipadyāmahe / nanu ca tad eva sūtraṃ vigṛhītaṃ vyākhyānaṃ bhavati / sūtrārthasyābhivyaktyupāyo vyākhyānam / yathā vaṭavṛkṣasthito daṃṣṭrītyasyārthasyābhivyaktiḥ kriyate vaṭe vṛkṣe sthito daṃṣṭrī /
analyzed: śabda apratipattiḥ na hi śabdān pratipadyāmahe kim tarhi vyākhyānataḥ udāharaṇāt vayam samāna jātīyān śabdān pratipadyāmahe nanu ca tat eva sūtram vigṛhītam vyākhyānam bhavati sūtra arthasya abhivyakti upāyaḥ vyākhyānam yathā vaṭa vṛkṣa sthitaḥ daṃṣṭrī iti asya arthasya abhivyaktiḥ kriyate vaṭe vṛkṣe sthitaḥ daṃṣṭrī iti asya arthasya abhivyaktiḥ kriyate vaṭe vṛkṣe sthitaḥ daṃṣṭrī iti asya arthasya abhivyaktiḥ kriyate vaṭe

original: [13.3] śabde lyuḍarthaḥ / bhede sati ṣaṣṭhyarthapratipattir asti / śabdasya hy anvākhyāpakatvena sūtraṃ saṃbandhi bhavati / lyuḍarthas tu nopapadyate / saṃskriyamāṇo hi śabdo 'parārthatvāt pradhānam / na ca pradhānasya karaṇabhāvo yuktaḥ / yathā puroḍāśasyotpattisaṃskārapratipattiṣūtpādyatvāt saṃskāryatvāt pratipādyatvāt prādhānyam eva /

original: [13.4] bhave ca / nanu cānvākhyāpakatvāt tasmin bhavāḥ syuḥ / evaṃ ca sati yāvān yogaḥ sarvaḥ vaiyākaraṇaḥ prāpnoti / tasmād avayavāvayavibhāvo 'trābhipretaḥ /
