original: [13.5] proktādayo 'pi nopapadyante / na hi śabdāḥ proktāḥ / purastāditam iti / bhāṣyasūtreṣu gurulāghavasyānāśritatvāt lakṣaṇaprapañcayoś ca mūlasūtreṣv āśrayaṇād ihāpi lakṣaṇaprapañcābhyāṃ pravṛttiḥ / tad yathā praskandanaṃ prapatanam iti / nanu ca bhīmādiṣv ete paṭhyante / ucyate / etad evāha kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam iti tasya bhīmādiḥ prapañca iti /
analyzed: prokta ādayaḥ api na upapadyante na hi śabdāḥ proktāḥ purastāt itam iti bhāṣya sūtreṣu gurulāghavasya anāśrita tvāt lakṣaṇa prapañcayoḥ ca mūlasūtreṣu āśrayaṇāt iha api lakṣaṇa prapañcābhyām pravṛttiḥ tat yathā praskandanam prapatanam iti nanu ca bhīma ādiṣu ete paṭhyante ucyate etat eva āha kṛtya lyuṭaḥ bahulam iti tasya bhīma ādiḥ prapañcaḥ iti

original: atha vā śabdair api śabdā vyākriyante / śabdo hy uccārasya svarūpaṃ prati codayati viparītavyāvṛttatvam abhivyanakti / samānajātīyānāṃ śabdāntarāṇāṃ pratipādako bhavati / bhinnajātīyakasya sādhor api nivṛttiḥ sarvathā bhavati / tatraikadeśe bhāṣye kathyate nāśvo na gardabha iti /
analyzed: atha vā śabdaiḥ api śabdāḥ vyākriyante śabdaḥ hi uccārasya svarūpam prati codayati viparīta vyāvṛtta tvam abhivyanakti samāna jātīyānām śabda antarāṇām pratipādakaḥ bhavati bhinna jātīyakasya sādhoḥ api nivṛttiḥ sarvathā bhavati tatra eka deśe bhāṣye kathyate na aśvaḥ na gardabhaḥ iti

original: [13.6] evaṃ tarhi lakṣyalakṣaṇe vyākaraṇam / naitat pratipattavyaṃ yathānyo bilvaśarado vanaspatimāhānya eva phalam iti / nāpy apśaradavat ekaśabdatvam ekanimittatvāt / nāpy akṣavat kriyāsāmānyāt / nāpy ekaśeṣāśrayaṇam / evaṃ hi kalpyamāne sarvaḥ śabda eva bhāṣyam anu ghaṭate /
analyzed: evam tarhi lakṣya lakṣaṇe vyākaraṇam na etat pratipattavyam yathā anyaḥ bilva śaradaḥ vanaspatim āha anyaḥ eva phalam iti na api eka śabda tvam eka nimitta tvāt na api akṣa vat kriyā sāmānyāt na api ekaśeṣa āśrayaṇam evam hi kalpyamāne sarvaḥ śabdaḥ eva bhāṣyam anu ghaṭate

original: yad vakṣyamāṇam anyaś cel lakṣyam āha anyo lakṣaṇam anyaḥ samudāyaṃ kim ucyate samudāyeṣu ca śabdaḥ pravṛtta iti / tasmāt yathaiva saṃghamaṇḍalasenāvanam ity ete śabdāḥ samudāyābhidhāyino nāvayavābhidhāyinaḥ evaṃ vyākaraṇaśabdo 'pi samudāyābhidhāyī nāvayavābhidhāyīti / evam apy ayaṃ doṣaḥ /
analyzed: yat vakṣyamāṇam anyaḥ ced lakṣyam āha anyaḥ lakṣaṇam anyaḥ samudāyam kim ucyate samudāyeṣu ca śabdaḥ pravṛttaḥ iti tasmāt yathā eva saṃgha maṇḍala senā vanam iti ete śabdāḥ samudāya abhidhāyinaḥ na avayava abhidhāyinaḥ evam vyākaraṇa śabdaḥ api samudāya abhidhāyī na avayava abhidhāyī iti evam api ayam doṣaḥ

original: yathaivaite vanādayonāvayave vartante evam ayam apy avayave na vartate /
analyzed: yathā eva ete vanādayaḥ na avayave vartante evam ayam api avayave na vartate

original: pūrve pañcālā iti / samudāyatvam āpāditaḥ samudāyaśabdenāpadiśyate / yathā gotvam āpādito bāhīko gośabdeneti / na hi śabdasyedaṃ saṃbhavati samudāyaṃ tyaktvāvayavam upasaṃkrāntum iti / ataḥ samudāyo yadāvayave kṛtsnam ātmānaṃ saṃniropayati tadā pravartate samudāyaśabdaḥ /
analyzed: pūrve pañcālāḥ iti samudāya tvam āpāditaḥ samudāya śabdena apadiśyate yathā go tvam āpāditaḥ bāhīkaḥ go śabdena iti na hi śabdasya idam saṃbhavati samudāyam tyaktvā avayavam upasaṃkrāntum iti atas samudāyaḥ yadā avayave kṛtsnam ātmānam saṃniropayati tadā pravartate samudāya śabdaḥ

original: evaṃ vyākaraṇaśabde 'pi samudāyavṛttir yadaikadeśe sūtre ātmānaṃ saṃniveśayati tadā tacchabdapravṛttiḥ kena kartavyā /
analyzed: evam vyākaraṇa śabde pi samudāya vṛttiḥ yadā eka deśe sūtre ātmānam saṃniveśayati tadā tad śabda pravṛttiḥ kena kartavyā

original: tailaṃ bhuktaṃ ghṛtaṃ bhuktam iti / kasminn upaghātake 'nugrāhake vā ghṛte taile śabdaṃ parikalpya samudāyo 'vayavavṛttiḥ / evaṃ śuklādiṣv avayavasyaiva kasyacit śuklīkaraṇāt samudāya evāyaṃ paṭākhyo 'nyarūpaḥ kṛta ity ekadeśe samudāyaśabdo vartate /
analyzed: tailam bhuktam ghṛtam bhuktam iti kasmin upaghātake nu grāhake vā ghṛte taile śabdam parikalpya samudāyaḥ vayava vṛttiḥ evam śukla ādiṣu avayavasya eva kasyacid śuklīkaraṇāt samudāyaḥ eva ayam paṭa ākhyaḥ nyarūpaḥ kṛtaḥ iti eka deśe samudāya śabdaḥ vartate

original: yathā na ca tāvat kārtsnyena ghaṭam upalabhate bhavati cāsya keṣucid evāvayaveṣu ghaṭabuddhiḥ evam eva sūtramātrāt samudāyaṃ pratipadyamāna eva vyākaraṇam iti tāvaty eva śabdaṃ prayuṅkte / yathā tādarthyād adhiśrayaṇamātraṃ dṛṣṭvā pacaty ayam iti prayuñjānaṃ prati vacanam ucyate nāyaṃ pacaty adhiśrayati kiṃ tu udakaṃ saṃpādayatīti /
analyzed: yathā na ca tāvat kārtsnyena ghaṭam upalabhate bhavati ca asya keṣucid eva avayaveṣu ghaṭa buddhiḥ evam eva sūtra mātrāt samudāyam pratipadyamānaḥ eva vyākaraṇam iti tāvati eva śabdam prayuṅkte yathā tādarthyāt adhiśrayaṇa mātram dṛṣṭvā pacati ayam iti prayuñjānam prati vacanam ucyate na ayam pacati adhiśrayati kim tu udakam saṃpādayati iti

original: [13.7] vyapadeśivadbhāvena bhaviṣyati / vyapadeśivadbhāvaś ca kvacit kathaṃcit / iha ekāco dve prathamasya ity asty evānvayavyatirekasamadhigamyamānārthavattayā dhāturūpatāsti varṇarūpatā / tatraikena rūpeṇāśritasya rūpāntareṇa yukto vyapadeśaḥ /
analyzed: vyapadeśivat bhāvena bhaviṣyati vyapadeśivat bhāvaḥ ca kvacid kathaṃcid iha eka a caḥ dve prathamasya iti asti eva anvaya vyatireka samadhigamyamāna arthavat tayā dhātu rūpa tā asti varṇa rūpa tā tatra ekena rūpeṇa āśritasya rūpa antareṇa yuktaḥ vyapadeśaḥ

original: atha vā samudāyāvayavakalpanāyāṃ yo 'sau samudāyaḥ prayogasamavāyī sa śabdabhedāya eti itaḥ ayanam iti tasyām ekadeśa etir iti / yathā śilāputrako 'yam anekakriyāviṣayo dṛṣṭas tasyedaṃ śarīram iti / iha tu sthūlaśirā rāhur ity asaty api samudāyāvayavabhāve śabdavyāpāramātrād evāsati bhede vyapadeśaḥ /
analyzed: atha vā samudāya avayava kalpanāyām saḥ asau samudāyaḥ prayoga samavāyī sa śabda bhedāya eti itas ayanam iti tasyām eka deśaḥ etiḥ iti yathā śilāputrakaḥ yam aneka kriyā viṣayaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ tasya idam śarīram iti iha tu sthūlaśirāḥ rāhuḥ iti asati api samudāya avayava bhāve śabda vyāpāra mātrāt eva asati bhede vyapadeśaḥ

original: śabdo hi vastujñānasadbhāvāsadbhāvānapekṣaḥ kaṃcid evārthabhāgaṃ niścitya pravartate / tad yathā vidyamānām api parvatām aṅguleraṅguliśabdo [na] bravīty evaṃ vidyamānām api śiromātratāṃ rāho rāhuśabdo na bravīti / yāvān eva hi rāhuśabdavācyo 'rthas tāvān evocyate / tasya śirasā yukto vyapadeśaḥ /
analyzed: śabdaḥ hi vastu jñāna sadbhāva asadbhāva anapekṣaḥ kaṃcid eva artha bhāgam niścitya pravartate tat yathā vidyamānām api aṅguleḥ aṅguli śabdaḥ na bravīti evam vidyamānām api śiraḥ mātra tām rāhoḥ rāhu śabdaḥ na bravīti yāvān eva hi rāhu śabda vācyaḥ rthaḥ tāvān eva ucyate tasya śirasā yuktaḥ vyapadeśaḥ

analyzed: yathā sati api ekatve vastunaḥ vasthāyāḥ abhidhānāt bhavati prakarṣa pratyayaḥ parudh bhavān paṭutaraḥ ca aiṣamaḥ iti evam iha api asti eva vyākaraṇasya grantha saṃdarbha rūpa tā asti eva avayava rūpa tā tatra avasthā bhedāt upapannaḥ vyapadeśaḥ sāmānya viśeṣa bhāvāt vā iha sūtram iti sāmānya abhidhātṛ jñāyate

original: kasyeti viśeṣabhāve cānanyatvavādino 'pi upādīyate vyākaraṇam iti / yadā samudāyavṛttau vyākaraṇaśabdaḥ kvacid eva ca sūtre sūtraśabdas tadā mukhyavadabhedaḥ / tatra viśeṣa eva sāmānyam eva vā /
analyzed: kasya iti viśeṣa bhāve upādīyate vyākaraṇam iti yadā samudāya vṛttau vyākaraṇa śabdaḥ kvacid eva ca sūtre sūtra śabdaḥ tadā mukhya vat abhedaḥ tatra viśeṣaḥ eva sāmānyam eva vā

original: tat nāsti vyapadeśivadbhāvaḥ / candanasya candanaṃ rūpādayo rūpādīnām iti / sāmānyaviśeṣabhāve tv ananyatvavādino 'pi bhavati vyapadeśaḥ candanasya gandha iti / avijānata etad evaṃ bhavati / etad uktaṃ bhavati / kaścid vyākhyānato 'pi na pratipadyate / kiṃ tarhi / akṣinikocādibhiḥ / tatra kiṃ śakyate vaktum / abhinayāt śabdapratipattir iti /
analyzed: tat na asti vyapadeśivat bhāvaḥ candanasya candanam rūpa ādayaḥ rūpa ādīnām iti sāmānya viśeṣa bhāve tu ananyatva vādinaḥ u pi bhavati vyapadeśaḥ candanasya gandhaḥ iti avijānataḥ etat evam bhavati etat uktam bhavati kaścid na pratipadyate kim tarhi akṣi nikoca ādibhiḥ tatra kim śakyate vaktum abhinayāt śabda pratipattiḥ iti

original: tatraivaṃ pratipattavyam / pratipadaṃ nopāyā ete / sūtrāt tv abhivyaktiḥ / sūtrād eva tv abhivyaktārthāc chabdapravṛttir iti / yad etad udāharaṇādīnām upādānam etan nānutantrāṇāṃ bhāṣyasya vā brūyāt śabdāntaraṃ pratipadyeteti / kiṃ tarhi / anabhibyaktaṃ sūtre abhivyañjayed iti / etam eva cārthaṃ samarthayate /
analyzed: tatra evam pratipattavyam pratipadam na upāyāḥ ete sūtrāt tu abhivyaktiḥ sūtrāt eva tu abhivyakta arthāt śabda pravṛttiḥ iti yat etat udāharaṇa ādīnām upādānam etat na anutantrāṇām bhāṣyasya vā brūyāt śabda antaram pratipadyeta iti kim tarhi an abhibyaktam sūtre abhivyañjayet iti etam eva ca artham samarthayate

original: yo hy utsūtraṃ kathayen nādo gṛhyate / na tat gṛhyate / kimartha punarutsūtraṃ na gṛhyate / ucyate / smṛtiśāstram idam / tatra yadā kaścid evam eva brūyāt ayaṃ śabda iti so 'vaśyaṃ pṛcchyeta katham asmābhiḥ pratyetavyam iti / yadi smṛtisūtram āha saṃdhīyate 'thāpralāpas tasya gṛhyate / yathā pāṇinīyasūtram idaṃ nāsti nyāṅkoḥ pratiṣedha iti /
analyzed: yaḥ hi utsūtram kathayet nādaḥ gṛhyate na tat gṛhyate punar utsūtram na gṛhyate ucyate smṛti śāstram idam tatra yadā kaścid evam eva brūyāt ayam śabdaḥ iti saḥ vaśyam pṛcchyeta katham asmābhiḥ pratyetavyam iti yadi smṛti sūtram āha saṃdhīyate tasya gṛhyate yathā pāṇinīya sūtram idam na asti pratiṣedhaḥ iti

original: tatraivaṃ vipratipattiḥ / naiyaṅkavam iti bhavitavyam iti / yas tv evaṃ prayuñjīta nyāṅkavam iti na vayam apaśabda iti pratipannāḥ / yadi tv asau smṛtyantaraṃ pradarśayati tasya hi pratiṣedhaḥ smṛtyantare / yatheha nyagrodhasya ca kevalasyeti muktasaṃśayaṃ pratipadyāmahe śabdo 'yam iti /
analyzed: tatra evam vipratipattiḥ naiyaṅkavam iti bhavitavyam iti yaḥ tu evam prayuñjīta nyāṅkavam iti na vayam apaśabdaḥ iti pratipannāḥ yadi tu asau smṛti antaram pradarśayati tasya hi pratiṣedhaḥ smṛti antare yathā iha nyagrodhasya ca kevalasya iti mukta saṃśayam pratipadyāmahe śabdaḥ yam iti

original: tasmād idam eva pratipattavyaṃ sūtrād evodāharaṇādīni jñātārthāt śabdapravṛttir iti /
analyzed: tasmāt idam eva pratipattavyam sūtrāt eva udāharaṇa ādīni jñāta arthāt śabda pravṛttiḥ iti

original: [14.1] kimartho varṇānām upadeśaḥ / arthaprayukte śabdaprayoge dharmaniyamaḥ / na tatraite 'rthavantaḥ / tatraiṣām upadeśo 'narthakaḥ / samudāyārtho 'py upadeśo na saṃbhavati / dhātuprātipadikapratyayānām upadeśe tatsthānāṃ varṇānām apy upadeśa iti / vṛttisamavāyārtha upadeśaḥ / na hy eṣāṃ svarūpāvadhāraṇārtha upadeśaḥ / kiṃ tarhi /
analyzed: kimarthaḥ varṇānām upadeśaḥ artha prayukte śabda prayoge dharma niyamaḥ na tatra ete rthavantaḥ tatra eṣām upadeśaḥ narthakaḥ samudāya arthaḥ u pi upadeśaḥ na saṃbhavati dhātu prātipadika pratyayānām upadeśe tad sthānām varṇānām api upadeśaḥ iti vṛtti samavāya arthaḥ upadeśaḥ na hi eṣām svarūpa avadhāraṇa arthaḥ upadeśaḥ kim tarhi

original: ānupūrvyārthaḥ / anenānupūrvyeṇa śāstre kiṃcit kāryaṃ kuryur iti / yad va śāstrāṅgopasaṃhārārtham etad ity evamartham ācaṣṭe / vṛttaye samavāyo vṛttisamavāya iti / ṣaṣṭhīsamāso 'yam / bhedas tādarthyena pradarśyate 'śvaghāsavat / vṛttyartho vā samavāya iti / vṛttyarthasamavāyasya vṛttiṃ prati nimittabhāvaḥ ākhyāyate /
analyzed: ānupūrvya arthaḥ anena ānupūrvyeṇa śāstre kiṃcid kāryam kuryuḥ iti yat śāstra aṅga upasaṃhāra artham etat iti evamartham ācaṣṭe vṛttaye samavāyaḥ vṛtti samavāyaḥ iti ṣaṣṭhī samāsaḥ yam bhedaḥ tādarthyena pradarśyate śvaghāsa vat vṛtti arthaḥ vā samavāyaḥ iti vṛtti artha samavāyasya vṛttim prati nimitta bhāvaḥ ākhyāyate

original: yathāsaṃkhyaṃ hi saṃniveśamātrād eva pravartate / pravṛttyarthaś cāsau samavāyaś ceti pravṛttisamavāya iti / yathā śākapārthiva iti / vṛttiprayojano vā iti / pārasparyeṇa nimittabhāvo nirdiśyate / pāramparyeṇa śāstrapravṛttiḥ samavāyasya prayojikā / yaiṣānubandhopalakṣitā śāstrapravṛttirakaḥ savarṇa ity asyāḥ pāramparyeṇa samavāyo nimittam iti /
analyzed: yathāsaṃkhyam hi saṃniveśa mātrāt eva pravartate pravṛtti arthaḥ ca asau samavāyaḥ ca iti pravṛtti samavāyaḥ iti yathā śāka pārthivaḥ iti vṛtti prayojanaḥ vā iti pārasparyeṇa nimitta bhāvaḥ nirdiśyate pāramparyeṇa śāstra pravṛttiḥ samavāyasya prayojikā yā eṣā anubandha upalakṣitā śāstra pravṛttiḥ akaḥ savarṇaḥ iti asyāḥ pāramparyeṇa samavāyaḥ nimittam iti

original: etac ca bhāṣye 'pi drakṣyata eva / kā punar vṛttiḥ / śāstrapravṛttiḥ / kuta evam / vṛttir iti kriyā / kriyā ca sādhanākāṅkṣiṇī / tatra prākaraṇikaṃ śabdānuśāsanaśāstraṃ sādhanatvena pratīyate / śāstrapravṛttau yaḥ samavāyas tadartho varṇānām upadeśaḥ / kim upadiśyate 'nenety upadeśaḥ / na / na hy etaiḥ kiṃcid upadiśyate /
analyzed: etat ca bhāṣye drakṣyate eva kā punar vṛttiḥ śāstra pravṛttiḥ kutas evam vṛttiḥ iti kriyā kriyā ca sādhana ākāṅkṣiṇī tatra prākaraṇikam śabda anuśāsana śāstram sādhana tvena pratīyate śāstra pravṛttau yaḥ samavāyaḥ tad arthaḥ varṇānām upadeśaḥ kim upadiśyate nena iti upadeśaḥ na na hi etaiḥ kiṃcid upadiśyate

original: itaro bhāvasādhanatvam ācaṣṭe / uccāraṇam / kuta etat / diśir uccāraṇakriyaḥ / uccārya hi varṇānāhopadiṣṭā mayā varṇā iti / iha yasmin vyāpāre nivṛtte 'nantaro yaḥ śabdaḥ prayujyate tasya tādarthyaṃ vijñāyate / yathā bhuktavatsu praviṣṭeṣu brāhmaṇeṣu bhuktam brāhmaṇaiḥ praviṣṭā brāhmaṇā iti / gamyate etan nūnam ayaṃ bhujeḥ praviśeś cārtha iti /
analyzed: itaraḥ bhāva sādhanatvam ācaṣṭe uccāraṇam kutas etat diśiḥ uccāraṇa kriyaḥ uccārya hi varṇān āha upadiṣṭāḥ mayā varṇāḥ iti iha yasmin vyāpāre nivṛtte nantaraḥ yaḥ śabdaḥ prayujyate tasya tādarthyam vijñāyate yathā bhuktavatsu praviṣṭeṣu brāhmaṇeṣu bhuktam brāhmaṇaiḥ praviṣṭāḥ brāhmaṇāḥ iti gamyate etat nūnam ayam bhujeḥ praviśeḥ ca arthaḥ iti

original: evam ihāpi varṇeṣūccāriteṣpanantaraṃ pṛcchati kimartha upadeśa iti / te pratipadyāmahe diśir uccāraṇakriya iti /
analyzed: evam iha api pṛcchati kimarthaḥ upadeśaḥ iti te pratipadyāmahe diśiḥ uccāraṇa kriyaḥ iti

original: [14.2] anubandhakaraṇārthaś ca / anubandhakaraṇaṃ śāstrasya pravṛttyaṅgam avaśyaṃ kartavyam / taccopadeśam antareṇa na bhavati / tatrānubandhā hala eva / ayaṃ tv ekaḥ ajanubandhaḥ laṇ iti lakāre akāraḥ / uraṇ rapara ity atra ca ṛkāralkārayo ralaparatvārthaḥ / pratyāhārārtham / pratyāhāro nāma vistīrṇasya yaḥ saṃkṣepaḥ /
analyzed: anubandha karaṇa arthaḥ ca anubandha karaṇam śāstrasya pravṛtti aṅgam avaśyam kartavyam tat ca upadeśam antareṇa na bhavati tatra anubandhāḥ ha laḥ eva ayam tu ekaḥ a c anubandhaḥ laṭ iti lakāre akāraḥ ra paraḥ iti atra ca ṛkāra lkārayoḥ ra la para tva arthaḥ pratyāhāra artham pratyāhāraḥ nāma vistīrṇasya yaḥ saṃkṣepaḥ

original: tatrādirantyena sahetyayaṃ pratyāhāro na saṃniveśam anubandhāṃś cāntareṇāstīti idam ucyate / samavāyaś cānubandhakaraṇaṃ ca pratyāhārārtham / pratyāhāro vṛttyarthaḥ / akaḥ savarṇe dīrgha eco 'yavāyāva iti /
analyzed: tatra ādiḥ antyena saha iti ayam pratyāhāraḥ na saṃniveśam anubandhān ca antareṇa asti iti idam ucyate samavāyaḥ ca anubandha karaṇam ca pratyāhāra artham pratyāhāraḥ vṛtti arthaḥ a kaḥ savarṇe dīrghaḥ e caḥ yava āyāvaḥ iti

original: [14.3] iṣṭabuddhyarthaś ca varṇānām upadeśaḥ / upadeśe hi sati yathābhūtā uccāritās tathābhūtāḥ sādhavo viparītāḥ tv asādhava iti sādhutvapratipattyartham api kartavya upadeśa iti / udāttādīnām apy upadeśaḥ kartavyaḥ / ete hi varṇā ekaśrutyā paṭhitā acmātṛkā / tad atrodāttādibhinnānāṃ bhinnakālānāṃ ca sādhutvaṃ prāptamataḥ sarva upadeṣṭavyāḥ /
analyzed: iṣṭa buddhi arthaḥ ca varṇānām upadeśaḥ upadeśe hi sati yathābhūtāḥ uccāritāḥ tathābhūtāḥ sādhavaḥ viparītāḥ tu asādhavaḥ iti sādhu tva pratipatti artham api kartavyaḥ upadeśaḥ iti udātta ādīnām api upadeśaḥ kartavyaḥ ete hi varṇāḥ eka śrutyā paṭhitāḥ a c mātṛkā tat atra udātta ādi bhinnānām bhinna kālānām ca sādhu tvam prāptam atas sarve upadeṣṭavyāḥ

original: nanu ca sarva evaite śāstreṇānvākhyātā udāttādayaḥ / ucyate / anupadiśyamānānāṃ kiṃbhūtā udāttādayaḥ pratipattavyā iti svarūpeṇānupadeśāt aśakyā teṣu pratipattir iti /
analyzed: nanu ca sarve eva ete śāstreṇa anvākhyātāḥ udātta ādayaḥ ucyate anupadiśyamānānām kiṃbhūtāḥ udātta ādayaḥ pratipattavyāḥ iti svarūpeṇa anupadeśāt aśakyā teṣu pratipattiḥ iti

original: [14.4] ākṛtyupadeśāt siddham / ākṛtyupadeśe nāntarīyako viśeṣaḥ / sa tv anāśritas tasmin kāle iti kālaguṇabhinneṣv ākṛtir astīti pratipatsyante ayam evāsau varṇo yo 'kṣarasamāmnāye upadiṣṭaḥ / yathā ekākṛtyupadeśe bhinneṣv api ca ya ākṛtiviśeṣeṣu sa evāyam iti pratipadyate /
analyzed: ākṛti upadeśāt siddham ākṛti upadeśe nāntarīyakaḥ viśeṣaḥ sa tu anāśritaḥ tasmin kāle iti kāla guṇa bhinneṣu ākṛtiḥ asti iti pratipatsyante ayam eva asau varṇaḥ kṣara samāmnāye upadiṣṭaḥ yathā eka ākṛti upadeśe bhinneṣu api ca yaḥ ākṛti viśeṣeṣu saḥ eva ayam iti pratipadyate

original: tatra yathaivākṛtisadbhāvāt kālaguṇabhinnānāṃ sādhutvam evaṃ guṇasvarabhinnānām apy ākṛtisadbhāvāt prasaktaṃ sādhutvam / atas tannivṛttyarthaṃ yatnaḥ kartavya ity āha / saṃvṛtādīnāṃ pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ / saṃvṛto nāma yo bāhyaḥ prayatnaḥ / ābhyantaro hi prayatno 'kārasya niṣpādakaḥ / naivaṃ kalaḥ / dhmāto yaḥ śvāsabhūyiṣṭhaḥ / eṇīkṛto 'vyaktaḥ /
analyzed: tatra yathā eva ākṛti sadbhāvāt kāla guṇa bhinnānām sādhu tvam evam guṇa svara bhinnānām api ākṛti sadbhāvāt prasaktam sādhu tvam atas tad nivṛtti artham yatnaḥ kartavyaḥ iti āha saṃvṛta ādīnām pratiṣedhaḥ vaktavyaḥ saṃvṛtaḥ nāma yaḥ bāhyaḥ prayatnaḥ ābhyantaraḥ hi prayatnaḥ ukārasya niṣpādakaḥ na evam kalaḥ dhmātaḥ yaḥ śvāsa bhūyiṣṭhaḥ eṇīkṛtaḥ vyaktaḥ

original: etāḥ svaradoṣabhāvanāḥ / etāni svaradoṣagotrāṇi / avagato hi vaktṝṇāṃ pramādāśaktijaḥ svaradoṣa iti / gargādibidādipāṭhāt saṃvṛtādīnāṃ nivṛttirbhaviṣyati / evaṃ manyate / naiva kvacid varṇā uccāryante / kiṃ tarhi / śabdasamudāyā eva paṭhyante / varṇātmakaś ca samudāyaḥ / samudāyaś ca nivṛttakalādikaḥ paṭhyate /
analyzed: etāḥ svara doṣa bhāvanāḥ etāni svara doṣa gotrāṇi avagataḥ hi vaktṝṇām pramāda aśakti jaḥ svara doṣaḥ iti garga ādi bida ādi pāṭhāt saṃvṛta ādīnām nivṛttiḥ bhaviṣyati evam manyate na eva kvacid varṇāḥ uccāryante kim tarhi śabda samudāyāḥ eva paṭhyante varṇa ātmakaḥ ca samudāyaḥ samudāyaḥ ca nivṛtta kalā ādikaḥ paṭhyate

original: atra siddhā saṃvṛtādīnāṃ nivṛttir iti / asty anyad gargādibidādipāthe prayojanam / etad uktaṃ bhavati / evam artho gargādibidādipāthaḥ / katham / anena saṃniveśena sādhutvaṃ syād anyena mā bhūt / garga iti / kiṃ vā kartavyam / pāṭhasthitānāṃ kalādinivṛttiḥ kṛtā syāt / yāni tu na paṭhyante śabdarūpāṇi eteṣv anivṛttāḥ kalādaya iti /
analyzed: atra siddhā saṃvṛta ādīnām nivṛttiḥ iti asti anyat garga ādi bida ādi pāthe prayojanam etat uktam bhavati evam arthaḥ garga ādi bida ādi pāthaḥ katham anena saṃniveśena sādhu tvam syāt anyena mā bhūt gargaḥ iti kim vā kartavyam pāṭha sthitānām kalā ādi nivṛttiḥ kṛtā syāt yāni tu na paṭhyante śabda rūpāṇi eteṣu anivṛttāḥ kalā ādayaḥ iti

original: evaṃ tarhi aṣṭādaśadhā bhinnā śāstrānte pratyāpattir yā tāṃ nidarśanaprakāreṇa kariṣyāmīti / kimarthaṃ punar nivṛttakalādikām ity ucyeta / na nivṛttasaṃvṛtādikām iti / saṃvṛtatvāt / kāryārthaṃ kalādayo 'bhupagamyante / śīṅmāsiṃ ca kalaṃ dhmātaṃ vādhyeṣye / ṅkāram akāraṃ ca no 'dhyeṣye / evaṃ ca vakṣyami / kalād dhmātād ātmanepadaṃ bhavati /
analyzed: evam tarhi aṣṭādaśadhā bhinnā śāstra ante pratyāpattiḥ yā tām nidarśana prakāreṇa kariṣyāmi iti kimartham punar nivṛtta kalā ādikām iti ucyeta na nivṛtta saṃvṛta ādikām iti saṃvṛta tvāt kārya artham kalā ādayaḥ ca kalam dhmātam vā adhyeṣye ṅkāram akāram ca no dhyeṣye evam ca vakṣyami kalāt dhmātāt ātmanepadam bhavati

original: atra tv idam aśakyaṃ pratipattum iko yaṇacīti / anubandhe 'sati itsaṃjñāśāstraṃ ca nāstīdam ādir antyena saheteti / tatra yāvanti pratyāhāropalakṣitāni kāryāṇi teṣu sarve nirdeṣṭavyāḥ //
analyzed: atra tu idam aśakyam pratipattum i kaḥ ya ṇ a ci iti anubandhe sati i t saṃjñā śāstram ca na asti idam ādiḥ antyena saheta iti tatra yāvanti pratyāhāra upalakṣitāni kāryāṇi teṣu sarve nirdeṣṭavyāḥ

original: [14.5] evaṃ tarhy ubhayam anena kriyate / samavāyaś ca sādhutvena pratipādyate / yathākārādayas te caivaṃbhūtā eva nirdiṣṭāḥ / kalādikāḥ sarvatrāsādhava iti / kathaṃ punae ekena yatnenobhayaṃ labhyam / iha saṃdhyakṣareṣu samudāyapara upadeśa iti nāvayavau varṇakāryaṃ pratipadyete /
analyzed: evam tarhi ubhayam anena kriyate samavāyaḥ ca sādhu tvena pratipādyate yathā ākāra ādayaḥ te ca evaṃbhūtāḥ eva nirdiṣṭāḥ kalā ādikāḥ sarvatra asādhavaḥ iti katham ekena yatnena ubhayam labhyam iha saṃdhyakṣareṣu samudāya paraḥ upadeśaḥ iti na avayavau varṇa kāryam pratipadyete

original: yathā varṇānām upadeśo 'vayavavinirjñānārtha ity akṣarasamāmnāye 'vayavā evāśrīyante na samudāyaḥ / evaṃ gargādibidādipāthe 'vayavā eva vinirjijñāsitāḥ syus tadanurodhāt tu samudāyopādānam / atha vā samudāyā eva / yadi samudāyās tatrāvayavānām evaṃviṣayāṇāṃ kalādyabhāvaḥ syāt / anyatra nivarteta eva / athāvayavaparam /
analyzed: yathā varṇānām upadeśaḥ vayava vinirjñāna arthaḥ iti akṣara samāmnāye vayavāḥ eva āśrīyante na samudāyaḥ evam garga ādi bida ādi pāthe vayavāḥ eva vinirjijñāsitāḥ syuḥ tad anurodhāt tu samudāya upādānam atha vā samudāyāḥ eva yadi samudāyāḥ tatra avayavānām evaṃviṣayāṇām kalā ādi abhāvaḥ syāt anyatra nivarteta eva atha avayava param

original: tasya kevalaṃ śaktyavacchedamātraṃ kriyate / śveto gaur iti / śvā sa ita iti prayoktā prayuṅkte / pratipattāraḥ yathāśaktyavacchedenārthaṃ pratipadyante / arthāntareṇa dvāvetau śabdāv uccāritau / yathā pradīpas tantreṇa pravartamāno 'rthināṃ yathābhipretam arthaṃ nirvartayati / ekasyaiva vā vidyādikā didṛkṣoś ca tantreṇa nirvartayati /

original: evaṃ śabdeṣu tādṛśīṃ kriyām āpāditakaraṇaparispandāṃ yathā tantreṇa dvād eva śabdāv uccāryete / upāyadvayaṃ ca loke śabdaprayogo vā yaugapadyaṃ vā / kadācit kramavataḥ śabdān prayuṅkte / sa katham / akṣo bhajyatām akṣo dīvyatām iti / kadācid upasaṃhṛtya kramaṃ yaugapadyenoccārayati / akṣā bhajyantāṃ dīvyantām iti /

analyzed: atha vā idam tāvat ayam praṣṭavyaḥ iti ayam abhiprāyaḥ sarveṣu eva amī samudāya sthāḥ upadiṣṭāḥ tatra siddhā eva kalā ādi nivṛttiḥ iti dhātavaḥ api śuddhāḥ paṭhyante culumpa ādayaḥ api bhāṣye eva uccāryante iti abhiprāyaḥ yāni tarhi agrahaṇāni ḍittha ādīni eteṣām api avaśyam svara varṇa ānupūrvī jñāna artham upadeśaḥ kartavyaḥ

original: atha vā gargādibidādīnāṃ ca svaravarṇānupūrvyarthe upadeśaḥ kartavyaḥ / evaṃ smaryate / iha yad eṣām uccāraṇaṃ tat pratyayavidhyartham iti / atha vā anenaivaṃ bruvatā etadāśritaṃ vyutpādyante ete sarva iti / ye na vyutpādyante teṣāṃ ko vṛttāntaḥ / ucyate / etamarthaṃ pratipādayati / ye 'py ete gargādayaḥ paṭhitāḥ ete 'pi na pāṇininotpāditāḥ /

analyzed: kim tarhi evaṃbhūtāḥ iti te smaryante yathā eva te evaṃbhūtāḥ eva smaryante evam anye pi śabdāḥ sāmānyena pratipāditāḥ uṇādayaḥ bahulam iti anena pratyayataḥ prakṛteḥ ca tat ūhyam iti śiṣṭa prayogam abhisamīkṣya prakṛtiḥ ūhitavyā pratyayaḥ ca avaśyam ca etat evam pratipattavyam iti tathā hi

original: [1.1] tatrākāra iti kāraśabdaḥ pratyayo "varṇāt kāraḥ" (P 3.3.108, vt. 3) iti / varṇavācino varṇāt svārthe varṇābhidheyatāyāṃ (? varṇābhidhāyino 'yaṃ) pratyaya iti / vākyasthenākāreṇa sūtrasthaḥ 'aiuṇ' ity akāro vyapadiśyate / atha kakāra iti kathaṃ pratyayaḥ? ny hya [hy ayaṃ] varṇaḥ / kiṃ tarhi? varṇasamudāyaḥ / naiṣa doṣaḥ /

original: [3.1] yugapaddeśapṛthaktvadarśanāt (vt. 12) / deśapṛthaktvenākārasya darśanaṃ yugapad asti / ayam ekatvavirodhī dharmaḥ / na hy eko devadatto yugapad deśapṛthaktvenopalabhyate / akāras tūpalabhyate / tasmād aneko 'kā ['kāra] iti / anyatve hetudvayam upanyastam /
analyzed: yugapad deśa pṛthaktva darśanāt vt deśa pṛthaktvena akārasya darśanam yugapad asti ayam ekatva virodhī dharmaḥ na hi ekaḥ devadattaḥ yugapad deśa pṛthaktvena upalabhyate akāraḥ tu upalabhyate tasmāt anekaḥ kāraḥ iti anyatve hetu dvayam upanyastam

original: ekasya parihāram āha---yad ucyate bhavatā 'kālaśabdavyavāyāt' iti, atra brūmaḥ---yadi punar ime varṇāḥ śakunivat syuḥ iti / etad uktaṃ bhavati---yo 'yaṃ vyavāyaḥ parikalpyate bhavatā kālaśabdābhyām, nāyaṃ vastuno vyavāyaḥ / kiṃ tarhi? vyañjakasya nimittasya pravṛttinivṛttibhyām upalabdhyanupalabdhī ete /
analyzed: ekasya parihāram āha yat ucyate bhavatā kāla śabda vyavāyāt iti atra brūmaḥ yadi punar ime varṇāḥ śakuni vat syuḥ iti etat uktam bhavati yaḥ yam vyavāyaḥ parikalpyate bhavatā kāla śabdābhyām na ayam vastunaḥ vyavāyaḥ kim tarhi vyañjakasya nimittasya pravṛtti nivṛttibhyām upalabdhi anupalabdhī ete

original: yad abhivyañjakanimittatvam akāsya [akārasya] tad varṇāntarābhivyañjake nimitte pravṛtte apravartamānaṃ nopalambhayati akāram, punaḥpravartamānam upalambhayati / tasmād upalabdhyanupalabdhyoḥ pravṛttinivṛttibhyām idaṃ bhavati, na tu vastuno bhedāt /
analyzed: yat abhivyañjaka nimitta tvam akā asya akārasya tat varṇa antara abhivyañjake nimitte pravṛtte a pravartamānam na upalambhayati akāram punar pravartamānam upalambhayati tasmāt upalabdhi anupalabdhyoḥ pravṛtti nivṛttibhyām idam bhavati na tu vastunaḥ bhedāt

original: yathā śakuniḥ pūrvaḥ paraś ca vastuno bhinnaḥ śakunyantareṇa vyavahita iti? etat tu śakyate vaktum, pūrvam anupalabdhaḥ saṃpraty upalabdhaḥ iti / evaṃ ca kṛtvedam āha---evam ayam akāro d ity atra dṛṣṭo da ity atropalabdhaḥ ṇḍa ity atra dṛśyate palabhyate [upalabhyate] / naivaṃ śakyam / anityatvam evaṃ syāt / asty ayaṃ tarkāśritaḥ samādhiḥ /
analyzed: yathā śakuniḥ pūrvaḥ paraḥ ca vastunaḥ bhinnaḥ śakuni antareṇa vyavahitaḥ iti etat tu śakyate vaktum pūrvam anupalabdhaḥ saṃprati upalabdhaḥ iti evam ca kṛtvā idam āha evam ayam akāraḥ d iti atra dṛṣṭaḥ daḥ iti atra upalabdhaḥ iti atra dṛśyate upalabhyate na evam śakyam anitya tvam evam syāt asti ayam tarka āśritaḥ samādhiḥ

original: śāstrasiddhāntas tu na bhavati / śāstre hy arthavataḥ śabdasya nityatvaṃ pratijñātam, padasya vākyasya vā / sa ca samudāyo 'bhyupagataḥ śāstre / samudāyaś ca varṇātmaka eva / (p. 9) tatraikatvapratijñāne karkaḥ, sa varṇasamudāyo nāsti / kakāro dvirupalabdho 'kāraś ca, rephaś ca sakṛd iti śakyaṃ vaktuṃ kar ityevaṃlakṣaṇaḥ samudāya iti /
analyzed: śāstra siddhāntaḥ tu na bhavati śāstre hi arthavataḥ śabdasya nitya tvam pratijñātam padasya vākyasya vā sa ca samudāyaḥ bhyupagataḥ śāstre samudāyaḥ ca varṇa ātmakaḥ eva tatra ekatva pratijñāne karkaḥ sa varṇa samudāyaḥ na asti kakāraḥ dvis upalabdhaḥ u kāraḥ ca rephaḥ ca sakṛt iti śakyam vaktum kaḥ iti evaṃlakṣaṇaḥ samudāyaḥ iti

original: evaṃ kāruka ity ayam api kāru ityevaṃlakṣaṇaḥ / asya ca prayogābhāvād arthavattaiva nāsti / tasmād abhyupagantavyam etat, avasthitā evāmī samudāyā artheṣu, bhinnair eva varṇair anugatā iti / yadi tu punar amī varṇā ādityavat syuḥ / yugapaddeśapṛthaktvadarśanād ity asya vyabhicāraḥ / ekasyāpi ātyasya [ādityasya] deśapṛthaktveṣūpalabdhiḥ dṛṣṭā /
analyzed: evam kārukaḥ iti ayam api iti evaṃlakṣaṇaḥ asya ca prayoga abhāvāt arthavat tā eva na asti tasmāt abhyupagantavyam etat avasthitāḥ eva amī samudāyāḥ artheṣu bhinnaiḥ eva varṇaiḥ anugatāḥ iti yadi tu punar amī varṇāḥ āditya vat syuḥ yugapad deśa pṛthaktva darśanāt iti asya vyabhicāraḥ ekasya api ātyasya ādityasya deśa pṛthaktveṣu upalabdhiḥ dṛṣṭā

original: tatrākāro devadatte narātmani punar āditye neti viṣamahetur iti (?) / viṣama upanyāsaḥ / etad ācaṣṭe---evaṃ mayoktam, na devadattam eko draṣṭā yugapat deśeṣūpalabhate [deśapṛthaktveṣūpalabhate] / ādityam api ca nopalabhate / yo hy upalabdhā sākete, nāsāv eva saurāṣṭrike / yo vṛkṣasyopariṣṭād āditya . . . upalabhate /
analyzed: tatra akāraḥ devadatte nara ātmani punar āditye na iti viṣama hetuḥ iti viṣamaḥ upanyāsaḥ etat ācaṣṭe evam mayā uktam na devadattam ekaḥ draṣṭā yugapad deśeṣu upalabhate deśa pṛthaktveṣu upalabhate ādityam api ca na upalabhate yaḥ hi upalabdhā sākete na asau eva saurāṣṭrike yaḥ vṛkṣasya upariṣṭāt ādityaḥ upalabhate

original: akāraṃ rupalabhate [punar upalabhate] / yasyāpi ca kṣaṇaviṣayam upalabdhiyaugapadyaṃ nāsti, tasyāpy ādityasyopabdhyā [ādityasyopalabdhyā] visadṛśy upalabdhir akārasya, muhūrtaviṣayasyopalabdhiyaugapadyasya saṃbhavāt / na cākāśam ekam / tasmāt dekadeśatvam akārasyānupapannam / akāram api nopalabhate /
analyzed: akāram punar upalabhate yasya api ca kṣaṇa viṣayam upalabdhi yaugapadyam na asti tasya api ādityasya upabdhyāḥ ādityasya upalabdhyāḥ visadṛśī upalabdhiḥ akārasya muhūrta viṣayasya upalabdhi yaugapadyasya saṃbhavāt na ca ākāśam ekam tasmāt d eka deśa tvam akārasya anupapannam akāram api na upalabhate

original: yady akārasya bhedāḥ syur upapadyate pṛthaktvam / tathaika eva deśaḥ śabdasyāpy ākāśaḥ / tasmād ahetur ayaṃ 'yugapaddeśapṛthaktvadarśanāt' iti / śrotropalabdhir buddhir grāhyaḥ [buddhinirgrāhyaḥ] prayogeṇābhijvalitaḥ / kimartham etad upādīyate? ucyate / vyabhicāriṇāṃ [avyabhicāriṇāṃ] dharmāṇāṃ pradarśanārtham /
analyzed: yadi akārasya bhedāḥ syuḥ upapadyate pṛthaktvam tathā ekaḥ eva deśaḥ śabdasya api ākāśaḥ tasmāt ahetuḥ ayam yugapad deśa pṛthaktva darśanāt iti śrotra upalabdhiḥ buddhiḥ grāhyaḥ buddhi nirgrāhyaḥ prayogeṇa abhijvalitaḥ kimartham etat upādīyate ucyate vyabhicāriṇām avyabhicāriṇām dharmāṇām pradarśana artham

original: śrotropalabdhitvam avyabhicaritam iti / na jātucit cakṣuṣā dṛśyate / tathā buddhinirgrāhyatvāt nānyena nirgṛhyate / dhvaninā vyajyamāno na pradīpādibhir abhivyajyate / evam ākāśam avyabhicāri / tasmān [nānyabhāvyam akārasya] / yā tv ekadeśasya sataḥ pṛthagdeśasyopalabdhiḥ, sā nimittakāraṇavaśāt /
analyzed: śrotra upalabdhi tvam avyabhicaritam iti na jātucit cakṣuṣā dṛśyate tathā buddhi nirgrāhya tvāt na anyena nirgṛhyate dhvaninā vyajyamānaḥ na pradīpa ādibhiḥ abhivyajyate evam ākāśam avyabhicāri tasmāt na anya bhāvyam akārasya yā tu eka deśasya sataḥ pṛthak deśasya upalabdhiḥ sā nimitta kāraṇa vaśāt

original: idaṃ tvayoktam 'na hy eko devadatto yugat [yugapat] srughne ca bhavati [mathurāyāṃ ca]' / atra brūmaḥ---pṛthivyā ekatvāt tad iha yo devadattaḥ kasmān na srughnaḥ kasmiṃścin mathureti (?), evam ākāśasyāpy ekadeśatve sati deśabahuvyavahāraḥ [deśabahutvavyavahāraḥ] pravartiṣyate / ākāśadeśā api bahavaḥ /
analyzed: idam tvayā uktam na hi ekaḥ devadattaḥ yugat yugapad srughne ca bhavati mathurāyām ca atra brūmaḥ pṛthivyāḥ ekatvāt tat iha yaḥ devadattaḥ kasmāt na srughnaḥ kasmiṃścid mathurā iti evam ākāśasya api eka deśa tve sati deśa bahu vyavahāraḥ deśa bahu tva vyavahāraḥ pravartiṣyate ākāśa deśāḥ api bahavaḥ

original: nanu ca pṛthivī svair avayavair ārabdheti tatrāvayavā deśatvena yuktāḥ / anārabdhaṃ ca punar ākāśam / satyam, evam etat / te tv avayavā atadātmānaḥ santaḥ samavāyitvād vyapadiśyante / evaṃ kiṃ na gṛhyate vṛkṣādibhiḥ saṃyogād ihākāśam iti vyapadiśyate / etāvāṃs tu viśeṣaḥ---samavāyino deśā vastusaṃpramohahetunā samavāyenaikātmyam iva nītāḥ /
analyzed: nanu ca pṛthivī svaiḥ avayavaiḥ ārabdhā iti tatra avayavāḥ deśa tvena yuktāḥ anārabdham ca punar ākāśam satyam evam etat te tu avayavāḥ a tad ātmānaḥ santaḥ samavāyi tvāt vyapadiśyante evam kim na gṛhyate vṛkṣa ādibhiḥ saṃyogāt iha ākāśam iti vyapadiśyate etāvān tu viśeṣaḥ samavāyinaḥ deśāḥ vastu saṃpramoha hetunā samavāyena aikātmyam iva nītāḥ

original: ātaś ca nītā yad anityatvam api kecit pratipannāḥ / (p. 10) avayavāvayavino deśavyavahāre tu nāsti kaścit prativiśeṣaḥ / tasmād deśabahutvāt sthito hetuḥ, 'yugapaddeśapṛthaktvadarśanād ānyabhāvyam akārasya' iti /
analyzed: ā atas ca nītāḥ yat anitya tvam api kecid pratipannāḥ avayava avayavinaḥ deśa vyavahāre tu na asti kaścid prativiśeṣaḥ tasmāt deśa bahu tvāt sthitaḥ hetuḥ yugapad deśa pṛthaktva darśanāt ānya bhāvyam akārasya iti

original: [4] ākṛtigrahaṇāt tu siddham (vt. 13) / pratyāhāre anuvṛttinirdeśe ca jātir eva codyate, na vyaktiḥ / vyaktyupādānaṃ tu yathā nālikeredvīpanivāsinaḥ (? nālikeradvīpanivāsinā) idam upadiśyate---ayaṃ gaur eva tvayā na padā spraṣṭavya iti / sa taṃ bālaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ kṛśaṃ copadiṣṭo vṛddhaṃ śabalaṃ sthūlam api na spṛśati /
analyzed: ākṛti grahaṇāt tu siddham v t pratyāhāre anuvṛtti nirdeśe ca jātiḥ eva codyate na vyaktiḥ vyakti upādānam tu yathā nālikeredvīpa nivāsinaḥ nālikeradvīpa nivāsinā idam upadiśyate ayam gauḥ eva tvayā na padā spraṣṭavyaḥ iti sa tam bālam kṛṣṇam kṛśam ca upadiṣṭaḥ vṛddham śabalam sthūlam api na spṛśati

original: tasyās tv ākṛter na vyavadhānaṃ vyavacchedo [vā] / vivṛtatvam, ye cānye dharmāḥ, sarve te vyaktidvārakāḥ / tatra pratyāhāre vivṛtākṛtir upadiṣṭā, tasyā eva ca śāstrānte pratyāpattir iti sarvaṃ siddham / yatra tv ākāragrahaṇe jātinirdeśād akāragrahaṇaṃ prāpnoti / tat tu na ca prāpnoti, prayatnabhedāt / yathā 'pūrvavayā brāhmaṇaḥ pratyuttheyaḥ' /

original: atra codyate―yathaiva pratyayasaṃjñā saṃdihyamānānyāsām apy anuvṛttau saṃbhavantyāṃ sannādiṣu kṛtārthā asaṃdihyamānā[bhiḥ] kṛtkṛtyataddhitatadrājasaṃjñābhir akṛtārthābhiḥ sammucīyate, evam iha kasmāt sammucayo na bhavati? iti / atrocyate / pratyayasaṃjñāyāḥ saṃjñipratipattyarthatve pratipattir na tu pradeśe kenacid vyāpāreṇopakariṣyata iti /
analyzed: atra codyate yathā eva pratyaya saṃjñā saṃdihyamānā anyāsām api anuvṛttau saṃbhavantyām sanna ādiṣu kṛtārthā a saṃdihyamānābhiḥ kṛt kṛtya taddhita tad rāja saṃjñābhiḥ akṛtārthābhiḥ sammucīyate evam iha kasmāt sammucayaḥ na bhavati iti atra ucyate pratyaya saṃjñāyāḥ saṃjñi pratipatti artha tve pratipattiḥ na tu pradeśe kenacid vyāpāreṇa upakariṣyate iti

original: bhinnakālatvād avirodhāc ca viśeṣasaṃjābhiḥ sammucīyate / iha tu‘vṛddhir ādaij’iti nirdeśād idaṃ samadhigamyate so 'yam abhisaṃbandhenāntarīkṛtya saṃjñinaḥ saṃjñāvyapadeśo 'yam iti / svaritaliṅgāsaṅgāc cedaṃ vyaktaṃ,‘'iko guṇavṛddhī’ity atropasthitavṛddhiśabdena sāhacaryāt pradeśe kaścid upakāraḥ kariṣyata iti /
analyzed: bhinna kāla tvāt avirodhāt ca viśeṣa saṃjābhiḥ sammucīyate iha nirdeśāt idam samadhigamyate saḥ yam abhisaṃbandhena antarīkṛtya saṃjñinaḥ saṃjñā vyapadeśaḥ yam iti svarita liṅga āsaṅgāt ca idam guṇa vṛddhī iti atra upasthita vṛddhi śabdena sāhacaryāt pradeśe kaścid upakāraḥ kariṣyate iti

original: tatra‘adeṅ guṇaḥ’ity atropasthitaṃ na kaṃ[cid] vyāpāram anuvidhīyate / kiṃ saṃjñāvyāpāram uta saṃjñivyāpāram iti saṃjñātvam evāsya saṃdihyamānam asaṃdigdho liṅgāsaṅgaḥ /‘adeṅ guṇaḥ’iti guṇaśabdasya saṃjñātvam asaṃdihyamānam / tatra saṃdihyamānasaṃjñāvyāpāreṇāsaṃdihyamānasaṃjñāvyāpārasya samakakṣatā na yukteti suṣṭhūcyate prakṛtsyāpavāda iti /
analyzed: tatra a d e ṅ guṇaḥ iti atra upasthitam na kaṃcid vyāpāram anuvidhīyate kim saṃjñā vyāpāram uta saṃjñi vyāpāram iti saṃjñā tvam eva asya saṃdihyamānam asaṃdigdhaḥ liṅga asaṅgaḥ guṇaḥ iti guṇa śabdasya saṃjñā tvam asaṃdihyamānam tatra saṃdihyamāna saṃjñā vyāpāreṇa a saṃdihyamāna saṃjñā vyāpārasya samakakṣa tā na yuktā iti suṣṭhu ucyate prakṛt sya apavādaḥ iti

original: [9] atha vā vakṣyaty etad iti / anenaitat pratipādayati―nyāyaprāptā maṇḍūkagatir vyākaraṇenāpi pratipāditeti / tatrānuvṛttasyāpi nirarthitve [asaṃbandhaṃ] vibhāṣāśrutir upasūcayati ity anena [yatrārthitvaṃ tatraiva] saṃnipatitavyam / antarāle tu grāmāntaraṃ gacchata iva mūlopasarpaṇam iti /
analyzed: atha vā vakṣyati etat iti anena etat pratipādayati nyāya prāptā maṇḍūka gatiḥ vyākaraṇena api pratipāditā iti tatra anuvṛttasya api nirarthi tve asaṃbandham vibhāṣā śrutiḥ upasūcayati iti anena yatra arthi tvam tatra eva saṃnipatitavyam antarāle tu grāma antaram gacchataḥ iva mūla upasarpaṇam iti

original: [10]	atha vobhayaṃ nivṛttaṃ tad apekṣiṣyāmahe / nanu cātrānena bhavitavyam, anaṃ[ta]rasya vidhir vā bhavati pratiṣedho veti / yatra hy ubhau svaryete tatrobhāv anumīyete, yatrānyataras tatrānyatamasyānumānam iti / satyam, evam etat / apekṣye tu dvidhā matir bhavati apekṣituḥ, bhedenābhedena ca /
analyzed: atha vā ubhayam nivṛttam tat apekṣiṣyāmahe nanu ca atra anena bhavitavyam anaṃtarasya vidhiḥ vā bhavati pratiṣedhaḥ vā iti yatra hi ubhau svaryete tatra ubhau anumīyete yatra anyataraḥ tatra anyatamasya anumānam iti satyam evam etat apekṣye tu dvidhā matiḥ bhavati apekṣituḥ bhedena abhedena ca

original: abhedena tāvat―devadattaś ca yajñadattaś ca viṣṇumitraś cety abhedenaitad iti / yadā bhedenāpekṣate tadānantareṇa bhavitavyam / yadā tu samudāyam apekṣate tadā samudāya evānantara iti lakṣyavaśād ayaṃ kadācit kiṃcit apekṣata iti /
analyzed: abhedena tāvat devadattaḥ ca yajñadattaḥ ca viṣṇumitraḥ ca iti abhedena etat iti yadā bhedena apekṣate tadā anantareṇa bhavitavyam yadā tu samudāyam apekṣate tadā samudāyaḥ eva anantaraḥ iti lakṣya vaśāt ayam kadācid kiṃcid apekṣate iti

original: [11a] kiṃ punar ayam alontyaśeṣa āhosvid alontyāpavādaḥ? śeṣo 'vayava ekadeśa iti paryāyāḥ / apavādo nivartakaḥ / svayaṃ cobhayam upapādayati, ekavākyatvā[t ta]ccheṣatvaṃ nānāvākyatvāt tadapavādatvam / (1) tat tv ekavākyatvaṃ nānāvākyatvaṃ ca katham iti naivaitad uktam /
analyzed: kim punar ayam alaḥ antya śeṣaḥ āhosvit śeṣaḥ vayavaḥ eka deśaḥ iti paryāyāḥ apavādaḥ nivartakaḥ svayam ca ubhayam upapādayati eka vākya tvāt tad śeṣa tvam nānā vākya tvāt tad apavāda tvam tat tu eka vākya tvam nānā vākya tvam ca katham iti na eva etat uktam

original: kathaṃ caitayor ekavākyatvaṃ syāt, kālabhedena śrutayor anekayogavyavahitayoḥ? (2) sati caikavākyabhāvanimitte nānāvākyasyābhāvāt sati ca nānāvākyabhāvanimitte ekavākyasyābhāvāt saṃdehānupapattiḥ / na caikasminn eva dvayor nānāvākyaikavākyabhāvayoḥ samavasthānam asti /
analyzed: katham ca etayoḥ eka vākya tvam syāt kāla bhedena śrutayoḥ aneka yogavyavahitayoḥ sati ca eka vākya bhāva nimitte nānā vākyasya abhāvāt sati ca nānā vākya bhāva nimitte eka vākyasya abhāvāt saṃdeha anupapattiḥ na ca ekasmin eva dvayoḥ nānā vākya eka vākya bhāvayoḥ samavasthānam asti

original: (3) kim arthāv etāv evopanyastau bādhāṅgāṅgibhāvau, na punar vikalpasamuccayāv api? (4) tathā nānāvākyatvam iha bādhānimittam uktam, anyatra tu samāveśanimittam,“tatra khyunnādipratiṣedho nānāvākyatvāt”(Pā. 3.4.67 Vā. 2) iti / etat sarvaṃ vaktavyam /
analyzed: kim arthau etau eva upanyastau bādhā aṅga aṅgi bhāvau na punar vikalpa samuccayau api tathā nānā vākya tvam iha bādhā nimittam uktam anyatra tu samāveśa nimittam tatra iti etat sarvam vaktavyam

original: [11ā] (1) yat tāvad ucyate, vyavahitayoḥ kathaṃ saṃbandha iti / nānantaryaṃ saṃbandhahetuḥ / evaṃ hy ucyate―“arthato hy asama[rthā]nām ānantaryam akāraṇam”/ yathā,“anaḍvāham udahāri yā tvaṃ vahasi śirasā bhāgini kumbhaṃ abhidhāvantam adrākṣīḥ”iti / eṣām ānantaryeṇāpi samniviṣṭānām upakāro nāsti tasyāḥ kriyāyāḥ / kutaḥ? asaṃbhavāt /
analyzed: yat tāvat ucyate vyavahitayoḥ katham saṃbandhaḥ iti na ānantaryam saṃbandha hetuḥ evam hi ucyate arthataḥ hi asamarthānām ānantaryam akāraṇam yathā anaḍvāham udahāri yā tvam vahasi śirasā bhāgini kumbham abhidhāvantam adrākṣīḥ iti eṣām ānantaryeṇa api samniviṣṭānām upakāraḥ na asti tasyāḥ kriyāyāḥ kutas asaṃbhavāt

original: nāsti anaḍuhaḥ śirasā vahanaṃ kumbhasya ca saraṇam iti / etannibandhanam upalabdhur anyayānupūrvyā buddhiviṣayaṃ vākyāntaram upaplavate / yathaivopāṃśu guṇayaṃs tannibandhanam arthaṃ pratipadyate / kecin manyante―etadupāyam aśabdakam evārthaṃ pratipadyate iti /
analyzed: na asti anaḍuhaḥ śirasā vahanam kumbhasya ca saraṇam iti etat nibandhanam upalabdhuḥ anyayā ānupūrvyā buddhi viṣayam vākya antaram upaplavate yathā eva upāṃśu guṇayan tad nibandhanam artham pratipadyate kecid manyante etat upāyam aśabdakam eva artham pratipadyate iti

original: evaṃ vyākaraṇe 'py arthalakṣaṇaḥ saṃbandho nā[nanta]ryakṛto, yathā‘baḍuṣu baḍuvacanam’(Pā. 1.4.21),‘ṅyāpprātipādikāḍ’(Pā. 4.1.1) iti / etat tu tiṅarthaṃ bhinnadeśam upadiṣṭam / evam ihāpi‘rājñaḥ ka ca’(Pā. 4.2.140) ityevamādyarthaḥ pṛthagupadeśaḥ syāt /
analyzed: evam vyākaraṇe pi artha lakṣaṇaḥ saṃbandhaḥ na ānantarya kṛtaḥ yathā baḍuṣu iti etat tu tiṅ artham bhinna deśam upadiṣṭam evam iha api rājñaḥ ka ca ca iti evamādi arthaḥ pṛthak upadeśaḥ syāt

original: (2) atha cārthalakṣaṇaḥ kasmiṃścid viṣaye saṃbandhaḥ syād iti, yasmiṃś ca viṣaye svanimittaprayukayor etayoḥ saṃnipātas tasminn ubhayam api saṃbhavati, aṅgāṅgibhāvo bādhā cety ataḥ saṃdehaḥ / yatra tv eka eva saṃbhavati tatraikasyaiva pravṛttir yathā kartṛpaśucodanāyām‘kartari . . .’(Pā. 3.4.67) iti sādhanam āśrayam apekṣate śaktimattvāt /
analyzed: atha ca artha lakṣaṇaḥ kasmiṃścid viṣaye saṃbandhaḥ syāt iti yasmin ca viṣaye etayoḥ saṃnipātaḥ tasmin ubhayam api saṃbhavati aṅga aṅgi bhāvaḥ bādhā ca iti atas saṃdehaḥ yatra tu ekaḥ eva saṃbhavati tatra ekasya eva pravṛttiḥ yathā kartṛ paśu codanāyām kartari iti sādhanam āśrayam apekṣate śaktimat tvāt

original: dravyanimittānuvidhāyitvāt paratantraṃ sa[d] dvitīyāpekṣam eva,‘paśau’(Pā. 3.2.25) iti dravyabhūtasya śabdenopādānāt / dhātoś ña pratyayaḥ kriyāvacanād utpadyamānaḥ sādhane bhavitum arhatīti na śakyate kalpayituṃ, paśau śuddhe pratyayaḥ karmādiguṇayukte veti / kutaḥ? karmādīnām acoditatvāt /
analyzed: dravya nimitta anuvidhāyi tvāt paratantram sat dvitīya apekṣam eva paśau iti dravya bhūtasya śabdena upādānāt dhātoḥ ña pratyayaḥ kriyā vacanāt utpadyamānaḥ sādhane bhavitum arhati iti na śakyate kalpayitum paśau śuddhe pratyayaḥ karma ādi guṇa yukte vā iti kutas karma ādīnām a codita tvāt

original: tasmād etayor atyantam upakāritvenāpekṣāyām etadviṣayam ekavākyatvam anumīyate, paśau kartari bhavatīti / evam aṇiñor ekasminn arthe saṃnipatitayor ekaikasminn etasyārthasyābhidhānāt viśeṣavihitaḥ sāmānyaviṣayaṃ bādhata iti bādhakatvenaivāpekṣā / iha tv aṅgasya guṇavṛddhī bhavata iti ṣaṣṭhī guṇavṛddhī ca /
analyzed: tasmāt etayoḥ atyantam upakāri tvena apekṣāyām etad viṣayam eka vākya tvam anumīyate paśau kartari bhavati iti evam aṇ iñoḥ ekasmin arthe saṃnipatitayoḥ ekaikasmin etasya arthasya abhidhānāt viśeṣa vihitaḥ sāmānya viṣayam bādhate iti bādhaka tvena eva apekṣā iha tu aṅgasya guṇa vṛddhī bhavataḥ iti ṣaṣṭhī guṇa vṛddhī ca

original: ṣaṣṭhīm apekṣya‘alo 'ntyasya’saṃnipatati / guṇavṛddhī apekṣya‘ikaḥ’iti saṃnipatati / evam etadekaviṣayasaṃnipāte (?), yady aṅgasyetīyaṃ śrutir anye 'li pravartate, avayavasamudāyān na hi kiṃcit [a]nyad asya rūpam asti / idam eva hi tasya rūpam aṅgasya / yathā‘ruha[ḥ] paḥ’(Pā. 4.3.43)‘rājñaḥ ka ca’(Pā. 4.2.140) iti /
analyzed: ṣaṣṭhīm apekṣya a laḥ n tyasya saṃnipatati guṇa vṛddhī apekṣya ekaḥ iti saṃnipatati evam etat eka viṣaya saṃnipāte yadi aṅgasya iti iyam śrutiḥ anye pravartate avayava samudāyāt na hi kiṃcid anyat asya rūpam asti idam eva hi tasya rūpam aṅgasya yathā ruhaḥ iti

original: etad uktaṃ bhavati―ruho ikārasya, rājño nakārasyeti / tatrāṅgasyeti yadā samudāyaśabdo 'ntye 'ly upasaṃhriyate, idam avatavasya viśeṣaṇam‘ikaḥ’iti / evam ayaṃ taccheṣo bhavati viśeṣaṇatvenāntyasyālaḥ / aṅgasyeti samudāyaśabdo 'ntye ali upasaṃhriyamāṇa ikā prāptatadantavidhir upasaṃhāreṇa yujyate, igantasyāṅgasyālo 'ntyasyeti /
analyzed: etat uktam ikārasya rājñaḥ nakārasya iti tatra aṅgasya iti yadā samudāya śabdaḥ ntye upasaṃhriyate idam viśeṣaṇam ikaḥ iti evam ayam tad śeṣaḥ bhavati viśeṣaṇa tvena antyasya a laḥ aṅgasya iti samudāya śabdaḥ ntye a li upasaṃhriyamāṇaḥ i kā prāpta tad anta vidhiḥ upasaṃhāreṇa yujyate i k antasya aṅgasya a laḥ ntyasya iti

original: evam api igantasyāṅgasya guṇa iti viśeṣyatvenālontyaśeṣatām āpadyate / atha tv aṅgasyetīyaṃ guṇavṛddhividhau naiva sthānaṣaṣṭhī, kiṃ tarhi,‘ikaḥ’ity eṣā sthānaṣaṣṭhī, etadviśeṣaṇam‘aṅgasya’iti, yathā‘ūd upadhāyā gohaḥ’(Pā. 6.4.89) iti, evaṃ sati‘alontyasya’ity etasya guṇavṛddhiviṣaye atyantam apravṛttir iti bādhakatvam asyohyate /
analyzed: evam api i k antasya aṅgasya guṇaḥ iti viśeṣya tvena alaḥ ntya śeṣa tām āpadyate atha tu aṅgasya iti iyam guṇa vṛddhi vidhau na eva sthāna ṣaṣṭhī kim tarhi ikaḥ iti eṣā sthāna ṣaṣṭhī etat viśeṣaṇam aṅgasya eti upadhāyāḥ iti evam sati alaḥ ntyasya eti etasya guṇa vṛddhi viṣaye atyantam apravṛttiḥ iti bādhaka tvam asya uhyate

original: iyam eva ca bādhā yā aprāptir iti / tatra taccheṣakalpanāyām ikaḥ pradhānaviprakarṣaḥ, aṅgasyaiva guṇo vidhinoktam iti(? -kta iti) śabdapratipattir arthapratipattiś ca bādhyate / apavādapakṣe tv iko guṇo 'ṅgasya tu pradhānavipra[ka]rṣa iti /
analyzed: iyam eva ca bādhā yā aprāptiḥ iti tatra tad śeṣa kalpanāyām i kaḥ pradhāna viprakarṣaḥ aṅgasya eva guṇaḥ vidhinā uktam iti ktaḥ iti śabda pratipattiḥ artha pratipattiḥ ca bādhyate apavāda pakṣe tu i kaḥ guṇaḥ ṅgasya tu pradhāna viprakarṣaḥ iti

original: (3) samuccayaḥ kasmān nopanyasta iti / asaṃbhavāt / ihābhinnārthānām ekakriyāviṣayaḥ samuccayo dṛśyate, yathā‘devadattaṃ sūpena lavaṇena dhṛtana bhojaya’iti / sūpādayo 'bhinnārthā upasecanena rasotpādanena snehanena bhujau samuccīyante / evam ihāṅgam ik ca guṇe samuccetum aśakye /
analyzed: samuccayaḥ kasmāt na upanyastaḥ iti asaṃbhavāt iha abhinna arthānām eka kriyā viṣayaḥ samuccayaḥ dṛśyate yathā devadattam sūpena lavaṇena bhojaya eti sūpa ādayaḥ bhinna arthāḥ upasecanena rasa utpādanena snehanena bhujau samuccīyante evam iha aṅgam ca guṇe samuccetum aśakye

original: aṅgaṃ hi prāptuvantaṃ yā yadā ca pratipadyate guṇam, [tadā] tad itarayā viśeṣaṇaṣaṣṭhyā bhavitavyam / ity evam api samuccayo na kāryarūpaḥ / vikalpaḥ ekakāryānāṃ viro[dha]vatām anyatamena kṛtatvāt pravartate, yathā‘devadattaṃ bhojaya prāsāde gṛhe kāṃsyapātryāṃ rājatyām’iti gṛhe prasāde ca bhojyaḥ /
analyzed: aṅgam hi yā yadā ca pratipadyate guṇam tadā tat itarayā viśeṣaṇa ṣaṣṭhyā bhavitavyam iti evam api samuccayaḥ na kārya rūpaḥ vikalpaḥ eka kāryānām virodhavatām anyatamena kṛta tvāt pravartate yathā devadattam bhojaya prāsāde gṛhe kāṃsya pātryām rājatyām iti gṛhe prasāde ca bhojyaḥ

original: evam ihāṅgasya vā bhavati, iko veti na yugapad vartate / ekasyāḥ ṣaṣṭhyāḥ kāryayogitvād iti /
analyzed: evam iha aṅgasya vā bhavati i kaḥ vā iti na yugapad vartate ekasyāḥ ṣaṣṭhyāḥ kārya yogi tvāt iti

original: (4a) atha nānāvākyatve ko virodhe parihāraḥ? ucyate / iha‘dadhi brāhmaṇebhyo dīyatāṃ takraṃ kauṇḍinyāya’iti kecid ekam eva vākyam iti pratipannā ekasyākhyātasya śrutatvāt / eko hi dadātir bhinnakarmako bhinnasaṃpradānakaś ceti /
analyzed: atha nānā vākya tve kaḥ virodhe parihāraḥ ucyate iha dadhi brāhmaṇebhyaḥ dīyatām takram kauṇḍinyāya eti kecid ekam eva vākyam iti pratipannāḥ ekasya ākhyātasya śruta tvāt ekaḥ hi dadātiḥ bhinna karmakaḥ bhinna saṃpradānakaḥ ca iti

original: yathaiva bhujir a[ne]kakaraṇa iti saty api bhujer bahukṛtvaḥ prayoge ekavākyataiva bhavatīti,‘devadattaṃ māsena bhojaya dadhnā bhojaya śākena bhojaya’iti / iha bhavantas tv āhuḥ dve ete vākye iti / ekaṃ vākyaṃ‘dadhi brāhmaṇebhyo dīyatām’, dvitīyaṃ‘takraṃ kauṇḍinyāya’iti / kriyāpadaṃ tu gatārthatvān na prayujyate /
analyzed: yathā eva bhujiḥ aneka karaṇaḥ iti sati api bhujeḥ bahu kṛtvas prayoge eka vākya tā eva bhavati iti devadattam māsena bhojaya dadhnā bhojaya śākena bhojaya eti iha bhavantaḥ tu āhuḥ dve ete vākye iti ekam vākyam dadhi brāhmaṇebhyaḥ dīyatām dvitīyam takram kauṇḍinyāya eti kriyā padam tu gatārtha tvāt na prayujyate

original: sa ca hra[sva]syārthato na saṃbhavatīti evam abhisaṃbandho bhavati―aṅgasya ya igdhrasvas tasya guṇo bhavatīti / atha vā, vidhīyamānatvāt guṇah pradhānam / tādarthyād ik cāṅgaṃ [ca] guṇau /
analyzed: sa ca hrasvasya arthataḥ na saṃbhavati iti evam abhisaṃbandhaḥ bhavati aṅgasya yaḥ i k hrasvaḥ tasya guṇaḥ bhavati iti atha vā vidhīyamāna tvāt guṇaḥ pradhānam tādarthyāt i k ca aṅgam ca guṇau

original: tatra hrasvādiśrutiḥ pradhāne na saṃbhavatīti tadaṅge vijñāyamānā ya[dā]sannam aṅgam i[g i]ti tasya viśeṣaṇaṃ yuktam, na punar viprakṛṣṭasya guṇasyāṅgasyety alo [? -to] pi nyāyāt etāny eva saṃbhavanti / udāharaṇamātraṃ cedam / ihāpi anantyasya pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ,‘aco ñṇiti’(Pā. 7.2.115) iti / atrāpy aṅgasyāco yatratatrasthasyeti pratipattavyam /
analyzed: tatra hrasva ādi śrutiḥ pradhāne na saṃbhavati iti tad aṅge vijñāyamānā yat āsannam aṅgam i k iti tasya viśeṣaṇam yuktam na punar viprakṛṣṭasya guṇasya aṅgasya iti nyāyāt etāni eva saṃbhavanti udāharaṇa mātram ca idam iha api anantyasya pratiṣedhaḥ vaktavyaḥ iti atra api aṅgasya a caḥ yatra tatra sthasya iti pratipattavyam

original: daridrāyakādiṣv anantyasyāco vṛddhiḥ prāpnoti / nanu ca or guṇādiṣu nirdiṣṭasthā[ni]katvāt avyāpāro 'syāḥ paribhāṣāyāḥ / satyam; evam etat / idaṃ tv evaṃ kṛtvā ucyate / bhavatā anantyaprāptir eva na vyavasitā /‘aṅgasya’itīdaṃ sāmānyaṃ viśeṣasyeko viśeṣāṇām iti evaṃ cet ihāpi hrasvādīnāṃ viśeṣāṇām‘aṅgasya’iti sāmānyaṃ viśeṣaṇam bhavitum arhati /
analyzed: daridrāyaka ādiṣu an antyasya a caḥ vṛddhiḥ prāpnoti nanu ca oḥ guṇa ādiṣu nirdiṣṭa sthānika tvāt syāḥ paribhāṣāyāḥ satyam evam etat idam tu evam kṛtvā ucyate bhavatā anantya prāptiḥ eva na vyavasitā aṅgasya eti idam sāmānyam viśeṣasya ikaḥ viśeṣāṇām iti evam ced iha api hrasva ādīnām viśeṣāṇām aṅgasya eti sāmānyam viśeṣaṇam bhavitum arhati

original: tataś cānantyasya prasaṅgo nāsti (? asti) / evaṃ ca sati igantalakṣaṇo na bhavaty ayam iti vakṣyamāṇam apy upapadyate,‘taddhitakāmyor iglakṣaṇāt’(Pā. 1.1.5 Vā. 4) iti / apare varṇayanti / atra iko vyāpāra [ā]śrīyate / aṅgasyeko guṇo bhavati / kiṃ sarvasya? na hi / kiṃ tarhi? or iti / kimarthaṃ punar idam upādānam? sarvāvasthasya pratipattyartham /
analyzed: tatas ca ānantyasya prasaṅgaḥ na asti asti evam ca sati i k anta lakṣaṇaḥ na bhavati ayam iti vakṣyamāṇam api upapadyate taddhita kāmyoḥ i k lakṣaṇāt iti apare varṇayanti atra i kaḥ vyāpāraḥ āśrīyate aṅgasya ekaḥ guṇaḥ bhavati kim sarvasya na hi kim tarhi iti kimartham punar idam upādānam sarva avasthasya pratipatti artham

original: asmiṃs tu vakṣyamāṇaṃ nopapadyate, iglakṣaṇatvād asya /
analyzed: asmin tu vakṣyamāṇam na upapadyate i k lakṣaṇa tvāt asya

original: [14]	pugantalaghūpadhagrahaṇam anantyaniyamārtham / siddho hi guṇo 'nantyasya / tatra punaḥśrutir niyamārthā bhaviṣyati / etad anena pradarśyate―sārrvadhātukārdhadhātukayoḥ (Pā. 7.3.84) ity atra‘aṅgasya’itīdaṃ kāryayogi / tad ikā viśeṣyate (? itīdaṃ kāryayogitvād ikaṃ viśeṣayati) iti / nanu ca vidheyasya bhāvān niyamānupapattiḥ /
analyzed: puk anta laghu upadhā grahaṇam anantya niyama artham siddhaḥ hi guṇaḥ na ntyasya tatra punaḥśrutiḥ niyama arthā bhaviṣyati etat anena pradarśyate sārrvadhātuka ārdhadhātukayoḥ iti atra aṅgasya eti idam kārya yogi tat i kā viśeṣyate iti idam kārya yogi tvāt i kam viśeṣayati iti nanu ca vidheyasya bhāvāt niyama anupapattiḥ

original: kiṃ ca vidheyam? hrepayatīti / anantyasya siddho guṇaḥ / antyasya ca pakā[ra]sya vidheyaḥ syāt, bhetteti dakārasya / ucyate / puki antaḥ, laghvī upadhetyeva sūtrārtham āśrityāyaṃ niyama iti varṇyate / nanu caivam api dāpayatyartham etat syāt / astv ākārasya guṇo, vṛddhiṃ kariṣyāmaḥ / cakrakeṣu ceṣṭato vyavasthā /
analyzed: kim ca vidheyam hrepayati iti anantyasya siddhaḥ guṇaḥ antyasya ca pakārasya vidheyaḥ syāt bhettā iti dakārasya ucyate antaḥ laghvī upadhā iti eva sūtra artham āśritya ayam niyamaḥ iti varṇyate nanu ca evam api dāpayati artham etat syāt astu ākārasya guṇaḥ vṛddhim kariṣyāmaḥ cakrakeṣu ceṣṭataḥ vyavasthā

original: ayaṃ paro (? -raḥ) sūtraikadeśo niyamāya bhaviṣyati, laghvī upadheti / prakṛtasyaiva niyamaḥ / . . . sārvadhātukārdhadhātukayoḥ pugantasyaiva nānyasyeti / sārvadhātukārdhadhātukayor aṅgasyeti laghvī [upadhā] kāryayoginīti na syād iha īhiteti / hrasvādiguṇas tv aniyata iti / atrāṅgasyeti viśeṣaṇaṣaṣṭhyau ceti /
analyzed: ayam paraḥ raḥ sūtra eka deśaḥ niyamāya bhaviṣyati laghvī upadhā iti prakṛtasya eva niyamaḥ sārvadhātuka ārdhadhātukayoḥ puk antasya eva na anyasya iti sārvadhātuka ārdhadhātukayoḥ aṅgasya iti laghvī upadhā kārya yoginī iti na syāt iha īhitā iti hrasva ādi guṇaḥ tu aniyataḥ iti atra aṅgasya iti viśeṣaṇa ṣaṣṭhyau ca iti

original: athāpy evaṃ niyamaḥ syāt―sārvadhātukārdhadhātukayor eva pugantalaghūpadhasyeti / nimittī niyato 'thātra hrasvādiṣu guṇaṃ na pratipadyeta, nimittasya tanniyamāt / īhitetyevamādiṣu guṇaḥ prāpnoty eva / athāpy ubhayato niyamaḥ syāt / kathaṃ punar ubhayato labhyo yāvatā punaḥśrutir niyamaḥ /
analyzed: atha api evam niyamaḥ syāt sārvadhātuka ārdhadhātukayoḥ eva puk anta laghu upadhasya iti nimittī tha atra hrasva ādiṣu guṇam na pratipadyeta nimittasya tad niyamāt īhita iti evamādiṣu guṇaḥ prāpnoti eva atha api ubhayatas niyamaḥ syāt katham punar ubhayatas labhyaḥ yāvatā punar śrutiḥ niyamaḥ

original: tatraikasmin niyamite punaḥśrutir aparā nāsti, yathā dvitīyo 'rtho niyamyate / ucyate / satyam / evam artham evedam ucyate athāpīti / yady apy evaṃ vyākhyāyetobhayato niyamārtham etat sūtram iti, evam api jusi guṇo 'niyataḥ / ubhayatra parigrahāt / laghūpadhaṃ caitat, jusaś ca sārvadhātuka[tva]m iti /
analyzed: tatra ekasmin niyamite punaḥśrutiḥ aparā nā asti yathā dvitīyaḥ rthaḥ niyamyate ucyate satyam evam artham eva idam ucyate atha api iti yadi api evam vyākhyāyeta ubhayatas niyama artham etat sūtram iti evam api jusi guṇaḥ niyataḥ ubhayatra parigrahāt laghu upadham ca etat jusaḥ ca sārvadhātuka tvam iti

original: [15]	evaṃ tarhi naivāyaṃ taccheṣo nāpi tadapavādaḥ / yan manyase―ekaviṣayasamnipātād ete paribhāṣe apekṣete, virodhena vā aṅgāṅgibhāvena veti, tan na / parasparānapekṣayā kāryaṃ prati pravṛttā ekā‘rājñaḥ ka ca’(Pā. 4.2.140) ityādiṣu, aparā hi guṇavṛddhyor ikaḥ sthānitvapratipādanena /
analyzed: evam tarhi na eva ayam tad śeṣaḥ na api tad apavādaḥ yat manyase eka viṣaya samnipātāt ete paribhāṣe apekṣete virodhena vā aṅga aṅgi bhāvena vā iti tat na paraspara anapekṣayā kāryam prati pravṛttāḥ ityādiṣu aparāḥ hi guṇa vṛddhyoḥ i kaḥ sthāni tva pratipādanena

original: yadi kathaṃcit ikah (?) ekatra saṃnipāto bhavati, naitāvataiva tayor apekṣā śakyā kalpayitum / yathā dīrghatvaitvayoḥ parasparam anapekṣamāṇayoḥ dṛṣṭ wkaviṣaye saṃnipāto vṛkṣebhya iti, tathānayoḥ paribhāṣayoḥ / tatrālontyaparibhāṣā samudāyaṣaṣṭhyā ekadeśasthāpane vyāpṛtā, iyam api [guṇavṛddhividhau ikaḥ sthānitvapratipādane /
analyzed: yadi kathaṃcid i kah ekatra saṃnipātaḥ bhavati na etāvatā eva tayoḥ apekṣā śakyā kalpayitum yathā dīrgha tva e tvayoḥ parasparam an apekṣamāṇayoḥ dṛṣṭ saṃnipātaḥ vṛkṣebhyaḥ iti tathā anayoḥ paribhāṣayoḥ samudāya ṣaṣṭhyāḥ eka deśa sthāpane vyāpṛtā iyam api guṇa vṛddhi vidhau i kaḥ sthāni tva pratipādane

original: niyamādiko] guṇavṛddhī bhavato vipratiṣedheneti / śeṣatve hy ekavākyatvād ātmanā saha kīdṛśo vipratiṣedhaḥ? virodhe ca saty utsargāpavādayor apy ayukto vipratiṣedha iti / niyamasyāvakāśo‘rājñaḥ ka ca’(Pā. 4.2.140) iti /
analyzed: niyama ādikaḥ guṇa vṛddhī bhavataḥ vipratiṣedhena iti śeṣa tve hi eka vākya tvāt ātmanā saha kīdṛśaḥ vipratiṣedhaḥ virodhe ca sati utsarga apavādayoḥ api ayuktaḥ vipratiṣedhaḥ iti niyamasya avakāśaḥ rājñaḥ iti

original: yatra‘iko guṇavṛddhī’[ity etatparibhāṣāvyāpāro nāsti /‘iko guṇavṛddhī’ity asyāvakāśaḥ cayanaṃ cāyako lavanaṃ lāvaka iti /‘alo 'ntyasya’] ity etatparibhāṣāvyāpāranimitto na kaścid viśeṣa upalabhyate yatra, tatra tasyāḥ pravṛttir anarthikā /
analyzed: yatra ekaḥ guṇa vṛddhī iti etad paribhāṣā vyāpāraḥ na asti i kaḥ guṇa vṛddhī iti asya avakāśaḥ cayanam cāyakaḥ lavanam lāvakaḥ iti alaḥ iti etad paribhāṣā vyāpāra nimittaḥ na kaścid viśeṣaḥ upalabhyate yatra tatra tasyāḥ pravṛttiḥ anarthikā

original: yadi ceka ity etayaivāntyasya guṇo pratipādite niyamo 'pi tasyaiva vidadhyāt, [na] kiṃcit kṛtaṃ syāt ity ata [au]dāsīnyaṃ niyamasya pratipadyāmahe iti / ihobhayaṃ prāpnoti, [me]dyati, mārṣṭhīti / niyamāt vyañjanasya syā[t, a]nayā ca iko 'nantyasya syād iti / naiṣa yukto vipratiṣedha iti /
analyzed: yadi ca ikaḥ iti etayā eva antyasya guṇaḥ pratipādite tasya eva vidadhyāt na kiṃcid kṛtam syāt iti atas audāsīnyam niyamasya pratipadyāmahe iti iha ubhayam prāpnoti medyati mārṣṭhi iti niyamāt vyañjanasya syāt anayā ca i kaḥ na antyasya syāt iti na eṣa yuktaḥ vipratiṣedhaḥ iti

original: ādau tāvat sūtrasaṃniveśa eva tair na jñāyate ity etad ācaṣṭe pūrvo 'yaṃ yogaḥ paro niyama iti / evam apīṣṭavācinā paraśabdena vyavahāro 'sti, na vyavasthi[ta]tvavācinā, pūrvaprāpta[pra]tiṣedhād anārabhamāṇa ity ata (? ity etad) āha―iṣṭavācī paraśabda iti / evam a[py a]yukto [vipratiṣedhaḥ /] dvikāryayogo hi vipratiṣedhaḥ /
analyzed: ādau tāvat sūtra saṃniveśaḥ eva taiḥ na jñāyate iti etat ācaṣṭe pūrvaḥ yam yogaḥ paraḥ niyamaḥ iti evam api iṣṭa vācinā para śabdena vyavahāraḥ sti na vyavasthita tva vācinā pūrva prāpta pratiṣedhāt anārabhamāṇaḥ iti atas iti etat āha eṣṭa vācī para śabdaḥ iti evam api ayuktaḥ vipratiṣedhaḥ dvi kārya yogaḥ hi vipratiṣedhaḥ

original: dvābhyāṃ kāryabhyāṃ yogo yatraikasya sthāninaḥ sa dvikāryayogaḥ, yo 'tra tatstho vipratiṣedhā[t]=dvikāryayogaviṣayatvāt tādrūpyaṃ (? tācchabdyaṃ) labhate / atha vā yogaḥ saṃbandhaḥ / dvikāryeṇa yogo yaḥ sa vipratiṣedha iti saṃbandhaviśeṣa eva vipratiṣedhaḥ / yathā virodhaśabdasya saṃbandhaviśeṣo ['rthaḥ], evaṃ vipratiṣedhaśabdasyāpi /
analyzed: dvābhyām kāryabhyām yogaḥ yatra ekasya sthāninaḥ sa dvi kārya yogaḥ tad sthaḥ vipratiṣedhāt dvi kārya yoga viṣaya tvāt tādrūpyam tācchabdyam labhate atha vā yogaḥ saṃbandhaḥ dvi kāryeṇa yogaḥ yaḥ sa vipratiṣedhaḥ iti saṃbandha viśeṣaḥ eva vipratiṣedhaḥ yathā virodha śabdasya saṃbandha viśeṣaḥ rthaḥ evam vipratiṣedha śabdasya api

original: nāvaśyaṃ dvikāryayoga eva vipratiṣedhaḥ / kiṃ tarhi? asaṃbhabo 'pi / yo 'yaṃ viprati[ṣe]dho bhavatā parigṛhyate dvikāryayogitvena, [tatra] yo 'saṃbhavah sa vipratiṣedhaḥ / yasmin asaṃbhave na ca kāryam dvikāryayogo 'sti / dvikāryayogo 'pi yasmin na saṃbhavati, tasminn api vipratiṣedha iti tatrāpy asaṃbhava eva /
analyzed: na avaśyam dvi kārya yogaḥ eva vipratiṣedhaḥ kim tarhi yaḥ yam vipratiṣedhaḥ bhavatā parigṛhyate dvi kārya yogi tvena tatra sa vipratiṣedhaḥ yasmin asaṃbhave na ca kāryam dvi kārya yogaḥ sti dvi kārya yogaḥ pi yasmin na saṃbhavati tasmin api vipratiṣedhaḥ iti tatra api asaṃbhavaḥ eva

original: asaṃbhavaṃ ca dvikāryayoga eva darśayati―iha tāvan vṛkṣebhya ity ekaḥ sthānī dvāv ādeśau, na cāsti saṃbhava iti / nanu caikasya sthāne dvāvādeśau bhavato yathā ekapakṣa ekasya pacśabdasya dvau pacśabdau, evaṃ vṛkṣebhya ity a[trā]kāra ekāraś ca kasmān na bhavataḥ / ucyate / na brūmah sarvatra na saṃbhavatīti /
analyzed: asaṃbhavam ca dvi kārya yoge eva darśayati iha tāvan vṛkṣebhyaḥ iti ekaḥ sthānī dvau ādeśau na ca asti saṃbhavaḥ iti nanu ca ekasya sthāne dvau ādeśau bhavataḥ yathā eka pakṣe ekasya pad śabdasya dvau pad śabdau evam vṛkṣebhyaḥ iti atra akāraḥ ekāraḥ ca kasmāt na bhavataḥ ucyate na brūmah sarvatra na saṃbhavati iti

original: kiṃ tarhi? evaṃbhūto na saṃbhavatīti, yo 'yaṃ prastutaḥ / tatra hi dīrghatvaṃ yañy anantaraṃ sādhutvenākhyātam etvam api jhali / na ca saṃbhavo 'sti yad ubhayoḥ svena svena nimittenānantaryaṃ syād iti / evaṃ kṛtvedam ucyate na cā[sti] saṃbhavo yad ekasya sthānino dvāv ādeśau syātām iti / ihedānīṃ medyatīti dvau sthāninau eka ādeśaḥ;
analyzed: kim tarhi evaṃbhūtaḥ na saṃbhavati iti yaḥ yam prastutaḥ tatra hi dīrgha tvam anantaram sādhu tvena ākhyātam api jha li na ca saṃbhavaḥ sti yat ubhayoḥ svena svena nimittena ānantaryam syāt iti evam kṛtvā idam ucyate na ca asti saṃbhavaḥ yat ekasya sthāninaḥ dvau ādeśau syātām iti iha idānīm medyati iti dvau sthāninau ekaḥ ādeśaḥ

original: na cāsti saṃbhavaḥ iti / atrāpi dṛṣṭaḥ saṃbhavaḥ /‘ekaḥ pūrvaparayoḥ’(Pā. 6.1.84),‘bhrasjo ropadheyo ram anyatarasyām’(Pā. 6.4.47) iti ca / ucyate / iha saṃbhavo nāsti / katham? mider iti sthānaṣaṣṭhyāṃ satyām upasaṃhāreṇa bhavitavyam / upasaṃhāre ceko 'pratipattir anik pratipadyate / aṅgasyeti viśeṣaṇaṣaṣṭhyām upasaṃhārāsaṃbhavaḥ /
analyzed: na ca asti saṃbhavaḥ iti atra api dṛṣṭaḥ saṃbhavaḥ ekaḥ pūrva parayoḥ pā 6184 bhrasjaḥ ra upadheyaḥ ram anyatarasyām pā 6447 iti ca ucyate iha saṃbhavaḥ na asti katham mideḥ iti sthāna ṣaṣṭhyām satyām upasaṃhāreṇa bhavitavyam upasaṃhāre pratipattiḥ pratipadyate aṅgasya iti viśeṣaṇa ṣaṣṭhyām upasaṃhāra asaṃbhavaḥ

original: atrāpi niyamaḥ prāpnotī[ti] / ayam abhiprāyaḥ / guṇo bhavatīty etat pravartate cayanādiṣu, niyamas tv audāsīnyaṃ karoti iti kiṃ kāraṇam? syād etat―na kaścid asti viśeṣa iti / ayam eva viśeṣaḥ, alontyavidhir bādhitavya iti / yāvac cedaṃ nārabhyate‘ika’iti, tāvat kiṃ manyase kim iha syād iti? niyamaḥ /
analyzed: atra api niyamaḥ prāpnoti iti ayam abhiprāyaḥ guṇaḥ bhavati iti etat pravartate cayana ādiṣu niyamaḥ tu audāsīnyam karoti iti kim kāraṇam syāt etat na kaścid asti viśeṣaḥ iti ayam eva viśeṣaḥ bādhitavyaḥ iti yāvat ca idam na ārabhyate ekaḥ eti tāvat kim manyase kim iha syāt iti niyamaḥ

original: evaṃ sa[rva]tra prāpte niyama idam ārabhyate ity apavādatva[m a]sya / tasmād asty etayor virodhitvenāpekṣeti kroṣṭrīyāṇāṃ na na samyag idaṃ darśanam, asaṃbaddham anayā paribhāṣayeti / athāpi kathaṃcit / adhyāruhyedaṃ vacanam / yady api kathaṃ cit niyama audāsīnyaṃ kuryāt cayanādiṣu, evam api doṣa eva vi[pra]tiṣedhe satīti /

original: [2] dhātugrahaṇaṃ kim artham? nanu guṇabhāvāt praśnānupapattiḥ / evaṃ ca kecid vṛttikārā `dhātulopa iti kimartham?' iti paṭhanti / samudāyam abhidadhatām api teṣām avayava eva codyate / anyathā bālavākyaṃ syāt, yatraiva vidhis tatraiva pratiṣedhaś ceti / naiṣa doṣaḥ / sāmarthyāt prāptiś cā(? prāptaṃ cā)pekṣyaṃ nirdiśati /
analyzed: dhātu grahaṇam kim artham nanu guṇa bhāvāt praśna anupapattiḥ evam ca kecid vṛtti kārāḥ dhātu lope iti kimartham iti paṭhanti samudāyam abhidadhatām api teṣām avayavaḥ eva codyate anyathā bāla vākyam syāt yatra eva vidhiḥ tatra eva pratiṣedhaḥ ca iti na eṣa doṣaḥ sāmarthyāt prāptiḥ ca ā prāptam ca apekṣyam nirdiśati

original: lūñ lavitā / nanu cātra vṛttau pratyudāharaṇaṃ nopapadyate, dhātulopanimitta ārdhadhātuke prati[ṣedha]vacanāt / ayam abhiprāyaḥ / sati dhātugrahaṇe bahuvrīhiḥ saṃbhavati / bahuvrīhau saty ubhayaviśeṣaṇaṃ bhavati /
analyzed: nanu ca atra vṛttau pratyudāharaṇam na upapadyate dhātu lopa nimitte ārdhadhātuke pratiṣedha vacanāt ayam abhiprāyaḥ sati dhātu grahaṇe bahuvrīhiḥ saṃbhavati bahuvrīhau sati ubhaya viśeṣaṇam bhavati

original: [2.1] kathaṃ punar anubandhalopo bhavati, na dhātulopaḥ? ucyate / iha dhātusaṃjñā itsaṃjñā ca yaugapadyena pravartete / yaś cetsaṃjñaḥ sa nāstīti śāstre 'bhyupagamaḥ / evaṃ ca sati yasyām evāvasthāyāṃ dhātusaṃjñā tasyām eva cetsaṃjñā / yadā ca dhātusaṃjñā saṃnipatitā tadā naivāsty anubandha iti asato nāsti dhātusaṃjñā /
analyzed: katham punar anubandha lopaḥ bhavati na dhātu lopaḥ ucyate iha dhātu saṃjñā it saṃjñā ca yaugapadyena pravartete yaḥ ced saṃjñaḥ sa na asti iti śāstre bhyupagamaḥ evam ca sati yasyām eva avasthāyām dhātu saṃjñā tasyām eva ced saṃjñā yadā ca dhātu saṃjñā saṃnipatitā tadā na eva asti anubandhaḥ iti asataḥ na asti dhātu saṃjñā

original: atha pūrvaṃ dhātusaṃjñā evam api bhāvārthānāṃ dhātusaṃjñā / arthaś ca prayogaśabdasyāpodṛtyānvayavyatirekābhyām ekadeśasya ]parikalpyate / na cānubandhasyānvayo vyatireko veti / yāvata evāvadher anvayavyatirekau tāvata(ti) eva kriyāvacanatvaṃ parikalpya dhātusaṃjñā pravartate iti naiṣa doṣaḥ /
analyzed: atha pūrvam dhātu saṃjñā evam api bhāva arthānām dhātu saṃjñā arthaḥ ca prayoga śabdasya apodṛtya anvaya vyatirekābhyām eka deśasya parikalpyate na ca anubandhasya anvayaḥ vyatirekaḥ vā iti yāvataḥ eva avadheḥ anvaya vyatirekau eva kriyā vacana tvam parikalpya dhātu saṃjñā pravartate iti na eṣa doṣaḥ

original: sasakārasyāpi dṛṣṭā kriyāvacanatā tiṣṭhāsatīty evamādiṣu /
analyzed: sa sakārasya api dṛṣṭā kriyā vacana tā evamādiṣu

original: [2.2] vṛṣabho roravīti / saty ārdhadhātukagrahaṇam / bhāṣyakāro 'py etadarthaṃ caitāni pratyudāharaṇāni upanyasyati, krameṇa sūtrapratyākhyānaṃ kariṣyāmi, pakṣe ca dhātugrahaṇam anarthakam iti vakṣyāmīti /
analyzed: vṛṣabhaḥ roravīti satī ārdhadhātuka grahaṇam bhāṣyakāraḥ u pi etad artham ca etāni pratyudāharaṇāni upanyasyati krameṇa sūtra pratyākhyānam kariṣyāmi pakṣe ca dhātu grahaṇam anarthakam iti vakṣyāmi iti

original: [2.3] catvāraḥ pakṣāḥ saṃbhavanto 'tro(?-vanti dvāvatro)panyastau---(?) lopaviśeṣaṇam ārdhadhātukagrahaṇam, (2) guṇavṛddhiviśeṣaṇam, (3) antareṇa bahuvrīhim ubhayaviśeṣaṇam āvṛtteḥ, yathopadeśagrahaṇam ‘ekāca upadeśe 'nudāttāt’ (A 7.2.10) iti, (4) bahuvrīhir iti /
analyzed: catvāraḥ pakṣāḥ dvau atra upanyastau lopa viśeṣaṇam ārdhadhātuka grahaṇam guṇa vṛddhi viśeṣaṇam antareṇa bahuvrīhim ubhaya viśeṣaṇam āvṛtteḥ yathā upadeśa grahaṇam eka a caḥ upadeśe n u dāttāt iti 4 bahuvrīhiḥ iti

original: [3] kiṃ punar idam ārdhadhātukagrahaṇam iti / kim ārdhadhātukādhāro lopo guṇavṛddhyabhāvasyopalakṣaṇatvenopādū¥īyate, atha ārthadhātukādhārayoḥ guṇavṛddhyor atannnimitto 'pi lopa upalakṣaṇatvenopādīyata iti / kiṃ punar atra nyāyyam ? ubhayam ity āha / katham ? dhātukam ubhayoḥ saṃbandhi saṃbhavatīti pṛcchati /
analyzed: kim punar idam ārdhadhātuka grahaṇam iti kim ārdhadhātuka ādhāraḥ lopaḥ guṇa vṛddhi abhāvasya upalakṣaṇa tvena upādūīyate atha ārthadhātuka ādhārayoḥ guṇa vṛddhyoḥ lopaḥ upalakṣaṇa tvena upādīyate iti kim punar atra nyāyyam ubhayam iti āha katham dhātukam ubhayoḥ saṃbandhi saṃbhavati iti pṛcchati

original: upeddhaḥ, preddha i[ty a]trāpi prāpnoti / nanv antaraṅgatvāt pūrvam evād guṇaḥ prāpnoti / ‘pūrvaṃ dhātur upasargeṇa yujyate’ iti / tasmād idam udāharaṇaṃ kaṣṭeddha iti / yadi ca [u]pasargatvaṃ tvanyaktavyemupagatare (?) . . . [-sargāt pūrvaṃ pratyayotpattiḥ, katham upe]ddhaḥ, preddhaḥ ? naiṣa doṣaḥ / vakṣyaty evāyam antaraṅgabahiraṅgabhāvam /
analyzed: upeddhaḥ preddhaḥ iti atra api prāpnoti nanu antaraṅga tvāt pūrvam guṇaḥ prāpnoti pūrvam dhātuḥ upasargeṇa yujyate iti tasmāt idam udāharaṇam kaṣṭa iddhaḥ iti yadi ca upasarga tvam sargāt pūrvam pratyaya utpattiḥ katham upeddhaḥ preddhaḥ na eṣa doṣaḥ vakṣyati eva ayam antaraṅga bahiraṅga bhāvam

original: yadi pūrvam upasargayogo 'bhyupagamyate, guṇo 'ntaraṅgo bahiraṅgaḥ, pratiṣedhaḥ / atha pūrvaṃ pratyayotpattiḥ, evam api guṇo bahiraṅgo 'ntaraṅgaḥ pratiṣedha iti / ayaṃ tu noktaḥ parihāraḥ aniglakṣaṇatvāt ity uttaratra vakṣyāmīti /
analyzed: yadi pūrvam upasarga yogaḥ bhyupagamyate guṇaḥ ntaraṅgaḥ bahiraṅgaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ atha pūrvam pratyaya utpattiḥ evam api guṇaḥ bahiraṅgaḥ ntaraṅgaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ iti ayam tu na uktaḥ parihāraḥ a nij lakṣaṇa tvāt iti uttaratra vakṣyāmi iti

original: nanu ca ‘nājānantarye bahiṣṭvaprakḷptiḥ’ iti na sādhvasādhuparijñānaṃ ced bhavati iti / etat tu nopapadyate / śāstrāt sādhvadādhupravṛtteḥ / anye varṇaniṣpattir ity āhuḥ / hiraṇyadyūr iti yaṇo nirvṛttiḥ / evaṃ tu sati pratiṣedho 'pi niṣpādyata ity ayam arthaḥ /
analyzed: nanu ca na ajā ānantarye bahiṣṭva prakḷptiḥ iti na sādhu asādhu parijñānam ced bhavati iti etat tu nā upapadyate śāstrāt sādhu adādhu pravṛtteḥ anye varṇa niṣpattiḥ iti āhuḥ iti nirvṛttiḥ evam tu sati niṣpādyate iti ayam arthaḥ

original: tasmād ayam arthaḥ, acāmānantaryasya vidhirūpeṇa yasmin śāstre āśrayaṇam asti tatrāpravṛttiḥ / iha tu pratiṣedhe na tayor āśrayaṇam ity adoṣaḥ /
analyzed: tasmāt ayam arthaḥ acām ānantaryasya vidhi rūpeṇa yasmin śāstre āśrayaṇam asti tatra apravṛttiḥ iha tu pratiṣedhe na tayoḥ āśrayaṇam iti adoṣaḥ

original: knopayatīty atrāpi prāpnoti / nanu cātra puko bahiraṅgatvāt yalopo na prāpnoti / atha nipātanāl lopaḥ ‘cele knope’ (A 3.4.33) iti, nipātanāt guṇo bhaviṣyati /
analyzed: knopayati iti atra api prāpnoti nanu ca atra pukaḥ bahiraṅga tvāt ya lopaḥ na prāpnoti atha nipātanāt lopaḥ cele iti nipātanāt guṇaḥ bhaviṣyati

original: yady evaṃ nārtho dhātugrahaṇena / antareṇa bahuvrīhim ubhayaviśeṣaṇam ārdhadhātukagrahaṇaṃ saṃbhavaty eṣa / lope ārdhadhātuke ye guṇavṛddhī prāpnutaḥ te na bhavata iti / na cānubandhalope ārdhadhātukanimittaḥ /
analyzed: yadi evam na arthaḥ dhātu grahaṇena antareṇa bahuvrīhim ubhaya viśeṣaṇam ārdhadhātuka grahaṇam saṃbhavati eṣa lope ārdhadhātuke ye guṇa vṛddhī prāpnutaḥ te na bhavataḥ iti na ca anubandha lope ārdhadhātuka nimittaḥ

original: [4] parigaṇanaṃ kartavyam  ‘na yaṅy akkyavalope ārdhadhātuke’ ity ayaṃ yogaḥ paṭhitavyaḥ / evaṃ paṭhyamāne knopayatvādayaḥ siddhā bhavanti / valopa ity atra kaścit viśeṣa āśrayitavyaḥ / tena jīveḥ pratyayo na sriveḥ /
analyzed: parigaṇanam kartavyam na yaṅi ārdhadhātuke iti ayam yogaḥ paṭhitavyaḥ evam paṭhyamāne knopa ya tva ādayaḥ siddhāḥ bhavanti va lope iti atra kaścid viśeṣaḥ āśrayitavyaḥ tena jīveḥ pratyayaḥ na sriveḥ

original: [4.1] numlopasrivyanubandhalope 'pratiṣedhārtham / num ity anuṣaṅgasya grahaṇam / pūrvācāryasaṃjñā [jñāta]vyā / anyathā numaḥ sthānāpnne [lope] iti iṣṭagrahaṇaṃ na grahyeta / atra parigaṇanād eteṣu nāsti pratiṣedhaḥ / asati hi parigaṇane dhātulopa iti pratiṣedhaḥ /
analyzed: pratiṣedha artham num iti anuṣaṅgasya grahaṇam pūrva ācārya saṃjñā jñātavyā anyathā numaḥ sthāna āpnne lope iti iṣṭa grahaṇam na grahyeta atra parigaṇanāt eteṣu na asti pratiṣedhaḥ asati hi parigaṇane dhātu lopaḥ iti pratiṣedhaḥ

original: [4.2] ikprakaraṇāt numlope vṛddhiḥ / yatra numi [ika iti] etad upatiṣṭhate sthānyantaranivṛttyarthaṃ tatrāyaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ / atra ika ity asyāvyāpāraḥ /
analyzed: i k prakaraṇāt num lope vṛddhiḥ yatra numi i kaḥ iti etat upatiṣṭhate sthāni antara nivṛtti artham tatra ayam pratiṣedhaḥ atra i kaḥ iti asya a vyāpāraḥ

original: [4.3] pratyayāśrayatvād anyatra siddham / ubhayaviśeṣaṇam ārdhadhātukam ity abhiprāyaḥ /
analyzed: pratyaya āśraya tvāt anyatra siddham ubhaya viśeṣaṇam ārdhadhātukam iti abhiprāyaḥ

original: jīradānur ity atra na prāpnoti / na hy ayaṃ pratyayāśrayo lopaḥ / kiṃ tarhi ? varṇāśrayaḥ / valopa iti vacanāt /
analyzed: jīra dānuḥ iti atra na prāpnoti na hi ayam pratyaya āśrayaḥ lopaḥ kim tarhi varṇa āśrayaḥ va lopaḥ iti vacanāt

original: [4.4] raki jyaḥ prasāraṇam / tatra kṅitīti siddhaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ / avagrahaś ca siddhaḥ / svaro 'pi bahuvrīhitvāt na duṣyati /
analyzed: ra ki jyaḥ prasāraṇam tatra k ṅ iti iti siddhaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ avagrahaḥ ca siddhaḥ svaraḥ pi bahuvrīhi tvāt na duṣyati

original: bahiḥ prakṛtyantaram / ātaś ca prakṛtyantaram avigānena viśiṣya yad upadiśanti khilapāṭhe / na hy ayam āhir iva pañcapadaviṣaya iti /
analyzed: bahis prakṛti antaram ā atas ca prakṛti antaram avigānena viśiṣya yat upadiśanti khila pāṭhe na hi ayam āhiḥ iva pañca pada viṣayaḥ iti

original: bhdedyate, chedyate ity atrāpi prāpnoti / dvayam apy etad ārdhadhātuke, ṇilopasyārdhadhātukanimittatvāt, ṇau cārdhadhātuke guṇavṛddhyoḥ prāptir iti / idaṃ tu nopapadyate / prāg eva sārvadhātukavikaraṇābhyāṃ ṇāv eva guṇasya kṛtatvāt /
analyzed: bh dedyate chedyate iti atra api prāpnoti dvayam api etat ārdhadhātuke ṇi lopasya ārdhadhātuka nimitta tvāt ṇau ca ārdhadhātuke guṇa vṛddhyoḥ prāptiḥ iti idam tu na upapadyate prāk eva sārvadhātuka vikaraṇābhyām ṇau eva guṇasya kṛta tvāt

original: naivaṃ vijñāyate iti / bahuvrīhir ayam ity etat kathayati / bahuvrīhau saty ekanimittatvābhyupagamo lopasya guṇavṛddhyoś ca / iha bhedyate ity a[nya]smin ārdhadhātuke lopo anyasmin guṇavṛddhī iti nāsti pratiṣedhaḥ /
analyzed: na evam vijñāyate iti bahuvrīhiḥ ayam iti etat kathayati bahuvrīhau sati eka nimitta tva abhyupagamaḥ lopasya guṇa vṛddhyoḥ ca iha bhedyate iti anyasmin ārdhadhātuke lopaḥ anyasmin guṇa vṛddhī iti na asti pratiṣedhaḥ

original: [5] yatra halacorādeśaḥ / yaṅo 'ci ca (A 2.4.74) iti samudāyaḥ pratyayasaṃjñaḥ / tasya ca lukā adarśanaṃ saṃbhavati iti /
analyzed: yatra ha l a coḥ ādeśaḥ ca ca ca iti samudāyaḥ pratyaya saṃjñaḥ tasya ca adarśanam saṃbhavati iti

original: atrāpy akāralope kṛte / ayam abhiprāyaḥ / yakāramātraṃ pratyayasaṃjñam evākārālope / yathā apacad iti ekāntāpagame 'pi avaśiṣṭe bhavaty eva pratyayasaṃjñā / na ca `yaṅo 'ci ca' (A 2.4.74) iti sahakāreṇa samudāyo vivakṣyate /
analyzed: atra api akāra lope kṛte ayam abhiprāyaḥ yakāra mātram pratyaya saṃjñam eva akāra ālope yathā apacat iti ekānta apagame avaśiṣṭe bhavati eva pratyaya saṃjñā na ca iti sahakāreṇa samudāyaḥ vivakṣyate

original: yathā gaur iti ākṛtyapadeśe varṇādayo na vivakṣyanta iti tadguṇaś cātadguṇaś ca bhavaty eva gaur evam ihāpi sati [asati] cākāre bhavaty eva yaṅ iti /
analyzed: yathā gauḥ iti ākṛti apadeśe varṇa ādayaḥ na vivakṣyante iti tad guṇaḥ ca a tad guṇaḥ ca bhavati eva gauḥ evam iha api sati asati ca ākāre bhavati eva yaṅ iti

original: luki kṛte na prāpnoti / vakṣyamāṇo 'bhiprāyo nityo lug iti /
analyzed: luki kṛte na prāpnoti vakṣyamāṇaḥ bhiprāyaḥ nityaḥ luk iti

original: idam iha saṃpradhāryam / avaśiṣṭasya lug ity abhiprāyaḥ / lopasyāvakāśaḥ ---cikīrṣitā / luko 'vakāśo---yakāramātram / samudāya ubhayaṃ prāœnoti / paratvāt yaṅo[ 'kārasya] lopaḥ iti /
analyzed: idam iha saṃpradhāryam avaśiṣṭasya luk iti abhiprāyaḥ lopasya avakāśaḥ cikīrṣitā samudāyaḥ ubhayam prāœnoti paratvāt kārasya lopaḥ iti

original: nityo luk / śāstrapravṛttinirtyeti luko nityatvam / lukā tu sarvasmin nivartite asaṃbhavo lopasyety anityatvam /
analyzed: nityaḥ luc śāstra pravṛtti nirtyā iti lukaḥ nitya tvam lukā tu sarvasmin nivartite asaṃbhavaḥ lopasya iti anitya tvam

original: anavakāśas tarhi luk / katham anavakāśatvaṃ manyate / nāprāpte lope luka ārambhāt / yadi hi luk nocyeta, ato lopaḥ syāt / atha vā pratyayasya lug ucyate / na ca yakāramātraṃ pratyayaḥ / kutaḥ ? prayoga abhāvāt / upadeśe ca yakāramātrasyānupadeśāt / ato naivāsya prayogāt pratyayatvādhyavasāyo, nopadeśāt /
analyzed: anavakāśaḥ tarhi luc katham anavakāśa tvam manyate na aprāpte lope lukaḥ ārambhāt yadi hi luc na ucyeta atas lopaḥ syāt atha vā pratyayasya luc ucyate na ca yakāra mātram pratyayaḥ kutas prayogaḥ abhāvāt upadeśe ca yakāra mātrasya anupadeśāt atas na eva asya prayogāt pratyaya tva adhyavasāyaḥ na upadeśāt

original: kiṃca ‘yaṅo 'ci ca’ (A 2.4.74) iti samudāyo nirdiṣṭaḥ / tasmād anavakāśo lug iti /
analyzed: kiṃca iti samudāyaḥ nirdiṣṭaḥ tasmāt anavakāśaḥ luk iti

original: sāvakāśo luk / ko 'vakāśaḥ ? avaśiṣṭaḥ / evaṃ manyate / bhinnaviṣayau lopalukau / asti ca yakāramātrasya pratyayatvasamadhigamo lolūyitādiṣu ya eva ca so 'yam ity ekatvādhyavasāyāt / na ca ‘yaṅo 'ci ca’ iti nirdeśarūpaṃ vivakṣitam / tasmād avaśiṣṭam avakāśa iti /
analyzed: sa avakāśaḥ luc kaḥ vakāśaḥ avaśiṣṭaḥ evam manyate bhinna viṣayau asti ca yakāra mātrasya pratyaya tva samadhigamaḥ lolūyita ādiṣu yaḥ eva ca saḥ yam iti ekatva adhyavasāyāt na ca ca iti nirdeśa rūpam vivakṣitam tasmāt avaśiṣṭam avakāśaḥ iti

original: athāpi kathaṃcit iti / pūrvoktayā kalpanayā ucyate /
analyzed: atha api kathaṃcid iti pūrva uktayā kalpanayā ucyate

original: evam apy allope yogavibhāgaḥ kariṣyate / yogavibhāgaś ca luko bādhanārtha eveti /
analyzed: evam api a l lope yogavibhāgaḥ kariṣyate yogavibhāgaḥ ca lukaḥ bādhana arthe eva iti

original: samānāśrayo luk lopena bādhyate / tulyakālatvāt / ‘bahulaṃ chandasi’ (A 2.4.73) iti sa nimittam anapekṣyāntaraṅgatvāt pravartata eva / nanu cāto lopo 'py ārdhadhātukasāmānye vidhīyate / ārdhadhātuko 'trāśrīyate / aṅgādhikāraś ca / athā vā, yady api sāmānyena tathāpi buddhisāmānyam āśrīyate luki tu buddhyāpi nāśrayaṇam iti /

original: guṇavṛddhiviśeṣaṇe 'pi sati vyavahite naiva prāpnoti / katham ? yathaiva ‘iko yaṇ aci’ iti bhūte 'pi yaṇy ānantarye vyāpriyate ‘ajanantaraparasya iko yaṇ bhavati’ iti ato yaṇ pravartate, e[va]m iha bhūtayor api guṇavṛddhyoḥ kṅitīti ānantaryaṃ syād eva /

original: [1] katham idaṃ vijñāyate ? kutaḥ praśnaḥ ? śabdāśrayas tāvad anupapannaḥ / anantaraśabdasya śrutatvāt / anekārthatvāt antaraśabdasya praśnaḥ / ayaṃ hi ya[pa]dyāty avivarapradeśabahir yogopasaṃvyāneṣu dṛṣṭaḥ iti / eṣāṃ saṃbhavāt vivarārtha eveti nāyaṃ praśnaḥ /
analyzed: katham idam vijñāyate kutas praśnaḥ śabda āśrayaḥ tāvat anupapannaḥ anantara śabdasya śruta tvāt aneka artha tvāt antara śabdasya praśnaḥ ayam hi a vivara pradeśa bahis yoga upasaṃvyāneṣu dṛṣṭaḥ iti eṣām saṃbhavāt vivara arthaḥ eva iti na ayam praśnaḥ

original: anantarā iti katham idaṃ vijñāyate ? avidyamānam antaraṃ yeṣām / antaram, vivaram, chidram, madhyam iti paryāyāḥ / kiṃbhūtaṃ punaḥ śabdasya vivaram ? varṇaśūnyo yo 'ntarālakālaḥ / āhosvid avidyamānā antarā eṣām iti / atra dvitīyā prāpnoti, tasyā uttaratra parihāraṃ vakṣyāmaḥ / keṣāṃcid granthaḥ---avidyamānam antaraṃ yeṣām i[ti] /
analyzed: anantarāḥ iti katham idam vijñāyate a vidyamānam antaram yeṣām antaram vivaram chidram madhyam iti paryāyāḥ kiṃbhūtam punar śabdasya vivaram varṇa śūnyaḥ yaḥ ntarāla kālaḥ āhosvit a vidyamānāḥ antarāḥ eṣām iti atra dvitīyā prāpnoti tasyāḥ uttaratra parihāram vakṣyāmaḥ keṣāṃcid granthaḥ a vidyamānam antaram yeṣām iti
