original: kiṃ punar idaṃ vigrahapadaṃ pṛṣṭhataḥ paṭhitavyam ? nety āha / kiṃ tarhi ? etad asau pṛcchati---dvau imau śabdau staḥ ‘halo 'nantarā’ iti / eko 'vastubhūtenādhikaraṇena viśeṣite anyapadārthe vartate / anyo 'pi [a]vyāvṛttenādhikaraṇenā[nā]dheyākāṅkṣeṇa / atha vā eka evāyaṃ śabdo 'nekaśaktiḥ / lakṣyānurodhāt kaḥ śabdaḥ āśritaḥ kiṃśaktir veti /
analyzed: kim punar idam vigraha padam pṛṣṭhatas paṭhitavyam na iti āha kim tarhi etat asau pṛcchati dvau imau śabdau staḥ ha laḥ nantarā iti ekaḥ vastu bhūtena adhikaraṇena viśeṣite anya padārthe vartate avyāvṛttena adhikaraṇena anādheya ākāṅkṣeṇa atha vā ekaḥ eva ayam śabdaḥ neka śaktiḥ lakṣya anurodhāt kaḥ śabdaḥ āśritaḥ kiṃśaktiḥ vā iti

original: avagrahe saṃyogasaṃjñā na prāpnoti / apsv ity ap 'su iti / vidyate hy atrāntaram / ardhamātrākālo hy avagraha iṣyate / ardhamātrākālaṃ sthitvā varṇāntaram uccāryate / kaḥ punar doṣaḥ syāt ? ‘guror nṛto 'nantyasua’ (A 8.3.86) iti pluto na syāt / nanu cādhikaraṇavācino nāsti saṃbandho guror anṛtādibhiḥ / evaṃ tarhi apsavya ity atra na syāt /
analyzed: avagrahe saṃyoga saṃjñā na prāpnoti apsu iti ap su iti vidyate hi atra antaram ardha mātrā kālaḥ hi avagrahaḥ iṣyate ardha mātrā kālam sthitvā varṇa antaram uccāryate kaḥ punar doṣaḥ syāt guroḥ nṛto iti plutaḥ na syāt nanu ca adhikaraṇa vācinaḥ na asti saṃbandhaḥ guroḥ anṛta ādibhiḥ evam tarhi ap savye iti atra na syāt

original: yathā na doṣas tathāstu / śiṣṭaprayogānuvidhāyi idaṃ śāstram / tatra yathā śiṣṭhapravṛttir na virudhyate, tathāśrīyata iti / naiva doṣo na prayojanam / doṣanivṛttyarthaṃ vā saṃyogasaṃjñāśrīyeta, prayojanapravṛttyarthaṃ vā / na cātrāpravartamānāyāṃ doṣo nāpi pravartamānāyāṃ prayojanam iti naivātra saṃyogasaṃjñā pravartate /
analyzed: yathā na doṣaḥ tathā astu śiṣṭa prayoga anuvidhāyi idam śāstram tatra yathā śiṣṭha pravṛttiḥ na virudhyate tathā āśrīyate iti na eva doṣaḥ na prayojanam doṣa nivṛtti artham vā saṃyoga saṃjñā āśrīyeta prayojana pravṛtti artham vā na ca atra apravartamānāyām doṣaḥ na api pravartamānāyām prayojanam iti na eva atra saṃyoga saṃjñā pravartate

original: nanu coktam---avagrahe pluto na syāt / apsavya iti / naitasminn avagraham icchanti / vyākaraṇe 'py ekapade saṃhitāvidheyasyāvagrahasya lakṣaṇam eva nāsti / kevalaṃ hi saṃhitā cāsaṃhitā ca vyākaraṇe /
analyzed: nanu ca uktam avagrahe plutaḥ na syāt ap savyaḥ iti na etasmin avagraham icchanti vyākaraṇe pi eka pade saṃhitā vidheyasya avagrahasya lakṣaṇam eva na asti kevalam hi saṃhitā ca asaṃhitā ca vyākaraṇe

original: anye varṇayanti---yathā paramavācā iti vākchabdasya ‘tadādi subantaṃ ca’ (MaBhā 1.167.1--2) ity anuvṛttyā bhasaṃjñā, evam apśabdasya ‘yaci’ iti / tan na / vyavadhānāt / vyavahito 'trāpśabdo vākśabdas tv anantara iti /
analyzed: anye varṇayanti yathā parama vācā iti vāc śabdasya tad ādi sup antam ca  iti anuvṛttyā bha saṃjñā evam ap śabdasya ya ci iti tat na vyavadhānāt vyavahitaḥ trāp śabdaḥ vāc śabdaḥ tu anantaraḥ iti

original: idaṃ[?ha] tarhi [na] prāpnoti, apsuyoniḥ, apsumatir iti / ‘apo yoniyanmatiṣu’ (A 6.3.1, vā. 7) iti aluki kṛte / atrāpi nāsti ava[gra]haḥ / evaṃ hi paṭhyate---‘samāsapadānām anto 'vagṛhyate’ iti / samāsapadaṃ ca saha supā, nāpśabda iti /
analyzed: idam ha tarhi na prāpnoti apsuyoniḥ apsumatiḥ iti vā iti a luki kṛte atra api na asti avagrahaḥ evam hi paṭhyate samāsa padānām antaḥ vagṛhyate iti samāsa padam ca saha supā na ap śabdaḥ iti

original: [2] saṃyogasaṃjñā[yāḥ] ca śāstre (ca) pratyekaṃ saṃbandho 'nyatra sahavacanāt / ānantaryaṃ tūpalakṣaṇārtham, ānantaryeṇopalakṣitāḥ pratyekaṃ saṃjñāṃ pratipadyeran / yathānantaryeṇāvasthitebhyo brāhmaṇebhyaḥ pādyamācamanīyaṃ dīyatām ity ānantaryeṇopalṣitāḥ pratyekaṃ pratipādyante, yat tv asaṃbhavi tat sādhāraṇyena pratipadyante /
analyzed: saṃyoga saṃjñāyāḥ ca śāstre ca pratyekam saṃbandhaḥ nyatra sahavacanāt ānantaryam tu upalakṣaṇa artham ānantaryeṇa upalakṣitāḥ pratyekam saṃjñām pratipadyeran yathā ānantaryeṇa avasthitebhyaḥ brāhmaṇebhyaḥ pādyam ācamanīyam dīyatām iti ānantaryeṇa upalṣitāḥ pratyekam pratipādyante yat tu asaṃbhavi tat sādhāraṇyena pratipadyante

original: ‘kanyā dīyatāmebhyaḥ’ iti jñāyate dāsī iyam ebhyo dīyatām iti /
analyzed: kanyā dīyatām ebhyaḥ iti jñāyate dāsī iyam ebhyaḥ dīyatām iti

original: yathānyatrāpi / yadi samāsasaṃjñāyāṃ sahagrahaṇaṃ na kriyate, tato 'yam arthaḥ syāt---‘ṣaṣṭhī’ (A 2.2.8) ‘samāsaḥ’ (A 2.1.3) iti ṣaṣṭhyantasya yadā subantena saha prayogas tadā samāsasaṃjñā pravartata iti sarvasya na syāt / dvayos tu prayoge pratyekaṃ syāt / ṛkpādaḥ, rājāśva iti pratyekaṃ samāsāntaḥ prāpnoti, svaraś ca /
analyzed: yathā anyatra api yadi samāsa saṃjñāyām saha grahaṇam na kriyate tatas yam arthaḥ syāt ṣaṣṭhī cc-228 samāsaḥ iti ṣaṣṭhī antasya yadā sup antena saha prayogaḥ tadā samāsa saṃjñā pravartate iti sarvasya na syāt dvayoḥ tu prayoge pratyekam syāt ṛk pādaḥ rāja aśvaḥ iti pratyekam samāsa antaḥ prāpnoti svaraḥ ca

original: evam ubhegrahaṇe sahārthe akriyamāṇe dve abhyastasaṃjñe pratyekaṃ syātām / evam ihānantaryaṃ naikasya dharmo yathāntādī / kiṃ tarhi ? dvayor ayaṃ dharmo, dvayoś cānantaryeṇopalakṣitayoḥ antareṇa saha vacanaṃ saṃyogasaṃjñā pratyekaṃ prāpnoti /
analyzed: evam ubhe grahaṇe saha arthe akriyamāṇe dve abhyasta saṃjñe pratyekam syātām evam iha ānantaryam na ekasya dharmaḥ yathā anta ādī kim tarhi dvayoḥ ayam dharmaḥ dvayoḥ ca ānantaryeṇa upalakṣitayoḥ antareṇa saha vacanam saṃyoga saṃjñā pratyekam prāpnoti

original: kiṃ ca syāt ? ayam abhiprāyaḥ---ekasyāpi tu saṃyogasaṃjñāyāṃ pūrvasya ‘saṃyoge guru’ (A 1.4.11) iti siddhā gurusaṃjñeti / niryāyād ity etvaṃ prasajyeta, rephayakārayor ānantaryāt pratyekaṃ saṃyogasaṃjñeti yakāreṇa saṃyogādyaṅgaṃ bhavati iti / kiṃ nivartitam ? yāyādvāyād iti / atha samudāye saṃyogasaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ dvirvacane ‘aco rahābhyām . .
analyzed: kim ca syāt ayam abhiprāyaḥ ekasya api tu saṃyoga saṃjñāyām pūrvasya saṃyoge guru iti siddhā guru saṃjñā iti niryāyāt iti e tvam prasajyeta repha yakārayoḥ ānantaryāt pratyekam saṃyoga saṃjñā iti yakāreṇa saṃyoga ādi aṅgam bhavati iti kim nivartitam yāyāt vāyāt iti atha samudāye saṃyoga saṃjñāyām satyām dvirvacane a caḥ ra hābhyām

original: .’ (A 8.4.46) iti kṛte prāpnoti / asiddhatvān na bhaviṣyati saṃyogasaṃjñeti yathoddeśe parihāraḥ /
analyzed: iti kṛte prāpnoti asiddha tvāt na bhaviṣyati saṃyoga saṃjñā iti yathā uddeśe parihāraḥ

original: iha ca dṛṣatkarotīti / saṃyogaḥ ante yasya iti lopaḥ prasajyeta iti / vyapadeśivadbhāvena vā /
analyzed: iha ca dṛṣatkaroti iti saṃyogaḥ ante yasya iti lopaḥ prasajyeta iti vyapadeśivat bhāvena vā

original: iha ca śaktā vasteti / saṃyogādilopaḥ prasajyeta / kakārataāra[yoḥ sakāratakāra]yoś cānantarye sati sakārakakārau saṃyogau cādī ca saṃyogādī bhavataḥ / athāpi saṃyogayor ādī iti, bhavataḥ sakayos ta[? sakau ta]kārayor ādī /

original: saṃyogāvādī yasya so 'yaṃ saṃyogādir iti / nanu copasarjanaśabdasya saṃkhyāviśeṣopādānaṃ vṛttau nāsti ity uktam / satyam evaitat / kiṃ tu pañcake prātipadikārthe yāsau prātipadikopādhibhūtā vibhaktivyaṅgyā saṃkhyā, sā vṛttau nāśrīyate / śrūyamāṇāyām api ca vibhaktau na vivakṣyate, dāsyāḥputra iti /
analyzed: saṃyoga avādī yasya saḥ yam saṃyoga ādiḥ iti nanu ca upasarjana śabdasya saṃkhyā viśeṣa upādānam vṛttau na asti iti uktam satyam eva etat kim tu pañcake prātipadika arthe yā asau prātipadika upādhi bhūtā vibhakti vyaṅgyā saṃkhyā sā vṛttau na āśrīyate śrūyamāṇāyām api ca vibhaktau na vivakṣyate dāsyāḥ putraḥ iti

original: kva cit tu gamyata eva saṃkhyāviśeṣo, māsajātaḥ, śaurpikaḥ iti / parimāṇeṣūpasarjaneṣv aktaparimāṇasyaiva ete vācakā iti / kva cit ādeśarūpeṇaiva vyajyante, tāvakīno māmakīna iti / evam ihādiśabdopādānādāśninaḥ saṃkhyāviśeṣavyāpāraḥ / katham ? etāvat vaktavyam ‘saṃyogād āta’ iti / aṅgasya yaḥ saṃyogas tasmāt paro ya ākāraḥ tasyaitvaṃ bhavatīti /
analyzed: kva cit tu gamyate eva saṃkhyā viśeṣaḥ māsa jātaḥ śaurpikaḥ iti parimāṇeṣu upasarjaneṣu akta parimāṇasya eva ete vācakāḥ iti kva cit ādeśa rūpeṇa eva vyajyante tāvakīnaḥ māmakīnaḥ iti evam iha ādi śabda upādānāt āśninaḥ saṃkhyā viśeṣa vyāpāraḥ katham etāvat vaktavyam saṃyogāt ā taḥ iti aṅgasya yaḥ saṃyogaḥ tasmāt paraḥ yaḥ ākāraḥ tasya etvam bhavati iti

original: so 'yam ādiśabdaḥ evamartham upādīyate, asmin vākya upasarjanapade āśritaḥ saṃkhyāviśeṣaḥ iti / yadi ca samartho bhavati upasarjane tat ādiśabdo 'rthaprakaraṇasthānīyaḥ śaknoti pratipādatitum iti / yathā ‘sārasvatau bhavataḥ’ iti kṛtaikaśeṣād ayaṃ taddhita iti liṅgād avasīyate---‘mithunaṃ ha vā etad yad uta sarasvatī ca sarasvāṃś ca’ iti /
analyzed: saḥ yam ādi śabdaḥ evamartham upādīyate asmin vākye upasarjana pade āśritaḥ saṃkhyā viśeṣaḥ iti yadi ca samarthaḥ bhavati upasarjane tat ādi śabdaḥ rtha prakaraṇa sthānīyaḥ śaknoti iti yathā sārasvatau bhavataḥ iti kṛta ekaśeṣāt ayam taddhitaḥ iti liṅgāt avasīyate mithunam ha vai etat yat uta sarasvatī ca sarasvān ca iti

original: atha vā aṅgasya (A 6.4.1) ity ucyate ‘āta’ iti ca, na ca liṅo yakāramātram asty aṅgaṃ saṃyogāt param ity evaṃ vijñāyate---ihāntaryaṃ nopalakṣaṇa[ta]yopanyastam / kiṃ tarhi ? parigṛhītānāntaryau saṃyogatvenāśritāv iti / niryāyād iti pūrvaḥ saṃyogo 'vayavo na bhavatīti nāsty etvam /

original: te[na] ṛkāre trīṇi rūpāṇi---ekam asaṃhitāviṣayaṃ, dve saṃhitāviṣaye / evaṃ ḷkāre 'pi /

original: tan na vaktavyaṃ bhavati / evaṃ manyate---dvāv apy etau dīrghau, (r)ṛkāra (l)ḷkāraś ca, tau bhaviṣyataḥ / ṛkāre ca savarṇaḥ, ḷkāre ca savarṇasaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ ṛkāraś ca (l)ḷkāraś ceti /

original: avaśyaṃ tad vaktavyam / ūkālo 'jjhasvadīrghaplutaḥ (A 1.2.27), na cāyam aj iti / katham anactvam ? kecin manyante---dvau rephāvardhāv a[tha] cāṅmātreti / te īṣatspṛṣṭakaraṇatvāt prayatnabhedaṃ manyante / apare varṇayanti / dvau rephau turīyāv a[tha] cāṅmātreti / kecin manyante---sakalaś ca rephaḥ ṛkāraś cājbhaktiś cārdhamātreti /
analyzed: avaśyam tat vaktavyam ū kālaḥ jhasva dīrgha plutaḥ na ca ayam a c iti katham an a c tvam kecid manyante dvau rephau ardhau atha ca āṅ mātrā iti te īṣat spṛṣṭa karaṇa tvāt prayatna bhedam manyante apare varṇayanti dvau rephau turīyau atha ca āṅ mātrā iti kecid manyante sakalaḥ ca rephaḥ ṛkāraḥ ca a c bhaktiḥ ca ardha mātrā iti

original: kiṃ tu saṃvṛtataro 'yam / ṛkāraś ca vivṛtaḥ / prayatnabhedāt nāsty asya ṛkāre[ṇa] grahaṇam iti / evaṃ tarhi
analyzed: kim tu saṃvṛtataraḥ yam ṛkāraḥ ca vivṛtaḥ prayatna bhedāt na asti asya ṛkāreṇa grahaṇam iti evam tarhi

original: actvaṃ vakṣyāmi / saty actve dīrghasaṃjñā labhyate / yasya tu pakṣo 'rdhatṛtīyamātro 'yam iti tasyāctve sati dīrghasaṃjñāyā abhāvaḥ, bhinnakālatvāt / tasmād dcimātra evāyam abhyupagantavyaḥ / tac cāvaśyaṃ vaktavyam tvayāpi ṛvāvacanaṃ bruvatā / katham ? vacanād idaṃ tāvat syāt / asya tu pluto 'śakyaḥ kartum / anayor hi pluta ucyate (? iṣyate) /
analyzed: a c tvam vakṣyāmi sati a c tve dīrgha saṃjñā labhyate yasya tu pakṣaḥ ṛdha tṛtīya mātraḥ yam iti tasya a c tve sati dīrgha saṃjñāyāḥ abhāvaḥ bhinna kāla tvāt tasmāt dci mātraḥ eva ayam abhyupagantavyaḥ tat ca avaśyam vaktavyam tvayā api ṛvāvacanam bruvatā katham vacanāt idam tāvat syāt asya tu śakyaḥ kartum anayoḥ hi plutaḥ ucyate iṣyate

original: yaś cāsau kriyate 'sāv apy anactvāt pluto na bhavatīti na sthānī nāpy ādeśa iti sthitam etat---yaś ca savrṇasaṃjñām ārabhate yaś ca savarṇadīrghatve ḷvāvacanaṃ karoti, ubhābhyām actvaṃ vakavyam iti /

original: kiṃ punar atra jyāyaḥ ? kiṃ savarṇasaṃjñāvidhānam uta ḷvāvacanam iti ? atra codyate---yadi lakṣaṇayor lakṣye samāno vyāpāra[s] tat etad upapadyate---‘kiṃ punar atra jyāyaḥ ?’ iti / ayam iha tu bhinna eva vyāpāraḥ /
analyzed: kim punar atra jyāyaḥ kim savarṇa saṃjñā vidhānam uta ḷvā vacanam iti atra codyate yadi lakṣaṇayoḥ lakṣye samānaḥ vyāpāraḥ tat etat upapadyate kim punar atra jyāyaḥ iti ayam iha tu bhinnaḥ eva vyāpāraḥ

original: katham ? yadi savarṇasaṃjñā vidhīyate, na tad ucyate ṛti ṛvāvacanam iti, hotṛ ṛkāra iti sthite dvayor dīrghayor upasthitayor yadi tāvat dvāv api ṛkārau sthāninau dvābhyāṃ rephābhyāṃ tadvantāv iti iti dvayo rephayorr dvirepheṇādeśena bhavitavyam iti---sarvakālaṃ dvirephako dīrghaḥ prāpnoti /
analyzed: katham yadi savarṇa saṃjñā vidhīyate na tat ucyate ṛ ti iti hotṛ ṛkāraḥ iti sthite dvayoḥ dīrghayoḥ upasthitayoḥ yadi tāvat dvau api ṛkārau sthāninau dvābhyām rephābhyām tadvantau iti iti dvayoḥ rephayoḥ dvirepheṇa ādeśena bhavitavyam iti sarvakālam dvirephakaḥ dīrghaḥ prāpnoti

original: athāyaṃ pakṣaḥ---saṃvṛtataram api(? -m iti), evam api vivṛtayoḥ ṛkārayoḥ sthāne kathaṃ saṃvṛtataro bhaviṣyati ? tena sarvakālaṃ vivṛtena bhavitavyam / tathā ḷkāre parabhūte ralavān nāsti dīrgha iti paryāyeṇa kadācit [ṛ iti] dīrghaḥ syāt, kadācit [l]ḷ iti doṣaḥ (? dīrghaḥ) / atha manyase rūpatrayaṃ sādhyam, tac caivaṃ sidhyatīti / tac ca na /
analyzed: atha ayam pakṣaḥ saṃvṛtataram api m iti evam api vivṛtayoḥ ṛkārayoḥ sthāne katham saṃvṛtataraḥ bhaviṣyati tena sarvakālam vivṛtena bhavitavyam tathā ḷkāre parabhūte ra lavān na asti dīrghaḥ iti paryāyeṇa kadācid ṛ iti dīrghaḥ syāt kadācid iti doṣaḥ dīrghaḥ atha manyase rūpa trayam sādhyam tat ca evam sidhyati iti tat ca na asti

original: bhinnaviṣayau ṛkāraḷkārau parigṛhya traiśabdyaṃ sidhyet, na tv anyat tasmāt / yas tu (l)ḷ vidhatte, tasya katham ? asau (l)ḷ vā vi[da]dhat pakṣe dīrghatvaṃ vidadhāty eva, (l)ḷ ity api /
analyzed: bhinna viṣayau ṛkāra ḷkārau parigṛhya traiśabdyam sidhyet na tu anyat tasmāt yaḥ tu lḷ vidhatte tasya katham asau lḷ vā vidadhat pakṣe dīrgha tvam vidadhāti eva lḷ iti api

original: nanu ca tasyāpi sa[va]rṇasaṃjñāṃ vidadhataḥ ṛ ṛtīti ḷkāraḥ syāt [saṃ]nihitaḥ, [ḷ]tīti ṛkāraḥ / tatra ekaikasmiṃs trairūpyaṃ prāpnoti / syād etat / pravibhāgopādānam anarthakam ṛti ḷti ceti / anyatarasmin pravibhāgopādānasāmarthyāt trairūpyaṃ mā bhūd iti / anyatrasmi[n] tat prāpnoti prāpnoti eva /

original: ḷkārasya laparatvaṃ vakṣyāmi / vyākhyāsyāmīty arthaḥ / katham ? pratyāhāre ‘raṭ / laṇ /’ iti lakāre yo 'kāraḥ asāv anunāsikaḥ pratijñāsyate / atas tenānetarad iti (? -stenāntyenetā sahito ?) repha ādis tanmadhya[stha]sya saṃjñā bhaviṣyati iti, ‘uraṇ raparaḥ’ (A 1.1.51) iti rephas tanmadhya[stha]ṃ lakāraṃ pratyāyayati /
analyzed: ḷkārasya la para tvam vakṣyāmi vyākhyāsyāmi iti arthaḥ katham pratyāhāre iti lakāre kāraḥ asau anunāsikaḥ pratijñāsyate atas tena anetarat iti stena antyena itā sahitaḥ rephaḥ ādiḥ tad madhya sthasya saṃjñā bhaviṣyati iti rephaḥ tad madhya stham lakāram pratyāyayati

original: evam apy ubhayoḥ ralau kasmān na bhavataḥ ? āntaratamyāt / yathā jaśbhāvināṃ jaśaḥ carbhāvināṃ caraḥ evaṃ rephavato rephavān ādeśaḥ, lakāravato lakāravāṃś ca iti /

original: [prakḷpyamānam iti] / yathaivaṃ kḷpyamānam iti ṇatvaṃ bhavati evaṃ ‘prakḷpyamānaṃ paśya’ iti ‘kṛtyacaḥ’ (A 8.4.29) iti ṇatvaṃ prāpnoti /

original: yatra plutāśrayaḥ prakṛtibhāvaḥ niṣidhyate tatrāvaśyaṃ pragṛhyāśrayaḥ prakṛtibhāvaḥ eṣitavya [i]ty āha---naivaṃ śakyam / upasthite hi doṣaḥ syāt / agnī3ti / ‘‘aplutavad upasthite’’ (A 6.1.129) iti plutāśraye prakṛtibhāve pratiṣiddhe yadi pragṛhyasaṃjñā na syāt pragṛhyāśrayo 'pi prakṛtibhāvo nāsti iti svarasaṃdhiḥ prasajyeta /
analyzed: yatra pluta āśrayaḥ prakṛti bhāvaḥ niṣidhyate tatra avaśyam pragṛhya āśrayaḥ prakṛti bhāvaḥ eṣitavyaḥ iti āha na evam śakyam upasthite hi doṣaḥ syāt agni iti apluta vat upasthite iti pluta āśraye prakṛti bhāve pratiṣiddhe yadi pragṛhya saṃjñā na syāt pragṛhya āśrayaḥ pi prakṛti bhāvaḥ na asti iti svara saṃdhiḥ prasajyeta

original: satyāṃ tu pragṛhyasaṃjñāyāṃ pratiṣiddhe plutāśraye pragṛhyāśrayaḥ prakṛtibhāvo bhavati / tatraitat syāt naivātreṣyate prakṛtibhāva iti tadartham āha---paṭhiṣyati hy ācāryaḥ / ‘‘vadvacanaṃ plutakryapratiṣedhārtham’’ ‘‘plutapratiṣedhe hi pragṛhyaplutapratiṣedhaprasaṅgo 'nyena vihitatvāt’’ (A 6.1.129 vā.1, 2) iti /
analyzed: satyām tu pragṛhya saṃjñāyām pratiṣiddhe pluta āśraye pragṛhya āśrayaḥ prakṛti bhāvaḥ bhavati tatra etat syāt na eva atra iṣyate prakṛti bhāvaḥ iti tad artham āha paṭhiṣyati hi ācāryaḥ vat vacanam pluta krya pratiṣedha artham pluta pratiṣedhe hi pragṛhya pluta pratiṣedha prasaṅgaḥ vihita tvāt iti

original: yadi pluta eva pratiṣidhyeta yo 'pi pragṛhyaḥ plutaḥ tasyāpi trimātratāyāṃ nivṛttāyāṃ dvimātrasya śravaṇaṃ syāt / plutāśraye tu prakṛtibhāve pratiṣiddhe ya evāpragṛhyaḥ plutas tasyaiva svarasaṃdhir bhavati devadattā3 iti devadatteti /
analyzed: yadi plutaḥ eva pratiṣidhyeta pragṛhyaḥ plutaḥ tasya api tri mātra tāyām nivṛttāyām dvi mātrasya śravaṇam syāt pluta āśraye tu prakṛti bhāve pratiṣiddhe yaḥ eva a pragṛhyaḥ plutaḥ tasya eva svara saṃdhiḥ bhavati devadatta iti devadatta iti

original: yas tu pragṛhyas tasya plutakārye pratiṣiddhe 'pi pragṛhyāśraye prakṛtibhāve kṛte trimātraśrutir upapannā bhavati / tasmād asti prayojanaṃ plutasya pragṛhyasaṃjñāyām / sā ca vyaktipadārthābhyupagamān na prāpnoti /
analyzed: yaḥ tu pragṛhyaḥ tasya pluta kārye pratiṣiddhe pi pragṛhya āśraye prakṛti bhāve kṛte tri mātra śrutiḥ upapannā bhavati tasmāt asti prayojanam plutasya pragṛhya saṃjñāyām sā ca vyakti padārtha abhyupagamāt na prāpnoti

original: [5] yadi punar dīrghāṇāṃ [a]taparāṇāṃ pragṛhyasaṃjñocyeta / kiṃ punar ayaṃ taparatvā[d] doṣa āgato yata ucyate---yadi punar dīrghāṇām iti ? vyaktipadārthābhyupagamāt tv ayaṃ doṣaḥ / tatra kecid āhuḥ---etad evāyam āha / parityajya vyaktiṃ yady ākṛtau padārthe dīrgha ucyeta, yatnādhiktyāt hrasveṣv aprasaṅgaḥ /
analyzed: yadi punar dīrghāṇām a ta parāṇām pragṛhya saṃjñā ucyeta kim punar ayam ta para tvāt doṣaḥ āgataḥ yatas ucyate yadi punar dīrghāṇām iti vyakti padārtha abhyupagamāt tu ayam doṣaḥ tatra kecid āhuḥ etat eva ayam āha parityajya vyaktim yadi ākṛtau padārthe dīrghaḥ ucyeta yatna ādhiktyāt hrasveṣu aprasaṅgaḥ

original: syāt plutasya ca syāt pragṛhyatvaṃ, tathā pratuya (? ca hras)vanivartakaṃ (? -naṃ) syāt ity ataparāṇām ity āha / itaras tu vyaktāv eva padārthe pareṇedam uktam ity āha---evam apy ekāra [eva] ekaḥ savarṇā[n] gṛhṇīyāt / na tvīkārokārau gṛhṇīyātām / anaṇtvāt iti /
analyzed: syāt plutasya ca syāt pragṛhya tvam tathā ca hrasva nivartakam syāt iti a ta parāṇām iti āha itaraḥ tu vyaktau eva padārthe pareṇa idam uktam iti āha evam api ekāraḥ eva ekaḥ savarṇān gṛhṇīyāt na tu īkāra ukārau gṛhṇīyātām an aṇ tvāt iti

original: atha vā vyaktāv eva padārtha kasyacit tāvad asti savarṇagrahaṇaṃ sāmarthyād ity āha ‘yadi punar’ iti / itara evam api kaścid doṣo [na] nivartata ity āha evam apīti / apara āha---dīrghāṇām api ‘‘aṇo 'pragṛhyasya . . .’’ (A 8.4.57) ity evamādiṣu ackāryāṇi dṛṣṭāni /
analyzed: atha vā vyaktau eva padārtha kasyacid tāvat asti savarṇa grahaṇam sāmarthyāt iti āha yadi punar iti itaraḥ evam api kaścid doṣaḥ na nivartate iti āha evam api iti aparaḥ āha dīrghāṇām api pragṛhyasya a 8457 iti evamādiṣu a c kāryāṇi dṛṣṭāni

original: tasmāt tat (? aṇ) savarṇasya ity atrāpi tathaiva bhavitum arhati ity uktaṃ ‘yadi punar dīrghāṇām ataparāṇām' iti / anyatrāpy a[ṇ]savrṇasyeti anena dīrghāḥ kāryāṇi labhante / grahaṇaśāstre yad aṇgrahanaṃ tatra nānyat grahaṇaśāstram asti / tasyaiva cāṇgrahaṇasya svātmani vṛttir ayuktā /
analyzed: tasmāt tat savarṇasya iti atra api tathā eva bhavitum arhati iti uktam yadi punar dīrghāṇām a ta parāṇām iti anyatra api aṇ savrṇasya iti anena dīrghāḥ kāryāṇi labhante grahaṇa śāstre yat aṇ grahanam tatra na anyat grahaṇa śāstram asti tasya eva ca aṇ grahaṇasya sva ātmani vṛttiḥ ayuktā

original: antareṇa cāṇgrahaṇaṃ yat pariśiṣṭaṃ tad aparisamāptārthatvāt grahaṇaṃ pratyasamartham ity āha---‘evam apy ekāra eka’ iti / yadi punar hrasvānām . . . iti / taparatve agnī vāyū ity atra na syāt / ataparatvāt punaḥ vyaktāv api padārthe ‘aṇ savarṇān gṛhṇāti’ iti dīrghāṇāṃ plutānāṃ ca siddhā pragṛhyasaṃjñā / hrasvasyāpi tu prāpnoti /
analyzed: antareṇa ca aṇ grahaṇam yat pariśiṣṭam tat aparisamāpta artha tvāt grahaṇam prati asamartham iti āha evam api ekāraḥ ekaḥ iti yadi punar hrasvānām iti ta para tve agnī vāyū iti atra na syāt a ta para tvāt punar vyaktau api padārthe aṇ savarṇān gṛhṇāti iti dīrghāṇām plutānām ca siddhā pragṛhya saṃjñā hrasvasya api tu prāpnoti

original: kathaṃ punar atra bahuvacanam ? kecid virūpaikaśeṣam āhuḥ ‘prathamayor’ iti (A 6.2.102; 7.1.28) yathā / udāharaṇabhedāt bhedam anye bruvanti /
analyzed: katham punar atra bahuvacanam kecid virūpa ekaśeṣam āhuḥ prathamayoḥ iti

original: [6] evaṃ tarhi kiṃ na etena [yatnena yat] siddhaḥ plutaḥ [svarasaṃdhiṣu] iti ? kathaṃ yat [tat] jñāpakam uktam ? jñāpakam anyathā samarthyate---plutaṃ prāpnoti plutabhāvī, pluto bhāvī asyeti vā / prāpnoti plutabhāvī, pluto asyeti vā / plutabhāvena (? -bhāvinaḥ) / sthānina eva prakṛtibhāvaḥ / asyāṃ kalpanāyām [aśrutaṃ vākyaṃ nānumeyaṃ bhavati /
analyzed: evam tarhi kim na etena yatnena yat siddhaḥ plutaḥ svara saṃdhiṣu iti katham yat tat jñāpakam uktam jñāpakam anyathā samarthyate plutam prāpnoti pluta bhāvī plutaḥ bhāvī asya iti vā prāpnoti pluta bhāvī plutaḥ asya iti vā pluta bhāvena bhāvinaḥ sthāninaḥ eva prakṛti bhāvaḥ asyām kalpanāyām aśrutam vākyam na anumeyam bhavati

original: asiddhapari]bhāṣāyāś cābdhayā [pra]kṛtibhāvaśāstrakalpanayā ca dvayam anugṛhītaṃ bhavati / guṇaśabdakalpanāyāś caitad eva liṅgaṃ, yad ayam ‘‘aplutād apluta’’ iti pratiṣedhaṃ śāsti / nanu ca sthāninaḥ plutām api tva(? plutabhāvitva)m āśraya[s] tāvat u(? a)pekṣitaḥ / tasya cāsiddhatvād asato 'pekṣā na yujyate /
analyzed: asiddha paribhāṣāyāḥ prakṛti bhāva śāstra kalpanayā ca dvayam anugṛhītam bhavati guṇa śabda kalpanāyāḥ ca etat eva liṅgam yat ayam aplutāt aplutaḥ iti pratiṣedham śāsti nanu ca sthāninaḥ plutām api pluta bhāvi tvam āśrayaḥ tāvat u apekṣitaḥ tasya ca asiddha tvāt upekṣā na yujyate

original: tatra samāhuḥ---iha kvacit śāstranimittakeṣu śabdeṣu buddhyā vyavahriyate, kvacit laukikaṃ darśanam āśrīyate / tathāhītaretarāśrayadoṣas tatra tatra parihriyate / ‘‘siddhaṃ tu nityaśabdatvāt’’ (A 1.1.1. vā. 9) /
analyzed: tatra samāhuḥ iha kvacid śāstra nimittakeṣu śabdeṣu buddhyā vyavahriyate kvacid laukikam darśanam āśrīyate tathā hi itaretarāśraya doṣaḥ tatra tatra parihriyate siddham tu nitya śabda tvāt

original: na hi vṛddhisaṃjñayādaico bhāvyante, satām ādaicāṃ sādhaka(? sādhu)tvamātram anvākhyāyata iti asaty eva hi pratipādake lakṣaṇe teṣāṃ sādhya(? sādhu)tvam ādrīyate / evaṃ kṛtvā ‘‘lakṣaṇapratipadoktayor’’ ity etat syāt / kvacit anāśrayaṇaṃ bhavati / śāstranirapekṣāyāṃ śabdapravṛttau na kiṃcit lakṣaṇoktaṃ na pratipadoktam asti /
analyzed: na hi vṛddhi saṃjñayā ā t ai caḥ bhāvyante satām ā t ai cām sādhaka sādhu tva mātram anvākhyāyate iti asati eva hi pratipādake lakṣaṇe teṣām sādhya sādhu tvam ādrīyate evam kṛtvā lakṣaṇa pratipada uktayoḥ iti etat syāt kvacid anāśrayaṇam bhavati śāstra nirapekṣāyām śabda pravṛttau na kiṃcid lakṣaṇa uktam na pratipada uktam asti

original: nanu ca loke sthānyādeśa[bhāvā]bhāvāt plutabhāvitvam anupapannam / naiṣa doṣaḥ / loke 'pi hi viṣayāviṣayabhāvaḥ paricchidyate, svaviṣaye ayaṃ bhavatīti / tathā coktam---‘‘ijādiyajādi[pravṛtti]ś caiva hi loke lakṣyata’’ ity evamādi / anantaram eva ca vakṣyati---‘‘mārthādīdādyarthānām’’ iti /
analyzed: nanu ca loke sthānya ādeśa bhāva abhāvāt pluta bhāvi tvam anupapannam na eṣa doṣaḥ loke hi viṣaya aviṣaya bhāvaḥ paricchidyate sva viṣaye ayam bhavati iti tathā ca uktam i c ādi yac ādi pravṛttiḥ ca eva hi loke lakṣyate iti evamādi anantaram eva ca vakṣyati mā artha ādi id ādi arthānām iti

original: etasyāṃ tu kalpanāyāṃ bhāvigativijñānam anarthakaṃ sāṃpratikatvam api hi laukikadarśane śakyam āśrayitum / ko vā viśeṣaḥ, yad upalakṣaṇārtham āśritasya plutasya sattvaṃ gṛhyeta na kāryiṇaḥ ? tatra kecid āhuḥ---satyaṃ, vartamānatvam api saṃbhavati bhāvitvam api bhāvitvaṃ tv ihāśritaṃ iti tan na yuktam /
analyzed: etasyām tu kalpanāyām bhāvi gati vijñānam anarthakam sāṃpratika tvam api hi laukika darśane śakyam āśrayitum kaḥ vā viśeṣaḥ yat upalakṣaṇa artham āśritasya plutasya sattvam gṛhyeta na kāryiṇaḥ tatra kecid āhuḥ satyam vartamāna tvam api saṃbhavati bhāvi tvam api bhāvi tvam tu iha āśritam iti tat na yuktam

original: sāṃpratikābhāve hi sarvatra bhāvitvam ādrīyate / api cānya eva pakṣaḥ saṃbhavati---‘‘yathoddeśaṃ saṃjñāparibhāṣam’’ āśrayitavyam iti //
analyzed: sāṃpratika abhāve hi sarvatra bhāvi tvam ādrīyate api ca anyaḥ eva pakṣaḥ saṃbhavati yathoddeśam saṃjñā paribhāṣam āśrayitavyam iti

original: [7] evam api yat siddhe pragṛhyasaṃjñākāryaṃ tat [plutasya] na sidhyati, kāryakāle hi saṃjñāparibhāṣe / anunāsikaparyudāsadeśāyāṃ pragṛhyasaṃjñāyāṃ siddhaḥ plutaḥ / tatra trimātrā(? -tra)tvāt pragṛhyasaṃjñāyām asatyāṃ agnī3 ity atrānunāsikaparyudāso na prāpnoti / evaṃ tarhi kiṃ na etena [kārya]kālaṃ [saṃjñāparibhāṣam] iti /
analyzed: evam api yat siddhe pragṛhya saṃjñā kāryam tat plutasya na sidhyati kārya kāle hi saṃjñā paribhāṣe anunāsika paryudāsa deśāyām pragṛhya saṃjñāyām siddhaḥ plutaḥ tatra tri mātrā tra tvāt pragṛhya saṃjñāyām asatyām agniḥ iti atra anunāsika paryudāsaḥ na prāpnoti evam tarhi kim na etena kārya kālam saṃjñā paribhāṣam iti

original: yathoddeśam eva bhaviṣyati / kathaṃ punar i[da]m abhyupagamamātreṇa śakyaṃ labdhum ? tatra kecid āhuḥ---ihāntareṇa guṇaṃ [pradhānāni] saṃbandhaṃ pratipadyante / upakārabhedāc ca pradhānānāṃ dvayī pravṛttir dṛṣṭā / kadācit rājā harmyā[? -styā]dideśa[m u]paśliṣyati, kadācit harmyā[? -styā]dayo rājadeśam upanīyante /
analyzed: yathoddeśam eva bhaviṣyati katham punar idam abhyupagama mātreṇa śakyam labdhum tatra kecid āhuḥ iha antareṇa guṇam pradhānāni saṃbandham pratipadyante upakāra bhedāt ca pradhānānām dvayī pravṛttiḥ dṛṣṭā kadācid rājā harmyā sti ādi deśam upaśliṣyati kadācid rāja deśam upanīyante

original: tatra yadā svakālā[va]sthite saṃjñāparibhāṣe guṇakālaṃ kāryāṇy upanipatanti, tadā pradhānam api guṇadeśavarti svakāryapratipattyarthaṃ bhavati yathā [yathā] nimittam udakadeśagamanam / tatra yadā guṇadeśavarti pradhānaṃ tadāyathoddeśatvam /
analyzed: tatra yadā sva kāla avasthite saṃjñā paribhāṣe guṇa kālam kāryāṇi upanipatanti tadā pradhānam api guṇa deśa varti sva kārya pratipatti artham bhavati yathā yathā nimittam udaka deśa gamanam tatra yadā guṇa deśa varti pradhānam tadā yathā uddeśa tvam

original: yadā tu bhinneṣu aṅgabhāvapratipattyrartham abhipre[tasya] kenacit pradhā[ne]nāsaṃyuktasya satyām api nānāvākyavidheyatāyāṃ laghvarthaṃ bhedaparityāge sāmānyāśrayaṇalabdhenābhedakalpe ca (-tvena) tattadupadeśe prakaraṇotkarṣeṇa kriyamāṇe pradhānaviyuktasya [saṃjñāparibhāṣasya] svakālānurodhena [na] kiṃcit kāryam asti, yataḥ kasyāṃcid avasthāyām
analyzed: yadā tu bhinneṣu aṅga bhāva pratipattyāḥ artham abhipretasya kenacid pradhānena asaṃyuktasya satyām api nānā vākya vidheya tāyām laghu artham bheda parityāge sāmānya āśrayaṇa labdhena abheda kalpe ca tvena tad tad upadeśe prakaraṇa utkarṣeṇa kriyamāṇe pradhāna viyuktasya saṃjñā paribhāṣasya sva kāla anurodhena na kiṃcid kāryam asti yatas kasyāṃcid avasthāyām

original: asvātantryeṇāśrayaṇamarhedata autpattikenārthavyāpārakrameṇa pradhānagāmitvaṃ, [tadā] pradhānavākyenāvibhāgāpattau kāryakālatvam //
analyzed: asvātantryeṇa āśrayaṇam arhet atas autpattikena artha vyāpāra krameṇa pradhāna gāmi tvam tadā pradhāna vākyena avibhāga āpattau kārya kāla tvam

original: [8] anye tv anyathaitat dvaitaṃ samarthayante / anekapradhānaviṣayeṣu hi guneṣu pratipradhānaṃ ca bhe[de]na pravṛttir dṛṣṭā sraganulepanādiṣu, abhedena ca . . . pratipādi[te]ṣu [guṇeṣu] tu . . . / tatra pratipradhānaṃ bhedakalpanāyāṃ svakālād apracyutānām eva oradhānānām anugrahe saṃbhavati kāryakālatvam /
analyzed: anye tu anyathā etat dvaitam samarthayante aneka pradhāna viṣayeṣu hi pratipradhānam ca bhedena pravṛttiḥ dṛṣṭā sraj anulepana ādiṣu abhedena ca pratipāditeṣu guṇeṣu tu tatra pratipradhānam bheda kalpanāyām sva kālāt apracyutānām eva oradhānānām anugrahe saṃbhavati kārya kāla tvam

original: abhedapravṛttau tv asaṃbhavo yad ekena guṇenānekaṃ pradhā[naṃ] svasmin kāle vyavashtitam api sambandhaṃ yāyād iti / guṇe svātmany avasthite viśiṣṭenātmasaṃskāreṇādhīne [sati] pradhānāni yugapat guṇakālam anupatanti [iti] yathodeśarūpa[tās tu] / dvayam api nopapadyate /
analyzed: abheda pravṛttau tu asaṃbhavaḥ yat ekena guṇena anekam pradhānam svasmin kāle vyavashtitam api sambandham yāyāt iti guṇe sva ātmani avasthite viśiṣṭena ātma saṃskāreṇa adhīne sati pradhānāni yugapad guṇa kālam anupatanti iti yathā udeśa rūpatāḥ tu dvayam api na upapadyate

original: evaṃ hi vakṣyati---‘‘yadi sapādāyāṃ saptādhyāyyāṃ pādo[no] 'dhyāyo 'siddho ya iha pañcamīnirdeśāḥ saptamīnirdeśāś ca’’ teṣām asiddhatvāt ‘tasminn iti nirdiṣṭe pūrvasya’ ‘tasmād ity uttarasya’’’ ity eṣa niyamo na prāpnoti / ‘‘naiṣa doṣaḥ / yady apīdaṃ tatrāsiddhaṃ tat tv iha siddham / katham / kāryakālaṃ hi saṃjñāparibhāṣam’’ iti /
analyzed: evam hi vakṣyati yadi sa pādāyām sapta adhyāyyām pāda ūnaḥ siddhaḥ ye iha pañcamī nirdeśāḥ saptamī nirdeśāḥ ca teṣām asiddha tvāt tasmin iti nirdiṣṭe pūrvasya tasmāt iti uttarasya iti eṣa niyamaḥ na prāpnoti na eṣa doṣaḥ yadi api idam tatra asiddham tat tu iha siddham katham kārya kālam hi saṃjñā paribhāṣam iti

original: tatra yathaiva kāryakālānāṃ guṇānām ekavākyabhāve pūrvaparavyapadeśahānena (? -nā)pṛthakkāryatvāc cedam asmin siddham ity etat [na] vidyate, evaṃ guṇadeśatve pradhānānām ekavākyabhāve pūrvaparavyapadeśavidhir [na] vijñāyate /
analyzed: tatra yathā eva kārya kālānām guṇānām eka vākya bhāve pūrva para vyapadeśa hānena na apṛthak kārya tvāt ca idam asmin siddham iti etat na vidyate evam guṇa deśa tve pradhānānām eka vākya bhāve pūrva para vyapadeśa vidhiḥ na vijñāyate

original: [9] evam ubhayasmin doṣaṃ parikalpya doṣāntaraprayojanāpa(? -pradarśanāpe)kṣāyāṃ praśnaḥ / [a] īdādayo dvivacanaṃ pragṛhyā iti cedanty asya vidhiḥ (vā. 1) / īdantādeḥ pacete iti / yo 'tredādir na tad dvivacanam / naiva kaścid ekāro dvivacanam astīti manyamāna āha---vacanād bhaviṣyati / dvivacanāvayave dvivavacanaśabdo vartate ity abhiprāyaḥ /

original: yathā ‘liṅsicau’ ity atrātmanepadāvayave ātmanepadam iti vyapadiśyate ‘liṅaḥ sīyuḍ’ (A 3.4.102) iti / asti vacane prayojanam / [kim] / khaṭve iti / yady apy etat na mukhyaṃ dvivacanaṃ, tathāpy atrādivadbhāvenāsti dvivacanavyapadeśa iti / trapuṇī jatunī ityādau tu pūrvabhaktatvāt numaḥ mukhyam eva dvivacanam iti nopanyastam /
analyzed: yathā liṅ sicau iti atra ātmanepada avayave ātmanepadam iti vyapadiśyate liṅaḥ iti asti vacane prayojanam kim khaṭve iti yadi api etat na mukhyam dvivacanam tathā api atra ādivat bhāvena asti dvivacana vyapadeśaḥ iti trapuṇī jatunī ityādau tu pūrva bhakta tvāt numaḥ mukhyam eva dvivacanam iti na upanyastam

original: [ā] īdādyantam iti ced ekasya vidhiḥ / (vā. 2) khaṭve iti / īdūtoḥ kevalayor eva saṃbhava iti na tāvad āśrīyate / kathaṃ punar ananyārtham ārabhyamāṇā ādyantavatparibhāṣā nāśritā ? ucyate / nāvaśyaṃ granthagauravam eva gauravaṃ bhavati / kiṃ tarhi ? pratipatti[gauravaṃ, prakriyā]gauravam api /
analyzed: ā ī t ādi antam iti ced ekasya vidhiḥ vā khaṭve iti ī t ū toḥ kevalayoḥ eva saṃbhavaḥ iti na tāvat āśrīyate katham punar ananya artham ārabhyamāṇā ādi anta vat paribhāṣā na āśritā ucyate na avaśyam grantha gauravam eva gauravam bhavati kim tarhi pratipatti gauravam prakriyā gauravam api

original: [i] etad api tu nāśrayiṣyāmīty āha---athavaivaṃ vakṣyāmi / īdādyantaṃ yad dvivacanāntam iti / nanu ca ‘saṃjñāvidhau pratyayagrahaṇe tadantavidhir nāsti’ iti / satyam, saṃjñāvidhau pratyayagrahaṇe tadantavidhiḥ pratiṣidhyate /
analyzed: i etat api tu na āśrayiṣyāmi iti āha athavā evam vakṣyāmi ī t ādi antam yat dvivacana antam iti nanu ca saṃjñā vidhau pratyaya grahaṇe tad anta vidhiḥ na asti iti satyam saṃjñā vidhau pratyaya grahaṇe tad anta vidhiḥ pratiṣidhyate

original: na tv iha dvavacanaṃ saṃjñitvenāśrīyate, kiṃ tarhi ? īdādyantam, tadviśeṣaṇaṃ dvivacanaṃm, īdādyantaṃ pragṛhyasaṃjñaṃ bhavati tac ced dvivacanāntam iti / kathaṃ punaḥ śrutyā prakaraṇena vā kāryiṇaḥ saṃnidhānam antareṇedādibhis tadantavidhiḥ ? [na kva] cid asti / pūrvas tarhi pakṣo nopapadyata īdādayo dvivacanam iti /
analyzed: na tu iha dva vacanam saṃjñi tvena āśrīyate kim tarhi ī t ādi antam tad viśeṣaṇam dvivacanam ī t ādi antam pragṛhya saṃjñam bhavati tat ced dvivacana antam iti katham punar śrutyā prakaraṇena vā kāryiṇaḥ saṃnidhānam antareṇa id ādibhiḥ tad anta vidhiḥ na kva cit asti pūrvaḥ tarhi pakṣaḥ na upapadyate ī t ādayaḥ dvivacanam iti

original: kecid āhuḥ---kāryakālaṃ hi saṃjñāparibhāṣaṃ yatho[dde]śaṃ ca / tatra kā[ryakā]le padādhikāre pragṛhyasaṃjñāvyāpārāt padaṃ kāryitvena saṃnihitam / tatra yathā ‘ṣyaṅaḥ saṃprasāraṇm’ (A 6.1.13) iti sāmarthyalabhyasaṃniyogaṃ pūrvapadaṃ kāryitvenāśrīyate, evaṃ padasya kāryiṇaḥ īdādibhiḥ tadantavidhir iti /
analyzed: kecid āhuḥ kārya kālam hi saṃjñā paribhāṣam yathoddeśam ca tatra kārya kāle pada adhikāre pragṛhya saṃjñā vyāpārāt padam kāryi tvena saṃnihitam tatra yathā iti sāmarthya labhya saṃniyogam pūrva padam kāryi tvena āśrīyate evam padasya kāryiṇaḥ ī t ādibhiḥ tad anta vidhiḥ iti

original: tathodeśatāyāṃ tu pragṛhyakāryeṣu anapekṣiteṣu pradhānaṃ kāryi[pa]daṃ kāryitve[na] nāśrīyate / evaṃ padasya kāryiṇo 'bhāvāt yathāśrutaparikalpanā / atha vā kāryakāla eva satīdādīnāṃ prādhānyāt tadantavidhyabhāvaḥ, na tv idam upapadyate / ‘yathoddeśaṃ hi saṃjñābhāṣam’ abhyupagatam /
analyzed: tathā udeśa tāyām tu pragṛhya kāryeṣu an apekṣiteṣu pradhānam kāryi padam kāryi tvena na āśrīyate evam padasya kāryiṇaḥ bhāvāt yathāśruta parikalpanā atha vā kārya kāle eva satī id ādīnām prādhānyāt tad anta vidhi abhāvaḥ na tu idam upapadyate yathoddeśam hi saṃjñā bhāṣam abhyupagatam

original: evaṃ tarhi pūrvaṃ dvivacanena tadantavidhiḥ ‘pratyayagrahaṇe yasmāt sa vihita’ iti / na hy atrāvaśyaṃ kāryiṇaḥ saṃ[ni]dhānam apekṣyate / tato dvivacanāntasya saṃjñinaḥ īdādibhis tadantavidhiḥ / na hīdādyantaṃ dvivacanāntam iti ayam uccārakramas tantram / dvivacanāntam īdādyantam etat bhavati /
analyzed: evam tarhi pūrvam dvivacanena tad anta vidhiḥ pratyaya grahaṇe yasmāt sa vihitaḥ iti na hi atra avaśyam kāryiṇaḥ saṃnidhānam apekṣyate tatas dvivacana antasya saṃjñinaḥ ī t ādibhiḥ tad anta vidhiḥ na hi id ādi antam dvivacana antam iti ayam uccāra kramaḥ tantram dvivacana antam ī t ādi antam etat bhavati

original: evaṃ tu sati pratyayarūpeṇa saṃjñina āśrayāt tadantavidhir apy avasito darśanamātrāt, evam api / dṛṣṭo hi prātipadikasaṃjñāyāṃ tadantavidhiḥ ‘‘kṛttaddhitasamāsāś ca (A 1.2.46)’’ iti / caturtha eva pakṣe tadantavidhyanupapattir uktā / sā ihāpi draṣṭavyā / doṣāntareṇa vā nvṛtte(? -tter) vihitatvāt ayaṃ doṣo nābhihitaḥ / īdādyantaṃ . . .

original: cet luki pratiṣedhaḥ / kathaṃ punar dvivacanāntasya samāsaḥ, yāvatā ‘‘saṃkhyāviśeṣo vyaktābhidhānam upasarjanaviśeṣaṇaṃ cayoga’’ ity ekārthībhāvakṛtā viśeṣā varṇitāḥ ? tathā ca ‘‘dvivacanabahuvacanāntānām asamāsa’’ ity uktam / tatra kecid āhuḥ---lukeyam anvākhyātā vibhaktir iṣyate / na ca sataḥ śabdasya lukānvākhyānamam asti /
analyzed: ced pratiṣedhaḥ katham punar dvivacana antasya samāsaḥ yāvatā saṃkhyā viśeṣaḥ vyakta abhidhānam upasarjana viśeṣaṇam ca yogaḥ iti ekārthībhāva kṛtāḥ viśeṣāḥ varṇitāḥ tathā ca dvivacana bahuvacana antānām asamāsaḥ iti uktam tatra kecid āhuḥ lukā iyam anvākhyātā vibhaktiḥ iṣyate na ca sataḥ śabdasya asti

original: tatra vākye dṛṣṭasya dvivacanasya vṛttiviṣaye saṃkhyāviśeṣaparityāgāt, yaivāsau svābhāvikī nivṛttiḥ sā lukvyāpāreṇānvākhyāyate / tathā cāha---‘‘avyayādāpo lugvacanā[n a]rthakyaṃ liṅgābhāvāt’’ (A 2.4.82 vā. 1) / kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ bhavānāpo lugvacanaṃ na mṛṣyati, vibhakter mṛṣyati ? asty atra viśeṣaḥ /
analyzed: tatra vākye dṛṣṭasya dvivacanasya vṛtti viṣaye saṃkhyā viśeṣa parityāgāt yā eva asau svābhāvikī nivṛttiḥ sā luc vyāpāreṇa anvākhyāyate tathā ca āha avyayāt āpaḥ luc vacanān arthakyam liṅga abhāvāt vā kim punar kāraṇam bhavān āpaḥ luc vacanam na mṛṣyati vibhakteḥ mṛṣyati asti atra viśeṣaḥ

original: pratyayalakṣaṇam ācāryaḥ prārthayamāno vibhakter lukam ārabhata’’ ity uktam / uhayaṃ hi svabhāvato nivartate / yasya tu nivṛttatvākhyāne prayojanam asti tasya nivṛttir ākhyāyate iti / tat tu na yuktaṃ prasaṅgābhāvāt / prasaktādarśanaṃ hi lopasaṃjñam /
analyzed: pratyaya lakṣaṇam ācāryaḥ prārthayamānaḥ vibhakteḥ lukam ārabhate iti uktam uhayam hi svabhāvataḥ nivartate yasya tu nivṛtta tva ākhyāne prayojanam asti tasya nivṛttiḥ ākhyāyate iti tat tu na yuktam prasaṅga abhāvāt prasakta adarśanam hi lopa saṃjñam

original: yat tu samāsārthavākyaṃ loke 'vyaktam adṛṣṭaprayogaṃ samāsasya pratipādakaṃ tatraikārthībhāvaviṣaye svārthamātropayogiṣūpasarjaneṣu svabhedenānarthiṣu vyapadeśārtham abhedenaikatvasaṃkhyāyām āśritāyāṃ bhedasaṃkhyāviṣayāṇāṃ vacanānām aprasaṅgo metava(? bhavet) yat ekārthībhāvaviṣayāṇy upasarjanapadāni anāśritabhedasaṃkhyāni svapadārthamātropakārīṇi
analyzed: yat tu samāsa artha vākyam loke vyaktam adṛṣṭa prayogam samāsasya pratipādakam tatra ekārthībhāva viṣaye sva artha mātra upayogiṣu upasarjaneṣu sva bhedena anarthiṣu vyapadeśa artham abhedena eka tva saṃkhyāyām āśritāyām bheda saṃkhyā viṣayāṇām vacanānām aprasaṅgaḥ bhavet yat ekārthībhāva viṣayāṇi upasarjana padāni anāśrita bheda saṃkhyāni sva padārtha mātra upakārīṇi

original: vijñāyante / śabdāntaropasaṃhitānāṃ tūpasarjanānāṃ saty api pradhānārthāskande saṃkhyāviśeṣavyaktāv anivṛttāyām eva sāmarthyāt [svi]śaurpikādiṣu mūlyaparimāṇāvadhāraṇārthe hi dviśabdaprayogaḥ saṃkhyāviśeṣasyānāśraye na syāt / na ca prayoganimittāpākaraṇaṃ yuktam / evaṃ māsajāte prayogaviśeṣasaṃpratyayaḥ /
analyzed: vijñāyante śabda antara upasaṃhitānām tu upasarjanānām sati api pradhāna artha āskande saṃkhyā viśeṣa vyaktau anivṛttāyām eva sāmarthyāt sviśaurpika ādiṣu mūlya parimāṇa avadhāraṇa arthe hi dvi śabda prayogaḥ saṃkhyā viśeṣasya anāśraye na syāt na ca prayoga nimitta apākaraṇam yuktam evam māsa jāte prayoga viśeṣa saṃpratyayaḥ

original: goṣucare 'navayavadravyasaṃyogārthaṃ vibhaktyupādānam / pratyākhyānapakṣe ‘jātyākhyāyām-’ (A 1.2.58) ity ekavacanam / vyavasthitavibhāṣā hi goviṣṭhira ekavacanam eva dṛśyate / varṣāsuje rūḍhiśabdasaṃpratyayaḥ / dviputra ubhayabhārya iti pūrvapadopādānasāmarthyāt / tathā hi [pra]tya[ya] eva tasya svārthaḥ /
analyzed: goṣucare nava yava dravya saṃyoga artham vibhakti upādānam pratyākhyāna pakṣe jāti ākhyāyām iti ekavacanam vyavasthita vibhāṣā hi goviṣṭhiraḥ eka vacanam eva dṛśyate varṣāsu je rūḍhi śabda saṃpratyayaḥ dvi putraḥ ubhaya bhāryaḥ iti pūrva pada upādāna sāmarthyāt tathā hi pratyayaḥ eva tasya svārthaḥ

original: tathā vṛddhinimittādiṣu nimittaśabdopādānasāmarthyaṃ yathāsaṃbhavaṃ draṣtavyam / tathā śabdāntaropasaṃdhānād avyaktaviśeṣe 'py upasarjane saṃkhyāviśeṣopādānasāmarthyaṃ dṛṣṭam / tad yathā / gārgyakulādiṣu pratyayasya bhāvābhāvābhyāṃ bhedavyaktiḥ / godau varaṇā ity atideśabhājivikāradarśanāt / tyauṣmākastāvako yuṣmatputraḥ ity ādeśarūpāt /
analyzed: tathā vṛddhi nimitta ādiṣu nimitta śabda upādāna sāmarthyam yathāsaṃbhavam draṣtavyam tathā śabda antara upasaṃdhānāt avyakta viśeṣe pi upasarjane saṃkhyā viśeṣa upādāna sāmarthyam dṛṣṭam tat yathā gārgya kula ādiṣu pratyayasya bhāva abhāvābhyām bheda vyaktiḥ godau varaṇāḥ iti atideśa bhāji vikāra darśanāt tyauṣmākaḥ tāvakaḥ yuṣmad putraḥ iti ādeśa rūpāt

original: tatra kumāryagāre 'pi prakṛtibhāva eva dvivacanakāryaṃ saṃkhyāviśeṣopādānavyaktini[mi]ttaṃ syāt / etasyāṃ kalpanāyāṃ rājapuruṣādiṣu viśeṣavācinaḥ śabdasyābhāvāṭ viśeṣo na [ga]myate / dāsyāḥ putrādiṣu caikavacanasaṃnidhānād ekatvaṃ gamyate ity āpannam / tatraikārthībhāvakṛtaś cāyaṃ saṃkhyāviśeṣa ity etan nopapadyate /
analyzed: tatra kumārī agāre pi prakṛti bhāvaḥ eva dvivacana kāryam saṃkhyā viśeṣa upādāna vyakti nimittam syāt etasyām kalpanāyām rāja puruṣa ādiṣu viśeṣa vācinaḥ śabdasya abhāvāt viśeṣaḥ na gamyate dāsyāḥ putra ādiṣu ca eka vacana saṃnidhānāt eka tvam gamyate iti āpannam tatra ekārthībhāva kṛtaḥ ca ayam saṃkhyā viśeṣaḥ iti etat na upapadyate

original: yac coktaṃ ‘‘nanu ca naitenaivaṃ hi [bhavi]tavyam’’ / na hi śabdanimittakena nāmārthena bhavitavyam, arthanimittakena śabdena bhavitavyam / tad evaṃ dṛśyatām artharūpam evaitad evaṃjātīyakaṃ yenātra viśeṣo na gamyata iti / avaśyaṃ caitad evaṃ vijñeyam /
analyzed: yat ca uktam nanu ca na etena evam hi bhavitavyam na hi śabda nimittakena nāma arthena bhavitavyam artha nimittakena śabdena bhavitavyam tat evam dṛśyatām artha rūpam eva etat evaṃjātīyakam yena atra viśeṣaḥ na gamyate iti avaśyam ca etat evam vijñeyam

original: yo hi manyate yo 'sau viśeṣavācī śabdas tadasāṃnidhyād atra viśeṣo na gamyata iti’’ iha tasya viśeṣo gamyeta---apsucaro [gaṣucaro] varṣāsuja iti / tat vipratiṣidhyate / tasmān na śabdaviśeṣakṛte saṃkhyāyāḥ parityāgopādāne, ekārthībhāvakṛta evāyaṃ viśeṣaḥ / tad etat samarthavārttike eva nirṇeṣyate / saptamyāmarthagrahaṇaṃ (tu) jñāpakaṃ . . . /
analyzed: yaḥ hi manyate asau viśeṣa vācī śabdaḥ tad asāṃnidhyāt atra viśeṣaḥ na gamyate iti iha tasya viśeṣaḥ gamyeta apsucaraḥ gaṣucaraḥ varṣāsujaḥ iti tat vipratiṣidhyate tasmāt na śabda viśeṣa kṛte saṃkhyāyāḥ parityāga upādāne ekārthībhāva kṛtaḥ eva ayam viśeṣaḥ tat etat samartha vārttike eva nirṇeṣyate saptamyām artha grahaṇam tu jñāpakam

original: saptamīty eva śrūyamāṇāyām, lukā luptāyāṃ tu pratyayalakṣaṇena siddhe 'rthagrahaṇaṃ pragṛhyaprakaraṇe pratyayalakṣaṇanivṛttyartham / etat tarhi jñāpakārtham arthagrahaṇaṃ kartavyam / ādyantavat paribhāṣāṃ cānyārthāṃ satīṃ mā śriśriyam ity ayaṃ pakṣa āśritaḥ / tatrākartavya[pra]kriyābhyupagamo na yukta iti /

original: [2] bhāradvājīyāḥ paṭhanti / vikṛtārtham iti teṣām adhikam / praṇidātā praṇidhātā / deṅdheṭer ete rūpe / pratipadoktam ākārāntatvam atra nāstīty āha---lakṣaṇapratipadoktayor iti / kātyāyanas tu ‘gāmādāgrahaṇeṣv aviśeṣa’ ity anena samarthyatvān naitad uktavān /

original: itaro yady evānarthakyād anupasargād vā nityanivṛttiṃ manyase, iṣṭe 'pi te viṣaye ghusaṃjñā na prāpnoti ity āha ihāpi tarhi na prāpnoti atrāpi hi dāpśabdasyārthavattvaṃ tam eva ca prati kriyāyogaḥ, na dāśabdasyārthavattvaṃ, na ca taṃ prati kriyāyoga iti ekaparihāreṇobhayor nivṛttiṃ karoti /

original: sa tasya vyatirekaṃ karoti iti na tasyopacaye 'pacaye vā sati vyapadeśavyāvṛttir bhavati / tad yathā loke labdhadevadattavyapadeśahānaṃ na bhavati tathā tṛcsanoḥ pratilabdhārdhadhātukavyapadeśayoḥ pratyayavaśādikārādir avayavāntaram upajāyate, akāre vā sano vigate nārdhadhātukavyapadeśanivṛttir bhavati / yadi hi syāt lavitā pipaṭhiṣitā . . .

original: (sati guṇe 'dābārdhadhātukanimitto na syāt), evam ihāpi dādhoḥ pratilabdhadhuvyapadeśayoḥ pratyayavaśāt pakāre 'vayavāntare lokaśāstrayor ivāvyatirekakara upajāte vigate vā praṇidayate iti ghusaṃjñāvyapadeśahānaṃ na bhavati /

original: tatraivaṃ sati dādhoḥ pratilabdhadhusaṃjñayor avyatirekakare avayavāntare pakāropajane 'nivṛttaghuvyapadeśayoḥ parataḥ ‘upasargasthāt’ idam ucyate arthavta iti / anarthakasyāpi tu labdhavyapadeśasyāvayavāntara upajāyamāne 'vyatirekakare vyapadeśahānaṃ na bhavati /

original: tathāhi ārdhadhātukanimitto ‘guṇo bhavati vṛddhir bhavatīti rephaśirasāvakārākārau bhavataḥ’ iti / tathā dāpayatimukhenedaṃ prastutam iti ‘arthavato hy āgamaḥ’ ity ucyate / labdhavyapadeśasyopacaye [ 'pacaye vā]pi svavyapadeśahānaṃ na bhavati / tathā hy ādyantamadhyānām api śabdānāṃ svavyapadeśa[hānaṃ na bhavati] /

original: pratiṣedho 'py ayaṃ kāryasyākaraṇāt na pratiṣedha iti vyapadiṣyate, pratiṣedham antareṇa siddhatvāt / tarabgrahaṇaṃ hy aupadeśikam / upadeśe prayuktam, upadeśe vā bhavam [aupadeśīkam] / śāstre yas tarapśabdaḥ sa gṛhyate avayavārthe iti etad vyācaṣṭe / śabdaḥ sahacāriṇo 'nubandhanārthasya saṃbandhita iti /

original: sa cānubandho yatra samānaśabdatvaṃ tatrārtham anyad vā dhruvaṃ nimittam upalakṣayati / yatra tu nāsti samānaśabdatvaṃ tatra śabdam eva pratipādayati / yatrāsyaitad rūpaṃ bhavati anubandhasahitam iti, artharūpavaraṇaṃ ca śrutisaṃbandhe bhavati iti prayogo 'bhisamīkṣyate /

original: tatra yo 'vyabhicārī nityaḥ pradhānārthe prayuktaḥ sa āśrayitavya ity āha---rūpanirgrahaś ca [śabdasya] nāntareṇa laukikaṃ prayogam iti / eṣa nyāyyaḥ / saty anubandhe laukike prayoge pravarteran / tatra na kāryā laukikāḥ prayogā iti laukikānubandhavyavahārasya nivṛttatvāt nāyaṃ tarapśabdaḥ /
analyzed: tatra yaḥ vyabhicārī nityaḥ pradhāna arthe prayuktaḥ saḥ āśrayitavyaḥ iti āha rūpa nirgrahaḥ ca śabdasya na antareṇa laukikam prayogam iti eṣa nyāyyaḥ sati anubandhe laukike prayoge pravarteran tatra na kāryāḥ laukikāḥ prayogāḥ iti laukika anubandha vyavahārasya nivṛtta tvāt na ayam tarap śabdaḥ

original: kas tarhi ? tarabśabda iti laukikāt prayogān nivṛttā anityaṃ guṇabhūtaṃ dvitīyaṃ prayogam upāsmahe / kāś cāsau ? upadeśo nāma / upadeśe 'pśabdo na tarapśabda iti / na laukike prayoge etadrūpaṃ, na śāśtre iti kālpanike rūpe prāptir na vidyate iti nāsti ghasaṃjñā /

original: [2] atha vāstvasya iti / kāryaṃ doṣāya na saṃjñeti / samānādhikaraṇeṣu ghāḍiṣu / ayaṃ tāvat nadyās tara iti vyadhikaraṇaḥ / prakarṣārthīyau ca svārthikau ca kārakaprakarṣe vartamānau samānādhikaraṇau / yadā tarhi saiva nadī sa [eva] taraḥ / nanu ca tīrṇir iti bhavitavyam / naiṣa doṣaḥ /
analyzed: atha vāstu asya iti kāryam doṣāya na saṃjñā iti samāna adhikaraṇeṣu ghāḍiṣu ayam tāvat nadyāḥ taraḥ iti vyadhikaraṇaḥ prakarṣa arthīyau ca svārthikau ca kāraka prakarṣe vartamānau samāna adhikaraṇau yadā tarhi sā eva nadī saḥ eva taraḥ nanu ca tīrṇiḥ iti bhavitavyam na eṣa doṣaḥ

original: yadā tīryate iti taraḥ, tara iti sāmānyamātraṃ prādhānyenāśrīyate [yadā] punas tīryate nadīty uttarakālaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ, tadā tadā nāsti pradhānasya liṅgasya tyāgaḥ, yathā mukhadvitīyā nāsikā vacanam asyrti, na tu vacanī iti / athavā rūḍhiḥ, taro nadyā viśeṣyate / samudāyeṣu hi śabdāḥ pravṛttā iti /
analyzed: yadā tīryate iti taraḥ taraḥ iti sāmānya mātram prādhānyena āśrīyate yadā punar tīryate nadī iti uttarakālam viśeṣaṇam tadā tadā na asti pradhānasya liṅgasya tyāgaḥ yathā mukha dvitīyā nāsikā vacanam na tu vacanī iti athavā rūḍhiḥ taraḥ nadyāḥ viśeṣyate samudāyeṣu hi śabdāḥ pravṛttāḥ iti

original: strīliṅgeṣu ghādiṣu (A 6.3.43) ‘striyām’ (A 6.3.3) iti ca vartate / samudāyeṣu hi liṅgyogāt svārthiko 'pi strīliṅga iti vyapadiśyate / brāhmaṇī rūpam iveti / brāhmaṇīveyam ākṛtiḥ brāhmaṇīrūpam iti / kecid udāharanti---sāmnas taraḥ sāmatara iti / nādūghasya (A 8.2.17) iti nuṭ prāpnoti / chāndasatvān na bhaviṣyati iti pratividhīyate /
analyzed: strī liṅgeṣu gha ādiṣu striyām iti ca vartate samudāyeṣu hi liṅga yogāt svārthikaḥ strī liṅgaḥ iti vyapadiśyate brāhmaṇī rūpam iva iti brāhmaṇī iva iyam ākṛtiḥ brāhmaṇī rūpam iti kecid udāharanti sāmnaḥ taraḥ sāma taraḥ iti iti prāpnoti chāndasa tvāt na bhaviṣyati iti pratividhīyate

original: bahuguṇavatuḍati saṃkhyā (A 1.1.23)
analyzed: saṃkhyā

original: saṃkhyāsaṃjñāyāṃ saṃkhyāgrahaṇam / adhikaraṇasaptamī, saṃkhyāsaṃjñāsūtre saṃkhyāgrahaṇam iti / athavā saṃkhyāsaṃjñāyāṃ vidhīyamānāyāṃ vidhārasyamānāyāṃ vihitāyāṃ vā saṃkhyāgrahaṇam iti / saṃkhyāgrahaṇaṃ cāsmin yoge, ‘bahuguṇavatuḍatisaṃkhyāḥ saṃkhyā’ ity evaṃ paṭhitavyam iti / etat pradarśyate---saṃkhyā ca saṃkhyāsaṃjñā bhavatīti vaktavyam /
analyzed: saṃkhyā saṃjñāyām saṃkhyā grahaṇam adhikaraṇa saptamī saṃkhyā saṃjñā sūtre saṃkhyā grahaṇam iti athavā saṃkhyā saṃjñāyām vidhīyamānāyām vihitāyām vā saṃkhyā grahaṇam iti saṃkhyā grahaṇam ca asmin yoge bahu guṇavat tuḍati saṃkhyāḥ saṃkhyāḥ iti evam paṭhitavyam iti etat pradarśyate saṃkhyā ca saṃkhyā saṃjñā bhavati iti vaktavyam

original: athavā evaṃ pāṭhaḥ kartavyaḥ---‘bahuguṇavatuḍati’ tataḥ ‘saṃkhyā ca’ iti / kiṃ prayojana,¥m ? abhiprāyo 'yam / yathā ‘paśur apatyaṃ devatā’, ‘prācāṃ, udīcāṃ’ iti laukikā evopādīyante śāstravyavahāre---na hy eṣāṃ śāstrāntare 'sti paribhāṣaṇam iti---evam ete 'py ekādadyaḥ śāstrāntareṇāparibhāṣitā laukikā eva / laukikaiś caivaṃ vyavahriyate /
analyzed: athavā evam pāṭhaḥ kartavyaḥ tatas saṃkhyā ca iti kim prayojanam abhiprāyaḥ yam yathā paśuḥ apatyam devatā prācām udīcām iti laukikāḥ eva upādīyante śāstra vyavahārena hi eṣām śāstra antare sti paribhāṣaṇam iti evam ete pi ekādadyaḥ śāstra antareṇa aparibhāṣitāḥ laukikāḥ eva laukikaiḥ ca evam vyavahriyate

original: athavā kiṃ prayojanam iti kim adhikārthapratipattyartham / ihedaṃ saṃkhyāgarahaṇam eṣām eva bahvādīnāṃ saṃcakṣāṇānāṃ saṃjñāpratipattyarthaṃ, vaipulyārthasya bahuśabdasya mā bhūt bahurodanaḥ, bahuḥ sūpa iti / pūgavacanasya saṃghavacanasya ca guṇaśabdasya yathā na syāt---
analyzed: athavā kim prayojanam iti kim adhika artha pratipatti artham iha idam saṃkhyā garahaṇam eṣām eva bahu ādīnām saṃcakṣāṇānām saṃjñā pratipatti artham vaipulya arthasya bahu śabdasya mā bhūt bahuḥ odanaḥ bahuḥ sūpaḥ iti pūga vacanasya saṃgha vacanasya ca guṇa śabdasya yathā na syāt

original: ‘‘lebhire vāri sāraṅgo gaṇaś cātra pipāsitāḥ’’ itīdam evaṃ varṇyate / [yadā] saṃkhyā ca bahvādayaḥ [ca] tadā saṃjñā saṃkhyā iti adhyavasāyārtham iti pradarśayati / ekādikāyāḥ saṃkhyāyāḥ saṃkhyāpradeśeṣu iti / saṃjñāyāḥ kāryārthatvāt pradeśam evopādatte / na hi saṃjñināṃ saṃjñāpratilambhārtham upādānām / kiṃ tarhi ? kāryapratipattyartham iti /
analyzed: lebhire vāri sāraṅgaḥ gaṇaḥ ca atra pipāsitāḥ iti idam evam varṇyate yadā saṃkhyā ca bahu ādayaḥ ca tadā saṃjñā saṃkhyā iti adhyavasāya artham iti pradarśayati eka ādikāyāḥ saṃkhyāyāḥ saṃkhyā pradeśeṣu iti saṃjñāyāḥ kārya artha tvāt pradeśam eva upādatte na hi saṃjñinām saṃjñā pratilambha artham upādānām kim tarhi kārya pratipatti artham iti

original: paśur apatyam iti yathā saṃpratyaya evam ihāpi bhaviṣyati ity āha---nanu caikādikā [saṃkhyā] loke saṃkhyā [iti] pratītā iti / itarathā hy asaṃpratyayo 'kṛtrimatvād yathā loke / kutaḥ ? kṛtrimākṛtimayoḥ kṛtrime kāryasaṃpratyayaḥ / yathaiva lokāt pratipanno bhavān iti / ko 'yaṃ nyāyo yenaivaṃ loke saṃpratyayaḥ iti ? ucyate /
analyzed: paśuḥ apatyam iti yathā saṃpratyayaḥ evam iha api bhaviṣyati iti āha nanu ca eka ādikā saṃkhyā loke saṃkhyā iti pratītā iti itarathā hi kṛtrima tvāt yathā loke kutas kṛtrima ākṛtimayoḥ kṛtrime kārya saṃpratyayaḥ yathā eva lokāt pratipannaḥ bhavān iti kaḥ yam nyāyaḥ yena evam loke saṃpratyayaḥ iti ucyate

original: iha gopālakaśabdo 'rthaviśeṣanimittam upādāya pravartamānaḥ pratividhānaṃ copādadīta yathā ‘pañcabhiḥ halaiḥ kṛṣati’ iti / kartṛtvaṃ vā ‘pālayaty etāḥ [gāḥ]’ iti jātiṃ vā / athavā rūḍhir nimittāntareṇopādīyamānā nimittāntaram apasārayati yathā kriyā jātyādīn apasārayati iti / tulyajātīyaviṣaya eva niyamo bhavati, evam ihāpīti /
analyzed: iha gopālaka śabdaḥ rtha viśeṣa nimittam upādāya pravartamānaḥ pratividhānam ca upādadīta yathā pañcabhiḥ halaiḥ kṛṣati iti kartṛ tvam vā pālayati etāḥ gāḥ iti jātim vā athavā rūḍhiḥ nimitta antareṇa upādīyamānā nimitta antaram apasārayati yathā kriyā jāti ādīn apasārayati iti tulya jātīya viṣayaḥ eva niyamaḥ bhavati evam iha api iti

original: bahvādaya evātra prakṛtā iti bhavaḥ // . . .
analyzed: bahu ādayaḥ eva atra prakṛtāḥ iti bhavaḥ

original: mahābhāṣyadīpikāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhamāhnikam /
analyzed: mahābhāṣya dīpikāyām ṣaṣṭham āhnikam

original: sarvādīni [sarvanāmāni] // 1.1.27 //
analyzed: sarva ādīni sarvanāmāni

original: 1.1 sarvādīni iti ko 'yaṃ samāsaḥ ? praśnānupapattiḥ, saṃdehasyābhāvāt / yatra śrutau samānāyāṃ viśeṣādhigamanimittaṃ nāsti, tatra saṃdeho bhavati / yathā sthūlapṛṣatīm iti svarā[n a]vadhāraṇāt prakṛtas tatpuruṣo ['thavā] bahuvrīhir iti na jñāyate / iha tu naivam / yadi tāvat sarvaś cāsāv ādiś ceti kalpyate, ādiśabdasyānarthakyam /
analyzed: sarva ādīni iti kaḥ yam samāsaḥ praśna anupapattiḥ saṃdehasya abhāvāt yatra śrutau samānāyām viśeṣa adhigama nimittam na asti tatra saṃdehaḥ bhavati yathā sthūla pṛṣatīm iti svarān avadhāraṇāt prakṛtaḥ bahuvrīhiḥ iti na jñāyate iha tu na evam yadi tāvat sarvaḥ ca asau ādiḥ ca iti kalpyate ādi śabdasya ānarthakyam

original: prādhānyāc cādiśabdasya liṅgavacanatyāgo na yuktaḥ / viśvādīnāṃ ca guṇe saṃniveśo 'narthakaḥ syāt /
analyzed: prādhānyāt ca ādi śabdasya liṅga vacana tyāgaḥ na yuktaḥ viśva ādīnām ca guṇe saṃniveśaḥ narthakaḥ syāt

original: 1.2 athaiva kalpyate, ‘ādīyate 'smādityādiḥ’, sarve 'smādādīyanta iti / rūḍhiśabdatvenādiśabdasya [evaṃ] kalpanānupapattiḥ /
analyzed: atha eva kalpyate ādīyate smāt iti ādiḥ sarve smāt ādīyante iti rūḍhi śabda tvena ādi śabdasya evam kalpanā anupapattiḥ

original: 1.3 atha sarvasyādir ity evam api [na], nānyo 'sti kaścit, yo 'syādiḥ syād iti bahuvrīhir evāyam iti saṃdeho nopapadyate / tathā ‘bahuvrīhir ity āhe'ty upadiṣṭe, idam api na praṣṭavyaṃ ‘ko 'sya vigraha iha ?’ iti /
analyzed: atha sarvasya ādiḥ iti evam api na na anyaḥ sti kaścid syāt iti bahuvrīhiḥ eva ayam iti saṃdehaḥ na upapadyate tathā bahuvrīhiḥ iti āha iti upadiṣṭe idam api na praṣṭavyam kaḥ sya vigrahaḥ iha iti

original: 1.4 naiṣa doṣaḥ / iha ekaśeṣaprakriyāyāṃ gārgyāv iti vivakṣitā kadācit jīvatpitṛkatvaṃ viśeṣaṃ vivakṣati, kadācit gargāpatyatvasāmānyam iti / vivakṣitradhīnā ceyaṃ pratipattiḥ / yathā tadādyācikhyāsāyām iti, tadā[dyā]khyāyām iti vaktavye ācikhyāsāgrahaṇaṃ, vivakṣitā yadā āditvena vivakṣati tatra kathaṃ syāt ? ity evamartham /
analyzed: na eṣa doṣaḥ iha ekaśeṣa prakriyāyām gārgyau iti vivakṣitā kadācid jīvat pitṛkatvam viśeṣam vivakṣati kadācid garga apatya tva sāmānyam iti vivakṣitṛ adhīnā ca iyam pratipattiḥ yathā tad ādi ācikhyāsāyām iti tad ādi ākhyāyām iti vaktavye ācikhyāsā grahaṇam vivakṣitā yadā ādi tvena vivakṣati tatra katham syāt iti evamartham

original: 1.5 iha ca kṛtaikaśeṣo 'yaṃ bahuvrīhir atha prāthamaikārthavṛttir ity etat pṛcchati / sarvaś cāsāv ādiś ca sarvādiḥ / sarvaśabda ādir vaiṣāṃ tāni imāni sarvādīni iti / ‘napuṃsakam anapuṃsakena’ (A 1.2.68) iti vā ‘svarabhinnānāṃ yasyottaraḥ svaravidhiḥ’ (A 1.2.64, vā 24) iti vā / tulyarūpapratipattyarthaṃ ca sarvaś cāsāv ādiś cety upādīyate /
analyzed: iha ca kṛta ekaśeṣaḥ yam bahuvrīhiḥ atha prāthamā eka artha vṛttiḥ iti etat pṛcchati sarvaḥ ca asau ādiḥ ca sarvādiḥ sarva śabdaḥ ādiḥ vā eṣām tāni imāni sarvādīni iti napuṃsakam anapuṃsakena a 1268 iti vā svara bhinnānām yasya uttaraḥ svara vidhiḥ vā 24 iti vā tulya rūpa pratipatti artham ca sarvaḥ ca asau ādiḥ ca iti upādīyate

original: evaṃ śakyate ekaśeṣaḥ prakalpayitum iti / antareṇa caikaśeṣatantraṃ śakyāśrayaṇaṃ sarvādiśabdavācyaṃ sarvanāmeti /
analyzed: evam śakyate ekaśeṣaḥ prakalpayitum iti antareṇa ca ekaśeṣa tantram śakya āśrayaṇam sarva ādi śabda vācyam sarvanāma iti

original: 1.6 itaro vakṣyamāṇaṃ nyāyaṃ buddhau kṛtvā bahuvrīhir ayaṃ mukhyā[rtha]vṛttir na punar abhyantarīkṛtapadārthāntara iti pratipādayati---bahuvrīhir ity āha iti / ko 'sya vigrahaḥ ? vigrahāt pratyāsannāḥ (? -nnāt) śakyo 'yam arthaḥ pratipattuṃ ‘kevalo vā bahuvrīhiḥ, kṛtaikaśeṣo vā’ /
analyzed: itaraḥ vakṣyamāṇam nyāyam buddhau kṛtvā bahuvrīhiḥ ayam mukhya artha vṛttiḥ na punar abhyantarīkṛta padārtha antaraḥ iti pratipādayati bahuvrīhiḥ iti āha iti kaḥ sya vigrahaḥ vigrahāt pratyāsannāḥ nnāt śakyaḥ yam arthaḥ pratipattum kevalaḥ vā bahuvrīhiḥ kṛta ekaśeṣaḥ vā

original: yathā sthūlapṛṣatīm iti vigrahāt viśeṣārtham iti samāso 'vagamyate iti pṛcchati ‘ko 'sya vigrahaḥ ?’ iti /
analyzed: yathā sthūla pṛṣatīm iti vigrahāt viśeṣa artham iti samāsaḥ vagamyate iti pṛcchati kaḥ sya vigrahaḥ iti

original: 1.7 atha ‘tānīmāni’ iti kimartham ? ucyate / anena vinānyapadārthatāyā [a]bhāvāt / na hi citrā gāvo 'syety etāv iti bahuvrīhiḥ, gavām upalakṣyamāṇatvāt / yatra ca citragavyas tadvato viśeṣaṇaṃ tatra bahuvrīhir iti virūpatā guṇapradhānabhāve bhavati / gomān dā[? mā]sajātaḥ vitragur iti pratyavamṛśyate sarvanāmnā ca anyapadārthaḥ /
analyzed: atha tāni imāni iti kimartham ucyate anena vinā anya padārtha tāyāḥ abhāvāt na hi citrāḥ gāvaḥ sya iti etau iti bahuvrīhiḥ gavām upalakṣyamāṇa tvāt yatra ca citragavyaḥ tadvataḥ viśeṣaṇam tatra bahuvrīhiḥ iti virūpa tā guṇa pradhāna bhāve bhavati gomān dāḥ māsa jātaḥ vitraguḥ iti pratyavamṛśyate sarvanāmnā ca anya padārthaḥ

original: 1.8 yady aevaṃ sarvaśabdasya / yadi mukhyārthavṛttir ayaṃ bahuvrīhiḥ / anyapadārthatvād bahuvrīheḥ / anyapadārtho hy arthaḥ prayojako bahuvrīheḥ / anyapadārthasya prādhā[nyā]t bahuvrīheḥ /
analyzed: sarva śabdasya yadi mukhya artha vṛttiḥ ayam bahuvrīhiḥ anya padārtha tvāt bahuvrīheḥ anya padārthaḥ hi arthaḥ prayojakaḥ bahuvrīheḥ anya padārthasya prādhānyāt bahuvrīheḥ

original: yathā rājapuruṣamānayeti jahatsvārthāyāṃ vṛttau aśabdako rājārtho lakṣaṇaṃ puruṣaśeṣabhāvam āpannaḥ śeṣitvaṃ na pratipadyata iti kriyā tādarthyena na pratipadyate / evaṃ citrā gāvo 'pi lakṣaṇopaśrutāḥ śeṣitvena nety āha / kiṃ tarhi ? aśabdakāḥ śeṣatām āpannāḥ kriyāyāṃ saṃnidhāne vijñāyante /
analyzed: yathā rāja puruṣam ānaya iti jahat svārthāyām vṛttau aśabdakaḥ rāja arthaḥ lakṣaṇam puruṣa śeṣa bhāvam āpannaḥ śeṣi tvam na pratipadyate iti kriyā tādarthyena na pratipadyate evam citrāḥ gāvaḥ pi lakṣaṇa upaśrutāḥ śeṣi tvena na iti āha kim tarhi aśabdakāḥ śeṣa tām āpannāḥ kriyāyām saṃnidhāne vijñāyante

original: 1.9 atha vā saha guṇair vartate yaḥ so 'yaṃ tadguṇaḥ / tadguṇasya saṃnidhā[? -vijñā]nam iti saṃnihitaviśeṣaṇo 'nyapadārthaḥ kriyāyāṃ saṃvijñāyata ity arthaḥ / kutaḥ punar etad evam iti ? / evaṃ hy uktam---‘matvarthe vā pūrvasya vidhānāt’ (A 2.2.25, vā 5) iti / matvarthīyāś ca kecit svasvāmibhāvamātraviṣayā yathā gomān iti /
analyzed: atha vā saha guṇaiḥ vartate yaḥ saḥ yam tad guṇaḥ tad guṇasya saṃnidhā vijñānam iti saṃnihita viśeṣaṇaḥ kriyāyām saṃvijñāyate iti arthaḥ kutas punar etat evam iti evam hi uktam matu arthe vā pūrvasya vidhānāt vā iti matu arthīyāḥ ca kecid sva svāmi bhāva mātra viṣayāḥ yathā gomān iti

original: kaścit saṃsargaviṣayo yathā daṇḍīti / kaśict ayutasaṃsargaviṣayo yathā viṣāṇīti / na hi maṇḍo gaur viṣāṇe grīvāyām āsakte ‘viṣāṇī’ iti bhavati / tathā yajñopavītīti, na ca yajñopavītībhavati, bhavati na ca nivītīti / evaṃ śuklavāsā lohitakoṣṇīṣāś cety etat bahuvrīhipadaṃ viśiṣṭesaṃsarge vartate yathā viṣāṇīti /
analyzed: kaścid saṃsarga viṣayaḥ yathā daṇḍī iti kaśid ayuta saṃsarga viṣayaḥ yathā viṣāṇī iti na hi maṇḍaḥ gauḥ viṣāṇe grīvāyām āsakte viṣāṇī iti bhavati tathā yajñopavītī iti na ca yajñopavītībhavati bhavati na ca nivītī iti evam śukla vāsāḥ lohitaka uṣṇīṣāḥ ca iti etat bahuvrīhi padam viśiṣṭe saṃsarge vartate yathā viṣāṇī iti

original: ayaṃ citragur iti svasvāmibhāvamātraviṣaya eveti / śabdasvabhāva evāyaṃ pravibhāgenārtheṣu pravartata iti grahītavyam /
analyzed: ayam citraguḥ iti sva svāmi bhāva mātra viṣayaḥ eva iti śabda svabhāvaḥ eva ayam pravibhāgena artheṣu pravartate iti grahītavyam

original: 1.10 na ca vyākaraṇe idaṃ darśanaṃ---yena vinā yo na vartate / yathā yathārthatattvā . . . / . . . vinā na bhujir asti / evaṃ vāsobhyām iti / tasmād vāsasī api bhujyaṅgam iti śabdārthaḥ / vyākaraṇe tadbhāvatadbhāvitvenārthavyavasthā /
analyzed: na ca vyākaraṇe idam darśanam yena vinā yaḥ na vartate yathā yathārtha tattvāḥ vinā na bhujiḥ asti evam vāsobhyām iti tasmāt vāsasī api bhuji aṅgam iti śabda arthaḥ vyākaraṇe tad bhāva tad bhāvi tvena artha vyavasthā

original: 1.11 idam api nāśriyate, na cehāny atra śiṣṭasya guṇopaguṇasaṃvijñānam iti / yaḥ śuklavāsā dṛṣṭas tam ānayeti, naivātra vāsasī lakṣaṇam iti / yadā codyate ye devadattādayo dṛṣṭāḥ, tān bhojayeti, tadānyatra śiṣṭo 'pi devadatto bhujiṃ pratipadyate / tasmāc chabdasvarūpam evānumantavyam /
analyzed: idam api na āśriyate na ca iha ani atra śiṣṭasya guṇa upaguṇa saṃvijñānam iti yaḥ śukla vāsāḥ dṛṣṭaḥ tam ānaya iti na eva atra vāsasī lakṣaṇam iti yadā codyate ye devadatta ādayaḥ dṛṣṭāḥ tān bhojaya iti tadā anyatra śiṣṭaḥ api devadattaḥ bhujim pratipadyate tasmāt śabda svarūpam eva anumantavyam

original: 1.12 nanu kriyāsaṃvijñāne 'pi sarvaśabdasya saṃjñayā [na] bhavitavyam / tadviṣṭānāṃ viśvādīnāṃ saṃnihitasarvaśabdānāṃ [saṃjñayā] bhavitavyam / yathā nāgayajñopavītī bhojyatām iti saṃnihitanāgayajñopavītī eva bhuṅkte, na pṛthaṅnāgaḥ / evam eva skandheputraṃ bhpjayeti sa putro bhuṅkte /
analyzed: nanu kriyā saṃvijñāne sarva śabdasya saṃjñayā na bhavitavyam tad viṣṭānām viśva ādīnām saṃnihita sarva śabdānām saṃjñayā bhavitavyam yathā nāga yajña upavītī bhojyatām iti saṃnihita nāga yajña upavītī eva bhuṅkte na pṛthak nāgaḥ evam eva skandheputram sa putraḥ bhuṅkte

original: 1.13 naiṣa doṣaḥ / yathaiva sahaputraṃ bhpjayeti sahaśabdapravṛttāv apradhānam api putraṃ bhujiḥ pratipadyate / na hy abhuñjāne saputre bhuktaṃ bhavatīti bhujiviśeṣa evāyam, na tu brūmaḥ śabdāt pratipattir iti / yathā nu kaścid dvābhyāṃ bhuñjīta, evam ayaṃ suputro bhuṅkte iti kriyāṃ pratipadyamānaḥ putro viśeṣaṇaṃ, na ca śabdasyāyaṃ dharma iti /
analyzed: na eṣa doṣaḥ yathā eva saha putram saha śabda pravṛttau apradhānam api putram bhujiḥ pratipadyate na hi a bhuñjāne sa putre bhuktam bhavati iti bhuji viśeṣaḥ eva ayam na tu brūmaḥ śabdāt pratipattiḥ iti yathā nu kaścid dvābhyām bhuñjīta evam ayam su putraḥ bhuṅkte iti kriyām pratipadyamānaḥ putraḥ viśeṣaṇam na ca śabdasya ayam dharmaḥ iti

original: 1.14 ihāpi sarvādīnāṃ viśvādīnāṃ saṃjñā pratyakṣā / anumānābhyāṃdi(? -nādinā) ca sarvaśabdo 'pi pratipadyate / evaṃ sarvādīnāṃ kṛtā bhavati / anekaprakārā hi śabdapravṛttiḥ / kvacid upalakṣaṇabhāva eva, na saṃnidhānaṃ, yathā citragur iti / kvacit kriyāyāṃ saṃnihitam, na tu kriyāyogiḥ, śuklavāsasaṃ bhojaya, nāgayajñopavītī bhojyatām iti /
analyzed: iha api sarva ādīnām viśva ādīnām saṃjñā pratyakṣā pratipadyate evam sarva ādīnām kṛtā bhavati aneka prakārā hi śabda pravṛttiḥ kvacid upalakṣaṇa bhāvaḥ eva na saṃnidhānam yathā citraguḥ iti kvacid kriyāyām saṃnihitam na tu kriyā yogī śukla vāsasam bhojaya nāga yajña upavītī bhojyatām iti

original: kvacit kriyāṃ pratipadyamāno viśeṣaṇam iti /
analyzed: kvacid kriyām pratipadyamānaḥ viśeṣaṇam iti

original: 1.15 atha vā ādiśabdaḥ samīpavacana ihopāttaḥ, sa ca samudāyasyaiva sāmīpyena viśeṣaṇaṃ na viśvādīnām avayavānām iti saumudāyasya saṃjñāyā[m a]nabhisaṃbandhād avayavānāṃ kriyate / te cānumīyamānāḥ / tatra yathaiva viśvādayo 'numīyamānāḥ saṃbadhyante, evaṃ sarvaśabdo 'pi kimiti na pratipadyate iti /
analyzed: atha vā ādi śabdaḥ samīpa vacanaḥ iha upāttaḥ sa ca samudāyasya eva sāmīpyena viśeṣaṇam na viśva ādīnām avayavānām iti saumudāyasya saṃjñāyām anabhisaṃbandhāt avayavānām kriyate te ca anumīyamānāḥ tatra yathā eva viśva ādayaḥ numīyamānāḥ saṃbadhyante evam sarva śabdaḥ api kim iti na pratipadyate iti

original: 1.16 yadā tv ādiśabdaḥ prakāravacanas tadāpi siddham / yathā kalyāṇpañcamā rātraya iti kalyāṇī pañcamīti nāsmāt prādhānyaṃ pratipadyate / kiṃ tarhi ? āsām iti / yathā devadattaśālāyā brāhmaṇā ānīyantām iti brāhmaṇyād devadatto 'py ānīyate / śālāvedād vā [? -c ca] / evaṃ sarvaśabdo 'pi eṣām iti anyapadārthe tu bhavati /
analyzed: yadā tu ādi śabdaḥ prakāra vacanaḥ tadā api siddham yathā kalyāṇ pañcamāḥ rātrayaḥ iti kalyāṇī pañcamī iti na asmāt prādhānyam pratipadyate kim tarhi āsām iti yathā devadatta śālāyāḥ brāhmaṇāḥ ānīyantām iti brāhmaṇyāt devadattaḥ u pi ānīyate śālāvedāt vā c ca evam sarva śabdaḥ u pi eṣām iti anya padārthe tu bhavati

original: 1.17 vyavasthāyāṃ tv ādiśabdaḥ samīpavacanaṃ cāśritya coditaṃ parihṛtaṃ ca, tayoś ca tv anyatvam eva / tadguṇasaṃvijñānasya (? -naṃ ca) samudāyaś ca samāsārtha iti bhāṣye 'py uktam eva pradarśitam /
analyzed: vyavasthāyām tu ādi śabdaḥ samīpa vacanam ca āśritya coditam parihṛtam ca tayoḥ ca tu anya tvam eva tad guṇa saṃvijñānasya ca samudāyaḥ ca samāsa arthaḥ iti bhāṣye pi uktam eva pradarśitam

original: [2.1] iha sarvanāmāni iti / nanu ca saṃjñānāṃ pūrvapadottarapadavyavahārābhāvaḥ / athā[pi] syāt, evam api hi na śāstrīyāṇām / kiṃ tarhi ? laukikīnām ity evam api nopapadyate /
analyzed: iha sarvanāmāni iti nanu ca saṃjñānām pūrva pada uttara pada vyavahāra abhāvaḥ atha api syāt evam api hi na śāstrīyāṇām kim tarhi laukikīnām iti evam api na upapadyate

original: 2.2 kiṃ ca, saṃjñāsaṃjñisaṃbandhasya ca kriyamāṇatvāt sarvatraiva vaktavyam / kathaṃ ṇatvaśāstraṃ pravartata iti / yāvatoktaṃ ‘siddhe śabdārthasaṃbandhe’ (MBh paspaśā vā. 1) iti / kiṃ ca, kiṃ kṛtaṇatvā saṃjñā, āhosvid akṛtaṇatvā uttarakālaṃ ṇatvaṃ pratipadyata iry etac ca vaktavyam /

original: yadi tāvat kṛtaṇatvā, kena ṇatvaṃ prāk saṃjñābhāvāt ? athākṛtaṇatvasya ṇatvam evam api śabdasya vikārāpatter anitya[tva]prasaṅgaḥ /
analyzed: yadi tāvat kṛta ṇa tvā kena ṇa tvam prāk saṃjñā bhāvāt atha a kṛta ṇa tvasya ṇa tvam evam api śabdasya vikāra āpatteḥ anitya tva prasaṅgaḥ

original: 2.3 svarūpe ca viniyoktuḥ kāmacārāt, kadācid ayam ekapadavyavahāraḥ / katham iti ? paramārthadarśane ca sarvatraivāyaṃ pravibhāgo nāsti /
analyzed: svarūpe ca viniyoktuḥ kāmacārāt kadācid ayam eka pada vyavahāraḥ katham iti parama artha darśane ca sarvatra eva ayam pravibhāgaḥ na asti

original: 2.4 śāstravyavahāre tu kvacit śabdārthānugamena pravibhāgo, yathā rājapuruṣaśabde vākyaviṣayaḥ śabdārthānugamo 'sti / kvacid arthāntaravṛttābhyām anvākhyānam arthāntaravṛttasya śabdasamudāyasya, yathā gaurakharo, lohitaśāliḥ, kṛṣṇasarpa iti / atyantaṃ samudāye gautvādayo na santi kharatvādayaś ca /
analyzed: śāstra vyavahāre tu kvacid śabda artha anugamena pravibhāgaḥ yathā rāja puruṣa śabde vākya viṣayaḥ śabda artha anugamaḥ asti kvacid artha antara vṛttābhyām anvākhyānam artha antara vṛttasya śabda samudāyasya yathā gaura kharaḥ lohita śāliḥ kṛṣṇa sarpaḥ iti atyantam samudāye gau tva ādayaḥ na santi khara tva ādayaḥ ca

original: jātyantaravṛttābhyāṃ svarūpamātre vṛttasya samudāyasyānvākhyāne anivṛttaḥ pūrvapadottarapadavyavahāraḥ /
analyzed: jāti antara vṛttābhyām sva rūpa mātre vṛttasya samudāyasya anvākhyāne anivṛttaḥ pūrva pada uttara pada vyavahāraḥ

original: 2.5 na ca śāstrasaṃjñā laukikībhyaḥ saṃjñābhyo bhidyante / yaś cāsau dharmaḥ. sa evāsām iti tadvad atrāpi ṇatvena bhavitavyam /
analyzed: na ca śāstra saṃjñāḥ laukikībhyaḥ saṃjñābhyaḥ bhidyante yaḥ ca asau dharmaḥ saḥ eva āsām iti tadvat atra api ṇa tvena bhavitavyam

original: 2.6 na ca saṃjñāsaṃbandhe nityatvaṃ virudhyate / kutaḥ ? śaktiniyamasya pauruṣeyatvāt / ekaśakridarśane 'nekaśaktidarśane ca śaktyavacchedaparigrahe puruṣasya vyāpārāt /
analyzed: na ca saṃjñā saṃbandhe nitya tvam virudhyate kutas śakti niyamasya pauruṣeya tvāt eka śakri darśane neka śakti darśane ca śakti avaccheda parigrahe puruṣasya vyāpārāt

original: 2.7 anyeṣāṃ darśanam / ya evaite pratyakṣāḥ śabdārthasaṃbandhāḥ gauraśvo 'gnir udakam iti ete nityāḥ / yas tv anumānāt saṃpratyāyayati asāv anityaḥ, yo 'yaṃ samayapūrvaka iti / yathaiva laukikān niviṣṭā anumānāt karaṇasaṃnipātino 'rthasyānupratipādayanti, śrutis tu sākṣātpratipādayati /
analyzed: anyeṣām darśanam ye eva ete pratyakṣāḥ śabda artha saṃbandhāḥ gauḥ aśvaḥ gniḥ udakam iti ete nityāḥ yaḥ tu anumānāt saṃpratyāyayati asau anityaḥ yaḥ yam samaya pūrvakaḥ iti yathā eva laukikān niviṣṭāḥ anumānāt karaṇa saṃnipātinaḥ rthasya anupratipādayanti śrutiḥ tu sākṣāt pratipādayati

original: 2.8 anyas tv āha---tatrāpy arthe saṃjñāśabdagaṇo 'pi nitya eva, śāstraṃ kṛtaṇatvasya ṇatvaṃ pratipadyate / saṃjñāyāṃ ṇatvaṃ bhavati, kṛtaṇatvaḥ sādhur bhavatīti / na ca svarūpāntaraṃ sṛjate / akṛtaṇatvā saṃjñā [na] kartavyā / nivartakaṃ hi ṇa[tvaśāstram] evaṃ ca kṛtvā uktaṃ ‘nyāyyabhāvāt kalpanaṃ saṃjñādiṣu’ iti /
analyzed: anyaḥ tu āha tatra api arthe saṃjñā śabda gaṇaḥ nityaḥ eva śāstram kṛta ṇa tvasya ṇa tvam pratipadyate saṃjñāyām ṇa tvam bhavati kṛta ṇa tvaḥ sādhuḥ bhavati iti na ca svarūpa antaram sṛjate a kṛta ṇa tvā saṃjñā na kartavyā nivartakam hi ṇa tva śāstram evam ca kṛtvā uktam nyāyya bhāvāt kalpanam saṃjñā ādiṣu iti

original: 2.9 sarvanāmasaṃjñāyāṃ nipātanāṇ ṇatvābhāvaḥ / nanu caivam eva kṛtvā coditaṃ ‘ṇatvaṃ prāpnoti’ iti / naiṣa doṣaḥ / etatpratipādayati / nāyaṃ kṛtaṇatvo loke / śāstre akṛtaṇatva ācāryeṇa prayukta iti / evaṃ hi saty[ apy a]sādhutvam asya syāt /
analyzed: sarvanāma saṃjñāyām nipātanāt ṇa tva abhāvaḥ nanu ca evam eva kṛtvā coditam ṇa tvam prāpnoti iti na eṣa doṣaḥ etat pratipādayati na ayam kṛta ṇa tvaḥ loke śāstre a kṛta ṇa tvaḥ ācāryeṇa prayuktaḥ iti evam hi sati api asādhu tvam asya syāt

original: kiṃ tu loke 'py ayaṃ yasya yasya saṃjñā tatra tatrākṛtaṇatva eva sann ācāryeṇa atra smaryate iti evaṃ caitat /
analyzed: kim tu loke pi ayam yasya yasya saṃjñā tatra tatra a kṛta ṇa tvaḥ eva san ācāryeṇa atra smaryate iti evam ca etat

original: 2.10 atha vā pūrvapakṣa idam ipanyastaṃ vidhivākyenopaskāravatā pratipādite ṇatve ‘pūrvapadāt saṃjñāyām agaḥ’ (A 8.4.3) iti / katham iyaṃ śrutir anyārthā pravartamānā saṃjñāsaṃjñisaṃbandhe vyāpṛtā, bādhikā bhaviṣyati iti /
analyzed: atha vā pūrva pakṣe idam vidhi vākyena upaskāravatā pratipādite ṇa tve pūrva padāt saṃjñāyām a gaḥ iti katham iyam śrutiḥ anya arthā pravartamānā saṃjñā saṃjñi saṃbandhe vyāpṛtā bādhakā bhaviṣyati iti

original: 2.11 itaras tv anumānapakṣasya[? -ś ca] smṛtir iti / tasmāt ṇatvam anumīyate, asmād apy aṇatvam, iti svabhāvasiddhaṃ ṇatvam, aṇatvaṃ ca kevalaṃ smaryate iti /
analyzed: itaraḥ tu anumāna pakṣasya ś ca smṛtiḥ iti tasmāt ṇa tvam anumīyate asmāt api a ṇa tvam iti svabhāva siddham ṇa tvam a ṇa tvam ca kevalam smaryate iti

original: 2.12 kim etan nipātanaṃ nāma ? pratiṣedho ṇatvasya vaktavya iti pratiṣedhaṃ nipātanena sādhayati bhavān / yadi ca pratiṣedhena tulyaṃ nipātanam ata etad upapadyate / kathaṃ ca tulyaṃ nipātanam ? yadi vidhiṃ nivartayati / avikalpitā nivṛttiḥ / tata eva tat tulyaṃ pratiṣedhena bhavatīti /
analyzed: kim etat nipātanam nāma pratiṣedhaḥ ṇa tvasya vaktavyaḥ iti pratiṣedham nipātanena sādhayati bhavān yadi ca pratiṣedhena tulyam nipātanam atas etat upapadyate katham ca tulyam nipātanam yadi vidhim nivartayati avikalpitā nivṛttiḥ tatas eva tat tulyam pratiṣedhena bhavati iti

original: 2.13 itaro ya eva pratiṣedhasya dharmaḥ sa eva nipātanasya / pratiṣedho hi svabhāvato 'pravṛttasyānumānam / na tu kīlapratikīyanyāyena / evaṃ nipātanam apīti idam upanyasyati atha kaḥ pratiṣedho nāma ? iti /
analyzed: itaraḥ yaḥ eva pratiṣedhasya dharmaḥ saḥ eva nipātanasya pratiṣedhaḥ hi pravṛttasya anumānam na tu kīla pratikīya nyāyena evam nipātanam api iti idam upanyasyati atha kaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ nāma iti

original: 2.14 aviśeṣeṇa kiṃcid uktvā / ‘ṛnnebhyo ṅīp’ (A 4.1.5) iti / viśeṣeṇa ‘na ṣaṭsvasrādibhyaḥ’ (A 4.1.10) iti / tatra vyaktam ācāryasyābhiprāyo gamyate, idaṃ na bhavatīti / ācāryeṇa na sa śabdo vivakṣito nopāttaity ayam abhiprāya ācāryasya gamyate /
analyzed: aviśeṣeṇa kiṃcid uktvā iti viśeṣeṇa na ṣaṣ svasṛ ādibhyaḥ iti tatra vyaktam ācāryasya abhiprāyaḥ gamyate idam na bhavati iti ācāryeṇa na sa śabdaḥ vivakṣitaḥ na upāttaḥ iti ayam abhiprāyaḥ ācāryasya gamyate

original: 2.15 kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ, vidhipratiṣedhacodanayoḥ vidhivākyasya na mradvīyate, pratiṣedhavākyasyaiva mradvīyate / brāhmaṇā bhojyantāṃ, kauṇḍinyo na bhojayitavya iti ? ucyate /
analyzed: kim punar kāraṇam vidhi pratiṣedha codanayoḥ vidhi vākyasya na mradvīyate pratiṣedha vākyasya eva mradvīyate brāhmaṇāḥ bhojyantām kauṇḍinyaḥ na bhojayitavyaḥ iti ucyate

original: 2.16 [a] viparyayaḥ samuccayo vā na śakyate pratipattum / vikalpo 'pi na bhavati / nirvṛttir atyantaṃ bādhitā syāt / virodhāc ca samuccayo na śakyaḥ kalpayituṃ pratipattuṃ [vā] / vikalpo 'pi na bhavati, nivṛttyabhyupagamāt / nivṛttir eva hy ādau katham ? prasaktaṃ hi nivartayatīti cet . . . sarveṇa sarvaṃ nivṛttyā bhavitavyam /
analyzed: a viparyayaḥ samuccayaḥ vā na śakyate pratipattum vikalpaḥ u pi na bhavati nirvṛttiḥ atyantam bādhitā syāt virodhāt ca samuccayaḥ na śakyaḥ kalpayitum pratipattum vā vikalpaḥ u pi na bhavati nivṛtti abhyupagamāt nivṛttiḥ eva hi ādau katham prasaktam hi nivartayati iti ced sarveṇa sarvam nivṛttyā bhavitavyam

original: kṛtārthasyā(ś cā)nyatra bhojanavidhir iti /
analyzed: kṛtārthasyāḥ ca anyatra bhojana vidhiḥ iti

original: 2.16 [ā] atha vā bhinnā eva prativākyaṃ śabdāḥ / tulyaśrutitvāt tulyapratipattuḥ pratipādanopāyāḥ / viśeṣaśabdād aviśṣṭa eva brāhmaṇaśabda uktaḥ kauṇḍinya iti manyate /
analyzed: ā atha vā bhinnāḥ eva prativākyam śabdāḥ tulya śruti tvāt tulya pratipattuḥ pratipādana upāyāḥ viśeṣa śabdāt aviśṣṭaḥ eva brāhmaṇa śabdaḥ uktaḥ kauṇḍinyaḥ iti manyate

original: 2.16 [i] anyeṣāṃ darśanam / [na] śakalakaṇṭakā jighṛkṣitā, nāntarīyakaṃ tūpādānam / evam ihāpi na kauṇḍinyo vivakṣito, nāntarīyakatvāt tūpādatte iti tyajyate vidhau kauṇḍinyaḥ /
analyzed: anyeṣām darśanam na śakalakaṇṭakāḥ jighṛkṣitāḥ nāntarīyakam tu upādānam evam iha api na kauṇḍinyaḥ vivakṣitaḥ nāntarīyaka tvāt tu upādatte iti tyajyate vidhau kauṇḍinyaḥ

original: 2.16 [ī] aparaṃ darśanam / pratyakṣānumānayoḥ pratyakṣaṃ balavat iti rūpeṇa saṃdihyamāno brāhmaṇaśrutau, pratiṣedhe cāsaṃdigdhaḥ / yayoś ca kriyayoḥ [vidhiḥ] pratyakṣnumānābhyāṃ coditas tayor vikalpena pravṛttir ayuktā /

original: 3.13 yady evam atiyuṣmadatyasmad iti na sidhyati / atikrāntebhyo yuṣmānānaya atiyuṣmadānayeti ‘pañcamyā at’ (A 7.1.31) ity atkāro na prāpnoti / praśliṣṭanirdeśo 'yam / akārātkārau yatra akārād vidhīyete tatra anupasarjana a ad iti / teṣāṃ tyaṃtvā (? tyadādyatvam a)nupasaṃgṛhītam akārāntād avidhānāt /

original: atha priyau dvau asyeti kathaṃ bhavitavyam ? na hy asāvakārāt parasyākāra iti / satvaṃ cāpratiṣeddham eva atitad iti / atisarvāyeti caitat cāparihṛtam eva /

original: ḍatarādikāryaṃ tu na śakyaṃ parihartum aprāmā(? kara)ṇi [ka]tvāt / aprā[kara]ṇike tu tadantavidhau ‘prayojanaṃ sarvanāmāvyayasaṃjñāyām’ (A 1.1.72 vā 8) ity ubhayatra pravṛttir apravṛttiś ca /

original: kiṃ tarhi ? arthadyotananimittaḥ tyadādīnāṃ yo 'rthas tasya dyotikāyāṃ vibhaktāv aṅgasya, evaṃ ca ḍatarādīnāṃ yau svamāvarthasya dyotakau tayor iti, evaṃ sarvanāmno yau ḍasiṅi iti / iha tu iṣyate atiyuṣmad atyuasmad iti /

original: 3.19 yady evaṃ paramapañca iti / abhiprāyaḥ / vidhānalakṣaṇo vibhaktyāḥ saṃbandha iti / atha vā tyadādīnām iti svarūpasyāśritatvāt tyadādirūpasya yo 'rthas tatsaṃbandhinī yā vibhaktir iti / na ceyaṃ svarūpasya vibhaktir iti /

original: 3.20 naiṣa doṣaḥ / ṣaṭpradhāna eṣa samāsaḥ / arthadyotananimittaḥ saṃbandho bhavati, tyadādīnām iti [na] rūpam āśrīyate / lakṣaṇamātram arthasya śabdaḥ / tyadādīnāṃ yo 'rtho dṛṣṭas tatsaṃbandhinyāṃ vibhaktāv iti / pradhāne vā kāryasaṃpratyayāt tasyāsāv artha iti vyapadiśyate / yathā ha[ye]ṣu gacchatsu rājā gacchatīti /
analyzed: na eṣa doṣaḥ ṣaṣ pradhānaḥ eṣa samāsaḥ artha dyotana nimittaḥ saṃbandhaḥ bhavati tyad ādīnām iti na rūpam āśrīyate lakṣaṇa mātram arthasya śabdaḥ tyad ādīnām yaḥ rthaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ tad saṃbandhinyām vibhaktau iti pradhāne vā kārya saṃpratyayāt tasya asau arthaḥ iti vyapadiśyate yathā hayeṣu gacchatsu rājā gacchati iti

original: 3.21 atra tv idaṃ codyaṃ---pañcakāḥ śakunaya iti svārthikattvātkanaḥ ‘ṣaḍbhyo luk’ (A 7.1.22) iti luk prāpnoti /
analyzed: atra tu idam codyam pañcakāḥ śakunayaḥ iti ṣaḍbhyaḥ luk 7122 iti luk prāpnoti

original: 3.22 iha tarhi priyasakthnā / na hy atra sakthno 'rthasaṃbandhinī vibhaktir iti / asati tadantavidhau na sidhyaty etad iti /

original: 3.23 saptamīnirdiṣṭe yad ucyate prakṛtavibhaktau tad bhavati iti / ‘iko 'ci vibhaktau’ ity anaṅ ucyate / tat prakṛtavibhaktāv ity arthanirdeśo 'yam /

original: 3.24 trayas tūpāyāḥ / aṅgasya yā vibhaktis tasyām anantarāṇām asthyādīnām iti / atha vā prakṛtasyāsthyādibhis tadantavidhiḥ / aṅgasyeti vā viśeṣaṇam asthyādayo viśeṣyā iti /
analyzed: trayaḥ tu upāyāḥ aṅgasya yā vibhaktiḥ tasyām anantarāṇām asthi ādīnām iti atha vā prakṛtasya asthi ādibhiḥ tad anta vidhiḥ aṅgasya iti vā viśeṣaṇam asthi ādayaḥ viśeṣyāḥ iti

original: 3.25 yady evam ati tat / idam api saptamyām ucyate / [te]nāsthyādivat prasaṅgaḥ /

original: 3.26 tac cāpi vaktavyam / na gṛhyamāṇavibhaktāv iti / kiṃ tarhi ? saptamīnirdiṣṭe yac ucyate iti /

original: katham idam ucyate anyad ato vihitāt pratyayāt iti ? vihitaviśeṣaṇe ca paramakatarad iti na sidhyati / idaṃ ca na sidhyati paramaṣaṭ atiyuṣmad iti /

analyzed: yadā tu sarva śabdaḥ kasyacid nāmadheya tvena upādīyate tadā parityajya svam pravṛtti nimittam sva rūpa mātra upakārī saṃjñā bhāvam anubhavati iti sva pravṛtti nimitta parityāge yam etat viśeṣe evam ca kṛtvā uktam kasya id iti saṃvijñapana pade ubhayathā kāya iti bhavitavyam guṇa nimittāyām tu samākhyāyām kasmai iti bhavitavyam iti

original: 3.48 evam upasarjanapadam api tyaktasvārtham atyaktasvārthaṃ vātikrānte viśeṣaṇatāmāpannamatikrāntārthavṛtti bhavatīti / na cātikrāntaṃ svena pravṛttinimittena bhavatīti viśeṣeṇāvasthānam / vākye tu svaṃ nimittaṃ na jahātīti saṃjñā kriyate /
analyzed: evam upasarjana padam api tyakta sva artham a tyakta sva artham vā atikrānte viśeṣaṇa tām āpannam atikrānta artha vṛtti bhavati iti na ca atikrāntam svena pravṛtti nimittena bhavati iti viśeṣeṇa avasthānam vākye tu svam nimittam na jahāti iti saṃjñā kriyate

original: 3.49 [saṃjñā ca nāma yato na laghīyaḥ /] śabdavyavahāro laghīyān aṇīyāṃś ca / tato 'pi saṃjñā laghīyasī kartavyā / evaṃ loko vyavaharatīti / mahattvaṃ saṃjñāyām anumānam āśritanimittā, nimittena prayuktā, yathā vāsudeve kṛṣṇaśabdo nimittena prayuktaḥ, sa nāmadheyaṃ, tathā sahasrabāhur iti bāhusahasraprayuktaṃ nāmeti /
analyzed: saṃjñā ca nāma yatas na laghīyaḥ śabda vyavahāraḥ laghīyān aṇīyān ca saṃjñā laghīyasī kartavyā evam lokaḥ vyavaharati iti mahā tvam saṃjñāyām anumānam āśrita nimittā nimittena prayuktā yathā vāsudeve kṛṣṇa śabdaḥ nimittena prayuktaḥ sa nāmadheyam tathā sahasra bāhuḥ iti bāhu sahasra prayuktam nāma iti

original: evaṃ sarvanāmatvaprayuktaṃ nāmadheyaṃ sarvādīnām iti /
analyzed: evam sarvanāma tva prayuktam nāmadheyam sarva ādīnām iti

original: 3.50 atra codyate---evam api yat saṃjñāśrayaṃ kāryaṃ smāyādi, tatsaṃjñopasarjanībhūtānāṃ na syāt, sarvāyātisarvāyeti / kutaḥ ? sarvanāmnāṃ sarvanāmeti saṃjñā / yat tv antargaṇam ‘adḍḍatarādibhyaḥ . . . ’ (A 7.1.25) ‘tyadādīnāma’ (A 7.2.102) iti, tadaviśeṣeṇa prāpnoti iti / parihāraś codyate / bhavatv evam /
analyzed: atra codyate evam api yat saṃjñā āśrayam kāryam tad saṃjñā upasarjanībhūtānām na syāt sarvāya atisarvāya iti kutas sarvanāmnām sarvanāmā iti saṃjñā yat tu antargaṇam a dḍḍatara ādibhyaḥ 7125 tyad ādīnām co iti tat aviśeṣeṇa prāpnoti iti parihāraḥ codyate bhavatu evam

original: akārātkārayos tu paurastyaḥ eva parihāraḥ /
analyzed: akāra atkārayoḥ tu paurastyaḥ eva parihāraḥ

original: ihabhavantas tv āhuḥ---naivaṃ vijñāyate, sarveṣāṃ yāni nāmāni, tāni sarvanāmāni, nānyānīti / kiṃ tarhi ? evaṃ pratisaṃdhiḥ kriyate / kimartham eṣāṃ ca viśvobhobhayeti mahatī saṃjñā kriyate / kimartham ete mahatyāḥ saṃjñāyāñ prayojakā iti / etad anumīyate, sarvanāmatvam eṣāṃ vidyate yasmāt tasmād ete mahatīṃ saṃjñāṃ prayojayantīti /
analyzed: ihabhavantaḥ tu āhuḥ na evam vijñāyate sarveṣām yāni nāmāni tāni sarvanāmāni na anyāni iti kim tarhi evam pratisaṃdhiḥ kriyate kimartham eṣām ca mahatī saṃjñā kriyate kimartham ete mahatyāḥ saṃjñāyāḥ prayojakāḥ iti etat anumīyate sarvanāma tvam eṣām vidyate yasmāt tasmāt ete mahatīm saṃjñām prayojayanti iti

original: yathā sati kārṣṇye, sati ca sahasrabāhutve prayojakau saṃjñāyor evam amī apīti / evaṃ sati taddharmayuktā gṛhītā ataddharmayuktāś cāgṛhītā eveti / katarādayas tyadādayaś ca svadharmāṇa eva saṃniviṣṭā iti sarvaṃ kāryaṃ saṃjñāśrayaṃ saṃniveśāśrayaṃ cāsaṃjñopasarjanībhūtānāṃ pratipāditam iti /
