original: 4.1 athobhasya sarvanāmatve ko 'rthaḥ ? akacprayojanam iti samāpto vākyārthaḥ / bhāṣyakāras tu naivaṃ vākyārthaṃ varṇayati / kevalaṃ pāṭhe prayojanāny upanyasyati / anyathābhāvo dvivacanaṭābviṣayatvāt / ubhaśabdo 'yaṃ dvivacanaṭābviṣayaḥ / ubhaśabdo hi pradhānaviṣayaṃ bhedam āśritya pravṛttaḥ, ubhau saṃmukhau hastau bhavata iti /
analyzed: atha ubhasya sarvanāma tve kaḥ rthaḥ akac prayojanam iti samāptaḥ vākya arthaḥ bhāṣyakāraḥ tu na evam vākya artham varṇayati kevalam pāṭhe prayojanāni upanyasyati anyathābhāvaḥ dvivacana ṭāp viṣaya tvāt ubha śabdaḥ yam dvivacana ṭāp viṣayaḥ ubha śabdaḥ hi pradhāna viṣayam bhedam āśritya pravṛttaḥ ubhau saṃmukhau hastau bhavataḥ iti

original: yathā dviśabdo bhedamātravacanaḥ / ato 'yaṃ dvivacanaviṣayaḥ, ṭābviṣayaś ca / na yadā . . . ṭābviṣayaḥ iti / dvivacanād anyatra ṭābviṣayaḥ ṭāpprakāraviṣaya ity evaṃ manyate / ke punaṣṭāpprakārāḥ ? svārthikā iti /
analyzed: yathā dvi śabdaḥ bheda mātra vacanaḥ atas yam dvivacana viṣayaḥ ṭāp viṣayaḥ ca na yadā ṭāp viṣayaḥ iti dvivacanāt anyatra ṭāp viṣayaḥ ṭāp prakāra viṣayaḥ iti evam manyate ke punar ṭāp prakārāḥ svārthikāḥ iti

original: 4.2 ihānye vaiyākaraṇāḥ paṭhanti ‘pratyayottarapadayor advivacanaṭāpor ubhasyobhayaḥ’ / anyeṣām ‘ubhayasya dvivacanaṃ ṭāp ca lopaś ca tapayaḥ’ / teṣāṃ ṭāp iti ṭābādayo nirdiśyante / yathā ‘ardharcāḥ puṃsi ca’ (A 2.4.31) iti / anyeṣāṃ evaṃ pāṭhaḥ ‘advivacanaṭāpau’ iti / kecit punar evaṃ paṭhanti ‘ubhasyobhayo 'dvivacae’ /
analyzed: iha anye vaiyākaraṇāḥ paṭhanti pratyaya uttara padayoḥ a dvivacana ṭāpoḥ ubhasya ubhayaḥ anyeṣām ubhayasya dvivacanam ṭāp ca lopaḥ ca tapayaḥ teṣām ṭāp iti ṭāp ādayaḥ nirdiśyante yathā ardharcāḥ puṃsi ca iti anyeṣām evam pāṭhaḥ a dvivacana ṭāpau iti kecid punar evam paṭhanti ubhasya ubhayaḥ dvivacas evam paṭhanti ubhasya ubhayaḥ dvivacas evam anya evam paṭhanti ubhasya ubhayaḥ dvivacas evam anya evam paṭhanti ubhasya ubhayaḥ dvivacas e

original: ubhasyobhayo bhavati advivacana iti /
analyzed: ubhasya ubhayaḥ bhavati a dvivacanaḥ iti

original: 4.3 etad iha śāstre nyāyasiddham / katham ? iha tāvat ‘ubhayo maṇir ubhaye devam anuṣyā’ iti bhedavacanasyobhaśabdasyāvayavabhedānugate 'vayavinyekasmin maṇau, param avayavabhedaṃ pratipanne samudāye devam anuṣyā ity ubhasyāpravṛttiḥ / vṛttāv api saṃkhyāviśeṣo vyaktābhidhānam iti parityaktabhedam upasarjanaṃ vartata iti /
analyzed: etat iha śāstre nyāya siddham katham iha tāvat ubhayaḥ maṇiḥ ubhaye devam anuṣyāḥ iti bheda vacanasya ubha śabdasya avayava bheda anugate vayavini ekasmin maṇau param avayava bhedam pratipanne samudāye devam anuṣyāḥ iti ubhasya apravṛttiḥ vṛttau api saṃkhyā viśeṣaḥ vyakta abhidhānam iti parityakta bhedam upasarjanam vartate iti

original: nivṛtte ca bhede nivartitavyam ubhaśabdena / ekādayaś ca śabdā naitasya paryāyā iti / ya eva śabdaḥ kayācic chrutyā tulyo 'rthena vā kenavit tenaiva pravartitavyam ity ubhayaśabda eva pravartate / bhinno hy etayor u[bho]bhayaśabdayoḥ śabdopakramo 'rthātmā, arthavas tu tu tulyam ubhayoḥ / ubhau ubhayamānayeti tāv evānīyete /
analyzed: nivṛtte ca bhede nivartitavyam ubha śabdena eka ādayaḥ ca śabdāḥ na etasya paryāyāḥ iti yaḥ eva śabdaḥ kayācid śrutyā tulyaḥ rthena vā kenavid tena eva pravartitavyam iti ubhaya śabdaḥ eva pravartate bhinnaḥ hi etayoḥ ubhā ubhaya śabdayoḥ śabda upakramaḥ rtha ātmā tu tu tulyam ubhayoḥ ubhau ubhayam ānaya iti tau eva ānīyete

original: 4.4 yady evaṃ dviśabdo 'pi bhedasya vṛttau parityaktatvād asādhuḥ prāpnoti / yady api parityakto bhedaḥ, yat tu dviśabdasya svaṃ pravṛttinimittaṃ tasyāparityāgāt pravartate / tena vṛttiviṣaye 'vayavāvayavinoḥ so 'yam ity abhisaṃbando bhavati / yāv etau dvau so 'yaṃ saṃgha iti dvayaśabdo na pravartate /
analyzed: yadi evam bhedasya vṛttau parityakta tvāt asādhuḥ prāpnoti yadi api parityaktaḥ bhedaḥ yat tu dvi śabdasya svam pravṛtti nimittam tasya a parityāgāt pravartate tena vṛtti viṣaye vayava avayavinoḥ saḥ yam iti abhisaṃbandaḥ bhavati yau etau dvau saḥ yam saṃghaḥ iti dvaya śabdaḥ na pravartate

original: 4.5 ubhaśabde kasmād iti ced evamartham eva ācārya ‘ubhād udātto nityam’ (A 5.2.44) iti nityagrahaṇaṃ karoti / nityam ayam anena rūpeṇāvayavinam ācaṣṭe, na tūbhaśabdarūpeṇeti sthitam / iha śāstre upasarjanam ubhaśabdas tyaktabhedaḥ sannāvayavinaṃ prāpnoti (? śāknoti) vaktum ity ubhayaśabdaḥ pravartate /
analyzed: ubha śabde kasmāt iti ced evam artham eva ācāryaḥ ubhāt udāttaḥ nityam iti nitya grahaṇam karoti nityam ayam anena rūpeṇa avayavinam ācaṣṭe na tu ubha śabda rūpeṇa iti sthitam iha śāstre upasarjanam ubha śabdaḥ tyakta bhedaḥ san avayavinam prāpnoti śāknoti vaktum iti ubhaya śabdaḥ pravartate

original: 4.6 yadā punar ayam ubhaśabdo dvivacanaṭābviṣāyaḥ / śābdasvabhāvato vacanān nyāyād vā / ka idānīm asyānyatra ? ubhayo 'nyatra / ubhaśabdo 'yaṃ yathā dvivacanaṭābviṣayas tathā pratipāditam / saṃprati yad uktam akajarthaḥ pāṭha iti taṃ paryanuyuṅkte / kiṃ ca syād yady atrākaj na syāt ? kaḥ prasajyeta / aoavādasyākaco 'bhāvāt /
analyzed: yadā punar ayam ubha śabdaḥ dvivacana ṭāp viṣāyaḥ śābda svabhāvataḥ vacanāt nyāyāt vā kaḥ idānīm asya anyatra ubhayaḥ nyatra ubha śabdaḥ yam yathā dvivacana ṭāp viṣayaḥ tathā pratipāditam saṃprati yat uktam akac arthaḥ pāṭhaḥ iti tam paryanuyuṅkte kim ca syāt yadi atra akac na syāt kaḥ prasajyeta bhāvāt

original: rūpe svare ca viśeṣam apaśyann āha---kaś cedādnīṃ kākacor viśeṣaḥ ? iti / avagrahe naivādaraḥ / ‘na lakṣaṇena padakārā anuvartyāḥ’ iti /
analyzed: rūpe svare ca viśeṣam a paśyan āhakaḥ ced ādnīm ka akacoḥ viśeṣaḥ iti avagrahe na eva ādaraḥ na lakṣaṇena pada kārāḥ anuvartyāḥ iti

original: 4.7 ubhaśabdo 'yaṃ dvivacanaṭābviṣaya ity uktam / anyābhāvo dvivanaṭābviṣayatvād iti bruvatā pratipāditam---ayam ubhaśabdo dvivacanaviṣayaḥ, ṭābviṣayaś ceti / tena dvivacane parataḥ śrūyamāṇa ubhaśabdena sādhunā bhavitavyaṃ na lupte, nāpi vyavahite iti / viṣayamayaṃ paratvopalakṣitaṃ pratipannaḥ /
analyzed: ubha śabdaḥ yam dvivacana ṭāp viṣayaḥ iti uktam anya abhāvaḥ dvivana ṭāp viṣaya tvāt iti bruvatā pratipāditam ayam ubha śabdaḥ dvivacana viṣayaḥ ṭāp viṣayaḥ ca iti tena dvivacane paratas śrūyamāṇaḥ ubha śabdena sādhunā bhavitavyam na lupte na api vyavahite iti viṣayam ayam paratva upalakṣitam pratipannaḥ

original: yadi vākac syāt, ayam ako liṅgāt tanmadhyapatitaḥ śrutibhede hetur na bhavatīti pratipādite dvivacanaviṣayatā na virudhyate /
analyzed: yadi vā akac syāt ayam a kaḥ liṅgāt tad madhya patitaḥ śruti bhede hetuḥ na bhavati iti pratipādite dvivacana viṣaya tā na virudhyate

original: 4.8 ke punaḥ sati nāyaṃ dvivacanaparaḥ syāt / pūrvasya luptatvād itarasya ca vyavadhānād iti asādhutvam ubhaśabdasya prasaktam ity aprayogo vā, atha vā ubhayaśabdasya prayogaḥ prāpnoti / tatra dvivacanaparatā vaktavyā / atideśaḥ kartavyaḥ / kaviṣaye dvivacanaviṣayavad bhavatīit, dvivacanapare vā ke ubhaśabdaḥ sādhur bhavatīti vaktavyam /
analyzed: ke punar sati na ayam dvivacana paraḥ syāt pūrvasya lupta tvāt itarasya ca vyavadhānāt iti asādhu tvam ubha śabdasya prasaktam iti aprayogaḥ vā atha vā ubhaya śabdasya prayogaḥ prāpnoti tatra dvivacana para tā vaktavyā atideśaḥ kartavyaḥ dvivacana viṣaya vat dvivacana pare vā ke ubha śabdaḥ sādhuḥ bhavati iti vaktavyam

original: 4.9 yathauva tarhi ke sati na . . . dvivacanapara evamāpy api sati ity etan nopapadyate / āpa āśrtitatvāt / evam uktaṃ ‘dvivacanaṭābviṣayatvāt’ iti pratipādita ābviṣayasya sādhutve 'nupapannam etat ‘evam āpy api sati na dvivacanaparaḥ syāt’ iti /
analyzed: tarhi ke sati na dvivacana paraḥ evam āpi api sati iti etat na upapadyate āpaḥ āśrtita tvāt evam uktam dvivacana ṭāp viṣayatvāt iti pratipāditaḥ āp viṣayasya sādhu tve nupapannam etat evam āpi api sati na dvivacana paraḥ syāt iti

original: 4.10 tatra varṇayanti---‘ubhasyobhayo 'dvivacanam i(? -ne' i)ti etasmin lakṣaṇe ṭāpo nāsti grahaṇam, ata etasminn idaṃ codyate iti / ihabhavantas tv āhuḥ / idaṃ darśitaṃ bhavatā dvivacane 'nantare śrūyamāṇe sādhur ubhaśabda iti na (ca) ṭāpo grahaṇam / na caitāvatā kṛtī tvam /
analyzed: tatra varṇayanti ubhasya ubhayaḥ dvivacanam i ne iti etasmin lakṣaṇe ṭāpaḥ na asti grahaṇam atas etasmin idam codyate iti ihabhavantaḥ tu āhuḥ idam darśitam bhavatā dvivacane nantare śrūyamāṇe sādhuḥ ubha śabdaḥ iti na ca ṭāpaḥ grahaṇam na ca etāvatā kṛtī tvam

original: idam api vaktavyam ‘sa ca ṭāp dvivacanapara eva bhavati, na ekavacanadvi(bahu)vacanapara' iti āpy āpi dvivacanaparatā vaktavyety ayam artho bhāṣyakāreṇopanyasto yathaiva . . . ke sati evam āpy api sati iti /
analyzed: idam api vaktavyam sa ca ṭāp dvivacana paraḥ eva bhavati na ekavacana dvi bahuvacana paraḥ iti āpi āpi dvivacana para tā vaktavyā iti ayam arthaḥ bhāṣyakāreṇa upanyastaḥ yathā eva ke sati evam āpi api sati iti

original: 4.11 avacanād āpi tadvacanam (tatparavijñānam) / na dvivacanaparatā evam āśrīyate dvivacanaṃ paraṃ [yasmā]t sa dvivacanaviṣayaḥ (? -paraḥ) iti, kiṃ tarhi ? arthalakṣaṇaṃ dvivacanaparatvam / yatra parārthābhidhānaṃ tatra bhede nivṛtte asādhutvam / ṭābādīnāṃ svārthikatvāt, yadāpi viparītaguṇapradhānād aparityaktabhedaḥ kaparo 'pi sādhur iti /
analyzed: avacanāt tad vacanam tatpara vijñānam na dvivacana para tā evam āśrīyate dvivacanam param yasmāt sa dvivacana viṣayaḥ paraḥ iti kim tarhi artha lakṣaṇam dvivacana paratvam yatra para artha abhidhānam tatra bhede nivṛtte asādhu tvam ṭāp ādīnām svārthika tvāt yadā api viparīta guṇa pradhānāt a parityakta bhedaḥ sādhuḥ iti

original: 4.12 yady evam iha katham ubhābhyām ubhayror iti ? ete api na bāhyārthe iti sādhutvam ubhaśabdasya prāpnoti / tataś ca ubhataḥ ubhatreti prāpnoti / atha manyase bāhyāyām eva śaktau tral, yathādhistrīti striyāṃ bāhya evādhikaraṇe samāsa iti, evaṃ sati ubhābhyām ubhayor ity atrāpi sādhutvaṃ na prāpnoti /
analyzed: yadi evam iha katham ubhābhyām ubhayroḥ iti ete api na bāhya arthe iti sādhu tvam ubha śabdasya prāpnoti tatas ca ubhatas ubhatra iti prāpnoti atha manyase bāhyāyām eva śaktau yathā adhi strī iti striyām bāhye eva adhikaraṇe samāsaḥ iti evam sati ubhābhyām ubhayoḥ iti atra api sādhu tvam na prāpnoti

original: tasmād eṣa parihāro 'vyayatvāt tasilādīnām ‘sadūśaṃ triṣu liṅgeṣu sarvāsu ca vibhaktiṣu’ iti / vibhaktyarthamātravacaneṣu tasilādiṣu sarvo bhedaḥ parityakta ity asādhutvam asmin viṣaya iti ubhayo 'nyatrety ubhayaśabdaḥ pravartate /
analyzed: tasmāt eṣa parihāraḥ vyaya tvāt tasil ādīnām sadūśam triṣu liṅgeṣu sarvāsu ca vibhaktiṣu iti vibhakti artha mātra vacaneṣu tasil ādiṣu sarvaḥ bhedaḥ parityaktaḥ iti asādhu tvam asmin viṣaye iti ubhayaḥ nyatra iti ubhaya śabdaḥ pravartate

original: 4.13 yady evam ubhayo maṇir ity atrāpy avayavini parārthe vartamāno bhedaṃ jahāti ity asādhutvaṃ prāpnoti / naiṣa doṣaḥ / etad evāsya prathamam utpattirūpam / atra pratipadya rūpam ayam anyatrobhaśabde nivṛṭte 'pi pravartate parārthābhidhāne cet pravṛtto 'yam atyantam ubhaśabda iti /
analyzed: yadi evam ubhayaḥ maṇiḥ iti atra api avayavini parārthe vartamānaḥ bhedam jahāti iti asādhu tvam prāpnoti na eṣa doṣaḥ etat eva asya prathamam utpatti rūpam atra pratipadya rūpam ayam anyatra ubha śabde nivṛṭte pravartate parārtha abhidhāne ced pravṛttaḥ yam atyantam ubha śabdaḥ iti

original: 4.14 nipātanena dvivaṇḍyādiṣu vikalpaḥ pratipādyate ubhāñjaliḥ ubhayāñjaliḥ ubhāpāṇiḥ ubhayapāṇir iti / etac ca sarvaṃ kākacordvāreṇobhaśabdasya viṣaye sādhutvam asādhutvaṃ ca pratipāditam / akajarthas tu na kartavyaḥ pāṭho 'nyārthas tu kartavyaḥ / ‘sarvanāmnaḥ tṛtīyā ca’ (A 2.3.27) ubhābhyāṃ hetubhyā idaṃ labdham, ubhayor hetvor iti /
analyzed: nipātanena dvi vaṇḍi ādiṣu vikalpaḥ pratipādyate ubha añjaliḥ ubhaya añjaliḥ ubhāpāṇiḥ ubhaya pāṇiḥ iti etat ca sarvam ka akacoḥ dvāreṇa ubha śabdasya viṣaye sādhu tvam asādhu tvam ca pratipāditam a kac arthaḥ tu na kartavyaḥ pāṭhaḥ tu kartavyaḥ sarvanāmnaḥ tṛtīyā ca ubhābhyām hetubhyā idam labdham ubhayoḥ hetvoḥ iti

original: 4.15 atha bhavataḥ / ayam api kimarthaḥ saṃniveśaḥ ? halantān na saṃbhavanti smāyādaya iti praśnaḥ / bhavato 'kaccheṣātvāni / śeṣo na sarvanāmalakṣaṇaḥ / kiṃ tarhi ? saṃniveśāśrayaḥ ‘tyadādīni . . . ’ (A 1.2.62) iti / udāharaṇamātram . . . / tṛtīyāpīṣyate / bhāṣyakārasyāpi udāharaṇamātram / anyāny api saṃniveśāśrayīṇi kāryāṇi vidyante /
analyzed: atha bhavataḥ ayam api kimarthaḥ saṃniveśaḥ ha l antāt na saṃbhavanti smāya ādayaḥ iti praśnaḥ śeṣaḥ na sarvanāma lakṣaṇaḥ kim tarhi saṃniveśa āśrayaḥ iti udāharaṇa mātram tṛtīyā api iṣyate bhāṣyakārasya api udāharaṇa mātram anyāni api saṃniveśa āśrayīṇi kāryāṇi vidyante

original: bhāvatyam iti mā bhūt /
analyzed: bhāvatyam iti mā bhūt

original: vibhāṣā diksamāse [bahuvrīhau] // 1.1.28 //
analyzed: vibhāṣā diś samāse bahuvrīhau

original: 1.1 diggrahaṇaṃ kimartham ? bahuvrīhigrahaṇe ya[d a]tra vṛttisūtra uktaṃ tadvaktukāmasyāyam abhiprāyaḥ / granthacchāyā tu na bhagnā bhavatīti sarvaṃ vṛttigranthasūtram upanyasyati / abhiprāyo 'pi cāsti paryanuyoga iti / evaṃ manyate / yathaiva vidhipratiṣedhāvasthā syāt, vyaktyantare ca vikalpaḥ /
analyzed: diś grahaṇam kimartham bahuvrīhi grahaṇe yat atra vṛtti sūtre uktam tad vaktu kāmasya ayam abhiprāyaḥ grantha chāyā tu na bhagnā bhavati iti sarvam vṛtti grantha sūtram upanyasyati ca asti paryanuyogaḥ iti evam manyate yathā eva vidhi pratiṣedha avasthā syāt vyakti antare ca vikalpaḥ

original: itarathā hi vikalpena kṛtatvād anarthakaṃ pratiṣedhavacanaṃ syāt / vaiparītyam api puruṣahitopadeśān neṣyata iti / ‘na bahuvrīhau’ (A 1.1.29) iti pratiṣedhaṃ vakṣyati / na hy etadviśiṣṭaviṣayāvadhāranam antareṇājñānaṃ nivartate / tatra nāsūyā kartavyā yacchāstram evopadeśakam ity etad anena granthenācaṣṭe /
analyzed: itarathā hi vikalpena kṛta tvāt anarthakam pratiṣedha vacanam syāt vaiparītyam api puruṣa hita upadeśāt na iṣyate iti na bahuvrīhau iti pratiṣedham vakṣyati na hi etad viśiṣṭa viṣaya avadhāranam antareṇa ajñānam nivartate tatra na asūyā kartavyā yat śāstram eva upadeśakam iti etat anena granthena ācaṣṭe

original: 2.1 atha sa[māsa]grahaṇaṃ kimartham / evaṃ manyate / yathai samāsa (? bahuvrīhi)grahaṇe sati sublopapuṃvadbhāvau pratipadyate, evam imām api vibhāṣāṃ kimiti na labheteti / samāsa eva yo bahuvrīhiḥ / yathā kartaiva yaḥ kartā, evaṃ samāsa eva yaḥ samāsa(bahuvrīhi)s tatra yathā syāt / yas tv asamāse 'pi, tatra mā bhūd iti /
analyzed: atha samāsa grahaṇam kimartham evam manyate samāsa bahuvrīhi grahaṇe sati sup lopa puṃvat bhāvau pratipadyate evam imām api vibhāṣām kim iti na labheta iti samāse eva yaḥ bahuvrīhiḥ yathā kartā eva yaḥ kartā evam samāsaḥ eva yaḥ samāsa bahuvrīhiḥ tatra yathā syāt yaḥ tu a samāse tatra mā bhūt iti

original: athavā samāsa ity etat svaryate / samāsa iti prakṛtya [yo] bahuvrīhir iti /
analyzed: athavā samāse iti etat svaryate samāse iti prakṛtya yaḥ bahuvrīhiḥ iti

original: 2.2 atha keyaṃ vācoyuktiḥ bahuvrīhivadbhāvena yo bahuvrīhir iti / yāvatātideśiko bahuvrīhir eva na bhavati, kevalaṃ kāryaṃ pratipadyate ? naiṣa doṣaḥ / yathā eṣa brahmadatta ity antareṇa vatimatideśa evam ayam api vyapadeśaḥ / atha vātideśe vyapadeśātideśapakṣo 'pi nimittam antareṇa vidyate / tato 'pi yuktam idam ucyate /
analyzed: atha kā iyam vācoyuktiḥ bahuvrīhi vat bhāvena yaḥ bahuvrīhiḥ iti yāvatā ātideśikaḥ bahuvrīhiḥ eva na bhavati kevalam kāryam pratipadyate na eṣa doṣaḥ yathā eṣa brahmadattaḥ iti antareṇa evam ayam api vyapadeśaḥ atha vā atideśe vyapadeśa atideśa pakṣaḥ pi nimittam antareṇa vidyate tatas u pi yuktam idam ucyate

original: 3.1 atha bahuvrīhigrahaṇaṃ kimartham ? vakṣyamāṇaṃ buddhau vartate / saṃprati tv evaṃ manyate / dvandve ye 'vayavās te sarvādiṣu paṭhyante / teṣāṃ ca vṛttimātre puṃvadbhāve kṛte samudāyāt sa evāvayavo 'bhidhatte / . . . nābhāvaḥ suṭa iti /
analyzed: atha bahuvrīhi grahaṇam kimartham vakṣyamāṇam buddhau vartate saṃprati tu evam manyate dvandve ye vayavāḥ te sarva ādiṣu paṭhyante teṣām ca vṛtti mātre puṃvat bhāve kṛte samudāyāt saḥ eva avayavaḥ abhidhatte na abhāvaḥ suṭaḥ iti

original: 3.2 dvandev mā bhūt / dakṣiṇottara[pūrvāṇām] / sarvanāmno vṛttimātre puṃvadbhāve prakriyābhedaḥ / kecit sarveṣām eva puṃbhadbhāvaṃ kurvanti / kecid uttarapade pūrvapadasya / tatra ya uttarapade pūrvapadasya kurvanti te na sarvatra, lokavijñābād iha na bhavitavyaṃ puṃvadbhāvena ‘aparādakṣiṇottarāṇām’ iti /
analyzed: sarvanāmnaḥ vṛtti mātre puṃvat bhāve prakriyā bhedaḥ kecid sarveṣām eva puṃbhadbhāvam kurvanti kecid uttara pade pūrva padasya tatra ye uttara pade pūrva padasya kurvanti te na sarvatra loka vijñābāt iha na bhavitavyam puṃvat bhāvena aparā dakṣiṇa uttarāṇām iti

original: 3.3 nanu ca sarveṣāṃ puṃvadbhāve sati paravalloṅganirdeśādāv utpa(? -nupapa)ttiḥ syāt / naiṣa doṣaḥ / vākyāvasthāyāṃ parasya liṅgaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ, tatsamāsasyātidiśyate / atha vā puṃvadbhāvena śabdamātraṃ nivartyate / arthasyānivṛttatvāt paravalliṅgam atidiśyate / tatra samudāyāt pūrvasmin nivṛtte vā ṭāpi ṭāb utpadyate / ṭābantād vā dvitīyaṣṭāb iti /
analyzed: nanu ca sarveṣām puṃvat bhāve sati syāt na eṣa doṣaḥ vākya avasthāyām parasya liṅgam dṛṣṭam tat samāsasya atidiśyate atha vā puṃvat bhāvena śabda mātram nivartyate arthasya anivṛtta tvāt para vat liṅgam atidiśyate tatra samudāyāt pūrvasmin nivṛtte vā ṭāpi ṭāp utpadyate ṭāp antāt vā dvitīyaḥ ṭāp iti

original: antādivadbhāvāc cāsti tābantatā, tadantavidhiś cāsti ‘prayojanaṃ sarvanāmavyayasaṃjñāyām’ iti (A 1.1.72 vā 8) / atha ṭāpottarasya puṃvadbhāvo nāsti, na ca dvitīyaṣṭāb utpadyate, tadā ‘pratyayagrahaṇe yasmāt sa vihita . . . ’ iti katham aṅgasyābantatā ? uktam atra ‘astrīpratyayeneti’
analyzed: anta ādi vat bhāvāt ca asti tāp anta tā tad anta vidhiḥ ca asti prayojanam sarvanāma vyaya saṃjñāyām iti vā atha ṭāpa uttarasya puṃvat bhāvaḥ na asti na ca dvitīya ṣṭāp utpadyate tadā pratyaya grahaṇe yasmāt sa vihitaḥ iti katham aṅgasya ap anta tā uktam atra a strī pratyayena iti

original: 3.4 yena nāprāpta . . . iti / nanu ca viṣayabhedād ayuktam idam ucyate / na hi dvandve ‘na bahuvrīhau’ (A 1.1.29) ity asti pratiṣedho, bahuvrīhau vā ‘dvandev ca’ (A 1.1.31) iti /
analyzed: yena na aprāptaḥ iti nanu ca viṣaya bhedāt ayuktam idam ucyate na hi dvandve na bahuvrīhau iti asti pratiṣedhaḥ bahuvrīhau vā ca iti

original: 3.5 ucyate / anyena prakāreṇedam upanyastaṃ ‘yena nāprāpta . . . ’ iti / katham ? yena nāprāpta nāvyāpte svasmin viṣaye pratiṣedhena tasyeyaṃ vibhāṣā syāt / tatra sa pratiṣedho 'nayā vibhāṣayā bādhitavyaḥ / kuta etat ? tasminn iyaṃ paravartamānād aprasaṅgā bahuvrīhau prāktapravṛttā kṛtārthā satī vipratiṣedhe paratvāt pratiṣedhāntareṇa bādhyate /
analyzed: ucyate anyena prakāreṇa idam upanyastam yena na aprāptaḥ iti katham yena na aprāpta na avyāpte svasmin viṣaye pratiṣedhena tasya iyam vibhāṣā syāt tatra sa pratiṣedhaḥ nayā vibhāṣayā bādhitavyaḥ kutas etat tasmin iyam paravartamānāt aprasaṅgā bahuvrīhau kṛtārthā satī vipratiṣedhe paratvāt pratiṣedha antareṇa bādhyate

original: 3.6 atha vā purastād apavādāḥ . . . śāstrāntareṇa bādhyante / śāstrāṇi ca bhedenāpekṣyante ity anantare kṛtārthaṃ śāstram itareṇa saha spardhate /
analyzed: atha vā purastāt apavādāḥ śāstra antareṇa bādhyante śāstrāṇi ca bhedena apekṣyante iti anantare kṛtārtham śāstram itareṇa saha spardhate

original: lakṣaṇapratipadoktayoḥ / nanu ca ‘diṅnāmāny antarāle’ (A 2.2.26) ity evaṃ samāsaḥ / yatra ca paricchinnarūpaḥ śabda upādīyate tatredam ucyate / yathā ‘śreṇyādayaḥ kṛtādibhiḥ’ (A 2.1.59) iti / ucyate / vyapadeśapratipadoktatā ihāśrīyate / ‘diksamāsa’ ity evaṃ vyapadeśaṃ kaḥ pratipattum arhati ? kiṃ yatra dig iti saṃśabdanam asty uta neti /
analyzed: lakṣaṇa pratipada uktayoḥ nanu ca diś nāmāni antarāle  / iti evam samāsaḥ yatra ca paricchinna rūpaḥ śabdaḥ upādīyate tatra idam ucyate yathā śreṇi ādayaḥ kṛta ādibhiḥ iti ucyate vyapadeśa pratipada ukta tā iha āśrīyate diś samāsaḥ iti evam vyapadeśam kaḥ pratipattum arhati kim yatra diś iti saṃśabdanam asti uta na iti

original: yuktaṃ yatra dig iti saṃśabdanam asti /
analyzed: yuktam yatra diś iti saṃśabdanam asti

original: 3.8 nanu coktaṃ sarvo bahuvrīhiḥ pratyārambhāt pratipadokto mahābāhur iti yathā / samāsāntarāpekṣātaḥ tad uktam / svakakṣāyāṃ tv asti lakṣaṇapratipadoktatvam / yathā ‘sādhakatamaṃ karaṇam’ iti (A 1.4.42) /
analyzed: nanu ca uktam sarvaḥ bahuvrīhiḥ pratyārambhāt pratipada uktaḥ mahā bāhuḥ iti yathā samāsa antara apekṣātaḥ tat uktam sva kakṣāyām tu asti lakṣaṇa pratipada ukta tvam yathā sādhakatama karaṇa iti

original: 3.9 ayaṃ parihāra ārabhyamāṇe ‘diṅnāmāny antarāla’ (A 2.2.26) ity etasminn upapadyate / yadā tu pratyākhyāyate ‘digsamāsasahayogayoś cāntarālapradhānābhidhānāt’ (A 2.2.28 vā. 1) iti tadā na saṃbhavaty ayaṃ parihāraḥ /
analyzed: ayam parihāraḥ ārabhyamāṇe diś nāmāni antarāla iti etasmin upapadyate yadā tu pratyākhyāyate diś samāsa sahayogayoḥ ca antarāla pradhāna abhidhānāt vā 1 iti tadā na saṃbhavati ayam parihāraḥ

original: 3.10 idaṃ tarhi prayojanam / uttarārtham eva bahuvrīhigrahaṇam avasthitam / vacanaprāmāṇyaṃ ca / bahiraṅgāpi(?-hi) jasi vibhāṣāntaraṅgeṇa pratiṣedhena bādhyate / itarathā hi dvitīyasya bahuvrīhigrahaṇasyānuvṛttir anarthikaiva syāt /
analyzed: idam tarhi prayojanam uttara artham eva bahuvrīhi grahaṇam avasthitam vacana prāmāṇyam ca jasi vibhāṣā antaraṅgeṇa pratiṣedhena bādhyate itarathā hi dvitīyasya bahuvrīhi grahaṇasya anuvṛttiḥ anarthikā eva syāt

original: 3.11 kathaṃ punar atra ‘vibhāṣā jasi’ iti prāptir asti / yāvatā yayor eva śabdayor dvandvas tāv eva na sarvādiṣu paṭhyete vastrāntaravasanāntaraśabdau ? tadantavidhinā syād iti / sa ca nāsty antaraśabdasyopasarjanatvād anvarthasaṃjñākaraṇāc ca / saṃjñopasarjanayoḥ sarvāditvam eva nāsit, yathātisarvāyeti, na dṛśyate bahuvrīhigrahaṇasya prayojanam /
analyzed: katham punar atra vibhāṣā jasi iti prāptiḥ asti yāvatā yayoḥ eva śabdayoḥ tau eva na sarva ādiṣu paṭhyete vastra antara vasana antara śabdau tad anta vidhinā syāt iti sa ca na asti antara śabdasya upasarjana tvāt anvartha saṃjñā karaṇāt ca saṃjñā upasarjanayoḥ sarva ādi tvam eva na asit yathā atisarvāya iti na dṛśyate bahuvrīhi grahaṇasya prayojanam

original: na bahurvīhau // 1.1.29 //
analyzed: na bahuḥ vīhau 1129

original: 1.1 kim udāharaṇam ? abhiprāyaḥ / sarvanāmnaḥ pūrvanipātāt tadantatā nāsti / yatra cānyasya pūrvanipātaḥ, sa na prayokṣyate priyaviśvāyeti / kutaḥ ? kulyārthasya śabdāntarasya bhāvāt viśvapriyāyeti prayokṣyate /
analyzed: kim udāharaṇam abhiprāyaḥ sarvanāmnaḥ pūrva nipātāt tad anta tā na asti yatra ca anyasya pūrva nipātaḥ sa na prayokṣyate priya viśvāya iti kutas kulya arthasya śabda antarasya bhāvāt viśva priyāya iti prayokṣyate

original: 1.2 idaṃ tarhi dvyanyāyeti / saṃkhyāyā nityasaṃkhyeyaparatantrāyā viśeṣaṇabhāvāt pūrvanipāto 'vaśyaṃbhāvīty asti tadantavidhiḥ / nanu cātrāpi sarvanāmna eva / evamartham upasaṃkhyānaṃ sarvanāmasaṃkhyayoḥ saṃnipāte yasya na prāpnoti pūrvanipātas tasya kathaṃ syād iti / kasya ca na prāpnoti ? sarvanāmnaḥ /
analyzed: idam tarhi dvi anyāya iti saṃkhyāyāḥ nitya saṃkhyeya paratantrāyāḥ viśeṣaṇa bhāvāt pūrva nipātaḥ vaśyaṃbhāvi iti asti tad anta vidhiḥ nanu ca atra api sarvanāmnaḥ eva evamartham upasaṃkhyānam sarvanāma saṃkhyayoḥ saṃnipāte yasya na prāpnoti pūrva nipātaḥ tasya katham syāt iti kasya ca na prāpnoti sarvanāmnaḥ

original: 1.3 naiṣa doṣaḥ / vakṣyaty etat iti / anenaitad vyākhyāyate, ‘nāyaṃ vākyārtho < yas tvayā parikalpita’ iti / idaṃ cāpy udāharaṇam / etat pradarśayati / loke cāyaṃ śabdo dṛṣṭaprayogaḥ pratiyaviśvāyeti / darśanasya ca vāvacanam eva liṅgam ‘vā priyasya’ (A 2.2.35 vā. 2) iti /
analyzed: na eṣa doṣaḥ vakṣyati etat iti anena etat vyākhyāyate na ayam vākya arthaḥ yaḥ tvayā parikalpitaḥ iti idam ca api udāharaṇam etat pradarśayati loke ca ayam śabdaḥ dṛṣṭa prayogaḥ darśanasya ca eva liṅgam vā iti

original: 1.4 kiṃ prayojanam ? abhiprāyaḥ / ātvaṃ tṛtīyā syāmādaya iti etatsarvanāmakāryam / etac ca bahubrīhau na saṃbhavati / ādyaṃ tāvat dṛkdṛśyavatuṣu vidhīyate / tṛtīyasyā aśravaṇaṃ smāyādīnāṃ ceti kāryāntaram upanyasyati akac mā bhūd iti / ajanteṣu kākacor viśeṣam apaśyann āha---kaś cedānīṃ kākacor viśeṣa iti / vyañjanānteṣu viśeṣaḥ /
analyzed: kim prayojanam abhiprāyaḥ ātvam tṛtīyā syāma ādayaḥ iti etat sarvanāma kāryam etat ca bahubrīhau na saṃbhavati ādyam tāvat dṛś dṛśya vatuṣu vidhīyate tṛtīyasyāḥ aśravaṇam smāyā ādīnām ca iti kārya antaram upanyasyati a ka c mā bhūt iti a c anteṣu ka akacoḥ viśeṣam apaśyan ca idānīm ka akacoḥ viśeṣaḥ iti vyañjana anteṣu viśeṣaḥ

original: viśeṣapradarśanaparam etat / avyañjanānteṣv apy asti viśeṣaḥ / dvikaputro dvakiputra iti /
analyzed: viśeṣa pradarśana param etat avyañjana anteṣu api asti viśeṣaḥ dvika putraḥ dvaki putraḥ iti

original: 1.5 kathaṃ punar icchatāpi / anupajāta evānyapadārthe bahuvrīhinimitte / pratiṣedhasya nimittaṃ bahiraṅgam / sarvanāmasaṃjñā caikaśabdanibandhanā nimittam akaca iti bahuvrīhyadhikaraṇasyākacā bhavitavyam /
analyzed: katham punar icchatā api an upajāte eva anya padārthe bahuvrīhi nimitte pratiṣedhasya nimittam bahis aṅgam sarvanāma saṃjñā ca eka śabda nibandhanā nimittam a kacaḥ iti bahuvrīhi adhikaraṇasya a kacā bhavitavyam

original: 1.6 gomatpriya iti yathā / śāstre yat liṅgadarśanaṃ ‘pratyayottarapadayoś ca’ (A 7.2.98) iti tad evaṃ samarthyate bahiraṅgo vā samāso 'ntaraṅgaṃ bādhate, samāsanimitto vā vidhir antaraṅgaṃ bādhata iti etatsāmānyam upādīyate jñāpakam / kiriyate tatra yatnaḥ / abhiprāyaḥ / lugviṣayam eva jñāpakam, na sarvaviṣayam /
analyzed: gomat priyaḥ iti yathā śāstre yat liṅga darśanam pratyaya uttara padayoḥ ca iti tat evam samarthyate bahiraṅgaḥ vā samāsaḥ ntaraṅgam bādhate samāsa nimittaḥ vā vidhiḥ antaraṅgam bādhate iti etat sāmānyam upādīyate jñāpakam tatra yatnaḥ abhiprāyaḥ luc viṣayam eva jñāpakam na sarva viṣayam

original: mā bhūd antaraṅgaparibhāṣāyā bādhanam iti /
analyzed: mā bhūt antaraṅga paribhāṣāyāḥ bādhanam iti

original: 1.10 gonardīyas tv āha / kim asyācāryasya darśanam ? eke tāvat varṇayanti---vastrāntaravasanāntarā ity evamarthaṃ bahuvrīhigrahaṇaṃ paṭhitavyam / tatra sati prayojane 'śakyam antaraṅgo vidhir bahuvrīhiṇā bādhitum / tādarthyaṃ vā pratipattum iti / etan na / saṃpraty evoktam ‘upasarjanapratiṣedhenāpy etat siddham’ iti /

original: 2.1 āḍhyapūrvāya dehi / abahuvrīhitvāt pratiṣedho na prāpnotīty upasaṃkhyāyate / vyavasthāyām ity ucyate / na tatra (? cātra) vyavasthā gamyate / prādhānyenety arthaḥ / pūrvaśabdo hi vṛttau āḍhyatvānugate bhūtapūrve guṇatām āpannaḥ / apradhānatvād upasarjanatve sati sarvāditvam eva nāsti yathātisarvāyeti /
analyzed: āḍhya pūrvāya dehi a bahuvrīhi tvāt pratiṣedhaḥ na prāpnoti iti upasaṃkhyāyate vyavasthāyām iti ucyate na tatra ca atra vyavasthā gamyate prādhānyena iti arthaḥ pūrva śabdaḥ hi vṛttau āḍhya tva anugate bhūtapūrve guṇatām āpannaḥ apradhāna tvāt upasarjana tve sati sarva ādi tvam eva na asti yathā atisarvāya iti

original: 2.2 anye varṇayanti / na cātra vyavasthā gamyata iti / yathā dakṣiṇā gāthakā iti dākṣiṇyam apāyi gāthakeṣv evam āḍhyatvam apāyyāḍhyapūrva iti / etat tu na saṃbhavati / kutaḥ ? yady apy āḍhyatvam apāyi, pūrvatvaṃ tu vyavasthitam / vyavasthā ca pūrvādīnāṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ nāḍhyatvasyeti /
analyzed: anye varṇayanti na ca atra vyavasthā gamyate iti yathā dakṣiṇāḥ gāthakāḥ iti dākṣiṇyam apāyi gāthakeṣu evam āḍhya tvam apāyi āḍhya pūrvaḥ iti etat tu na saṃbhavati kutas yadi api āḍhya tvam apāyi pūrva tvam tu vyavasthitam vyavasthā ca pūrva ādīnām viśeṣaṇam na āḍhya tvasya iti

original: 2.3 anye jahatsvārthāyāṃ vṛttau nāsti vyavasthārtha iti varṇayanti /

original: kasyacic ca sadṛasya dharmasyānugamāc chakyata evaṃbhūtāṃ vṛttiṃ niṣpādayitum iti tādarthyam adhyavasīyate / yat tv atyantaṃ viguaṇaṃ vākyaṃ tasmin nāsti pratiṣedho 'devadattena pūrvasmin kāla’ iti /

original: 1.2 atha vā samāsa iti varta[māne]punaḥ samāsagrahaṇe (? ṇasya) / nanu cāsamāsagrahaṇam etat ? ucyate / yady apy evaṃ tathāpi kṛtākāre savarṇanirdeśe samāsa ity etac chrutisaṃnipāti netarad iti samāsagrahaṇam iti bravīti / yogavibhāge ca nañivayuktanyāyena samāsasadṛśe pratiṣedho 'samāse, na tu ‘devadattena pūrvasmin kāla’ iti /
analyzed: atha vā samāse iti samāsa grahaṇe ṇasya nanu ca a samāsa grahaṇam etat ucyate yadi api evam tathā api kṛta ākāre savarṇa nirdeśe samāse iti etat śruti saṃnipāti na itarat iti samāsa grahaṇam iti bravīti yoga vibhāge ca samāsa sadṛśe samāse na tu devadattena pūrvasmin kāle iti

original: anye tu pratiyogaṃ saṃjñāvidhānāt ‘jasaḥ śī’ (A 7.1.17) ity etasmin saṃjñā vidhīyate, tena jaskārya eva vibhāṣāny atra pratiṣedha iti //

original: 1.1 avarādīnāṃ ca punaḥ sūtrapāṭhe grahaṇānarthakyaṃ, gaṇe paṭhitatvāt / nirjñātā vṛttikārodāharaṇebhya eva jasi vibhāṣā / sarvādiṣu ca sarvatra nityā sarvanāmasaṃjñā kathaṃ syād iti pūrvādīni viśiṣṭārthopalakṣitāni paṭhitānīty etad api nirjñātam / tad iha vākyakāro na sūtrārabhbhaṃ paryanuyuṅkte /
analyzed: avara ādīnām ca punar sūtra pāṭhe grahaṇa ānarthakyam gaṇe paṭhita tvāt nirjñātā vṛtti kāra udāharaṇebhyaḥ eva jasi vibhāṣā sarva ādiṣu ca sarvatra nityā sarvanāma saṃjñā katham syāt iti pūrva ādīni viśiṣṭa artha upalakṣitāni paṭhitāni iti etat api nirjñātam tat iha vākyakāraḥ na paryanuyuṅkte

original: sarveṣāṃ tu svarūpeṇa pratipadam uccāraṇaṃ tribhiḥ sūtraiḥ kimarthaṃ kriyata ity etadvākyenopanyasyati /
analyzed: sarveṣām tu sva rūpeṇa pratipadam uccāraṇam tribhiḥ sūtraiḥ kimartham kriyate iti etad vākyena upanyasyati

original: 1.2 avarādīnām avaraprakārāṇām āśritasvarūpāṇām / gaṇapāṭhe ni[rdiṣṭā eva pratyabhijñātā] bhaviṣyantīti pratyākhyāta eva vākyakāreṇa trisūtryāṃ pratipadam avarādīnāṃ pāṭhaḥ / bhāṣyakāras tu sūtrakārābhiprāyaṃ vyācakṣāṇaḥ pratividhatte---kathaṃ punarjñāyase sa pūrvaḥ pāṭhaḥ, ayaṃ punaḥ pāṭha iti ?
analyzed: avara ādīnām avara prakārāṇām āśrita svarūpāṇām gaṇa pāṭhe nirdiṣṭāḥ eva pratyabhijñātāḥ bhaviṣyanti iti pratyākhyātaḥ eva vākyakāreṇa tri sūtryām pratipadam avara ādīnām pāṭhaḥ bhāṣyakāraḥ tu sūtrakāra abhiprāyam vyācakṣāṇaḥ pratividhatte katham punar jñāyase sa pūrvaḥ pāṭhaḥ ayam punar pāṭhaḥ iti

original: 1.3 atra bhinnagranthasaṃniveśe kathaṃbhūtaṃ paurvāparyam ? paurvāparyeṇa pāṭhāśrayaṃ gauravaṃ parihṛtaṃ bhavati / tatraitasminn anye bhāṣyakārasyābhiprāyam evaṃ vyākhyātāraḥ samarthayante / ayam āśiśabdo niyatanirjñātasaṃniveśeṣu pūrvavyavasthiteṣu keṣucid gaṇeṣūpādīyamāno dṛṣṭaḥ / tadyathā śreṇyādiṣu / tatraiva vyavasthārtham ācakṣate /
analyzed: atra bhinna grantha saṃniveśe kathaṃbhūtam paurvāparyam paurvāparyeṇa pāṭha āśrayam gauravam parihṛtam bhavati tatra etasmin anye bhāṣyakārasya abhiprāyam evam vyākhyātāraḥ samarthayante ayam āśi śabdaḥ niyata nirjñāta saṃniveśeṣu pūrva vyavasthiteṣu kaścitsu gaṇeṣu upādīyamānaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ tat yathā śreṇi ādiṣu tatra eva vyavasthā artham ācakṣate

original: kvacit tu laukikāviṣṭaprayogasadṛśāḥ kenacid ekadeśasya sādṛśyena samanvitāḥ pratipadya prakārārtham āśiśabdaṃ sūtre 'pūrvasamudāyavṛttyudāharaṇasthānīyā gaṇāḥ paṭhyante / yathā kṛtādayaḥ / tathā ca vakṣyati ‘śreṇyādayaḥ paṭhyante, kṛtādir ākṛtigaṇaḥ’ iti /
analyzed: kvacid tu laukika āviṣṭa prayoga sadṛśāḥ kenacid eka deśasya sādṛśyena samanvitāḥ pratipadya prakāra artham āśi śabdam sūtre pūrva samudāya vṛtti udāharaṇa sthānīyāḥ gaṇāḥ paṭhyante yathā kṛta ādayaḥ tathā ca vakṣyati śreṇi ādayaḥ paṭhyante kṛta ādiḥ ākṛti gaṇaḥ iti

original: 1.4 yeṣu ca vyavasthārtha ādiśabdas teṣu pūrvaṃ vyavasthitasaṃniveśeṣu nirjñātā(? niyatā)nupūrvyeṣu sūtram ārabhyate / yeṣu tu prakārārtha ādiśabdas teṣu śiṣṭaprayogasādṛśyamātranibandhane pūrvaṃ sūtre paṭhite vṛttyudāharaṇavad uttarakālaṃ gaṇanidarśanārthenārthāḥ paṭhyante / na ca teṣu bhāṣyasūtreṣu gurulaghu prati yatnaḥ kriyate /
analyzed: yeṣu ca vyavasthā arthaḥ ādi śabdaḥ teṣu pūrvam vyavasthita saṃniveśeṣu nirjñātāḥ niyata ānupūrvyeṣu sūtram ārabhyate yeṣu tu prakāra arthaḥ ādi śabdaḥ teṣu śiṣṭa prayoga sādṛśya mātra nibandhane pūrvam sūtre paṭhite vṛtti udāharaṇa vat uttara kālam gaṇa nidarśana arthena arthāḥ paṭhyante na ca teṣu bhāṣya sūtreṣu guru laghu prati yatnaḥ kriyate

original: tathā ca ‘na cedānīm ācāryāḥ kṛtvā sūtrāṇi nivartayanti’ iti / bhāṣyasūtrāṇi hi lakṣaṇaprapañcābhyāṃ nidarśanasamarthanaparāṇi /
analyzed: tathā ca na ca idānīm ācāryāḥ kṛtvā sūtrāṇi nivartayanti iti bhāṣya sūtrāṇi hi lakṣaṇa prapañcābhyām nidarśana samarthana parāṇi

original: tathā ca vibhaktīnāṃ sūtrasaṃniveśaviśeṣās teṣu kiṃcid vikalpyate kiṃcid avikalpitaṃ tathaiva paṭhyate, tathā vyākaraṇāntareṣv avicchinnānupūrvyapāramparyā gaṇasūtrasaṃniveśaviśeṣās teṣu kiṃcid vikalpyate, kiṃcid avikalpitaṃ tathaiva paṭhyate / tathā hi---pūrvācāryasaṃjñābhiḥ pūrvācāryanirdeśaiś ca prātipadikapāṭhaprāyeṇa vyavahāro dṛśyate /
analyzed: tathā ca vibhaktīnām sūtra saṃniveśa viśeṣāḥ teṣu kiṃcid vikalpyate kiṃcid a vikalpitam tathā eva paṭhyate tathā vyākaraṇa antareṣu avicchinna ānupūrvya pāramparyāḥ gaṇa sūtra saṃniveśa viśeṣāḥ teṣu kiṃcid vikalpyate kiṃcid a vikalpitam tathā eva paṭhyate tathā hi pūrva ācārya saṃjñābhiḥ pūrva ācārya nirdeśaiḥ ca prātipadika pāṭha prāyeṇa vyavahāraḥ dṛśyate

original: kṛnmakārasaṃdhyakṣarānto 'vyayībhāvaścety evamādi /
analyzed: kṛt makāra saṃdhi akṣara antaḥ vyayībhāvaḥ ca iti evamādi

original: 1.5 tatra vyavasthāpya(? khya) ādiśabde vijñāyamāne sa pūrvaḥ pāṭhaḥ, pūrvam ācāryeṇoccāritaḥ / sūtrapāṭhas tv avarakālaḥ / tathā ca laghu sūtraṃ kartavyam ity avarādīnāṃ punaḥ pāṭhaḥ pratipadaṃ trisūtryāṃ pratyākhyātaḥ /
analyzed: tatra vyavasthāpya khye ādi śabde vijñāyamāne sa pūrvaḥ pāṭhaḥ pūrvam ācāryeṇa uccāritaḥ sūtra pāṭhaḥ tu avara kālaḥ tathā ca laghu sūtram kartavyam iti avara ādīnām punar pāṭhaḥ pratipadam tri sūtryām pratyākhyātaḥ

original: yadi tu prakārārtha ādiśabdaḥ pścād ācāryeṇa grahaṇakavat gaṇeṣu pāṭhāt kecit samuccitāḥ, kuśalair vā praṇetṛbhiḥ smṛtyartham uparacitās tatas teṣu gurulaghubhāvaṃ pratyanādaraḥ / paṭhitam api ca punaḥ paṭhyate / upasaṃkhyānāny api ca prakṣipyante / ‘upāddvyajajinamagaurādayaḥ’ (A 6.2.194) / ‘nirajinodajinopājināḥ’ /
analyzed: yadi tu prakāra arthe ādi śabdaḥ pūcāt ācāryeṇa grahaṇaka vat gaṇeṣu pāṭhāt kecid samuccitāḥ kuśalaiḥ vā praṇetṛbhiḥ smṛti artham uparacitāḥ tatas teṣu guru laghu bhāvam pratyanādaraḥ paṭhitam api ca punar paṭhyate upasaṃkhyānāni api ca prakṣipyante upa āt dvi a c ajina ma gaura ādayaḥ nirajina udajina upājināḥ

original: ‘śunaḥ prasāraṇaṃ dīrghatvam’ / ‘dvitīyānupasarge’ / ‘pravṛddhādiṣu khaṭvārūḍha’ iti / ‘nadyajādyudāttatve’ bṛhanmahator upasaṃkhyānam (vā. 6.1.173.1) / ‘gaurādiṣu bṛhatyañ mahatyaḥ saudharmya’ iti / bidādiṣu gopavanādis tu saṃhitāpāṭho dvitīyādhyāyavad eva / kaṇvādayo gargādiṣu paṭhitāḥ, ‘kaṇvādibhyaḥ . . . ’ (A 4.2.111) iti punaḥ paṭhyante /
analyzed: śunaḥ prasāraṇam dīrgha tvam dvitīyā an upasarge pravṛddha ādiṣu khaṭvārūḍhaḥ iti nadī a c ādi udātta tve bṛhat mahatoḥ upasaṃkhyānam vā gaura ādiṣu mahatyaḥ saudharmyaḥ iti bida ādiṣu gopavana ādiḥ tu saṃhitā pāṭhaḥ dvitīya adhyāya vat eva kaṇva ādayaḥ garga ādiṣu paṭhitāḥ kaṇva ādibhyaḥ iti punar paṭhyante

original: 1.3 atrāpi ya eṣa manuṣyaḥ / ayam abhiprāyaḥ / kriyamāṇepy upasaṃvyānagrahaṇe na sidhyati śāṭakayuga iti manyate / bhāvyupasaṃvyānaṃ buddhau kṛtvā pravartiṣyate vyapadeśa ity evaṃ kecid vyākhyātāro varṇayanti / anye tu manyante / ādigrahaṇaṃ vākye kṛtaṃ, tasyedaṃ prayojanaṃ---śāṭakatrayārthaṃ śāṭakacatuṣṭayārthaṃ vā /

original: tayoś ca viśeṣavidhānād ekasminn aprasaṅga iti /
analyzed: tayoḥ ca viśeṣa vidhānāt ekasmin aprasaṅgaḥ iti

original: [2.34] na cāpy evaṃ vigrahaḥ kariṣyate / na sarvā asarvā iti / kiṃ ca bhoḥ, asmin vigrahe doṣopanyāsaḥ na sarvā vibhaktayo 'smād iti ? nety āha / kiṃ tarhi ? na sarvā vibhaktayaḥ utpattau nimittam asyeti / ucyate / asmin vigrahe kriyamāṇe sūtre yo doṣaḥ sa uktaḥ /
analyzed: na ca api evam vigrahaḥ kariṣyate na sarvāḥ asarvāḥ iti kim ca bhoḥ asmin vigrahe doṣa upanyāsaḥ na sarvāḥ vibhaktayaḥ smāt iti na iti āha kim tarhi na sarvāḥ vibhaktayaḥ utpattau nimittam asya iti ucyate asmin vigrahe kriyamāṇe sūtre yaḥ doṣaḥ saḥ uktaḥ

original: idānīṃ vṛttikārāntara[mata]m upanyasyati yasmin pakṣe kriyāmāṇe sūtre tu na kaścit doṣo bhavati / sa tu kena darśanena ? asarvā vibhaktaya iti / etad utsṛjya evam āśrayati ayam asarvā vibhaktir asmād iti /
analyzed: idānīm vṛtti kāra antara matam upanyasyati yasmin pakṣe kriyāmāṇe sūtre tu na kaścid doṣaḥ bhavati sa tu kena darśanena asarvāḥ vibhaktayaḥ iti etat utsṛjya evam āśrayati ayam asarvā vibhaktiḥ asmāt iti

original: [2.35] [atra] ucyate / avyayeṣu vibhaktyutpattau catvāraḥ prakārāḥ / aviśeṣeṇotpadyanta utpannānāṃ niyama ity etasmin darśane 'nāśritārthopanibandhanāḥ kevalaṃ saṃskārāyaivotpadyante / tatra yady api asarvā vibhaktir ity ayaṃ vigrahas tathāpi . . . kṣatiḥ, savrasyāvibhakter utpannatvāt /
analyzed: atra ucyate avyayeṣu vibhakti utpattau catvāraḥ prakārāḥ aviśeṣeṇa utpadyante utpannānām niyamaḥ iti etasmin darśane na āśrita artha upanibandhanāḥ kevalam saṃskārāya eva utpadyante tatra yadi api asarvā vibhaktiḥ iti ayam vigrahaḥ tathā api kṣatiḥ savrasyāḥ avibhakteḥ utpanna tvāt

original: sarvasyāś cotpattau liṅgam---‘nāvyayībhāvād ato 'mtvapañcamyāḥ’ (A 2.4.83), ‘tṛtīyāsaptamyor bahulam’ (A 2.4.84) iti / ekārthāyāṃ pravṛttāv arthāt tathāvyayāt yathāvyayībhāvāt /
analyzed: sarvasyāḥ ca utpattau liṅgam na avyayībhāvāt a taḥ m tva pañcamyāḥ tṛtīyā saptamyoḥ bahulam iti ekārthāyām pravṛttau arthāt tathā avyayāt yathā avyayībhāvāt

original: [2.36] athāpy evaṃ kalpyate, kenacid eva vacanena saṃskartuṃ śakyate / kutaḥ svādīni tadāśritāni ca pravartiṣyante ? amavyatikrame ca prayojanaṃ nāsti / tasmāt prathamāyā eva kevalam ekavacanam iti / evam api tathāvigrahaḥ kriyate yathā sidhyati /
analyzed: atha api evam kalpyate kenacid eva vacanena saṃskartum śakyate kutas sva ādīni tad āśritāni ca pravartiṣyante ama vyatikrame ca prayojanam na asti tasmāt prathamāyāḥ eva kevalam ekavacanam iti evam api tathā vigrahaḥ kriyate yathā sidhyati

original: [2.37] atha tu prātipadikagrahaṇasya prayojanam uktam / avyayebhyaḥ kathaṃ prathamā sapūrvāyāḥ prathamāyāvibhāṣety evam artham ity etasmin vigrahe sidhati na sarvā vibhaktayo 'smād iti / asmiṃs tu na sidhyati na sarvā vibhaktir asmād iti / sarvā hi vibhaktis tūtpannā vyavasīyate /
analyzed: atha tu prātipadika grahaṇasya prayojanam uktam avyayebhyaḥ katham prathamā sa pūrvāyāḥ prathamāyāḥ vibhāṣā iti evam artham iti etasmin vigrahe sidhati na sarvāḥ vibhaktayaḥ smāt iti asmin tu na sidhyati na sarvā vibhaktiḥ asmāt iti sarvā hi vibhaktiḥ tu utpannā vyavasīyate

original: [2.38] tatra yadanantaram upanyastaṃ sa pakṣa āśriyate / idaṃ cānantaram ekavacanam utsargataḥ, sarvāny ekavacanāni avyayebhyaḥ pravartanta iti etāsmin darśane / sarvaśabdaś ca prakārakārtsnye 'pi vartate / sarvāṇy annāni bhuktāni, sarvāṇi caraṇāni dṛṣṭānīti /
analyzed: tatra yat anantaram upanyastam sa pakṣaḥ āśriyate idam ca anantaram ekavacanam utsargataḥ sarvāni ekavacanāni avyayebhyaḥ pravartante iti darśane sarva śabdaḥ ca prakāra kārtsnye vartate sarvāṇi annāni bhuktāni sarvāṇi caraṇāni dṛṣṭāni iti

original: ekadeśe 'pi pravartamāne suśabde vāmśabde vā utpannāḥ sarvā vibhaktaya iti vyapadeśaḥ syāt / tasmāt sākalyapratipattyarthaṃ vigraha āśrīyate asarvo vibhaktir iti /
analyzed: eka deśe pi pravartamāne su śabde vā amśabde vā utpannāḥ sarvāḥ vibhaktayaḥ iti vyapadeśaḥ syāt tasmāt sākalya pratipatti artham vigrahaḥ āśrīyate a sarvaḥ vibhaktiḥ iti

original: [2.39] yac ca liṅga sarvavibhaktyutpattau tadavyayībhāvasyaiva bhedavattvam ity asya pratipādakaṃ ca / yathā samāsakāṇḍe ekavadbhāvakāṇḍe caikārthībhāvasya samāhāravyavasthāviṣayaṃ vacanam / ‘sapūrvāyā . . . vibhāṣā’ iti vyavasthitavibhāṣety evaṃ samarthayitavyam /
analyzed: yat ca sarva vibhakti utpattau tad avyayībhāvasya eva bhedavat tvam iti asya pratipādakam ca yathā samāsa kāṇḍe ekavat bhāva kāṇḍe ca ekārthībhāvasya samāhāra vyavasthā viṣayam vacanam sa pūrvāyāḥ vibhāṣā iti vyavasthita vibhāṣā iti evam samarthayitavyam

original: kramavyatikrame 'pi śāstre dvitīyaiva pūrvā na prathameti prayoge 'py anukramabhāva iti /
analyzed: krama vyatikrame pi śāstre dvitīyā eva pūrvā na prathamā iti prayoge pi anukrama bhāve iti

original: [2.41] evaṃ gate kṛty api tulyam etat _ evam avasthite vigrahe na sarvā asarvety asarvavibhaktir ity etāvat tu paṭhitavyam / tataś ca kṛty api tulyam etat asarvavibhaktitvam iti / ‘kṛnmejantaḥ’ (A 1.1.39) ity etan na paṭhitavyam / māntasya kāryaṃ grahaṇaṃ na tatreti athaḥ / trayaḥ kṛdarthā iti ktvātosunkasunāṃ nirdeśaḥ /
analyzed: evam gate kṛti api tulyam etat evam avasthite vigrahe na sarvā asarvā iti asarva vibhaktiḥ iti etāvat tu paṭhitavyam tatas ca kṛti api tulyam etat asarva vibhakti tvam iti iti etat na paṭhitavyam ma antasya kāryam grahaṇam na tatra iti athaḥ trayaḥ kṛt arthāḥ iti nirdeśaḥ

original: ete kṛdarthā grahaṇena pāṭhena na kāryāḥ / tato yogāḥ / yogāś ca kāryāḥ, ‘svarādinipātanam’ (A 1.1.37) ity evamādayaḥ /
analyzed: ete kṛt arthāḥ grahaṇena pāṭhena na kāryāḥ tatas yogāḥ yogāḥ ca kāryāḥ svara ādi nipātanam iti evamādayaḥ

original: [2.42] athānye ca varṇayanti / tenānye ca na kartavyā iti / atra tv avyavasthāvācitvāt śībhāvo durlabhaḥ / iyāḍiyājīkārāś ceti evam eke varṇayanti / ‘trayaḥ kṛdarthāgrahaṇena yogāḥ’---kṛdartham agrahaṇaṃ yasmin hetau sa kṛdarthāgrahaṇaḥ / yasmin hetāv āśrīyamāṇe kṛdarthāgrahaṇam ārabhyate / kaś cāsau hetuḥ ? na sarvā vibhaktir iti vigrahaḥ /
analyzed: atha anye ca varṇayanti tena anye ca na kartavyāḥ iti atra tu avyavasthā vāci tvāt śībhāvaḥ durlabhaḥ ca iti evam eke varṇayanti trayaḥ kṛt artha agrahaṇena yogāḥ kṛt artham agrahaṇam yasmin hetau sa kṛt artha agrahaṇaḥ yasmin hetau āśrīyamāṇe kṛt artha agrahaṇam ārabhyate kaḥ ca asau hetuḥ na sarvā vibhaktiḥ iti vigrahaḥ

original: taddhita iti cāgrahaṇam / tatra yathaiva ca ‘kṛnmejantaḥ’ ity etan na paṭhyate evam asmād api ye trayo yogāḥ, te 'pi na kartavyāḥ ‘svarādinipātamavyam’ (A 1.1.37), ‘ktvātosunkasunaḥ’ (A 1.1.40), ‘avyayībhāvaś ca’ (A 1.1.41) iti /
analyzed: taddhite iti ca agrahaṇam tatra yathā eva ca kṛt m e c antaḥ iti etat na paṭhyate evam asmāt api ye trayaḥ yogāḥ te na kartavyāḥ svara ādi nipātam avyam ac 1137 ktvā tosun kasunaḥ avyayībhāvaḥ ca a 1141 iti

original: [2.43] idānīm evam avasthite saṃkhyāviśeṣaṃ ye cāśritāḥ, teṣāṃ prāpnoty avyayasaṃjñā asarvavibhaktitvāt eko dvau bahava iti / ata eṣāṃ vyāvṛttyarthaṃ kuṇināpi taddhitagrahaṇaṃ kartavyam / kriyamāṇe 'pi taddhitagrahaṇe ṇamulādīnām aprāptir iti ‘kṛnmejantaḥ’ ity etad vaktavyam, svarādayaś ca na kṛto na taddhitāḥ /
analyzed: idānīm evam avasthite saṃkhyā viśeṣam ye ca āśritāḥ teṣām prāpnoti avyaya saṃjñā a sarva vibhakti tvāt ekaḥ dvau bahavaḥ iti atas eṣām vyāvṛtti artham kuṇinā api taddhita grahaṇam kartavyam kriyamāṇe taddhita grahaṇe ṇamula ādīnām aprāptiḥ iti kṛt m e c antaḥ iti etat vaktavyam svara ādayaḥ ca na kṛtaḥ na taddhitāḥ

original: idānīm āha---tasmāt svarādigrahaṇaṃ ca kāryam iti / evam api viśatyādiṣu doṣaḥ / viṃśatiśabda ekavacanāntas taddhitaś ca / apare varṇayanti / evam api varaṇādiṣu doṣo bhavati / varaṇaśabdo 'pi bahuvacanāntas taddhitaś ca / evam ubhayaśabdo 'pi kadācin na dvivacanaviṣaya ity avyayasaṃjñā prāpnoti /
analyzed: idānīm āha tasmāt svara ādi grahaṇam ca kāryam iti evam api viśati ādiṣu doṣaḥ viṃśati śabdaḥ ekavacana antaḥ taddhitaḥ ca apare varṇayanti evam api varaṇa ādiṣu doṣaḥ bhavati bahuvacana antaḥ taddhitaḥ ca evam kadācid na dvivacana viṣayaḥ iti avyaya saṃjñā prāpnoti

original: ato gaṇapāṭha eva jyāyānasyāpi vṛttikārasyety etad anena pratipādayati / kṛttaddhitānāṃ grahaṇam / gaṇapāṭha eva / kṛtaś ca taddhitāś ca gaṇa eva paṭhitavyā iti / tasmiṃś ca satīdaṃ sūcakam uktaṃ sūtrakāravṛttikārayor lakṣaṇabhāvena pravṛttam ity etad avasthitam /
analyzed: atas gaṇa pāṭhaḥ eva jyāyānasya api vṛtti kārasya iti etat anena pratipādayati kṛt taddhitānām grahaṇam gaṇa pāṭhe eva kṛtaḥ ca taddhitāḥ ca gaṇaḥ eva paṭhitavyāḥ iti tasmin ca sati idam sūcakam uktam sūtrakāra vṛtti kārayoḥ lakṣaṇa bhāvena pravṛttam iti etat avasthitam

original: [3.1] pāṭhena ca samastam avyayasaṃjñam idaṃ paṭhantv ity uktam---pāṭheneyam avyayasaṃjñā kriyata iti / seha na prāpnoti paramoccaiḥ paramanīcair iti / saṃjñāvidhau pradeśe śrutiprakaraṇasāmarthyānām abhāvāt nāsti tadantasya prāptir iity aktaparimāṇānām eva saṃjñayā bhavitavyam iti tadantavidhinā bhaviṣyati /
analyzed: pāṭhena ca samastam avyaya saṃjñam idam paṭhantu iti uktam pāṭhena iyam avyaya saṃjñā kriyate iti sā iha na prāpnoti parama uccais parama nīcais iti saṃjñā vidhau pradeśe śruti prakaraṇa sāmarthyānām abhāvāt na asti tad antasya prāptiḥ i iti akta parimāṇānām eva saṃjñayā bhavitavyam iti tad anta vidhinā bhaviṣyati

original: aupasaṃkhyānikena ca tadantavidhinā prayojanaṃ ca sarvanāmāvyayasaṃjñāyām iti /
analyzed: aupasaṃkhyānikena ca tad anta vidhinā prayojanam ca sarvanāma avyaya saṃjñāyām iti

original: [3.2] ihāpi tarhi prāpnoti [atyuccaiḥ] atyuccaisau atyccaisa iti / katham atra samāso yāvatā uccaiḥśabdo 'dhikaraṇa[śakti]pradhānaḥ, na ca tasyātikramaṇena saṃbandhaḥ / yathā ‘tatra paśyeti’ na dṛśinādhikaraṇasya saṃbandhaḥ / kasya tarhi ? tatrasthasya / athaivaṃ parikalpyate uccādhikaraṇasahacaritatvāt uccairvyapadeśa iti /
analyzed: iha api tarhi prāpnoti atyuccais atyuccaisau iti katham atra samāsaḥ yāvatā uccais śabdaḥ dhikaraṇa śakti pradhānaḥ na ca tasya atikramaṇena saṃbandhaḥ yathā tatra paśya iti na dṛśinā adhikaraṇasya saṃbandhaḥ kasya tarhi tatrasthasya atha evam parikalpyate ucca adhikaraṇa sahacarita tvāt uccais vyapadeśaḥ iti

original: evam api avyayatvaṃ durlabham / arthāpetaṃ vidhānaṃ kalpyate vinā nānā iti yathā / evam api dvitīyasyā abhāvaḥ / idaṃ coktam---atyādayaḥ krāntādyarthe dvitīyayā saha samasyanta iti / tasmād evaṃ kalpyate ‘bhavati vai kasyacit arthāt prakaraṇād vāpekṣyaṃ nirjñātam’ / yathā ‘brāhmaṇasya śuklāḥ’ iti / na ca saunāgaṃ darśanam āśrīyate /
analyzed: evam api avyaya tvam durlabham artha apetam vidhānam kalpyate vinā nānā iti yathā evam api dvitīyasyāḥ abhāvaḥ idam ca uktam ati ādayaḥ krānta ādi arthe dvitīyayā saha samasyante iti tasmāt evam kalpyate bhavati vai kasyacid arthāt prakaraṇāt vā apekṣyam nirjñātam yathā brāhmaṇasya śuklāḥ iti na ca saunāgam darśanam āśrīyate

original: kiṃ tarhi ? siddhaṃ tu ‘kvāṅsvatidurgativacanāt’, ‘prādayaḥ ktārthe’ iti /
analyzed: kim tarhi siddham tu pra ādayaḥ kta arthe iti

original: [3.3] upasarjanasya neti pratiṣedho bhaviṣyati / samudāyasyānupasarjanatvāt kathaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ syād iti / ucyate / upasarjanāvayavatvād upasarjanavyapadeśo bhaviṣyati / upasarjanāvayavasya na bhavaty avyayasaṃjñeti / sarvanāmasaṃjñāyāṃ prakṛtaḥ paṭhyate tatra pratiṣedhaḥ / tasmiṃś ca svaritaichnam āsaṅktavyam iti / sa vai tatra pratyākhyāyate ca /
analyzed: upasarjanasya na iti pratiṣedhaḥ bhaviṣyati samudāyasya an upasarjana tvāt katham pratiṣedhaḥ syāt iti ucyate upasarjana avayava tvāt upasarjana vyapadeśaḥ bhaviṣyati upasarjana avayavasya na bhavati avyaya saṃjñā iti sarvanāma saṃjñāyām prakṛtaḥ paṭhyate tatra pratiṣedhaḥ tasmin ca svarita echnam āsaṅktavyam iti sa vai tatra pratyākhyāyate ca

original: anuccāryamāṇe aśakyaḥ svaritāsaṅgo 'pekṣyo vā /
analyzed: an uccāryamāṇe aśakyaḥ upekṣyaḥ vā

original: [3.4] anvarthasaṃjñā yathā vijñāyeta / nanu cānvarthasaṃjñāyāṃ kalpyamānāyām arthe pāratantryam āpadyamānā svarūpādhiṣṭhānā na bhavatīti saṃjñātvaṃ durlabham / athārthanirapekṣā svarūpamātranibandhanā, arthopādānam alabhyam / ucyate / loke dviprakārā saṃjñā / sati ca nimitte nimittaprasaktā na tu nimittam abhidadhatī pravartate /
analyzed: anvartha saṃjñā yathā vijñāyeta nanu ca anvartha saṃjñāyām kalpyamānāyām arthe pāratantryam āpadyamānā sva rūpa adhiṣṭhānā na bhavati iti saṃjñā tvam durlabham atha artha nirapekṣā sva rūpa mātra nibandhanā artha upādānam alabhyam ucyate loke dvi prakārā saṃjñā sati ca nimitte nimitta prasaktā na tu nimittam abhidadhatī pravartate

original: yathā vāsydevasya śrīkṛṣṇa iti nāmadheyaṃ sati kṛṣṇaguṇe kṛtam, na tu kṛṣṇaśabdaḥ kṛṣṇaygaṃ pratyāyayan pravartate / kadācit gaurasyaiva kṛṣṇa iti saṃjñā kriyate / evam iyam avyayasaṃjñā nimittena anānāgamanena prayuktā anabhidadhatī anānāgamaṇaṃ pravṛtteti / asyānumānaṃ mahattvakaraṇaṃ yasyānānāgamanam asti tasyeyaṃ saṃjñeti /
analyzed: yathā vā asya devasya śrī kṛṣṇaḥ iti nāmadheyam sati kṛṣṇa guṇe kṛtam na tu kṛṣṇa śabdaḥ pratyāyayan pravartate kadācid gaurasya eva kṛṣṇaḥ iti saṃjñā kriyate evam iyam avyaya saṃjñā nimittena anānāgamanena prayuktā anabhidadhatī anānāgamaṇam pravṛttā iti asya anumānam mahat tva karaṇam yasya anānāgamanam asti tasya iyam saṃjñā iti

original: yasya tu nānāgamanam asti na tasya / atyuccaiḥśabdaś ca nānā gacchatīti anavyayatvam /
analyzed: yasya tu nānā gamanam asti na tasya ati uccais śabdaḥ ca nānā gacchati iti anavyaya tvam

original: [3.5] atha vā yathaiva prasāraṇasaṃjñāyāṃ vibhaktiviśeṣo liṅgam āvṛter evam ihāpi nibandhanavākyam etad upanyastam / etad upagrahaṃ tu viniyogavākyam āvṛtta, ity asya vā liṅgaṃ mahattvaṃ tenāvyayam ity āvarti śabdarūpam avasīyate / tantreṇa vaikakriyayā dvau śabdau uccāritāv ity asya vā mahattvaṃ liṅgam iti /
analyzed: atha vā yathā eva prasāraṇa saṃjñāyām vibhakti viśeṣaḥ liṅgam āvṛteḥ evam iha api nibandhana vākyam etat upanyastam etat upagraham tu viniyoga vākyam āvṛttaḥ iti asya vā liṅgam mahā tvam tena avyayam iti āvarti śabda rūpam avasīyate tantreṇa vā eka kriyayā dvau śabdau uccāritau iti asya vā mahā tvam liṅgam iti

original: [3.6] na vyeti ity avyayam iti / kva punar na vyeti ? śloke saptamyā nirdeśa iti ihāpi tathaiva saptamīnirdiṣṭam / strīpuṃnapuṃsakāni sattvaguṇāḥ ekatvadvitvabahutvāni / guṇānāṃ rūpādīnāṃ pravṛtter arthe ye sthityāvirbhāvatirobhāvās te luṅgatvena parigṛhyante /

original: [3.1] saṃnipātaḥ saṃśleṣaḥ samparkaḥ ānantaryam ity anarthāntaram / etallakṣaṇo yo vidhir iti tadarthaḥ / so 'nimittam / kasya ? tadvighātasya / taṃ vihantīti tadvighātaḥ, vighātakasya vidhyantarasyānimittam / vighātaṃ ca prayojaneṣv eva pradarśayiṣyāmi yasya yasya vighāto bhavati /

analyzed: yat pūrva uttara padayoḥ ānantaryam tasya tuk vighātakaḥ vartate ayam ca tuk yadi avayava bhaktaḥ na ca avayava avayavaḥ vayava grahaṇena gṛhyate tatas idam prayojanam upapadyate atha tu samudāya bhaktaḥ vayava avayavaḥ vayavaḥ vā bhavati na eva ānantaryam vihanyate iti aprayojanam idam paribhāṣāyāḥ

original: [3.3] bahiraṅgaṃ hrasvatvam antaraṅgas tuk / dvipadāśrayatvāt hrasvo bahiraṅgaḥ, ekapadāśrayatvāt antaraṅgas tug iti / atha grāmaṃ nayati kulaṃ grāmaṇi kulam iti katham, yatraittarapadikaṃ hrasvatvaṃ na bhavati ? atrāpi ‘hrasvo napuṃsake prātipadikasya’ (A 1.2.47) samudāyāśrayaṃ hrasvatvaṃ varṇāśrayas tuk ity upapadyate bahiraṅgatvam /
analyzed: bahiraṅgam hrasva tvam antaraṅgaḥ tuk dvi pada āśraya tvāt hrasvaḥ bahiraṅgaḥ eka pada āśraya tvāt antaraṅgaḥ tuk iti atha grāmam nayati kulam grāmaṇi kulam iti katham yatra aittarapadikam hrasva tvam na bhavati atra api hrasvaḥ napuṃsake prātipadikasya samudāya āśrayam hrasva tvam varṇa āśrayaḥ tuk iti upapadyate bahiraṅga tvam

original: saṃnipātaparibhāṣāyāṃ tu satyāṃ grāmaṇicchatram iti doṣaḥ / atra hi gramaṇyaḥ chatram iti hrasvatve kṛte kviblakṣaṇas tuk antaraṅgatvān nāsti, chalakṣaṇo 'pi saṃnipātalakṣaṇatvād ity atukkasya śravaṇaṃ prāpnoti grāmaṇichatram iti / bahiraṅgaparibhāṣāyāṃ tu satyāṃ chalakṣaṇaḥ samānāśrayatvāt pravartate /
analyzed: saṃnipāta paribhāṣāyām tu satyām grāmaṇi chatram iti doṣaḥ atra hi gramaṇyaḥ chatram iti hrasva tve kṛte kvip lakṣaṇaḥ tuk antaraṅga tvāt na asti saṃnipāta lakṣaṇa tvāt iti atukkasya śravaṇam prāpnoti grāmaṇi chatram iti bahiraṅga paribhāṣāyām tu satyām cha lakṣaṇaḥ samāna āśraya tvāt pravartate

original: [3.4] nalopo vṛtrahabhiḥ / vibhaktiprātipadikāśrayo nalopaḥ saṃnipātalakṣaṇaḥ ity animittaṃ tuko bhavati / atha ‘ato lopaḥ’ kvipi kasmān na bhavati ? uktam etad ‘ārdhadhātukopadeśe yadakārāntam’ iti / asiddho nalopa iti / dvividham apy asiddhatvam atropapadyate pūrvatrāsiddhatvaṃ bahiraṅgāsiddhatvaṃ ca /
analyzed: na lopaḥ vṛtrahabhiḥ vibhakti prātipadika āśrayaḥ na lopaḥ saṃnipāta lakṣaṇaḥ iti animittam tukaḥ bhavati atha atas lopaḥ kvipi kasmāt na bhavati uktam etat ārdhadhātuka upadeśe yat akāra antam iti asiddhaḥ na lopaḥ iti dvividham api asiddha tvam atra upapadyate pūrvatra asiddha tvam bahiraṅga asiddha tvam ca

original: vibhaktyāśrayatvān nalopo bahiraṅgo bhavati /
analyzed: vibhakti āśraya tvāt na lopaḥ bahis aṅgaḥ bhavati

original: [3.5] udupadhatvam akittvasya nikucite / nalopo yaḥ ‘aniditām . . . ’ (A 6.4.24) iti sa kitpratyayāśrayaḥ / tadantaraṃ cidupadhatvam upajāyamānaṃ saṃnipātinaḥ pratyayasya kittvavyapadeśaṃ nihantīty anayā paribhāṣayākittvavyapadeśasya nimittaṃ na bhavatītikalpyate / nātra saṃnipātino 'saty api kittve kaścid ānantaryasya vighātaḥ /
analyzed: u t upadhā tvam a k it tvasya nikucite na lopaḥ yaḥ iti sa kit pratyaya āśrayaḥ tad antaram cit upadhā tvam upajāyamānam saṃnipātinaḥ pratyayasya kit tva vyapadeśam nihanti iti anayā paribhāṣayā a kit tva vyapadeśasya nimittam na bhavati iti kalpyate na atra saṃnipātinaḥ sati api kit tve kaścid ānantaryasya vighātaḥ

original: [3.6] nābhāvo yañi dīrghatvasyāmunā / ne kartavye mubhāvaḥ siddhaḥ / ne tu yat prāpnoti tatpratyasiddhatvam ity arthaṃ parikalpya prayojanopanyāsaḥ / sūtrīyam ukāramātram āśritya nābhāvaḥ pravartamānaḥ saṃnipātalakṣaṇo vighātasyānimittam / kasyātra vighātaḥ yāvatā paraḥ saṃnipātī nābhāvenaiva vihataḥ ? ānantaryam asty eva / tatredaṃ kalpyate /
analyzed: na abhāvaḥ ya ñi dīrgha tvasya amunā ne kartavye mu bhāvaḥ siddhaḥ ne tu yat prāpnoti tat prati asiddha tvam iti artham parikalpya prayojana upanyāsaḥ sūtrīyam ukāra mātram āśritya na abhāvaḥ pravartamānaḥ saṃnipāta lakṣaṇaḥ vighātasya animittam kasya atra vighātaḥ yāvatā paraḥ saṃnipātī na abhāvena eva vihataḥ ānantaryam asti eva tatra idam kalpyate

original: sa ca saṃnipātī dīrghatve kriyamāṇe ākāreṇa vihanyate / tasmāt pūrvasya saṃnipātino rūpavighātasyānimittaṃ bhavati /
analyzed: sa ca saṃnipātī dīrgha tve kriyamāṇe ākāreṇa vihanyate tasmāt pūrvasya saṃnipātinaḥ rūpa vighātasya animittam bhavati

original: [3.7] na mu ṭādeśa iti / sarvavibhaktyantaḥ samāsa ity evaṃ vakṣyati / sarvavibhaktyā ca saṃbandhasāmānyāśrayād eva sthāsyate /
analyzed: na mu ṭādeśaḥ iti sarva vibhakti antaḥ samāsaḥ iti evam vakṣyati sarva vibhaktyā ca saṃbandha sāmānya āśrayāt eva sthāsyate

original: [3.8] ātvaṃ kittvasyopādāsta / luṅi sici pare bhūte guṇe kṛte uttarakālam ātma itīmāṃ prakriyām āśritya saṃnipātalakṣaṇatvam ātvasya / tadātvaṃ ghusaṃjñāpratibaddhasya kittvasyānimittam / atrāpi vyapadeśanumittaṃ kittvam iti / evaṃ ca kṛte hrsvād aṅgād iti parasya saṃnipātino rūpam apy atra vihanyate /
analyzed: ā tvam kit tvasya upādāsta luṅi sici pare bhūte guṇe kṛte uttara kālam ātmā iti imām prakriyām āśritya saṃnipāta lakṣaṇa tvam ā tvasya tadātvam ghu saṃjñā pratibaddhasya kit tvasya animittam atra api vyapadeśa anumittam kit tvam iti evam ca kṛte hrsvāt aṅgāt iti parasya saṃnipātinaḥ rūpam api atra vihanyate

original: [3.9] tisṛcatasṛtvaṃ ṅībvidheḥ / tricaturau ca vibhaktiṃ cāśrityādeśaḥ saṃnipātalakṣaṇaḥ / sa īkārasyānimittam / īkāro hi pravartamānaḥ saṃnipātinor ānantaryaṃ vihanti pūrvasya ca yaṇādeśena rūpam iti /
analyzed: tisṛ catasṛ tvam ṅīp vidheḥ tri caturau ca vibhaktim ca āśritya ādeśaḥ saṃnipāta lakṣaṇaḥ saḥ īkārasya animittam īkāraḥ hi pravartamānaḥ saṃnipātinoḥ ānantaryam vihanti pūrvasya ca ya ṇa ādeśena rūpam iti

original: [3.10] yad ayaṃ ‘na tisṛcatasṛ’ iti / idam aliṅgam / kutaḥ / upasamastārtham etat syāt priyatisṛṣṇāṃ brāhmaṇānām iti / atha tu chandasy uktaṃ, tatropanyastam / etau hi tisṛcatasṛśabdau svasrādiṣu paṭhyete iti /
analyzed: yat ayam na tisṛ catasṛ iti idam aliṅgam kutas upasamasta artham etat syāt brāhmaṇānām iti atha tu chandasi uktam tatra upanyastam etau hi tisṛ catasṛ śabdau svasṛ ādiṣu paṭhyete iti

original: [3.11] śatāni sahasrāṇi / aṅgaṃ sarvanāmasthānaṃ cāśritya num saṃnipātalakṣaṇaḥ / parasya saṃnipātino lakṣaṇasya luki kṛte rūpavighātaḥ / tataś cānantaryavighāto 'pi / atrāpy upadeśavacanam astīti, etad apy aprayojanaṃ dṛśyate ṣṇāntety antavacanāc ca /
analyzed: śatāni sahasrāṇi aṅgam sarvanāmasthānam ca āśritya num saṃnipāta lakṣaṇaḥ parasya saṃnipātinaḥ lakṣaṇasya kṛte rūpa vighātaḥ tatas ca ānantarya vighātaḥ atra api upadeśa vacanam asti iti etat api aprayojanam dṛśyate anta vacanāt ca

original: [3.12] śakaṭau paddhatau / acca gheḥ (A 7.3.111) / audārabhyate / tenaikāreṇa parasya vikṛtaṃ rūpamatvena pūrvasya, tannimittas tu ṭāp pravartamānaḥ aṅgapratyayayyor ānantaryaṃ vihanyāt / taccāśakyaṃ vihantum / ekādeśasyāntavadbhāvāt / atha tv evaṃ vihanyetakārye hy antavadbhāvaḥ, na cānantaryaṃ nāma śāstrakāryam /
analyzed: śakaṭau pad hatau a t ca gheḥ  / tad ekāreṇa parasya vikṛtam rūpam a tvena pūrvasya tad nimittaḥ tu ṭāp pravartamānaḥ aṅga pratyayayyoḥ ānantaryam vihanyāt tat ca aśakyam vihantum eka ādeśasya antavat bhāvāt atha tu evam hi antavat bhāvaḥ na ca ānantaryam nāma śāstra kāryam

original: laukikam etad iti syād vyavadhānam / ṭāpi sati yāḍāmbhāvayoḥ kṛtayoḥ śakaṭāyām ity aniṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ syāt / athāpi audac ca gher iti taparatvasya idam eva prayojanaṃ varṇayanti tan mā bhūd iti /
analyzed: laukikam etat iti syāt vyavadhānam ṭāpi sati śakaṭāyām iti aniṣṭam rūpam syāt atha api au t ca gheḥ iti ta para tvasya idam eva prayojanam varṇayanti tat mā bhūt iti

original: [3.13] iyeṣa uvoṣa / guṇe kṛte . . . ām prāpnoti / atra iyaṅi vihite prāglādeśāt dhātvadhikāra ity antaraṅgatvāt lādeśa kṛte dvirvacanāt paratvāt ‘puganta . . .’ (A 7.3.86) iti ca guṇe kṛta ekāraḥ saṃnipātalakṣaṇaḥ sa nimittamāmo na bhavati / āmi sati saṃnipātinaḥ pratyayasya rūpavirodho vighāta iti /
analyzed: iyeṣa uvoṣa guṇe kṛte ām prāpnoti atra iyaṅi vihite prāk lādeśāt dhātu adhikāraḥ iti antaraṅga tvāt lādeśa kṛte dvirvacanāt paratvāt puk anta iti ca guṇe kṛte ekāraḥ saṃnipāta lakṣaṇaḥ sa nimittam āmaḥ na bhavati āmi sati saṃnipātinaḥ pratyayasya rūpa virodhaḥ vighātaḥ iti

original: uvoṣeti katham upanyastaṃ yāvatā ‘uñavidajāgṛbhya . . . ’ (A 3.1.38) iti vibhāṣita evāmpratyayaḥ / evaṃ manyate vibhāṣā kiti kṛtārthā ūṣāṃcakratuḥ ūṣāṃcakrur iti / iha tu piti guṇe kṛte lakṣaṇāntareṇām pratyayaḥ pravarteteti / atrāpi matupo 'yam artho varṇyate nityayoge matub iti / tena nityaṃ yo gurumān tasyāyamām /
analyzed: katham upanyastam yāvatā iti vibhāṣitaḥ eva am pratyayaḥ evam manyate vibhāṣā k iti kṛtārthā ūṣāṃcakratuḥ ūṣāṃcakruḥ iti iha tu p iti guṇe kṛte lakṣaṇa antareṇa ām pratyayaḥ pravarteta iti atra api matupaḥ yam arthaḥ varṇyate nitya yoge matup iti tena nityam yaḥ gurumān tasya ayam ām

original: ayaṃ hy anitya iti idam apy aprayojanam /
analyzed: ayam hi anityaḥ iti idam api aprayojanam

original: [3.14] tasya doṣo varṇāśrayaḥ . . . / katham a[tra] vyavasthitaṃ saṃnipātalakṣaṇatvaṃ yāvatā prakṛtirevāvasthitasya pratyayasya nimittam / evaṃ manyate---svabhāvato 'vasthitasya ‘at iñ’ (A 4.1.95) ity anena pratyayatvasaṃjñā upādīyate / samudāyasya vā sādhutvaṃ tasyaiva vā parasya sataḥ sādhutvam iti / saṃjñāyā vā saṃnipātalakṣaṇāyāḥ sādhutvam /
analyzed: tasya doṣaḥ varṇa āśrayaḥ katham atra vyavasthitam saṃnipāta lakṣaṇa tvam yāvatā prakṛtiḥ eva avasthitasya pratyayasya nimittam evam manyate svabhāvataḥ iti anena pratyaya tva saṃjñā upādīyate samudāyasya vā sādhu tvam tasya eva vā parasya sataḥ sādhu tvam iti saṃjñāyāḥ vā saṃnipāta lakṣaṇāyāḥ sādhu tvam

original: [3.15] na pratyayaḥ saṃnipātalakṣaṇaḥ / asyābhiprāyaḥ / bhavati vai kiṃcid ācāryāṇāṃ kāryavat / ‘buddhau kṛtve’ti prakṛtito 'jāta eva pratyaya upalabhyate / ayaṃ ca pakṣaḥ ‘paraś ca’ (A 3.1.2) iti sūtre varṇitaḥ / ‘etad eva tat parasya kāryaṃ yad asau paraḥ syād’ iti / kiṃ ca na sādhutvaṃ saṃjñā vā varṇavicālasya nimittaṃ syāt /
analyzed: na pratyayaḥ saṃnipāta lakṣaṇaḥ asya abhiprāyaḥ bhavati vai kiṃcid ācāryāṇām kārya vat buddhau kṛtvā iti prakṛtitaḥ jātaḥ eva pratyayaḥ upalabhyate ayam ca pakṣaḥ paraḥ ca iti sūtre varṇitaḥ etat eva tat parasya kāryam yat asau paraḥ syāt iti kim ca na sādhu tvam saṃjñā vā varṇa vicālasya nimittam syāt

original: saṃjñā pāraṃparyeṇaiva nimittam / na caivaṃ bhūtaṃ nimittaṃ bhavatīty etad ācaṣṭe na pratyayaḥ saṃnipātalakṣaṇa iti /
analyzed: saṃjñā pāraṃparyeṇa eva nimittam na ca evam bhūtam nimittam bhavati iti etat ācaṣṭe na pratyayaḥ saṃnipāta lakṣaṇaḥ iti

original: [3.16] aṅgasaṃjñā tarhi [a]nimittaṃ syāt / aṅgasaṃjñā hi prakṛtipratyayasaṃnipātalakṣaṇā / sā varṇavicālasyānimittaṃ syāt / sāṃnipātī hi rūpeṇa kriyate iti / etasmin idam asamarthitam avarṇāśrayaḥ pratyayo 'varṇavicālasyeti / aviśeṣeṇāṅgasaṃjñāyāḥ saṃnipātalakṣaṇatvāt sarvāṇy evāṅgāni kāryāṇi paryavasannāni bhavanti /
analyzed: aṅga saṃjñā tarhi animittam syāt aṅga saṃjñā hi prakṛti pratyaya saṃnipāta lakṣaṇā sā varṇa vicālasya animittam syāt sāṃnipātī hi rūpeṇa kriyate iti etasmin idam asamarthitam avarṇa āśrayaḥ pratyayaḥ varṇa vicālasya iti aviśeṣeṇa aṅga saṃjñāyāḥ saṃnipāta lakṣaṇa tvāt sarvāṇi eva aṅgāni kāryāṇi paryavasannāni bhavanti

original: [3.17] kecid idam udāharaṇam upanyasyanti / adhukṣat, alikṣat iti / ayaṃ hi ksaḥ śalantāṃ prakṛtim aniṭaṃ ccliṃ cāśritya pravartamānaḥ saṃnipātalakṣaṇo bhavati / ayam animittaṃ ghatvaḍhatvakutvānām / na cātrāsiddhatvam asti / adeśatvād asyāḥ paribhāṣāyāḥ / vidhideśā ceyam iti pūrveti aśakyā vyapadeṣṭum /
analyzed: kecid idam udāharaṇam upanyasyanti adhukṣat alikṣat iti ayam hi ksaḥ śa lantām prakṛtim an iṭam c c lim ca āśritya pravartamānaḥ saṃnipāta lakṣaṇaḥ bhavati ayam animittam gha tva ḍha tva ku tvānām na ca atra asiddha tvam asti adeśa tvāt asyāḥ paribhāṣāyāḥ vidhi deśā ca iyam iti pūrvā iti aśakyā vyapadeṣṭum

original: bhāṣyakāreṇa tv avarṇāśrayaḥ pratyaya itīmam eva vākyapāṭham āśritya dākṣir ity upanyastam /
analyzed: bhāṣyakāreṇa tu a varṇa āśrayaḥ pratyayaḥ iti imam eva vākya pāṭham āśritya dākṣiḥ iti upanyastam

original: [3.18] āttvaṃ pugvidheḥ / krāpayati / ṇau parabhūte vṛddhau kṛtāyām āttvam ity asyāṃ prakriyāyām āttvaṃ saṃnipātalakṣaṇaṃ, tat puko nimittam / ānantaryaṃ hi puk saṃnipātinor nihanti / aṅgasya ya ākāras tasya pug iti avayavabhaktaṃ pukaṃ matvā doṣa uktaḥ /
analyzed: ā t tvam puk vidheḥ krāpayati ṇau para bhūte vṛddhau kṛtāyām ā t tvam iti asyām prakriyāyām ā t tvam saṃnipāta lakṣaṇam tat pukaḥ nimittam ānantaryam hi puk saṃnipātinoḥ nihanti aṅgasya yaḥ ākāraḥ tasya puk iti avayava bhaktam pukam matvā doṣaḥ uktaḥ

original: [3.19] adīdapad iti / pukā cānantaryaṃ vihatam / pūrvasya tu saṃnipātino vighāta iti animittaṃ syāt /
analyzed: adīdapat iti ca ānantaryam vihatam pūrvasya tu saṃnipātinaḥ vighātaḥ iti animittam syāt

original: [3.20] tyadādyakāraṣṭābvidheḥ / atvam aṅgavibhaktyoḥ saṃnipātakṛtaṃ ṭāpo 'nittaṃ syāt / ṭāpi hi sati parasya saṃnipātino 'bhāva iti /
analyzed: tyad ādi akāra ṭāp vidheḥ a tvam aṅga vibhaktyoḥ saṃnipāta kṛtam syāt ṭāpi hi sati parasya saṃnipātinaḥ bhāvaḥ iti

original: [3.21] papivān ity atra pūrvasya saṃnipātino nivṛtter animittam iṭ syāt /
analyzed: papivān iti atra pūrvasya saṃnipātinaḥ nivṛtteḥ animittam iṭ syāt

original: [3.22] agnimān ity atra udāttapūrvaṃ matupaṃ cāśritya matupa udāttatvaṃ saṃnipātalakṣaṇam / tat pūrvasya ‘anudāttaṃ padam eka[varjam]’ (A 6.1.158) iti nighāte kartavye na nimittaṃ syāt / anudāttatve sati pūrvasya saṃnipātinaḥ śrutir nihanyata iti /
analyzed: agnimān iti atra udātta pūrvam matupam ca āśritya matupaḥ udātta tvam saṃnipāta lakṣaṇam tat pūrvasya anudāttam padam eka varjam a 61158 iti nighāte kartavye na nimittam syāt anudātta tve sati pūrvasya saṃnipātinaḥ śrutiḥ nihanyate iti

original: [3.23] brāhmaṇi brahmabandhu / atra hi hrasvatvam ‘ambārthanadyor hrasvaḥ’ (A 7.3.107) iti saṃbuddhau vidhīyamānaṃ saṃnipātalakṣaṇaṃ parasya saṃnipātino vināśe na nimittaṃ syād iti / mā bhūd evaṃ ṅyantād ity evaṃ bhaviṣyati---‘halṅyāp’ (A 6.1.68) iti dīrghagrahaṇe asati sthānivadbhāvo nāsti pratiṣedhāt / evaṃ hy uktaṃ ‘ṅyābgrahaṇe dirgha’ iti /
analyzed: brāhmaṇi brahmabandhu atra hi hrasva tvam ambā artha nadyoḥ hrasvaḥ iti saṃbuddhau vidhīyamānam saṃnipāta lakṣaṇam parasya saṃnipātinaḥ vināśe na nimittam syāt iti mā bhūt evam ṅī antāt iti evam bhaviṣyati ha l ṅyāp A 6168 iti dīrgha grahaṇe asati sthānivat bhāvaḥ na asti pratiṣedhāt evam hi uktam ṅī āp grahaṇe dirghaḥ iti

original: [3.26] tasmān nārtho 'nayā paribhāṣayā / ko 'bhiprāyaḥ ? yadi doṣāḥ bhūyāṃsaḥ alpāni prayojanāni / tāny evopasaṃkhyātavyāni / na kartavyā paribhāṣā yasya doṣā anujñāyante iti / na hi doṣāḥ santīti paribhāṣā na kartavyā /
analyzed: tasmāt na arthaḥ nayā paribhāṣayā kaḥ bhiprāyaḥ yadi doṣāḥ bhūyāṃsaḥ alpāni prayojanāni tāni eva upasaṃkhyātavyāni na kartavyā paribhāṣā yasya doṣāḥ anujñāyante iti na hi doṣāḥ santi iti paribhāṣā na kartavyā

original: etat pratipādayati---sarvā vāk sāparādhā doṣānuṣaṅgiṇī yathā sthānivadādeśa ity asminn alvidhir api prasakta iti kiṃ na kartavyā ? doṣeṣu tu pratividadhāti / yac ca manyase doṣā bhūyāṃsa iti tac ca na / kutaḥ ? yasmāt doṣāḥ khalv api sākalyena parigaṇitāḥ / prayojanānām udāharaṇamātram /
analyzed: etat pratipādayati sarvā vāc sa aparādhā doṣa anuṣaṅgiṇī yathā sthāni vat ādeśaḥ iti asmin a l vidhiḥ api prasaktaḥ iti kim na kartavyā doṣeṣu tu pratividadhāti yat ca manyase doṣāḥ bhūyāṃsaḥ iti tat ca na kutas yasmāt doṣāḥ khalu api sākalyena parigaṇitāḥ prayojanānām udāharaṇa mātram

original: katham ? iha sārvadhātukārthdhadhātukayor guṇe bhavatīti, akṅitīti viśeṣe 'syābhāvāt etad varjam anyasmin viśeṣe nāsau pravartata ity adhyavasīyate / evam iha ye doṣā upāttās tān varjayitvāny atredaṃ pravṛttaṃ prayojanopasaṃgrāhi sāmānyaviṣayaṃ śāstram itīdam ucyate---tasmād yāny etasyā iti /
analyzed: katham iha sārvadhātuka ārthdhadhātukayoḥ guṇe bhavati iti ak ṅ iti iti viśeṣe etat varjam anyasmin viśeṣe na asau pravartate iti adhyavasīyate evam iha ye doṣāḥ upāttāḥ tān atra idam pravṛttam prayojana upasaṃgrāhi sāmānya viṣayam śāstram iti idam ucyate tasmāt yāni etasyāḥ iti

original: [3.27] sarvāṇy eva tu bhāṣye uktāni prayojanāni / na doṣaḥ sākalyena parigaṇitāḥ / doṣāntarasya bhāvāt / iha ‘ṅer yaḥ’ iti yatvaṃ saṃnipātalakṣaṇaṃ tat dīrghasyānimittaṃ prāpnoti / saṃnipātino rūpāntarapratipatteḥ / yathā amunā iti /
analyzed: sarvāṇi eva tu bhāṣye uktāni prayojanāni na doṣaḥ sākalyena parigaṇitāḥ doṣa antarasya bhāvāt iha ṅeḥ yaḥ iti ya tvam saṃnipāta lakṣaṇam tat dīrghasya animittam prāpnoti saṃnipātinaḥ rūpa antara pratipatteḥ yathā amunā iti

original: [3.28] pratividheyaṃ doṣeṣv iti / na ca pratividhānam uktam / tatraivaṃ pratividhīyate / aṅgasaṃjñā ced animittaṃ syāt, anavakāśā eva aṅgavidhayaḥ saṃpadyante / tataś cāṅgasaṃjñāyā apyānarthakyam / krāpayatīty ākārāntasya vidhānāt arthavato hy āgamas tadguṇībhūto gṛhyata iti śāstre yad ānantaryaṃ na hi tad vihanyate /
analyzed: pratividheyam doṣeṣu iti na ca pratividhānam uktam tatra evam pratividhīyate aṅga saṃjñā ced animittam syāt anavakāśāḥ eva aṅga vidhayaḥ saṃpadyante tatas ca aṅga saṃjñāyāḥ api ānarthakyam krāpayati iti ākāra antasya vidhānāt arthavataḥ hi āgamaḥ tad guṇībhūtaḥ gṛhyate iti śāstre yat ānantaryam na hi tat vihanyate

original: adīdapad iti liṅgāt hrasvatvaṃ yad ayaṃ ‘māraṇatoṣaṇaniśāmaneṣu jñā’ jānāter mitvaṃ śāsti / atra upadhādhikārāt nākṛte puki hrasvatvam astīti nirdeśād avasīyate ‘āpjñapyṛdhāmīt’ (A 7.4.55) iti / yā sā ‘na yāsayoḥ’ (A 7.3.45) iti nirdeśāt / anyeṣu tv ākāralopādiṣu cintyaṃ pratividhānam /
analyzed: adīdapat iti liṅgāt hrasva tvam yat ayam māraṇa toṣaṇa niśāmaneṣu jñā jānāteḥ m i tvam śāsti atra upadhā adhikārāt na akṛte puki hrasva tvam asti iti nirdeśāt avasīyate iti yā sā na iti nirdeśāt anyeṣu tu ākāra lopa ādiṣu cintyam pratividhānam

original: [1.1] yadi sūtram atha vā pāṭhaḥ ‘kṛnmakārasaṃdhyakṣarānto 'vyayībhāvaś ca’ iti athāpy anavyayam avyayaṃ bhavatīti avyayībhāva iti tadvat atideśo 'thāsarvavibhaktir athāliṅgasaṃkhya iti vā / sarvathaiva tu lugmukhasvaropacārāḥ prayojanam (vā. 1) iti /
analyzed: yadi sūtram atha vā pāṭhaḥ kṛt makāra saṃdhi akṣara antaḥ vyayībhāvaḥ ca iti atha api anavyayam avyayam bhavati iti avyayībhāvaḥ iti tadvat atideśaḥ a sarva vibhaktiḥ atha a liṅga saṃkhyaḥ iti vā sarvathā eva tu luk mukha svara upacārāḥ prayojanam vā iti

original: [1.2] upāgni pratyagni iti kriyāviśeṣane vibhaktyarthe 'sattvavacanatve ca sāmānyasyopādānāt aliṅgasaṃkhyatvam asty eveti / ‘pañcan’śabdasya sattvavacanatve 'pi liṅgaviśeṣopādānasāmarthyaṃ nāsti / dāsyāḥ putrādiṣu tu naiva saṃkhyārthaṃ vibhakter upādānam, kiṃ tūpādhir ākrośasya / varṣāsujaḥ foṣucara iti saṃjñāyāḥ abhivyaktyartham /
analyzed: upāgni pratyagni iti kriyā viśeṣane vibhakti arthe sattva vacana tve ca sāmānyasya upādānāt aliṅga saṃkhya tvam asti eva iti pañcan śabdasya sattva vacana tve liṅga viśeṣa upādāna sāmarthyam na asti dāsyāḥ putra ādiṣu tu na eva saṃkhyā artham vibhakteḥ upādānam kim tu upādhiḥ ākrośasya iti saṃjñāyāḥ abhivyakti artham

original: iha tu sulug iti saṃskāramātraṃ vibhaktyā kriyate, na aṃkhyāviśeṣagatir iti /
analyzed: iha tu su luk iti saṃskāra mātram vibhaktyā kriyate na aṃkhyā viśeṣa gatiḥ iti

original: [1.3] upāgnimukha iti mukhasvaraḥ syāt / upapayaskāra iti ca satvaṃ syāt / evaṃ vaktavyam---svaropacāranivṛttiḥ prayojanam iti / naiṣa doṣaḥ / yathā mukhasvara upacāraś ca / yathotsargaḥ sāpavādo vyavasthito bhavati tathaiva tatprayojanam ity etad ācaṣṭe /
analyzed: upa agni mukhe iti mukha svaraḥ syāt upa payaskāre iti ca sattvam syāt evam vaktavyam svara upacāra nivṛttiḥ prayojanam iti na eṣa doṣaḥ yathā mukha svaraḥ upacāraḥ ca yathā utsargaḥ sa apavādaḥ vyavasthitaḥ bhavati tathā eva tad prayojanam iti etat ācaṣṭe

original: [1.4] kiṃ punar idaṃ parigaṇanam āhosvid udāharaṇamātram / nanu codāharaṇamātre vākyopanyāsa eva na prayujyate, sarvaprayojanānām iṣṭatvāt / eṣo 'bhiprāyaḥ praśne / yady udāharaṇamātram, vākyam anarthakam eva / pariṅaṇane sūtrānarthakyam / śakyante hi liṅgād apy etāni pratipattam iti /
analyzed: kim punar idam parigaṇanam āhosvit udāharaṇa mātram nanu ca udāharaṇa mātre vākya upanyāsaḥ eva na prayujyate sarva prayojanānām iṣṭa tvāt eṣaḥ bhiprāyaḥ praśne yadi udāharaṇa mātram vākyam anarthakam eva pariṅaṇane sūtra ānarthakyam śakyante hi liṅgāt api etāni pratipattam iti

original: [1.5] parigaṇanam ity āha / apy evācāryaṃ nirdiśann itiśabdo lolaṃ vā / api khalv apy āhur iti / evaṃ khalv apy āhur ity arthaḥ / parigaṇanam evānena samarthayante / yasmād anyo 'pi pratiṣidhyate, tasmād etāny eva prayojanāni / atha vā svarūpeṇa kenacid eva prayojanānyanvākhyātāni / anye punar aniṣṭāni vyāvartayanti /
analyzed: parigaṇanam iti āha api eva ācāryam nirdiśan iti śabdaḥ lolam vā api khalu api āhuḥ iti evam khalu api āhuḥ iti arthaḥ parigaṇanam eva anena samarthayante yasmāt pratiṣidhyate tasmāt etāni eva prayojanāni atha vā sva rūpeṇa kenacid eva prayojanāni anvākhyātāni anye punar aniṣṭāni vyāvartayanti

original: teṣāṃ yāny avyāvartitāni prayojanāni ity etat bhāṣyakāro vyācaṣṭe /
analyzed: teṣām yāni a vyāvartitāni prayojanāni iti etat bhāṣyakāraḥ vyācaṣṭe

original: [1.6] uccair adhīyāneti / āmantritakārakatvāt parāṅgavadbhāvaḥ prasaktaḥ / so 'vyayānāṃ neti pratiṣidhyate / tena nānāpadasvara eva bhavati / sa ihāpi syāt---upāgnyadhīyāna iti / agneḥ samīpe 'dhyayanādhikaraṇe upāgniśabdo vartate ity āmantritakārakatvād avyayapratiṣedho neṣyate / parāṅgavadbhāvād aikasvaryam eva bhavati / akacyavyayagrahaṇāt /
analyzed: uccais adhīyāna iti āmantrita kāraka tvāt para aṅga vat bhāvaḥ prasaktaḥ saḥ vyayānām na iti pratiṣidhyate tena nānā pada svaraḥ eva bhavati saḥ iha api syāt upāgni adhīyānaḥ iti agneḥ samīpe dhī ayana adhikaraṇe upāgni śabdaḥ vartate iti āmantrita kāraka tvāt avyaya pratiṣedhaḥ na iṣyate para aṅga vat bhāvāt aikasvaryam eva bhavati akaci avyaya grahaṇāt

original: yathaivāvyayasya prakarṣāḍayaḥ kriyādvārakāḥ, evam ihāpīty asty akacā saṃbandha ity upāgnakīty aniṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ prasajyeta / upakumbhībhūtaṃ kumbhasamīpasthībhūtam ity arthaḥ /
analyzed: yathā eva avyayasya kriyā dvārakāḥ evam iha api iti asti a kacā saṃbandhaḥ iti upāgnakī iti aniṣṭam rūpam prasajyeta upakumbhībhūtam kumbha samīpa sthībhūtam iti arthaḥ

original: [1.7] ācāryapravṛttir jñāpayatīti / atra codyate---yady asmāl liṅgāt nivṛttir yogasya ca kriyate, tarhi idam api nārabdhavyaṃ ‘sārvadhātukārthadhātukayoḥ’ (A 7.3.84) iti / kṅiti pratiṣedhād asti vidhir iti śakyaṃ pratipattum / tatraiṣo 'bhiprāyaḥ /
analyzed: ācārya pravṛttiḥ jñāpayati iti atra codyate yadi asmāt liṅgāt nivṛttiḥ yogasya ca kriyate tarhi idam api na ārabdhavyam sārvadhātuka ārthadhātukayoḥ iti k ṅ iti pratiṣedhāt asti vidhiḥ iti śakyam pratipattum tatra eṣaḥ bhiprāyaḥ

original: kriyamāṇe 'py asmin yoge viśiṣṭāny eva prayojanāni smartavyāni lugādīni, na tu parāṅgavadbhāvapratiṣedhādīti / evaṃ cet liṅgād eva tāni sādhayituṃ śakyāni / kiṃ sūtreṇeti /
analyzed: kriyamāṇe pi asmin yoge viśiṣṭāni eva prayojanāni smartavyāni luk ādīni na tu para aṅga vat bhāva pratiṣedha ādi iti evam ced liṅgāt eva tāni sādhayitum śakyāni kim sūtreṇa iti

original: [1.8] anuttarapadasthasyeti vartate / avaśyaṃ cātrānuvṛttir abhyupagantavyā / paramapayaḥkumbho gopayaḥkumbha ity evam artham / tasmād uttarapadasthatvād iha na bhaviṣyati upapayaḥkāra iti /
analyzed: anuttara pada sthasya iti vartate avaśyam ca atra anuvṛttiḥ abhyupagantavyā parama payaḥ kumbhaḥ go payaḥ kumbhaḥ iti evam artham tasmāt uttara pada stha tvāt iha na bhaviṣyati upapayaḥkāraḥ iti

original: [1.9] naikaṃ prayojanaṃ yogārambhaṃ prayojayati---saṃhñāyogaṃ paribhāṣāyogaṃ vā / anyat tu prayojayati ‘jāgurūkaḥ’ (A 3.2.165), ‘aṇ kuṭilikāyāḥ’ (A 4.4.18) iti /
analyzed: na ekam prayojanam yoga ārambham prayojayati saṃhñā yogam paribhāṣā yogam vā anyat tu prayojayati jāgurūkaḥ aṇ kuṭilikāyāḥ iti

original: [1.10] yady etāvat prayojanaṃ syāt / ayam abhiprāyaḥ / sūtre sāmānyenoccāryamāṇe viśeṣakāryasyānumānāt pratipattiḥ / kārye evaṃ tūccāryamāṇe sākṣāt pratipattiḥ / tatra sākṣāt pratipatter anumānapratipattir garīyasīti svaraprakaraṇa eva paṭhitavyaṃ ‘nāvyayībhāvāvyayadikśabdagomahat’ iti / na caivaṃ paṭhitam /
analyzed: yadi etāvat prayojanam syāt ayam abhiprāyaḥ sūtre sāmānyena uccāryamāṇe viśeṣa kāryasya anumānāt pratipattiḥ kārye evam tu uccāryamāṇe sākṣāt pratipattiḥ tatra sākṣāt pratipatteḥ anumāna pratipattiḥ garīyasī iti svara prakaraṇe eva paṭhitavyam na avyayībhāva avyaya diś śabda go mahat iti na ca evam paṭhitam

original: tasmād idam api na prayojanam iti sarvavyākhyānakārair idam avasitaṃ mukhasvareṇaiva bhavitavyam upāgnimukha iti /
analyzed: tasmāt idam api na prayojanam iti sarva vyākhyāna kāraiḥ idam avasitam mukha svareṇa eva bhavitavyam upāgni mukhe iti

original: [1.11] anye varṇayanti / idam ekaṃ prayojanaṃ mukhasvarapratiṣedho, na cāsya grahaṇaṃ tatrāsti / ‘naikaṃ prayojanaṃ yogārambhaṃ prayojayati’ iti yad uktam anavyayam avyayam adhyavasitaṃ saṃbhavatīti tenedaṃ sādhyate / tasmin pratiṣedhe tenāvyayadikśabdenāvyayībhāvasyāvyayakāryātideśa iti /
analyzed: anye varṇayanti idam ekam prayojanam mukha svara pratiṣedhaḥ na ca asya grahaṇam tatra asti na ekam prayojanam yoga ārambham prayojayati iti yat uktam anavyayam avyayam adhyavasitam saṃbhavati iti tena idam sādhyate tasmin pratiṣedhe tena avyaya diś śabdena avyayībhāvasya avyaya kārya atideśaḥ iti

original: [1.12] atha varṇyate bhāṣye---tatraivāyaṃ brūyāt / na coktam / idaṃ ca sūtram asti / tasmād anyad api prayojanam ihāgamayitavyam / kiṃ punas tat ? ṣaṣṭhīsamāsasya pratiṣedho devadattasyopakumbham iti ‘. . . suhitārthasadavyayam . . . ’ (A 2.2.11) iti /
analyzed: atha varṇyate bhāṣye tatra eva ayam brūyāt na ca uktam idam ca sūtram asti tasmāt anyat api prayojanam iha āgamayitavyam kim punar tat ṣaṣṭhī samāsasya pratiṣedhaḥ devadattasya upa kumbham iti su hita artha sat avyayam iti

original: [1.1] śi sarvanāmasthānaṃ suḍanapuṃsakasyeti cet jasi śipratiṣedhaḥ / yady evaṃ paṭhyeta / atha tv evaṃ paṭhyate---śtrīpuṃsayoḥ suḍ iti / naiṣa doṣaḥ syāt / asmin hi nirdeśe 'napuṃsakasyeti śakyam arthaḥ kalpayituṃ napuṃsakasyeti na bhavatīti /
analyzed: śi sarvanāmasthānam suṭ a napuṃsakasya iti ced jasi śi pratiṣedhaḥ yadi evam paṭhyeta atha tu evam paṭhyate śtrīpuṃsayoḥ suṭ iti na eṣa doṣaḥ syāt asmin hi nirdeśe napuṃsakasya iti śakyam arthaḥ kalpayitum napuṃsakasya iti na bhavati iti

original: [1.2] atha ‘śi sarvanāmasthānam’ iti kimartham asyopādānam ? ucyate / viṣaya pradarśanārtham / evaṃ hi vijñāyamāne śisarvanāmasthānam iti yā prāptiḥ sā na prāpnoti / apara evaṃ varṇayanti / yadi yathā ‘śisarvanāmasthānam’ iti svatantraṃ lakṣaṇaṃ saṃjñāyām evaṃ vākyabhedena suṭ sarvanāmasthānaṃ tato 'napuṃsakasyeti pratiṣedhavākye ayaṃ doṣaḥ /
analyzed: atha śi sarvanāmasthānam iti kimartham asya upādānam ucyate viṣaya pradarśana artham evam hi vijñāyamāne śi sarvanāmasthānam iti yā prāptiḥ sā na prāpnoti apare evam varṇayanti yadi yathā śi sarvanāmasthānam iti svatantram lakṣaṇam saṃjñāyām evam vākya bhedena suṭ sarvanāmasthānam tatas napuṃsakasya iti pratiṣedha vākye ayam doṣaḥ

original: [1.3] jasi śipratiṣedha ity adhikaraṇe viṣayabhāvenopātte jasviṣayo yaḥ śiḥ, atha vā jaseḥ śiḥ jasiśir iti / śilakṣaṇasyāvakāśaḥ śasviṣayaḥ śiḥ kuṇḍāni paśyeti /

original: [1.4] asamarthasamāsaś cāyaṃ draṣṭavyaḥ / yatra vartipadasyā kriyābhidhīyamānā nityatvāc cāvagatārthāśrūyamāṇānumīyamānā svabhāvanivṛttā nañā dyotyate, tatra sākṣāt saṃbandhāt samarthasamāsaḥ / iha tu napuṃsakaśabdasya naño 'saṃbandhāt sarvanāmasthānasaṃjñākartṛkena bhavati nāsaṃbandhād idam ucyate ‘asamarthasamāsaś cāyaṃ draṣṭavyaḥ’ iti /

original: [1.5] asamarthasamāse ca saty ayaṃ doṣaḥ / kutaḥ ? pratiṣedhāt / yady api prasajyapratiṣedhe paryudāse cobhayatrāprāpty anumānam, ayaṃ tu viśeṣaḥ---prasajyapratiṣedhe vicchedoṣakramā pravṛttiḥ, paryudāse tu viśeṣṭam eva pratipadyamāno vicchedopakramaṃ pratipadyate /
analyzed: asamartha samāse ca sati ayam doṣaḥ kutas pratiṣedhāt yadi api prasajya pratiṣedhe paryudāse ca ubhayatra aprāptī anumānam ayam tu viśeṣaḥ prasajya pratiṣedhe viccheda ūṣa kramā pravṛttiḥ paryudāse tu viśeṣṭam eva pratipadyamānaḥ viccheda upakramam pratipadyate

original: [1.6] asmiṃś ca nirdeśe śakyam upakalpayitum / tatreṣṭārthatvād evaṃ kalpayiṣyāmaḥ---paryudāso 'yam iti / sati paryudāse 'napuṃsakam anyopalakṣaṇārtham upādīyate / dviprakārā hi pravṛttiḥ svalakṣaṇena paralakṣaṇābhāvena [ca] / yathā kṣatriyaviṭsūdrān bhojyeti vyapadeśaḥ, atha vābrāhmāṇān bhojayeti /
analyzed: asmin ca nirdeśe śakyam upakalpayitum tatra iṣṭārtha tvāt evam kalpayiṣyāmaḥ paryudāsaḥ yam iti sati paryudāse napuṃsakam anya upalakṣaṇa artham upādīyate dvi prakārā hi pravṛttiḥ sva lakṣaṇena para lakṣaṇa abhāvena ca yathā kṣatriya viś sūdrān bhojya iti vyapadeśaḥ atha vā abrāhmāṇān bhojaya iti

original: yadi cādyam eva vidhānam idaṃ nānyatpratipādakaṃ kiṃcid asti brāhmaṇasyaikānteneti, na brāhmaṇo bhojyate / yatra ca niyamas tatrāpy apravṛttiḥ /
analyzed: yadi ca ādyam eva vidhānam idam na anyat pratipādakam kiṃcid asti brāhmaṇasya ekāntena iti na brāhmaṇaḥ bhojyate yatra ca niyamaḥ tatra api apravṛttiḥ

original: iha ca napuṃsakābhāvena strīpuṃsāv upalakṣyamāṇāv iti upalakṣaṇasya prādhānyāt pratiṣedho vidhir vā tatsamavāyīti napuṃsakaṃ na spṛśati, kiṃ tu tad upalakṣitau strīpuṃsau ity etad ācaṣṭe napuṃsake na vyāpāra iti /
analyzed: iha ca napuṃsaka abhāvena strī puṃsau upalakṣyamāṇau iti upalakṣaṇasya prādhānyāt pratiṣedhaḥ vidhiḥ vā tad samavāyi iti napuṃsakam na spṛśati kim tu tat upalakṣitau strī puṃsau iti etat ācaṣṭe napuṃsake na vyāpāraḥ iti
