original: [1.7] aprāpter vā / saty asamarthasamāsadarśane pratiṣedhasyāprāptiḥ / kutaḥ ? anantarasya vidhir vā . . . pratiṣedho veti / ānantaryaṃ cehārthakṛta śrutikṛtaṃ ca / katham ? napuṃsakasya neti pṛthakpratiṣedhe āśrīyamāṇe ‘śi sarvanāmasthānam’ aśakyam idaṃ pratiṣeddhum / kutaḥ ? ārambhasāmarthyāt / napuṃsakaviṣaya eva hi śiḥ /
analyzed: aprāpteḥ vā sati asamartha samāsa darśane pratiṣedhasya aprāptiḥ kutas anantarasya vidhiḥ vā pratiṣedhaḥ vā iti ānantaryam ca iha artha kṛta śruti kṛtam ca katham napuṃsakasya na iti pṛthak pratiṣedhe āśrīyamāṇe śi sarvanāmasthānam aśakyam idam pratiṣeddhum kutas ārambha sāmarthyāt napuṃsaka viṣayaḥ eva hi śiḥ

original: ato 'rthādiyamanantarā prāptiḥ suḍ iti iyaṃ pravṛttirūpeṇāśritā / aśakyāsty eva pratibaddhum, suṭo yā kācit prāptiḥ suḍ iti vā śir iti veti / kiṃ tarhi ? suḍ ity evaṃ prāptiḥ sā napuṃsakasya neti idam ucyate pūrvā prāptir apratiṣiddhā tayā bhaviṣyati /
analyzed: atas rthāt iyam anantarā prāptiḥ suṭ iti iyam pravṛtti rūpeṇa āśritā aśakyā asti eva pratibaddhum suṭaḥ yā kācid prāptiḥ suṭ iti vā śiḥ iti vā iti kim tarhi suṭ iti evam prāptiḥ sā napuṃsakasya na iti idam ucyate pūrvā prāptiḥ apratiṣiddhā tayā bhaviṣyati

original: [1.8] nanu ceyaṃ prāptiḥ pūrvāṃ prāptiṃ bādhata iti / vipratiṣedhenety abhiprāyaḥ / kayoḥ punar atra vipratiṣedhaḥ ? samāveśaḥ saṃjñānām iṣyate 'taḥ sa tayor nāsti vipratiṣedhaḥ / lakṣaṇayor api na saṃbhavaty ekakāryatvāt / ekaṃ kāryaṃ saṃjñā / ucyate / pratiṣedhāviśiṣṭatadviśiṣṭayor eva vipratiṣedho lakṣaṇayor vā / pratiṣedhāc cāsti virodhaḥ /
analyzed: nanu ca iyam prāptiḥ pūrvām prāptim bādhate iti vipratiṣedhena iti abhiprāyaḥ kayoḥ punar atra vipratiṣedhaḥ samāveśaḥ saṃjñānām iṣyate sa tayoḥ na asti vipratiṣedhaḥ lakṣaṇayoḥ api na saṃbhavati eka kārya tvāt ekam kāryam saṃjñā ucyate pratiṣedha aviśiṣṭa tad viśiṣṭayoḥ eva vipratiṣedhaḥ lakṣaṇayoḥ vā pratiṣedhāt ca asti virodhaḥ

original: yāś ca svabhinnaphalā viruddhas tāsāṃ samāveśa iti / tatra śir ity asyāvakāśaḥ kuṇḍāni paśyeti / suḍ ity asyāvakāśaḥ rājānau rājāna iti / ihobhayaṃ prāpnoti kuṇḍāni tiṣṭhanti iti / paratvāt suḍ ity anayā bhavitavyam / paratvaṃ pūrvasyā anuvṛtter anumānam / parasyā api pratiṣedho 'numānam aprāpteḥ /
analyzed: yāḥ ca sva bhinna phalāḥ viruddhaḥ tāsām samāveśaḥ iti tatra śiḥ iti asya avakāśaḥ kuṇḍāni paśya iti suṭ iti asya avakāśaḥ rājānau rājānaḥ iti iha ubhayam prāpnoti kuṇḍāni tiṣṭhanti iti paratvāt suṭ iti anayā bhavitavyam paratvam pūrvasyāḥ anuvṛtteḥ anumānam parasyāḥ api pratiṣedhaḥ numānam aprāpteḥ

original: na ca devadattasya hantari hate devadattasyāsti prādurbhāvaḥ / notsahate pratiṣiddhā satī bādhitum /
analyzed: na ca devadattasya hantari hate devadattasya asti prādurbhāvaḥ na utsahate pratiṣiddhā satī bādhitum

original: [1] navetibibhāṣāyām arthasaṃjñākaraṇam / ubhayathāpy anupapannam etat / arthābhāvād asattvabhūtatvāc cārthasya saṃjñāsaṃbandhānupapattiḥ / naśabdavāśabdau bhinnau upādīyete, athāpy ekau navāśabdau yathā nakir mākir iti, sarvathā padāntaropādānasya pratiṣedhyasya vikalpyasya vā nivṛttiḥ vikalpo vāvadyotyate /
analyzed: artha saṃjñā karaṇam ubhayathā api anupapannam etat artha abhāvāt asattva bhūta tvāt ca arthasya saṃjñā saṃbandha anupapattiḥ naśabda vāśabdau bhinnau upādīyete atha api ekau na vāśabdau yathā nakir mākir iti sarvathā pada antara upādānasya pratiṣedhyasya vikalpyasya vā nivṛttiḥ vikalpaḥ vā avadyotyate

original: iha ca ‘na veti vibhāṣe’ti pratiṣedhyavikalpyavācinoḥ śabdayor aprayogād artha eva nāsti / kasya saṃjñā kriyatām ? athāpy asty arthaḥ saṃnihitaḥ syāt, evam api na bhavati, vā bhavati, na vā bhavaty evaṃbhūtaḥ syāt / evaṃbhūtasya cārthasyāsattvabhāvāt saṃjñāyā anabhisaṃbandhaḥ / saṃjñāṃ prati hi saṃjñini ṣaṣṭhī prathamā vā vyāpriyate /
analyzed: iha ca na vā iti vibhāṣā iti pratiṣedhya vikalpya vācinoḥ śabdayoḥ aprayogāt arthaḥ eva na asti kasya saṃjñā kriyatām atha api asti arthaḥ saṃnihitaḥ syāt evam api na bhavati vā bhavati na vā bhavati evaṃbhūtaḥ syāt evaṃbhūtasya ca arthasya a sattva bhāvāt saṃjñāyāḥ anabhisaṃbandhaḥ saṃjñām prati hi saṃjñini ṣaṣṭhī prathamā vā vyāpriyate

original: asattvabhūtasya ca na śeṣabhāvāpattiḥ / nāpi idaṃ tad iti vyapadiśyata iti /
analyzed: asattva bhūtasya ca na śeṣa bhāva āpattiḥ nā api idam tat iti vyapadiśyate iti

original: [2] yat tāvad ucyate arthābhāvād ity etad ayuktam / kutaḥ ? upalakṣaṇabhāvena sūtre pravartamāno navāśabdo dravyaśabdasāṃnidhye pravartate kriyāśabdasāṃnidhye vā / kriyāśabdaś ca guṇībhūtakriyaḥ pradhānībhūtakriyaś ca / tatra dravyaśabdayoge na staḥ pratiṣedhavikalpau /
analyzed: yat tāvat ucyate artha abhāvāt iti etat ayuktam kutas upalakṣaṇa bhāvena sūtre pravartamānaḥ navāśabdaḥ dravya śabda sāṃnidhye pravartate kriyā śabda sāṃnidhye vā kriyā śabdaḥ ca guṇībhūta kriyaḥ pradhānībhūta kriyaḥ ca tatra dravya śabda yoge na staḥ pratiṣedha vikalpau

original: kutaḥ ? dravyaśabdāḥ pravartamānā dravyeṣv avasthitākārām eva buddhiṃ pravartayanti, yady asti yadi nāsti so 'rthaḥ / tasmād evaṃbhūto yo 'rthaḥ tasya rūpam evāśakyaṃ pratiṣeddhuṃ vikalpayituṃ veti /
analyzed: kutas dravya śabdāḥ pravartamānāḥ dravyeṣu avasthita ākārām eva buddhim pravartayanti yadi asti yadi na asti saḥ rthaḥ tasmāt evaṃbhūtaḥ yaḥ rthaḥ tasya rūpam eva aśakyam pratiṣeddhum vikalpayitum vā iti

original: [3] yo 'rtho vidheyarūpaḥ sa eva nivāryate vikalpyate vā / kaḥ punar asau ? kriyā, sattā, prātipadikaṃ vā ālambhanaṃ kriyāśabdaprayoge /
analyzed: yaḥ rthaḥ vidheya rūpaḥ saḥ eva nivāryate vikalpyate vā kaḥ punar asau kriyā sattā prātipadikam vā ālambhanam kriyā śabda prayoge

original: [4] katham apācaka iti ? atra kecit pacāv eva nañaḥ saṃnipāta iti pratipannāḥ / kecit punar evaṃ manyante---oacikriyākartur yaḥ sattāviśeṣas taṃ svabhāvanivṛṭtam avadyotayatīti /
analyzed: katham a pācakaḥ iti atra kecid pacau eva nañaḥ saṃnipāte iti pratipannāḥ kecid punar evam manyante oaci kriyā kartuḥ yaḥ sattā viśeṣaḥ tam svabhāva nivṛṭtam avadyotayati iti

original: [5] iha kathaṃ ‘na pacatī’ti ? atrāpi kecit pacim eva sattāviśeṣe pratipannāḥ / kecit punar bhavati pacatīti sādhyasādhanabhāvasyādṛṣṭatvāt paceḥ sattāsaṃbandham eva nivartayati nañ iti /
analyzed: iha katham na pacati iti atra api kecid pacim eva sattā viśeṣe pratipannāḥ kecid punar bhavati pacati iti sādhya sādhana bhāvasya adṛṣṭa tvāt paceḥ sattā saṃbandham eva nivartayati nañ iti

original: [6] yathā mātuḥ smaratīty atra bhinne darśane / kecin manyante---yo 'yaṃ śeṣabhāvo mātuḥ smaraṇe, ayaṃ yathā rājñaḥ puruṣo, vṛkṣasya śākheti kriyāvyaveto dadātināvasthānena ca, iyaṃ smaraṇakriyā api / smaraṇaṃ mātṛviṣayatvāt tatra pravartate tatrāvatiṣṭhata iti pravṛttir avasthānaṃ vā śeṣasya nimittam iti /
analyzed: yathā mātuḥ smarati iti atra bhinne darśane kecid manyante yaḥ yam śeṣa bhāvaḥ mātuḥ smaraṇe ayam yathā rājñaḥ puruṣaḥ vṛkṣasya śākhā iti kriyā vyavetaḥ dadātinā avasthānena ca iyam smaraṇa kriyā api smaraṇam mātṛ viṣaya tvāt tatra pravartate tatra avatiṣṭhate iti pravṛttiḥ avasthānam vā śeṣasya nimittam iti

original: tatra sādhyāpi smṛtiḥ sādhyarūpeṇāvivakṣitā saṃbandhitvenopakrāntā ṣaṣṭhyā nimittaṃ bhavati / yadā sādhyarūpā vivakṣyate, tadā dvitīyaiva bhavati mātaraṃ smaratīti / yathā vṛkṣasya phalam iti, vṛkṣāt phalaṃ patatīit /
analyzed: tatra sādhyā api smṛtiḥ sādhya rūpeṇa avivakṣitā saṃbandhi tvena upakrāntā ṣaṣṭhyāḥ nimittam bhavati yadā sādhya rūpā vivakṣyate tadā dvitīyā eva bhavati mātaram smarati iti yathā vṛkṣasya phalam iti vṛkṣāt phalam patati iit

original: [7] keṣāṃcid darśanam---asaty eva kriyāntare smaraṇam eva kriyā śeṣasya nimittaṃ bhavati / kriyā hi sādhyatvena saṃbandhitvena vā śakyā dravyeṇāpekṣitum /
analyzed: keṣāṃcid darśanam asati eva kriyā antare smaraṇam eva kriyā śeṣasya nimittam bhavati kriyā hi sādhya tvena saṃbandhi tvena vā śakyā dravyeṇa apekṣitum

original: [8] dravyāṇāṃ parasparam upakāraābhāvaḥ / yuktaḥ kriyāvyayetaḥ saṃbandha iti / ato 'rthavān navāśabdaḥ /
analyzed: dravyāṇām parasparam upakāra ābhāvaḥ yuktaḥ kriyā vyaya itas saṃbandhaḥ iti atas rthavān navā śabdaḥ

original: [9] yad apy ucyate asattvabhāvād asaṃbandhaḥ iti / atra brūmaḥ / saṃjñākaraṇakāle sattvabhūtasya pratyavamarśāt yuktaḥ saṃjñāyāḥ kriyāsaṃbandhaḥ / iha yodopakāritvenāśrito 'rthātmā vasturūpatayā upasaṃhriyate, tadā pratyavamṛṣṭaḥ sarvanāmnā kāryayogī saṃpadyate / yathā pacati yas tasyāpatyam iti / tathā sattvabhūto 'yam artha iti /
analyzed: yat api ucyate a sattva bhāvāt asaṃbandhaḥ iti atra brūmaḥ saṃjñā karaṇa kāle sattva bhūtasya pratyavamarśāt yuktaḥ saṃjñāyāḥ kriyā saṃbandhaḥ iha rtha ātmā vastu rūpa tayā upasaṃhriyate tadā pratyavamṛṣṭaḥ sarvanāmnā kārya yogī saṃpadyate yathā pacati yaḥ tasya apatyam iti tathā sattva bhūtaḥ yam arthaḥ iti

original: evam iha saṃjñāsaṃbandhakāle sarvanāmnā pratyavamṛṣṭaḥ naño 'rtho vārthaś ca vastubhūtaḥ / āśritaśabdavyāpāre tu pradeśeṣv asattvabhūta eveti yuktaḥ saṃbandhaḥ, na bhavatīti yo 'rtho vā bhavatīti yo 'rthas tasyeyaṃ vibhāṣeti saṃjñā pratipattavyeti /
analyzed: evam iha saṃjñā saṃbandha kāle sarvanāmnā pratyavamṛṣṭaḥ nañaḥ rthaḥ vā arthaḥ ca vastu bhūtaḥ āśrita śabda vyāpāre tu pradeśeṣu asattva bhūtaḥ eva iti yuktaḥ saṃbandhaḥ na bhavati iti yaḥ rthaḥ vā bhavati iti yaḥ rthaḥ tasya iyam vibhāṣā iti saṃjñā pratipattavyā iti

original: [10] kathaṃ punar ekam eva vastu sattvabhūtam asattvabhūtaṃ syāt ity atra kaiścit vāstavaṃ sarvaśakti iti prapañcitam / tasya tu viśiṣṭārthabhāgopanipātinaḥ śabdās tāṃ tāṃ śaktim avacchindantīti pratipannāḥ / apare punaḥ---naiva vastu kiṃcid asti, śabdā eva tu pravartamānās taṃ tam arthaṃ prakalpayanti /
analyzed: katham punar ekam eva vastu sattva bhūtam a sattva bhūtam syāt iti atra kaiścid vāstavam sarva śakti iti prapañcitam tasya tu viśiṣṭa artha bhāga upanipātinaḥ śabdāḥ tām tām śaktim avacchindanti iti pratipannāḥ apare punar na eva vastu kiṃcid asti śabdāḥ eva tu pravartamānāḥ tam tam artham prakalpayanti

original: sā ca prakalpanaśaktiḥ niyatā ‘gaccha hanyate kaṃsaḥ’ iti / ekasminn eva vastuni kaścit pacatīti prayuṅkte / kaścit śeṣabhāvam āpādya prayuṅkte pacateḥ karteti / kaścit pācakaḥ / na tu karaṇādirūpaṃ, dātreṇa lunāti, grāmād āgacchati, brāhmaṇāya dadāti iti /
analyzed: sā ca prakalpana śaktiḥ niyatā gaccha hanyate kaṃsaḥ iti ekasmin eva vastuni kaścid pacati iti prayuṅkte kaścid śeṣa bhāvam āpādya prayuṅkte pacateḥ kartā iti kaścid pācakaḥ na tu karaṇa ādi rūpam dātreṇa lunāti grāmāt āgacchati brāhmaṇāya dadāti iti

original: [11] atha ko 'yaṃ nirdeśaḥ navetivibhāṣāyām iti ? yāvatārthavat samudāyānāṃ prātipadikasaṃjñā pratiṣiddhaiva / ucyate / anukaraṇaśabdatvād atra prātipadikatvam / tataś cārthavatāṃ nāyaṃ samudāyaḥ, eka evāyaṃ śabdaḥ svenārthenārthavān iti / nanu ca prakṛtivad anuparaṇam ity anayā paribhāṣayā prātipadikasaṃjñāpratiṣedhaḥ prāpnoti / naiṣa doṣaḥ /
analyzed: atha kaḥ yam nirdeśaḥ na vā iti vibhāṣāyām iti yāvatā arthavat samudāyānām prātipadika saṃjñā pratiṣiddhā eva ucyate anukaraṇa śabda tvāt atra prātipadika tvam tatas ca arthavatām na ayam samudāyaḥ ekaḥ eva ayam śabdaḥ svena arthena arthavān iti nanu ca prakṛti vat anuparaṇam iti anayā paribhāṣayā prātipadika saṃjñā pratiṣedhaḥ prāpnoti na eṣa doṣaḥ

original: prakṛtidvārikā yā saṃjñātideśād upalabhyate sā śaktā pratiṣeddhum / yā tu svāśrayā tasyā apratiṣedhaḥ / evam apy aṭābantatvād yāḍāmbhāvau na prāpnutaḥ / āpaḥ samudāyād avihitatvāt / ayam apy adoṣaḥ / āb ante yasya śrūyate sa ābanta ity ucyate / pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣā hi pratiṣiddhā astrīpratyayeneti / evaṃ caitat / atha vā evaṃ varṇyate /
analyzed: prakṛti dvārikā yā saṃjñā atideśāt upalabhyate sā śaktā pratiṣeddhum yā tu sva āśrayā tasyāḥ apratiṣedhaḥ evam api a ṭāp anta tvāt na prāpnutaḥ apaḥ samudāyāt avihita tvāt ayam api adoṣaḥ āp ante yasya śrūyate saḥ āp antaḥ iti ucyate pratyaya grahaṇa paribhāṣā hi pratiṣiddhā a strī pratyayena iti evam ca etat atha vā evam varṇyate

original: na veti uccārya āśritya yā vibhāṣā, tasyāṃ vibhāṣāyām idam ucyate---arthasaṃjñākaraṇam iti /

original: [12] kiṃ prayojanam ? kim evaṃ sati bhavataḥ prayojanam abhipretam ity āha / śabdasaṃpratyaya iti / atha vā vaiparītyenāpi nivartakabhāvena pravartamānaṃ prayojanatvenopadiśyate / yathānyatreti / hetudvayam atrāntarbhūtaṃ dṛṣṭānte / anyatra hi saṃjñākaraṇe 'rthaśruter abhāvāt /
analyzed: kim prayojanam kim evam sati bhavataḥ prayojanam abhipretam iti āha śabda saṃpratyayaḥ iti atha vā vaiparītyena api nivartaka bhāvena pravartamānam prayojana tvena upadiśyate yathā anyatra iti hetu dvayam atra antarbhūtam dṛṣṭānte anyatra hi saṃjñā karaṇe rtha śruteḥ abhāvāt

original: yathā dādhāśrutiḥ svārtham anupahitārthapratyāyane vyāpṛtā saṃjñitvenāśrīyate iti dāśatiprabhṛtīnāṃ nivṛttyartham / pradeśe ca dādhārūpaṃ pratīyamānam / na ca pratiyamāne śabde tadarthasya saṃnidhānaṃ yuktam anumeyatvād iti saṃjñākāle nāpi pradeśe 'rthasyāsti saṃsparśaḥ /
analyzed: yathā dādhā śrutiḥ sva artham anupahita artha pratyāyane vyāpṛtā saṃjñi tvena āśrīyate iti dāśati prabhṛtīnām nivṛtti artham pradeśe ca dādhā rūpam pratīyamānam na ca pratiyamāne śabde tad arthasya saṃnidhānam yuktam anumeya tvāt iti saṃjñā kāle nā api pradeśe rthasya asti saṃsparśaḥ

original: [13] tat tarhi kartavyam arthasaṃjñākaraṇam / sāmānyakaroter viśeṣakarotiḥ karma / atha vā śāstram arthasaṃjñākaraṇaṃ kartavyam iti / itikaraṇo 'rthanitdeśārthaḥ / itikaraṇaḥ kriyate / kriyata iti karaṇaḥ, itiś cāsau karaṇaś ca itikaraṇaḥ / api sāmānyaviśeṣabhāvāt sādhyasādhanasaṃbandhaḥ /
analyzed: tat tarhi kartavyam artha saṃjñā karaṇam sāmānya karoteḥ viśeṣa karotiḥ karma atha vā śāstram artha saṃjñā karaṇam kartavyam iti itikaraṇaḥ rtha nitdeśa arthaḥ itikaraṇaḥ kriyate kriyate iti karaṇaḥ itiḥ ca asau karaṇaḥ ca itikaraṇaḥ api sāmānya viśeṣa bhāvāt sādhya sādhana saṃbandhaḥ

original: [14] kiṃ gatam etat itinā āhosvit śabdādhikyādarthādhikyam ? etad uktaṃ bhavati / kim anupapattikam asmābhir grahītavyam, yasmāt bhavatetir uccārita iti yasyeyaṃ kākavāśitasyāvasthā iti / aparaḥ prakāraḥ / smṛtiśāstram idam /

original: tatra yathaiva lopo(? loke) loṣṭādibhiḥ parimāṇaṃ laukikāt smaranti, evam avyayam itiḥ smṛtihetur atra, yathā viparītaliṅgapravṛttes tu śabdo liṅgatvena prayukta ity uktaṃ bahuguḍo drākṣeti /

original: [15] gatam ity āha / gataṃ pratītam upasaṃgṛhītam ity arthaḥ / kutaḥ / kiṃ lokād atha vyākaraṇāt iti / kecid arthāḥ śāstrād gamyante---yathākāraikāraukārā vṛddhir iti śāstrād eva samadhigamaḥ / paśur apatyaṃ devateti lokāt / atha vā kuta iti kuto hetoḥ, kuto nimittād iti / vyākaraṇe aparisādhitatvāt lokam evopādatte---lokata iti /
analyzed: gatam iti āha gatam pratītam upasaṃgṛhītam iti arthaḥ kutas kim lokāt atha vyākaraṇāt iti kecid arthāḥ śāstrāt gamyante yathā ākāra ekāra aukārāḥ vṛddhiḥ iti śāstrāt eva samadhigamaḥ paśuḥ apatyam devatā iti lokāt atha vā kutas iti kutas hetoḥ kutas nimittāt iti vyākaraṇe a parisādhita tvāt lokam eva upādatte lokataḥ iti

original: [16] tad yathā loke gaur ity ayam āheti gośabdād itikaraṇaḥ paraḥ prayujyamānaḥ / gośabdaprakṛtiko gośabda ity ucyate prātipadikād itiśabdasya prayogāt /

original: [17] kathaṃ punar nitye śabdārthasaṃbandhe ‘śabde cārthe cā’py atyantam asaṃbaddha evārthena / atha kecit śabdāḥ svarūpādhiṣṭhānā eva / kecit arthādhiṣṭhānā eva / sarvathā ca svasmāt arthāt pracyutir nopapadyate /
analyzed: katham punar nitye śabda artha saṃbandhe śabde ca arthe ca api atyantam asaṃbaddhe eva arthena atha kecid śabdāḥ svarūpa adhiṣṭhānāḥ eva kecid artha adhiṣṭhānāḥ eva sarvathā ca svasmāt arthāt pracyutiḥ na upapadyate

original: [18] tatra yathtiva ‘svārtham abhidhāya śabdo nirapekṣaḥ’ ity ayaṃ karamaḥ upanyastaḥ, pratipattyupāyārtham anuṣṭhānam / na hi tatra sakṛduccāritasya śabdasya pravṛttir asakṛd itīdam abhidhāyedaṃ bravītīti na yujyate / samuccayenābhidhānaṃ nāsti, anekaśabdādhiṣṭhānatvāt samuccyasya / samuccyaś ca---plakṣaś ca nyagrodhaś ca, vṛkṣaś ca vṛkṣaś ceti /
analyzed: tatra sva artham abhidhāya śabdaḥ nirapekṣaḥ iti ayam karamaḥ upanyastaḥ pratipatti upāya artham anuṣṭhānam na hi tatra sakṛt uccāritasya śabdasya pravṛttiḥ asakṛt iti idam abhidhāya idam bravīti iti na yujyate samuccayena abhidhānam na asti aneka śabda adhiṣṭhāna tvāt samuccyasya samuccyaḥ ca plakṣaḥ ca nyagrodhaḥ ca vṛkṣaḥ ca vṛkṣaḥ ca iti

original: vikalpo 'pi na saṃbhavati / paryāyeṇa śruter arthānām anavagateḥ / tasmāt saṃsargavādinaḥ sarvaviśeṣayuktārthān saṃniviṣṭā buddhir utpadyate / tasmin viśeṣaśabda uccārite sa tu yathā pānakadravya āsvādite guḍādīnapoddharati idam asti idam asti iti, evaṃ viśiṣṭākārāyāṃ buddhau pravṛttāyāṃ saṃbhavinas tadviṣayān arthān apoddharati /
analyzed: vikalpaḥ pi na saṃbhavati paryāyeṇa śruteḥ arthānām anavagateḥ tasmāt saṃsarga vādinaḥ sarva viśeṣa yukta arthān saṃniviṣṭā buddhiḥ utpadyate tasmin viśeṣa śabde uccārite sa tu yathā pānaka dravye āsvādite guḍa ādīn apoddharati idam asti idam asti iti evam viśiṣṭa ākārāyām buddhau pravṛttāyām saṃbhavinaḥ tad viṣayān arthān apoddharati

original: apoddharaṃś ca kaścit kāryapratipattyartham etadrūpāṃ pratipadyamāno nāgṛhītaviśeṣaṇā viśeṣye buddhir ity evam pūrvaṃ jātīḥ pratipadyate / kaścit tu niradhiṣṭhānasthāyino 'pravṛttir iti pūrvaṃ dravyam eva pratipadyate /
analyzed: apoddharan ca kaścid kārya pratipatti artham etad rūpām pratipadyamānaḥ na agṛhīta viśeṣaṇā viśeṣye buddhiḥ iti evam pūrvam jātīḥ pratipadyate kaścid tu pravṛttiḥ iti pūrvam dravyam eva pratipadyate

original: [19] evam ihāpi naiva pūrvaṃ śabde paścād arthe kiṃ tu yathā vṛddhirūpatām āpāditeṣu ādaikṣu tādrūpyeṇa vipariṇateṣu so 'yam ity abhisaṃbandhāt ekayogakṣemībhūteṣu mṛjer vṛddhir iti ta eva vṛddhirūpeṇābhidhīyante, evaṃ loke 'pi yo gośabdaḥ so 'yaṃ piṇḍa iti gośabdo gorūpatām āpāditaṃ piṇḍam abhidadhatīti kevalaṃ gośabdaprayoge kim ayam arthe
analyzed: evam iha api na eva pūrvam śabde paścāt arthe kim tu yathā vṛddhi rūpa tām āpāditeṣu tādrūpyeṇa vipariṇateṣu saḥ yam iti abhisaṃbandhāt eka yogakṣemībhūteṣu mṛjeḥ vṛddhiḥ iti te eva vṛddhi rūpeṇa abhidhīyante evam loke yaḥ go śabdaḥ saḥ yam piṇḍe iti go śabdaḥ go rūpa tām āpāditam piṇḍam abhidadhati iti kevalam go śabda prayoge kim ayam arthe

original: pratyasta uta nety aviśeṣaḥ / itiḥ prayujyamāno 'rthe yāsyāpratyastarūpatā tasyām avasthitasya yaḥ prayogaḥ tam abhivyanakti itiśabdaḥ / tatrāsya yo 'rthas tasya śabdabhāvenāvipariṇāmaḥ / iyam atra pracyutiḥ /

original: [20] yady evam iha kathaṃ navāśabdād itikaraṇa iti / na hy atrārthāsaṅgāt śabdaḥ svarūpe pravartata iti / satyam, evam etat / nirjñāte tu śabdārthayoḥ saṃbandhe kadācit yo 'yam arthaḥ sa navāśabda iti vipariṇāmaḥ / itiśabdaḥ pravartamāno navāśabdārthasya śabdena yo vibhāgābhāvas taṃ vyavacchinatti ity etāv etaiva pratipādayanti / anye varṇayanti /
analyzed: yadi evam iha katham navā śabdāt iti karaṇaḥ iti na hi atra artha āsaṅgāt śabdaḥ svarūpe pravartate iti satyam evam etat nirjñāte tu śabda arthayoḥ saṃbandhe kadācid yaḥ yam arthaḥ sa navā śabdaḥ iti vipariṇāmaḥ iti śabdaḥ pravartamānaḥ navā śabda arthasya śabdena yaḥ vibhāga abhāvaḥ tam vyavacchinatti iti etau etau eva pratipādayanti anye varṇayanti

original: śabdārthayoḥ kadācit śabdaḥ pradhānam artha upalakṣaṇam, artho vā pradhānaṃ śabda upalakṣaṇam / guṇapradhānabhāvasya viparyayakṛd itiśabda ity etat pracyavanam / atha vā eka eva śabdaḥ sarvaśaktipracitaḥ / tasya itinā śaktir apacchidyate ity etat pracyuvanam /

original: atha vā bhinnā eva śabdāḥ, sārūpyāt sa evāyam iti tattvabuddhyutpattau nimittaṃ bhavanti ity anya eva gośabdo yo 'rthe prayujyate 'nya evāyam iti pare / asmin darśane na pracyutir upapadyate / atha vā śakyam evā[n a]rthavad varṇavat padāny anarthakāny eva / evam eva ca vākyāt evārthapratipattiḥ gaur ity ayam āheti /
analyzed: atha vā bhinnāḥ eva śabdāḥ sārūpyāt saḥ eva ayam iti tattva buddhi utpattau nimittam bhavanti iti anyaḥ eva go śabdaḥ yaḥ rthe prayujyate eva ayam iti pare asmin darśane na pracyutiḥ upapadyate atha vā śakyam eva an arthavat varṇavat padāni anarthakāni eva evam eva ca vākyāt eva artha pratipattiḥ gauḥ iti ayam āha iti

original: samudāye 'rthavati kuto gośabdasya śabdapadārthakatvam iti pracyuter abhāvaḥ / vyākāraṇe tu śabdavyavahāre prasiddhā loke 'rthā iti prasiddheḥ viparyāsamupadyotayanta itiśabdā iti sthitam etat---itikaraṇo 'rthanirdeśārtha iti /
analyzed: samudāye rthavati kutas go śabdasya śabda padārthaka tvam iti pracyuteḥ abhāvaḥ tu śabda vyavahāre prasiddhāḥ loke rthāḥ iti prasiddheḥ viparyāsam upadyotayantaḥ iti śabdāḥ iti sthitam rtha nirdeśa arthaḥ iti

original: [21] atha keyaṃ vācoyuktiḥ yāsāvarthapadārthakatā iti / athapadārthakatā hi saṃbandha ucyate / saṃbandhād ayaṃ pracyavamāno 'rthād api pracyuto bhavati iti / kiṃ ca saṃbandhāc cāyam artha upātta iti yad eva nimittam arthābhidhāne tasyaivopādānaṃ yuktam iti /

original: [23] samānaśabdapratiṣedhaḥ / samānaḥ śabdo vācako yeṣām arthānāṃ te samānaśabdāḥ / teṣāṃ samānaśabdānām arthānāṃ saṃjñitvasya pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ / navāśabdo hy anekārthaḥ / pratiṣedhavikalpatvādiviśiṣṭe pravṛttinimitte cānāśrīyamāṇe sarvasya navāśabdavācyasyārthasya saṃjñayā bhavitavyam /

original: āśrīyamāṇe vā viśeṣe kuta etat ayaṃ viśeṣo netara iti saṃdehaḥ / ataḥ sarvaprasaṅgaḥ saṃdeho vā iti samānaśabdapratiṣedhaś codyate / navā kuṇḍikā, navā ghaṭikā iti pratyagravacanatā nirdiśyate / yuktaṃ ca yat pratyagravacanasyaiva syāt / pratiṣedhavikalayor hi vākyaikadeśabhūyayor navāśabdayoḥ śravaṇād anumīyamānaṃ vākyāntaram /
analyzed: āśrīyamāṇe vā viśeṣe kutas etat ayam viśeṣaḥ na itaraḥ iti saṃdehaḥ atas sarva prasaṅgaḥ saṃdehaḥ vā iti samāna śabda pratiṣedhaḥ codyate navā kuṇḍikāḥ navā ghaṭikāḥ iti pratyagra vacana tā nirdiśyate yuktam ca yat pratyagra vacanasya eva syāt pratiṣedha vikalayoḥ hi vākya eka deśa bhūyayoḥ navā śabdayoḥ śravaṇāt anumīyamānam vākya antaram

analyzed: iha tu sākṣāt pratyagra vāci tvam iti

original: [23] kiṃ ca syāt / saṃjñā hi na saṃskāraḥ / kiṃ tarhi / tatprayuktaṃ kāryam iti / vibḥāṣā diksamāse bahuvrīhāv iti / kathaṃ kṛtvedam ucyate yāvatā sarvādayaḥ śabdāḥ, na ca navapurāṇatvaṃ śabdadharmaḥ / na ca sarvanāmasaṃjñāyā navapurāṇatvena saṃbhavo 'sti / kiṃ ca dakṣiṇapurveti diśa eva tad abhidhānam /
analyzed: kim ca syāt saṃjñā hi na saṃskāraḥ kim tarhi tad prayuktam kāryam iti diś samāse bahuvrīhau iti katham kṛtvā idam ucyate yāvatā sarva ādayaḥ śabdāḥ na ca nava purāṇa tvam śabda dharmaḥ na ca sarvanāma saṃjñāyāḥ nava purāṇa tvena saṃbhavaḥ sti kim ca diśaḥ eva tat abhidhānam

original: tasyāś ca navapurāṇatvenātyantam asaṃbhavaḥ / sūtre ‘vibhāṣā diksamāsa’ ity anena pratyagrārtha ity etad upasthāpyate / tatra pratyagrārthavṛttau yaḥ tasya sarvanāmasaṃjñā syāt ity ayam arthaḥ prasajyate / yadā ca ‘itaḥ idam’ ity evaṃrūpā dik bhāgeṣu nyastā bhavati tadā eṣa evārtho 'vadhitvena pravartate---pūrvo vṛkṣo grāmād iti /
analyzed: tasyāḥ ca nava purāṇa tvena atyantam asaṃbhavaḥ sūtre vibhāṣā diś samāsaḥ iti anena pratyagra arthaḥ iti etat upasthāpyate tatra pratyagra artha vṛttau yaḥ tasya sarvanāma saṃjñā syāt iti ayam arthaḥ prasajyate yadā ca itas idam iti evaṃrūpā diś bhāgeṣu nyastā bhavati tadā eṣaḥ eva arthaḥ vadhi tvena pravartate pūrvaḥ vṛkṣaḥ grāmāt iti

original: evam antarālam api yadā bhāge nyastarūpaṃ bhavati tadā śālānyā vāntarālatvenāśrīyamāṇā navapurāṇatayā saṃbhavatīti smāyādivyaṅgyaṃ pratyagratvam etadanvākhyānāt pratipadyate, yathā vṛkṣaparṇaṃ svarādivyaṅgyaṃ pratipadyate susthaṇḍileṣv iti /
analyzed: evam antarālam api yadā bhāge nyasta rūpam bhavati tadā śālā anyā vā antarāla tvena āśrīyamāṇā nava purāṇa tayā saṃbhavati iti smāyā ādi vyaṅgyam pratyagra tvam etad anvākhyānāt pratipadyate yathā vṛkṣa parṇam svara ādi vyaṅgyam pratipadyate su sthaṇḍileṣu iti

original: [24] na vā vidhir pūrvakatvāt pratiṣedhasaṃpratyayo yathā loke / arthaprakaraṇādibhiḥ śabdārthasyāvacchede viśeṣe 'vasthānaṃ dṛṣṭam / saindhavaśabdasya saindhavam ānayeti bhojanaprakaraṇe lavaṇe 'vasthānaṃ dṛṣṭam / mṛgayāprakaraṇe 'śve 'vasthānam /
analyzed: na vā vidhiḥ pūrvaka tvāt pratiṣedha saṃpratyayaḥ yathā loke artha prakaraṇa ādibhiḥ śabda arthasya avacchede viśeṣe va sthānam dṛṣṭam saindhava śabdasya saindhavam ānaya iti bhojana prakaraṇe lavaṇe va sthānam dṛṣṭam mṛgayā prakaraṇe śve va sthānam

original: evam iha pradeśānābhūta saṃjñāvidhānāt yathābhūtaḥ pradeśe 'rtho, navāśabdasya tathābhūtasyopādānaṃ yuktam / vidhipūrvakā vibhāṣāśabdāḥ pradeśeṣu / tasmāt vidheyasya codyamānatvāt prakñātatvād vā pratiṣedhārthīya evam bhaviṣyati, na pratyagrārthīyaḥ /
analyzed: evam iha saṃjñā vidhānāt yathābhūtaḥ pradeśe rthaḥ navā śabdasya tathābhūtasya upādānam yuktam vidhi pūrvakāḥ vibhāṣā śabdāḥ pradeśeṣu tasmāt vidheyasya codyamāna tvāt prakñāta tvāt vā pratiṣedha arthīyaḥ evam bhaviṣyati na pratyagra arthīyaḥ

original: loke 'pi yatra viṣaye prastute navāśabdaḥ prayujyate, pratiṣedhārtha eva tatra gamyate na pratyagrārtha iti etad upādāya dṛṣṭāntopanyāsaḥ /
analyzed: loke pi yatra viṣaye prastute navā śabdaḥ prayujyate pratiṣedha arthaḥ eva tatra gamyate na pratyagra arthaḥ iti etat upādāya dṛṣṭānta upanyāsaḥ

original: [24] itaro dṛṣṭāntaṃ vyabhicārayati---asti kāraṇaṃ yena loka iti / viliṅgaṃ hi bhavān nirdeśaṃ karoti / viliṅgam iti vyadhikaranam ity arthaḥ / viliṅganirdeśād eva pratiṣedhasaṃpratyayaḥ, na tu vidhipūrvakatvād iti / etam evārthaṃ samarthayate---aṅga hi samānaliṅgo nirdeśaḥ kriyatām iti / etac caiva na jānīmaḥ kvacid vyākaraṇa iti /
analyzed: itaraḥ dṛṣṭāntam vyabhicārayati asti kāraṇam yena lokaḥ iti viliṅgam hi bhavān nirdeśam karoti viliṅgam iti vyadhikaranam iti arthaḥ viliṅga nirdeśāt eva pratiṣedha saṃpratyayaḥ na tu vidhi pūrvaka tvāt iti etam eva artham samarthayate aṅga hi samāna liṅgaḥ nirdeśaḥ kriyatām iti etat ca eva na jānīmaḥ kvacid vyākaraṇe iti

original: naiva vyākaraṇe kvacit samādhikaranena nirdeśaḥ / ihāpi ‘vibhāṣā senāsurācchāyā’ śālāniśānām (A 2.4.25) iti / bhavet samānaliṅgo nirdeśo, na tu samānavibhaktikaḥ / tasmān naiva vyākaraṇe vibhāṣāpradeśeṣu śakyaṃ jñātuṃ śrutisaṃnipātāt samānādhikaraṇatvaṃ vyadhikaraṇatvaṃ vā /
analyzed: na eva vyākaraṇe kvacid nirdeśaḥ iha api vibhāṣā senā surā chāyā śālā niśānām iti bhavet samāna liṅgaḥ nirdeśaḥ na tu samāna vibhaktikaḥ tasmāt na eva vyākaraṇe vibhāṣā pradeśeṣu śakyam jñātum śruti saṃnipātāt samāna adhikaraṇa tvam vyadhikaraṇa tvam vā

original: yadā tu pauruṣeyeṇa vyāpāreṇa dakṣiṇapūrvādiṣu kalpyate tadā syād vā na vā pratiṣedhavācinaḥ śurisaṃnipātāt saṃpratyayo, na tu pratyagravācina ity etad anena prakāreṇa vyācaṣṭe---api ca kāmacāra iti /
analyzed: yadā tu pauruṣeyeṇa vyāpāreṇa dakṣiṇa pūrva ādiṣu kalpyate tadā syāt vā na vā pratiṣedha vācinaḥ śuri saṃnipātāt saṃpratyayaḥ na tu pratyagra vācinaḥ iti etat anena prakāreṇa vyācaṣṭe api ca kāmacāre iti

original: [26] anena yat prāg uktaṃ ‘asti kāraṇam’ iti tad vyabhicārayati / samānaliṅge 'pi nirdeśe pratiṣedhavācinaḥ saṃpratyayād ayuktam idam ucyate viliṅgaṃ hi bhavān nirdeśaṃ karoti iti / prayujyamāno 'pi navāśabdo yadā vidheye saṃnipatati tadātyantaṃ dravyeṇāsaṃbandhāt pratiṣedhavācī / yadā tu dravyavācinā samānādhikaraṇas tadātyantaṃ pratyagravācīti /
analyzed: anena yat prāk uktam asti kāraṇam iti tat vyabhicārayati samāna liṅge pi nirdeśe pratiṣedha vācinaḥ saṃpratyayāt ayuktam idam ucyate viliṅgam hi bhavān nirdeśam karoti iti prayujyamānaḥ pi navā śabdaḥ yadā vidheye saṃnipatati tadā atyantam dravyeṇa asaṃbandhāt pratiṣedha vācī yadā tu dravya vācinā samāna adhikaraṇaḥ tadā atyantam pratyagra vācī iti

original: na śakyaṃ vaktuṃ sa eva liṅgavān aliṅgaś ceti / yadā ca prasiddham idaṃ bhavati yathā ca yavāgūṃ navām atyuṣāṇṃ nityaṃ bhuṅkte iti taittirīyakāḥ / tasmān navāśabdo na pratyagravācī sṃbhavati iti pratiṣedhavācy eva pratīyate /
analyzed: na śakyam vaktum saḥ eva liṅgavān aliṅgaḥ ca iti yadā ca prasiddham idam bhavati yathā ca yavāgūm navām nityam bhuṅkte iti taittirīyakāḥ tasmāt nava śabdaḥ na pratyagra vācī sṃbhavati iti pratiṣedha vācī eva pratīyate

original: yasya tu naivaṃ yavāgūbhojanaṃ prasaktam, sa pūrvam evipadiśyate tatra pratiṣedhavācino 'narthakam upādānam iti pratyagrārthaḥ pratīyate iti yuktam / prayoktuḥ kāmacāra iti / iha tu śāstre yady api kāmacāraḥ syāt, evam api na doṣaḥ syāt / yats tu prayoktur ekarasaiva pravṛttiḥ, tata idam api nāsti kadācit pratyagravācina iti /
analyzed: yasya tu na evam yavāgū bhojanam prasaktam sa pūrvam tatra pratiṣedha vācinaḥ narthakam upādānam iti pratyagra arthaḥ pratīyate iti yuktam prayoktuḥ kāmacāraḥ iti iha tu śāstre yadi api kāmacāraḥ syāt evam api na doṣaḥ syāt tu prayoktuḥ ekarasā eva pravṛttiḥ tatas idam api na asti kadācid pratyagra vācinaḥ iti

original: [27] etat samarthayate---na ceha . . . vibhāṣāgrahaṇeneti / kutaḥ ? saṃjñāgrahaṇasya prādhānyāt / tatra bhavatir vidheyatvenopāttaḥ pradhānam, tadaṅgānītarāṇi iti / pradhānam utsṛjya vidheyaṃ na tadaṅgeṣu sarvādiṣu saṃnipatiṣyati vibhāṣāśrutir iti pūrva eva hetuḥ pratyāgrārthāgrahaṇasya ‘na vā vidhipūrvakatvāt pratiṣedhasaṃpratyaya’ iti /
analyzed: etat samarthayatena ca iha vibhāṣā grahaṇena iti kutas saṃjñā grahaṇasya prādhānyāt tatra bhavatiḥ vidheya tvena upāttaḥ pradhānam tad aṅgāni itarāṇi iti pradhānam utsṛjya vidheyam na tad aṅgeṣu sarva ādiṣu saṃnipatiṣyati vibhāṣā śrutiḥ iti pūrvaḥ eva hetuḥ na vā vidhi pūrvaka tvāt pratiṣedha saṃpratyayaḥ iti

original: [28] vidhyanityatvam anupapannaṃ pratiṣedhasaṃjñākaraṇāt / sūtre navāśabdau ekanipāto yathā nakir mākir iti / pratiṣedhārthīyaś cāyaṃ yathānantaram eva pratiṣedhe prayukte vākye ‘na vā vidhipūrvakatvād . . . ’ iti / tena vibhāṣeti navāśabdasya yo 'rthaḥ pratiṣedhas tasya saṃjñā ‘vibhāṣā śveḥ’ iti / evaṃ ca sati śuśāva śuśuvatur iti na sidhyati /
analyzed: vidhi anitya tvam anupapannam pratiṣedha saṃjñā karaṇāt sūtre navā śabdau eka nipātaḥ yathā nakir mākir iti pratiṣedha arthīyaḥ ca ayam yathā anantaram eva pratiṣedhe prayukte vākye na vā vidhi pūrvaka tvāt iti tena vibhāṣā iti navā śabdasya yaḥ rthaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ tasya saṃjñā vibhāṣā śveḥ iti evam ca sati śuśāva śuśuvatuḥ iti na sidhyati

original: [29] siddhaṃ tu prasajyapratiṣedhavacanāt / loke 'pi prasajyapratiṣedho dṛṣṭaḥ / grāmo bhavatā gantavyo na veti / na hy antareṇa pratiṣedhyaṃ pratiṣedhavākyasya pravṛttir yuktā / ataḥ pratiṣedhavākyād eva prasaṅgavākyam anumīyate / vipratiṣiddhaṃ tu / ekaṃ lakṣyaṃ buddhau kṛtvāha ‘vibhāṣā śveḥ’ iti / ekam idaṃ śvayatirūpam /
analyzed: siddham tu prasajya pratiṣedha vacanāt loke prasajya pratiṣedhaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ grāmaḥ bhavatā gantavyaḥ na vā iti na hi antareṇa pratiṣedhyam pratiṣedha vākyasya pravṛttiḥ yuktā atas pratiṣedha vākyāt eva prasaṅga vākyam anumīyate vipratiṣiddham tu ekam lakṣyam buddhau kṛtvā āha vibhāṣā śveḥ iti ekam idam śvayati rūpam

original: tatraikasyaiva rūpasya bhavati na bhavatīti ca vipratiṣiddham āpadyate ity etad ācaṣṭe---na jñāyate kenābhiprāyeṇeti /
analyzed: tatra ekasya eva rūpasya bhavati na bhavati iti ca vipratiṣiddham āpadyate iti etat ācaṣṭena jñāyate kena abhiprāyeṇa iti

original: [30] itaraḥ samadhigataprāmāṇyatvād ācāryasya ‘vibhāṣā śveḥ’ iry etad evaṃ pratipattavyam / bahava ete śvayatayaḥ lakṣyasamavāyino 'nena rūpeṇa gṛhītāḥ / teṣu kiṃcid eva rūpaṃ nivṛttiṃ parigṛhyāvasthitaṃ saṃprasāraṇasya, kiṃcit prasaṅgam iti / yathaiva bhinnān dhātūn samāśritya keṣuṣit pratiṣedhaḥ syād evam api draṣṭavyam /
analyzed: itaraḥ samadhigata prāmāṇya tvāt ācāryasya vibhāṣā śveḥ etat evam pratipattavyam bahavaḥ ete śvayatayaḥ lakṣya samavāyinaḥ nena rūpeṇa gṛhītāḥ teṣu kiṃcid eva rūpam nivṛttim parigṛhya avasthitam saṃprasāraṇasya kiṃcid prasaṅgam iti yathā eva bhinnān dhātūn samāśritya pratiṣedhaḥ syāt evam api draṣṭavyam

original: kutaḥ ? ekasminn atyantaṃ vipratiṣedhāt vidhipratiṣedhayor iti / evam ‘ūrṇor vibhāṣā’ iti / bahava ūrṇotayaḥ, bahava iḍādayaḥ pratyayā grahītavyāḥ samudāyo vety etad anena pratipādayati / na vā prasaṅgasāmarthyād anyatra pratiṣedhaviṣayāt iti /
analyzed: kutas ekasmin atyantam vipratiṣedhāt vidhi pratiṣedhayoḥ iti evam ūrṇoḥ vibhāṣā iti bahavaḥ ūrṇotayaḥ bahavaḥ iḍā ādayaḥ pratyayāḥ grahītavyāḥ samudāyaḥ vā iti etat anena pratipādayati na vā prasaṅga sāmarthyāt anyatra pratiṣedha viṣayāt iti

original: [31] tad etat kva siddhaṃ bhavati ? yā aprāpte vibhāṣās tāsu hi dvāv api prasaṅgapratiṣedhau akṛtārthāv iti yuktaṃ yat pratiṣedho vikalpārthaḥ syāt / prāptikaraṇasya tulyatvāt / yā hi prāpte vibhāṣā tasyāṃ pūrvo vidhiḥ sāmānye utsṛṣṭaḥ kṛtārthaḥ / tasya viśeṣe aprāptyanumānaṃ vādhaḥ prāpnoty eva / tena na vikalpaḥ / atra codyate /
analyzed: tat etat kva siddham bhavati yāḥ aprāpte vibhāṣāḥ tāsu hi dvau api prasaṅga pratiṣedhau akṛtārthau iti yuktam yat pratiṣedhaḥ vikalpa arthaḥ syāt prāpti karaṇasya tulya tvāt yā hi prāpte vibhāṣā tasyām pūrvaḥ vidhiḥ sāmānye utsṛṣṭaḥ kṛtārthaḥ tasya viśeṣe aprāpti anumānam vādhaḥ prāpnoti eva tena na vikalpaḥ atra codyate

original: yadi prāptavibhāṣāsv ekāntena nivṛttiḥ prāpnoti, ‘vibhāṣā dikyasamāse’ ity atra vibhāṣāśrutiḥ navāśabdārthasya pratiṣedhasya vāciketi bahuvrīhāv ity eva vaktavyam / ‘na bahuvrīhau’ iti pratiṣedhopādānam anarthakam / vibhāṣāgrahaṇam eva tatrānuvartiṣyate / tathā ‘vibhāṣā vipralāpe’ iti ‘vyaktavācāṃ samuccāraṇe’ kṛtārtho vidhir vipralāpe bādhyeta /
analyzed: yadi prāpta vibhāṣāsu ekāntena nivṛttiḥ prāpnoti vibhāṣā dikya samāse iti atra vibhāṣā śrutiḥ navā śabda arthasya pratiṣedhasya vācikā iti bahuvrīhau iti eva vaktavyam na bahuvrīhau iti pratiṣedha upādānam anarthakam vibhāṣā grahaṇam eva tatra anuvartiṣyate tathā vibhāṣā vipralāpe iti vyakta vācām samuccāraṇe kṛtārthaḥ vidhiḥ vipralāpe bādhyeta

original: [33] vibhāṣeti mahagīyaṃ saṃjñā kriyate / anyatra mahatīnāṃ sāṃjñānām anvarthatvam / iha ca na mahattvam anvarthānumānam / kiṃ tarhi ? saṃjñibhedasyaivānumānam / nāyam ekanipātaḥ / nipātadvayam etat / dvayoś cārthayoḥ pratiṣedhavikalpayor eṣā saṃjñā / na ca vibhāṣā śabdasya vācyaṃ saṃjñidvitvam / kiṃ tarhi ? pravṛttinimittamātram /
analyzed: vibhāṣā iti mahagīyam saṃjñā kriyate anyatra mahatīnām sāṃjñānām anvartha tvam iha ca na mahā tvam anvartha anumānam kim tarhi saṃjñi bhedasya eva anumānam na ayam eka nipātaḥ nipāta dvayam etat dvayoḥ ca arthayoḥ pratiṣedha vikalpayoḥ eṣā saṃjñā na ca vibhāṣā śabdasya vācyam saṃjñi dvi tvam kim tarhi pravṛtti nimitta mātram

original: atra tv etad eva vicārayitavyam---kim iyaṃ saṃjñā pratiṣedhavikalpayoḥ pratyekaṃ yathā vṛddhisaṃjñā, atha samudāyasya yathā saṃyogasaṃjñeti / tatra yadi pratyekam, idaṃ nāsti pratiṣedhavikalpābhyām ekasmin pravartitavyam iti / tena yathaiva kvacid ākāro vṛddhiḥ kvacid aukāra evaṃ kvacit pratiṣedhaḥ kvacid vikalpaḥ syāt /
analyzed: atra tu etat eva vicārayitavyam kim iyam saṃjñā pratiṣedha vikalpayoḥ pratyekam yathā vṛddhi saṃjñā atha samudāyasya yathā saṃyoga saṃjñā iti tatra yadi pratyekam idam na asti pratiṣedha vikalpābhyām ekasmin pravartitavyam iti tena yathā eva kvacid ākāraḥ vṛddhiḥ kvacid aukāraḥ evam kvacid pratiṣedhaḥ kvacid vikalpaḥ syāt

original: kramaś ca durlabhaḥ, pūrvaṃ nivṛttiḥ paścād vikalpa iti / atha samudāyaḥ saṃjñī, evam api yathā saṃyogasaṃjñā samudāyasyaiva nāvayavayoḥ evam iyam apīti idaṃ nopapadyate, aprāptavibhāṣāsu pratiṣedhyaṃ nāstīti kṛtvā vety anena vikalpo bhaviṣyati iti, samudāyasya cet kṛtārthā saṃjñā sā katham avayavapradeśaṃ pratipādayiṣyati ? kramaś cātyantam eva
analyzed: kramaḥ ca durlabhaḥ pūrvam nivṛttiḥ paścāt vikalpaḥ iti atha samudāyaḥ saṃjñī evam api yathā saṃyoga saṃjñā samudāyasya eva na avayavayoḥ evam iyam api iti idam na upapadyate aprāpta vibhāṣāsu pratiṣedhyam na asti iti kṛtvā vā iti anena vikalpaḥ bhaviṣyati iti samudāyasya ced kṛtārthā saṃjñā sā katham avayava pradeśam pratipādayiṣyati kramaḥ ca atyantam eva

original: durlabhaḥ samudāyasyākramatvāt / ata idam api nopapadyate nety anena pratiṣiddhe vety anena vikalpo bhaviṣyatīti / ucyate /

original: śakyate tatrāpi pūjā kalpayitum---dṛśyate hi loke āhopuruṣikayāpi pūjā, gālavasya yamāt hrasve pravṛttis tasmāt tvam api prayuṅkṣveti saṃbhavati pramāṇīkaraṇāt pūjā, dvidhā pratipattis tu na bhavatīty āha---tatkīrtane ca dvedhāpratipattiḥ / śāstrāt hrasvam eva pratipanno na dīrgham iti /

original: [49] aśiṣyo vā viditatvāt / vāśabdo vikalpe / śiṣyo vā ity arthaḥ / śabdasaṃjñā svarūpādhiṣṭhānā / yā tasyās tadrūpāyā eva pradeśeṣu pravṛttiḥ śāstre ca tayā saṃvyavahāro yathā vṛddhyādiṣu / iyaṃ caivaṃbhūtā na bhavatīti etad ācaṣṭe / ye 'pi hy etāṃ sāṃjñāṃ nārabhanta iti /

original: [50] tatra yadaivaṃ pratipattiḥ śāstrākṛtir lakṣyākṛtau pravartata iti tado 'bhayatravibhāṣārtha kartavyo yogaḥ / itarathā hi ‘vibhāṣā śveḥ’ (A 6.1.30) iti vibhāṣā śabda ekasmin vākyaśeṣe upakṣīṇo na bhavati, bhavati vā, pravṛttyantarasyābhāvāt ubhayam asamarthaḥ kartum iti /
analyzed: tatra yadā evam pratipattiḥ śāstra ākṛtiḥ lakṣya ākṛtau pravartate iti kartavyaḥ yogaḥ itarathā hi vibhāṣā śveḥ iti vibhāṣā śabdaḥ ekasmin vākyaśeṣe upakṣīṇaḥ na bhavati bhavati vā pravṛtti antarasya abhāvāt ubhayam asamarthaḥ kartum iti

original: yadā tv evaṃ manyase lakṣyavyaktiṣu śāstravyaktaya iti tadaitan nibandhanād ‘vibhāṣā śveḥ’ iti yāval lakṣyaṃ tatsamavāyino bahūn yogān pratipadyata iti nārabdhavyo yogaḥ / etam eva cārthaṃ pradarśayatā ācāryeṇa pradeśeṣu bhinnalakṣaṇaḥ śabdavyavahāraḥ kṛtaḥ / etat pradarśayati---ācāryaḥ khalv api saṃjñāmārabhamāṇa iti /
analyzed: yadā tu evam manyase lakṣya vyaktiṣu śāstra vyaktayaḥ iti tadā etat nibandhanāt vibhāṣā śveḥ iti yāvat lakṣyam tad samavāyinaḥ bahūn yogān pratipadyate iti na ārabdhavyaḥ yogaḥ etam eva ca artham pradarśayatā ācāryeṇa pradeśeṣu bhinna lakṣaṇaḥ śabda vyavahāraḥ kṛtaḥ etat pradarśayati ācāryaḥ khalu api saṃjñām ārabhamāṇaḥ iti

original: kathaṃ tad uktaṃ ‘bhāradvājaḥ svasmāt mātāt pracyāvyate’ iti ? ucyate / yathānena smṛtvopanibaddhaṃ tataḥ pracyāvyata iti /
analyzed: katham tat uktam bhāradvājaḥ svasmāt mātāt pracyāvyate iti ucyate yathā anena smṛtvā upanibaddham tatas pracyāvyate iti

original: [51.1] aprāpte trisaṃśayāḥ / aprāpta ity etat svaryate / trisaṃśayā iti na ‘trayah saṃśayāḥ yāsu vibhāṣāsu tāstrisaṃśayāḥ’ / kuta etat ? ekatvāt saṃśayasya / yathā sthāṇuḥ puruṣa ity eka eva saṃśayo na dvau saṃśayau / atas tryadhiṣṭhānatvāt trisaṃśayā iti ucyate /
analyzed: aprāpte tri saṃśayāḥ aprāpte iti etat svaryate tri saṃśayāḥ iti na trayaḥ saṃśayāḥ yāsu vibhāṣāsu tāḥ tri saṃśayāḥ kutas etat eka tvāt saṃśayasya yathā sthāṇuḥ puruṣaḥ iti ekaḥ eva saṃśayaḥ na dvau saṃśayau atas tri adhiṣṭhāna tvāt tri saṃśayāḥ iti ucyate

original: [51.2] ‘dvandve ca / vibhāṣā jasi’ iti vibhāṣāprakaraṇopalakṣaṇārtham upāttam / iha tu saṃśayaḥ ‘prathamacaramataye’ti [yadi ‘sarvādīni’ ity anuvartate tataḥ] prāpte 'tha nivṛttaṃ pūrvavipratiṣedhaś caivam aprāpte, tathā paravipratiṣedha evam ubhayatra / ‘sarvādīni . .
analyzed: dvandve ca vibhāṣā jasi iti vibhāṣā prakaraṇa upalakṣaṇa artham upāttam iha tu saṃśayaḥ prathama carama tayā iti yadi sarva ādīni iti anuvartate tatas prāpte nivṛttam pūrva vipratiṣedhaḥ ca evam aprāpte tathā para vipratiṣedhaḥ evam ubhayatra sarva ādīni

original: .’ ity asyāvakāśo [jasbhinne, dvādiṣu ca vikalpo] yasmāt sarvādi na bhavati dvaye dvayā iti / ihobhayaṃ prāpnoti ubhaye iti / dhyānagrahakāreṇoktam---aprāpte pūrvavipratiṣedhāt antaraṅgatvād vā / antaraṅgam ity eva kasmāt ? prakṛtimātrāśrayaṇāt / vibhāṣā tūbhayajasimāśritya bahiraṅgā /
analyzed: iti asya avakāśaḥ jas bhinne dva ādiṣu ca vikalpaḥ yasmāt sarva ādi na bhavati dvaye dvayāḥ iti iha ubhayam prāpnoti ubhaye iti dhyānagraha kāreṇa uktam aprāpte pūrva vipratiṣedhāt antaraṅga tvāt vā antaraṅgam iti eva kasmāt prakṛti mātra āśrayaṇāt vibhāṣā tu ubhaya jasim āśritya bahiraṅgā

original: ayaṃ tūbhayam etad anāśrityāprāpte vibhāṣāṃ varṇayati---aprāpte 'yac pratyayāntaram iti / yas tvayajādeśaḥ parigṛhyate, sa hy ubhayaśabdāt pratyayāntaraṃ vijñāsyate / tatraivaṃ pāṭhaḥ kriyate---‘ubhād avayave 'yac’ / tataḥ ‘saṃkhyāyās tayap’ / ‘dvitribhyāṃ tayasyāyajve’ti / atha vā ‘saṃkhyāyā avayave tayap’ / ‘ubhād ayac’ / ‘dvitribhyāṃ vā’ /
analyzed: ayam tu ubhayam etat an āśritya aprāpte vibhāṣām varṇayati aprāpte yat pratyaya antaram iti yaḥ tu a ya c ādeśaḥ parigṛhyate sa hi ubhaya śabdāt pratyaya antaram vijñāsyate tatra evam pāṭhaḥ kriyate ubhāt avayave yat tatas saṃkhyāyāḥ tayap dvi tribhyām tayasya ayajvā iti atha vā saṃkhyāyāḥ avayave tayap ubhāt ayac dvi tribhyām vā

original: tailamātrā . . . atrāpi prāpnoti / nanu cākārānta evāyam / naiṣa doṣaḥ / naivam ucyate tailamātrāśabdāt prāpnotīti / kiṃ tarhi ? tailamātrīti bhavitavyam iti / sadṛśasyāpy asaṃniviṣṭasyeti / kathaṃ cāyaṃ na saṃniviṣṭa ity etat śakyaṃ pratipattum ? ucyate / anubandhe 'saty api artha evopalakṣito nimittaṃ pratyabhijñāne /
analyzed: taila mātrāḥ atra api prāpnoti nanu ca ākāra antaḥ eva ayam na eṣa doṣaḥ na evam ucyate taila mātrā śabdāt prāpnoti iti kim tarhi taila mātrī iti bhavitavyam iti sadṛśasya api asaṃniviṣṭasya iti katham ca ayam na saṃniviṣṭaḥ iti etat śakyam pratipattum ucyate anubandhe sati api arthaḥ eva upalakṣitaḥ nimittam pratyabhijñāne

original: evaṃ cehārthenaiva saṃniviṣṭo vijñāsyate, pramāṇārthavṛttiḥ yaḥ sa saṃniviṣṭa iti / yas tu parimāṇārthavṛttiḥ syāt iyam asya mātrā idam asya parimāṇam iti tasyāsaṃniveśaḥ / prātipadikāt parasya pramāṇavācinaḥ saṃniveśāt yathoktaṃ ‘luṅi sijādidarśanāt’ iti /
analyzed: evam ca iha arthena eva saṃniviṣṭaḥ vijñāsyate pramāṇa artha vṛttiḥ yaḥ sa saṃniviṣṭaḥ iti yaḥ tu parimāṇa artha vṛttiḥ syāt iyam asya mātrā idam asya parimāṇam iti tasya a saṃniveśaḥ prātipadikāt parasya pramāṇa vācinaḥ saṃniveśāt yathā uktam luṅi sic ādi darśanāt iti

original: [51.3] ūrṇor vibhāṣā / yady aparisamāptakriyam idam avidhāyakaṃ kasyacid āsaktasvaritaliṅgam upādīyate, [yathā] ‘samarthānāṃ prathamād vā’ iti, ataḥ ‘asaṃyogāl liṭ kit’ ity atra pratilabdhakriyaṃ tasmin nānāvākyatvenaiva pravartate / asaṃyogāl liṭ kit bhavati / ūrṇoter vibhāṣā bhavatīti / nānāvākyatvaṃ cāsaṃyogagrahaṇād evānumīyate /
analyzed: ūrṇoḥ vibhāṣā yadi a parisamāpta kriyam idam a vidhāyakam kasyacid āsakta svarita liṅgam upādīyate yathā samarthānām prathamāt vā iti atas a saṃyogāt liṭ k it iti atra pratilabdha kriyam tasmin nānā vākya tvena eva pravartate a saṃyogāt liṭ k it bhavati ūrṇoteḥ vibhāṣā bhavati iti nānā vākya tvam ca a saṃyoga grahaṇāt eva anumīyate

original: asaṃyogānta eva hi ūrṇotir iti / iha tu vacanam iḍupajīvanārtham / atha vidhāyakam idam / evaṃ sati liḍviṣaye 'nārambhāt sāvakāśāv etāv iti vipratiṣedhe sati iha yadi paravipratiṣedha evaṃ sati aprāpteyam / pūrvavipratiṣedha evam ubhayatra / katham ? iha pūrvā vibhāṣā paro nityo vidhiḥ / pūrvatra parā vibhāṣā pūrvo vidhir iti
analyzed: asaṃyoga antaḥ eva hi ūrṇotiḥ iti iha tu vacanam iṭ upajīvana artham atha vidhāyakam idam evam sati liṭ viṣaye na ārambhāt sa avakāśau etau iti vipratiṣedhe sati iha yadi para vipratiṣedhaḥ evam sati aprāptā iyam pūrva vipratiṣedhaḥ evam ubhayatra katham iha pūrvā vibhāṣā paraḥ nityaḥ vidhiḥ pūrvatra parā vibhāṣā pūrvaḥ vidhiḥ iti

original: aprāpte / anyad dhi kittvam anyat ṅittvam / vibhāṣayā ṅittvaṃ, nitye vidhau kittvam / etat śrutibhedād anyatvaṃ saṃprasāraṇāsaṃprasāraṇādikāryam etayor bhinnam iti /
analyzed: aprāpte anyat hi k it tvam anyat ṅ it tvam vibhāṣayā ṅ it tvam nitye vidhau k it tvam etat śruti bhedāt anya tvam saṃprasāraṇa a saṃprasāraṇa ādi kāryam etayoḥ bhinnam iti

original: ekaṃ cet ṅitkitau / katham ekatvam ? evaṃ manyate / nāyaṃ tadvad atideśaḥ / kiṃ tarhi ? kāryātideśaḥ / yad atideśāt pravartate tatkāryam / taccorṇoter ṅittve kittve cāviśiṣṭam / guṇapratiṣedho 'tra kāryam / sa tu kiṃ nityaḥ pratiṣedha āhosvit vibhāṣeti / etad āha---‘ekaṃ cet’ iti / yady api nānā evam api saṃdehaḥ /
analyzed: ekam ced ṅ it kitau katham eka tvam evam manyate na ayam tadvat atideśaḥ kim tarhi kārya atideśaḥ yat atideśāt pravartate tat kāryam tat ca ūrṇoteḥ ṅ it tve k it tve ca aviśiṣṭam guṇa pratiṣedhaḥ kāryam sa tu kim nityaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ āhosvit vibhāṣā iti etat āha ekam ced iti yadi api nānā evam api saṃdehaḥ

original: kathaṃ punar ‘vibhāṣorṇoḥ’ ity etat ‘sārvadhātukam apit’ (A 1.2.4) ity atra vartate ? iṭaś cāpittvāt vākyabhedena pravṛttir ity anumīyate / tatra yadi sārvadhātukaṃ ṅit bhavati ūrṇoter iha sārvadhātukaṃ vibhāṣeti prāpte / atha na svaryate viśeṣeṇa / tatra ‘sārvadhātukam apit’ ity asyāvakāśaḥ---cinutaḥ /
analyzed: katham punar vibhāṣā ūrṇoḥ iti etat sārvadhātukam a p it a iti atra vartate iṭaḥ ca a p it tvāt vākya bhedena pravṛttiḥ iti anumīyate tatra yadi sārvadhātukam ṅ it bhavati ūrṇoteḥ iha sārvadhātukam vibhāṣā iti prāpte atha na svaryate viśeṣeṇa tatra sārvadhātukam a p it iti asya avakāśaḥ cinutaḥ

original: ‘vibhāṣorṇoḥ’ ity asyāpi prorṇavitā prorṇuvitā / ihobhayaṃ prāpnoti---praurṇuvīti / ata āha---aprāpte / paravipratiṣedho 'yam iti /
analyzed: vibhāṣā ūrṇoḥ iti asya api prorṇavitā prorṇuvitā iha ubhayam prāpnoti praurṇuvīti atas āha aprāpte para vipratiṣedhaḥ yam iti

original: [51.4] vibhāṣopayamane / nanu ca gandhanopayam anayor atyantabhedāt saṃdehena na bhavitavyam / evaṃ manyate / gandhanāṅgam upayamanaṃ gandhanam iti vyapadiśyate / yathā yā yonau vidyotate, tasyā yā balāhakāt vidyotata iti / atra pūrvavipratiṣedhād vāprāpte vibhāṣā / atha vopayamānāśrayaṃ bhavati / na ca gandhanāśrayaṃ bhavati /
analyzed: vibhāṣā upayamane nanu ca anayoḥ atyanta bhedāt saṃdehena na bhavitavyam evam manyate gandhana aṅgam upayamanam gandhanam iti vyapadiśyate yathā yā yonau vidyotate tasyāḥ yā balāhakāt vidyotate iti atra pūrva vipratiṣedhāt vā aprāpte vibhāṣā atha vā upayama anāśrayam bhavati na ca gandhana āśrayam bhavati

original: kutaḥ ? tasyāprādhānyāt / ity evaṃ seyam aprāpte vibhāṣā /
analyzed: kutas tasya aprādhānyāt iti evam sā iyam aprāpte vibhāṣā

original: [51.5] anupasargād vā / upaparābhyām ity anenārambhād vā vṛttyādayo na saṃbadhyante eva / upaparāpūrve na saṃbhavanti vā vṛttyādayaḥ / ‘āṅaḥ udgamane’ (A 1.3.40) ity arthāntaram evopādīyate vṛttyādivirodhi / tathā ‘veḥ pādaviharaṇe’ (41) / ‘propābhyāṃ samarthābhyām’ (42) iti prārambhe samānārthatvam etayor na vṛttyādiṣu iti /
analyzed: an upasargāt vā upa parābhyām iti anena ārambhāt vā vṛtti ādayaḥ na saṃbadhyante eva upa parā pūrve na saṃbhavanti vā vṛtti ādayaḥ āṅaḥ udgamane iti artha antaram eva upādīyate vṛtti ādi virodhi tathā veḥ pāda viharaṇe 41 pra upābhyām samarthābhyām iti prārambhe samāna artha tvam etayoḥ na vṛtti ādiṣu iti

original: [51.6] vibhāṣā vṛkṣamṛgādīnām / ye 'tra mṛgādayaḥ prāṇinas te na saṃbadhyante ‘jātir aprāṇinām’ (A 2.4.6) ity anena / vṛkṣādayas tv aprāṇina eva, tatra ye carmamayā mṛgādayas tatreyaṃ vibhāṣā / na tu prāṇiṣv ity evaṃ bhavitavyam / prāpte vibhāṣā / ‘jātir aprāṇinām’ iti nivṛttam, pūrvavipratiṣedhaś ca /
analyzed: vibhāṣā vṛkṣa mṛga ādīnām ye tra mṛga ādayaḥ prāṇinaḥ te na saṃbadhyante jātiḥ aprāṇinām iti anena vṛkṣa ādayaḥ tu aprāṇinaḥ eva tatra ye carma mayāḥ mṛga ādayaḥ tatra iyam vibhāṣā na tu prāṇiṣu iti evam bhavitavyam prāpte vibhāṣā jātiḥ aprāṇinām iti nivṛttam pūrva vipratiṣedhaḥ ca

original: antareṇāpi pūrvavipratiṣedham iyam aprāpte vibhāṣā / gauṇamukhyayor mukhye saṃpratyaya iti mukhyeṣu paśuṣu vibhāṣā na mṛdgavādiṣu /
analyzed: antareṇa api pūrva vipratiṣedham iyam aprāpte vibhāṣā gauṇa mukhyayoḥ mukhye saṃpratyayaḥ iti mukhyeṣu paśuṣu vibhāṣā na mṛd gavādiṣu

original: [51.7] uṣavid . . . / pratyayāntād iti vāmi prāpte / ijāder ity atra pratyayāntād ity etan na saṃbadhyate / asyāpi vidher nityatvāt vacanānarthakyam āpadyate iti / atha kathaṃ pratyayāntā uṣādaya uṣādivyapadeśaṃ labhante, yāvatāaktaparimāṇānuṣādīn parigṛhya vibhāṣā vidhīyate ? ucyate /
analyzed: uṣ vid pratyaya antāt iti vāmi prāpte i c ādeḥ iti atra pratyaya antāt iti etat na saṃbadhyate asya api vidheḥ nitya tvāt vacana ānarthakyam āpadyate iti atha katham pratyaya antāḥ uṣa ādayaḥ uṣa ādi vyapadeśam labhante yāvatā aakta parimāṇān uṣa ādīn parigṛhya vibhāṣā vidhīyate ucyate

original: ‘sanādyantā dhātavaḥ’ (A 3.1.32) ity atra prakāracatuṣṭayam---tad ekadeśavijñānam, tadvad atideśaḥ, saṃjñāsaṃjñisaṃbandhaḥ, pratyākhyānam iti /
analyzed: san ādi antāḥ dhātavaḥ iti atra prakāra catuṣṭayam tat eka deśa vijñānam tadvat atideśaḥ saṃjñā saṃjñi saṃbandhaḥ pratyākhyānam iti

original: tad ekadeśavijñānaṃ tāvat---yathā samāsānta ity antagrahaṇena samāsaikadeśatvaṃ ḍajādīnām iti bahvṛcādigrahaṇena gṛhyante, evam ihāpi snādayo 'natā eṣām = ekadeśā eṣāṃ te ime sanādyantā ity evaṃvijñāyamāne uṣeḥ sanekadeśo gṛhyate uṣigrajaṇeneti / nanu caivaṃ kalpyamāne saṃjñāvidhir ayaṃ na bhavatīti sanā tadantavidhir asti /
analyzed: tat eka deśa vijñānam tāvati athā samāsa ante iti anta grahaṇena samāsa eka deśa tvam ḍaja ādīnām iti bahvṛca ādi grahaṇena gṛhyante evam iha api sna ādayaḥ natāḥ eṣām eka deśāḥ eṣām te ime san ādi antāḥ iti evam vijñāyamāne uṣeḥ gṛhyate nanu ca evam kalpyamāne saṃjñā vidhiḥ ayam na bhavati iti tad anta vidhiḥ asti

original: evaṃ ca sati sanantopyanyasyaikadeśo vijñāyeta /  naiṣaḥ doṣaḥ / samānārthasya vā sananta ekadeśaḥ syāt, anyārthasya vā / tatra samānārthasyoktatvāt prayogo nāsti pac pipakṣatīti / anyārthasya virodhāt asaṃbandhe sati prayogābhāvāt pipakṣatīti / atha vā sanādineva prādhānyenāśrayiṣyāṃaḥ / na ca pradhānena tadantavidhir astīti /
analyzed: evam ca sati san antaḥ upi anyasya eka deśaḥ vijñāyeta na eṣaḥ doṣaḥ samāna arthasya vā san antaḥ eka deśaḥ syāt anya arthasya vā tatra samāna arthasya ukta tvāt prayogaḥ na asti pac pipakṣati iti anya arthasya virodhāt asaṃbandhe sati prayoga abhāvāt pipakṣati iti atha vā san ādinā iva prādhānyena āśrayiṣyāṃaḥ na ca pradhānena tad anta vidhiḥ asti iti

original: ekadeśeṣu pratyayād ity anuvartamāne uṣigrahṇena grahaṇāt vibhāṣety evaṃ prāpte iyaṃ vibhāṣā / atha nivṛttam, kevalo 'pi uṣir uṣiḥ sanatopi / tatra yadi pūrvavipratiṣedha evam aprāpte paravipratiṣedha evam ubhayatrety asti saṃdehaḥ /
analyzed: eka deśeṣu pratyayāt iti anuvartamāne uṣi grahṇena grahaṇāt vibhāṣā iti evam prāpte iyam vibhāṣā atha nivṛttam uṣiḥ uṣiḥ tatra yadi pūrva vipratiṣedhaḥ evam aprāpte para vipratiṣedhaḥ evam ubhayatra iti asti saṃdehaḥ

original: atha vā tadvad atideśo 'yam, yathā ‘bahugaṇavatuḍ ati saṃkhyā’ (A 1.1.23)---saṃkhyāśabde ekādipadārthake āśrīyamāṇe tadvad atideśo vijñāyate---saṃkhyāvad bhavatīti /
analyzed: atha vā tadvat atideśaḥ yam yathā ati saṃkhyā saṃkhyā śabde eka ādi padārthake āśrīyamāṇe tadvat atideśaḥ vijñāyate saṃkhyāvat bhavati iti

original: etat tu parīkṣyam, saty api ca tadvad atideśe kim uṣādibhiḥ sanantaiḥ sāmānyātidiṣṭaṃ kāryaṃ labdhavyaṃ pratyayotpattiḥ, antodāttatvam, athoṣādīnām api yat kāryaṃ tad apīti / eṣa sāmānyakāryaṃ prati prakṛtaḥ / kuta etat ? sāmānye viśeṣāṇāṃ vyabhicāritvāt / yathā brāhmaṇavad asmin iti na māṭhare yat tad atidiśyate /

original: yatra tu viśeṣa uccarati, sā saṃjñā syāt yathā ‘vibhāṣā kṛvṛṣoḥ’ (A 3.1.120) iti cikīrṣateḥ saṃjñā syāt / etac ca pratyākhyātam---dhātvarthe vidhīyante sanādayaḥ, tatra sthānivadbhāvāt siddhā saṃjñeti / aprāpte / pratyayāntā dhātvantarāṇi /
analyzed: yatra tu viśeṣaḥ uccarati sā saṃjñā syāt yathā vibhāṣā kṛ vṛṣoḥ iti cikīrṣateḥ saṃjñā syāt etat ca pratyākhyātam dhātvarthe vidhīyante san ādayaḥ tatra sthānivat bhāvāt siddhā saṃjñā iti aprāpte pratyaya antāḥ dhātu antarāṇi

original: etad ākhyātam anena prakāreṇa naikadeśasaṃvijñānaṃ sanādīnāṃ, tadvad atideśo [vā], kiṃ tu saṃjñāsaṃjñisaṃbandhaḥ, pratyākhyānaṃ vā / tataś cādhhikyāt uṣādigrahaṇenāgrahaṇāt saṃdeho nopapadyate / apare saṃśayam evaṃ varṇayanti / uṣiḥ kvibanta ācāre kvipā pratyayāntaś ca bhavati tacchrutiś ceti /
analyzed: etat ākhyātam anena prakāreṇa na eka deśa saṃvijñānam sana ādīnām tadvat atideśaḥ vā kim tu saṃjñā saṃjñi saṃbandhaḥ pratyākhyānam vā tatas ca ādhhikyāt uṣa ādi grahaṇena agrahaṇāt saṃdehaḥ na upapadyate apare saṃśayam evam varṇayanti uṣiḥ kvip antaḥ ācāre kvipā pratyaya antaḥ ca bhavati tad śrutiḥ ca iti

original: idam apy evaṃ samarthayante ‘pratyayāntā dhātvantarāṇi’ iti / naitasmād ācārakvib astīti /
analyzed: idam api evam samarthayante pratyaya antāḥ dhātu antarāṇi iti na etasmāt ācāra kvip asti iti

original: [51.8] dipādīnāṃ vibhāṣā / ‘dīpajana . . . ’ (A 3.1.61) ity etat svaryate itīhānumitam / samudāyenānumīyate---bhāvakarmaṇoś ciṇ bhavati, dīpādīnāṃ vibhāṣeti / na tv aṅgāṅgibhāvena / kuta etat ? pṛthakpāṭhāt / itarathā hy evam eva paṭhet---‘bhāvakarmaṇor dīpādibhyo vibhāṣā’ iti /
analyzed: dipa ādīnām vibhāṣā dīpa jana iti etat svaryate iti iha anumitam samudāyena anumīyate bhāva karmaṇoḥ ciṇ bhavati dīpa ādīnām vibhāṣā iti na tu aṅga aṅgi bhāvena kutas etat pṛthak pāṭhāt itarathā hi evam eva paṭhet bhāva karmaṇoḥ dīpa ādibhyaḥ vibhāṣā iti

original: atha vidhāyakam idam, kartarīti ca nivṛttam, paravipratiṣedhāt aprāpte, pūrvavipratiṣedhād ubhayatra prāpte iyaṃ vibhāṣā /
analyzed: atha vidhāyakam idam kartari iti ca nivṛttam para vipratiṣedhāt aprāpte pūrva vipratiṣedhāt ubhayatra prāpte iyam vibhāṣā

original: aprāpte / kartarīti hi vartate / vidhāyakaṃ cedam ity abhiprāyaḥ / evam api saṃdeho nyāyye vā kartari karmakartari veti / yadi kartarīty etad api svaryate, tatra kartṛparigṛhītā dīpādayo vākyabhedeneha kriyāśabdaṃ labhante / bhāvakarmaṇoś ciṇ bhavati / dīpādibhyaḥ kartari karmaṇi vibhāṣeti prāpte yaṃ vibhāṣā /
analyzed: aprāpte kartari iti hi vartate vidhāyakam ca idam iti abhiprāyaḥ evam api saṃdehaḥ nyāyye vā kartari karma kartari vā iti yadi kartari iti etat api svaryate tatra kartṛ parigṛhītāḥ dīpa ādayaḥ vākya bhedena iha kriyā śabdam labhante bhāva karmaṇoḥ ciṇ bhavati dīpa ādibhyaḥ kartari karmaṇi vibhāṣā iti prāpte yam vibhāṣā

original: atha kartarīti na svaryate, karmakartā kartā bhavatīti dīpādīnāṃ karmakartari ubhayaprāptau pūrvaparavipratiṣedhāhyāṃ saṃdeha upapadyate / sakarmakasya kartā karmavad bhavatīti / yady api budhiḥ sakarmakas tathāpy ekarasaṃ parihāraṃ vakṣyāmīti aviśeṣeṇoktam---akarkāś ca dīpādaya iti / sopasargāḥ sakarmakā bhavantīti /
analyzed: atha kartari iti na svaryate karma kartā kartā bhavati iti dīpa ādīnām karma kartari ubhaya prāptau pūrva para vipratiṣedha āhyām saṃdehaḥ upapadyate sakarmakasya kartā karma vat bhavati iti yadi api budhiḥ sakarmakaḥ tathā api ekarasam parihāram vakṣyāmi iti aviśeṣeṇa uktam akarkāḥ ca dīpa ādayaḥ iti sa upasargāḥ sakarmakāḥ bhavanti iti

original: sopasargo hy arthāntaravṛttitvaṃ pratilabhate, bhavati anubhavatīti / karmasthabhāvakānāṃ karmasthakriyāṇām iti / parispandāparispandabhedena vibhakto 'rthātmā bhedenopātto---bhāvaḥ kriyeti / kathaṃ punar etal labhyam ? evaṃ tatroktam---‘karmasthakriyā karmaśabdenocyate’ iti / yathā pacatiḥ karmasthakriyaḥ /
analyzed: sa upasargaḥ hi artha antara vṛtti tvam pratilabhate bhavati anubhavati iti karma stha bhāvakānām karma stha kriyāṇām iti parispanda a parispanda bhedena vibhaktaḥ rtha ātmā bhedena upāttaḥ bhāvaḥ kriyā iti katham punar etat labhyam evam tatra uktam karma stha kriyā karma śabdena ucyate iti yathā pacatiḥ karma stha kriyaḥ

original: karmaṇi hi kriyākṛto viśeṣa upalabhyata iti /
analyzed: karmaṇi hi kriyā kṛtaḥ viśeṣaḥ upalabhyate iti

original: idaṃ tu ‘acaḥ kartṛyaki’ (A 6.1.15) ity anena virudhyate / evaṃ hi tatrāvasthitaṃ ‘jāyate svayam eva’ iti / janer upadeśe evātvam / tataś copadeśe 'janto 'yam iti / yadi ca kartṛsthabhāvako 'yam, kuto 'sya kartṛyak ? iti /
analyzed: idam tu a caḥ kartṛ yaki iti anena virudhyate evam hi tatra avasthitam jāyate svayam eva iti janeḥ upadeśe eva a tvam tatas ca upadeśe yam iti yadi ca kartṛ stha bhāvakaḥ yam kutas sya kartṛ yak iti

original: [51.9] vibhāṣāgre[prathamapūrveṣu] / ābhīkṣṇye iti nivṛttam, pūrvavipratiṣedhaś ca / tatra tv idam uktam---‘agrādiṣv aprāptavidheḥ samāsapratiṣedhaḥ’ iti / aprāptavidhāne hy agrādayo nimittaṃ pratyayotpattau / atha tu prāpta iyaṃ vibhāṣā, evaṃ sati nivṛtter nimittam agrādaya ity upapadatvabhāva iti /
analyzed: vibhāṣā agre prathama pūrveṣu ābhīkṣṇye iti nivṛttam pūrva vipratiṣedhaḥ ca tatra tu idam uktam agra ādiṣu aprāpta vidheḥ samāsa pratiṣedhaḥ iti aprāpta vidhāne hi agra ādayaḥ nimittam pratyaya utpattau atha tu prāpte iyam vibhāṣā evam sati nivṛttyāḥ nimittam agra ādayaḥ iti upapada tva bhāvaḥ iti

original: atha tu prāpta iyaṃ vibhāṣā, evaṃ sati nivṛtter nimittagrādaya ity upapadatvābhāva iti / parihāraścokto 'maiva yat saha nirdiṣṭam upapadaṃ tat samasyata iti /

original: [51.10] tṛnnādīnāṃ vibhāṣā / ‘tṛnnannatīkṣṇaśuciṣu’ (A 6.2.161) iti, ‘ākrośe ca’, ‘saṃjñāyām’ iti---yadi ‘ackau’ iti nivṛttam, ataḥ saṃdehena bhavitavyam / atha ‘ākrośe’ ity atra ackāv anuvartete, niḥsaṃdigdham aprāptavibhāṣeyam /
analyzed: tṛn n ādīnām vibhāṣā tṛn anna tīkṣṇa śuciṣu A iti ākrośe ca saṃjñāyām iti yadi a c kau iti nivṛttam atas saṃdehena bhavitavyam atha ākrośe iti atra a c anuvartete niḥsaṃdigdham aprāpta vibhāṣā iyam

original: [51.11] ekahalādau (A 6.3.59) ‘saṃjñāyām’ ity anuvṛttam / ‘aiṣaṃ vāsa . . .’ (58) ity atra nānumīyeta, ārambhasāmarthyāt / asti punaḥ kācit saṃjñā saṃbhavati ‘ekahalādau pūrayitavye’ ? astīty āha---upadānam iti /
analyzed: eka ha l ādau saṃjñāyām iti anuvṛttam aiṣam vāsaḥ iti atra na anumīyeta ārambha sāmarthyāt asti punar kācid saṃjñā saṃbhavati eka ha l ādau pūrayitavye asti iti āha aupadānam iti

original: [51.12] cādibhir yoga iti / kasya yoge ? yuṣmadasmadoḥ / grāmas tava ca svaṃ mama ca svam iti / yadā tu svasya yogas tadā bhavamty evādeśāḥ / grāmaś ca te svam / nagaraṃ ca me svam iti /

original: [51.13] yaṅi iti vā nitye prāpte / ‘aci vibhāṣā’ (A 8.2.21) ity atra ‘yaṅi’ iti vartate / yaṅi acīti / tatraivaṃ bhavitavyam, yatra yaṅparaḥ ajanantato bhavatīti / kva ca bhavatīti ? yaṅluki nijegila iti / apare varṇayanti / avayavalope kṛte yaṅi ya ekadeśas tasminn acīti /

original: saṃjñayā samāsanirdeśo tu saṃjñāyā akramāḥ saṃjñino yugapatpratipadyamānāḥ sarvair anudeśibhiḥ saṃ[ba]dheran / evaṃ samāsanirdeśe 'pi samudā[yā]tmaka eko 'rtho 'bhinno dvaṃdvenocyate iti idam uktaṃ vākyakāreṇa ‘saṃjñāsamāsanirdeśāt sarvaprasaṅgo 'nudeśasya’ /

original: tatra yathāsaṃkhyād evaṃ pratipadyeran iti tipo ṇal bhavati, tasaḥ atus bhavati, ity ataḥ samāsanirdeśo na kalpaśakyaḥ (?) saṃbandhayitum ity etad ācaṣṭe samāsanirdeśo 'yam iti /

original: [3] yady api [tāvat] loka eṣa dṛṣṭāntaḥ yady api loke darśanam / dṛṣṭāntasyāpi tu darśanasyāpi tu / puruṣārambha iti / apūrvam idam aprasiddhaṃ loke ārambhasādhyam iti kathyate /

original: [4] kau punaḥ ṭakitau bhavataḥ iti / etat pṛcchati---yasya ṭakitau [a]bhidhīyete kau tau tasya bhavataḥ ? kiṃbhūtaḥ ādir bhavati, anto vā ? āgamāv ity āha / avasthita ārdhadhātuke paścād vidhīyamāno 'vayavāntaram anivartayann avayavatvaṃ pratipadyate ity etad ācaṣṭe /

original: [5] yuktaṃ punaḥ [yan] nityeṣv iti / śāstrasiddhānto 'yaṃ na bhavatīty etat bravīti / atha kenacit prakāreṇa itavya evāyaṃ svabhāvataḥ, kim anena iṭ bhavatīti ? atha yuktaṃ yann ity eṣu śabdeṣv iti / yathaivāsti[mapamṛdya bhavatiṃ] pratipadyase nitye 'pi śabda, evam āgamam api pratipadyasv eveti / śabdāntarair iha bhavitavyam iti /
analyzed: yuktam punar yat nityeṣu iti śāstra siddhāntaḥ yam na bhavati iti etat bravīti atha kenacid prakāreṇa itavyaḥ eva ayam svabhāvataḥ kim anena iṭ bhavati iti atha yuktam yan iti eṣu śabdeṣu iti yathā eva āstim apamṛdya bhavatim pratipadyase nitye pi śabde evam āgamam api pratipadyasu eva iti śabda antaraiḥ iha bhavitavyam iti

original: itsaṃjñau ca saṃjñeti pratijñātam / tatretsaṃjñakānāṃ yo deśas taddeśatvād iddharmeṇa vyapadiṣṭau nivṛttisāmānyāc ca yathetsaṃjño nivartate evam etāv api iti / tena iḍ iti yaṣṭakāraḥ tenādyartha upasthāpyaḥ ity etad uktaṃ bhavati iṭ, bhavatīti / sarvasmiṃś cādeśe ikārādau prasakte sthāne 'ntaratamatvāt tavyasya itavyo bhavatīti /

original: evam ihāpi ‘careṣ ṭaḥ’ iti yadi tannimittam ādyantaparibhāṣāyās tatsaṃdihyate, kimīkārārtham athādyartham, iti yathā iḍāgamādiṣu pravartata evam ihāpi pravartate, śramādīnāṃ tu vyavasthitaṃ prayojanāntarābhāvād asaṃdigdham iti nimittaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ cāsaṃdigdhe tataś cāpavādatvaṃ yuktam itīdam āha---viṣama upanyāsa iti /

original: [13] prayojanaṃ nāma [tad] vaktavyaṃ yan niyogataḥ syāt tatorayojanam / sa (?) ceha nimittaṃ yad anapekṣya kiṃcit pravartate, yathā ‘kamer ṇiṅ’ (A 3.1.30) iti ṅitkaraṇam ātmanepadārthaṃ, vṛddhipratiṣedhārthaṃ, sāmānyagrahaṇāvighātārthaṃ vānyanirapekṣaṃ pravartate / ṇakāraḥ sāmānyagrahaṇe vṛddhau ca /

original: evam iha tātaṅo ṅittvaṃ na ṅittvamātrād eva guṇapratiṣedhe pravartate / kīṃ tarhi ? sati sarvādeśe / evaṃ ṭittvasyāpi prayojanaṃ śakyaṃ vaktuṃ tadā yadi paraḥ, saṃbhavati tataṣṭittvam īkārasya nimittam iti /

original: yasmāt prayojanāt saṃdigdhatvaṃ ṭittvasya parigṛhyate, tad eva prayojanaṃ paratvapratibaddham ity ataḥ saṃdehanimittam ity asaṃdehāt paratvam anena bādhitavyam iti idam ucyate---nāpavādatvād iti /

original: tatra kecid evaṃ pratipannāḥ ---sāmānyāpahṛtabuddher viśeṣam apratipadyamānasya pratipattur viśeṣepra[ti]pattyupāyo 'yam / ‘viśeṣo 'trācāryasya vi[va]kṣitaḥ, sthāneyogatvaṃ nāma / evaṃ pratipadyasva ṣaṣṭhīnirdeśeṣu’ iti / apare manyante---‘aster’ ity etat sāmānyarūpaṃ notsahate viśeṣam upādātum iti sthāna ity etad upatiṣṭhate /

original: tad apasthānād idaṃ vākyam anumīyate ---asteḥ sthāne bhūr bhavati iti /

original: [2.1.1] avayavaṣaṣṭhyādaas tu na sidhyanti / aviśeṣasya vivakṣitatvāt na sidhyanti / aviśeṣasya vivakṣitatvā[d a]tra vākyāntaropalpavaḥ / goha iti copadhāyā iti [ca] sthānaṣaṣṭhyāv ete iti gohaś cāntyasya syāt, yatra vikṛtaḥ, kṅitsu na syāt / upadhāmātrasya ca syād dhātvantarasya pacāder iti /

original: [2.1.1.1] avayavaṣaṣṭhyādīnāṃ cāprāptir yo[ga]syāsaṃdigdhatvāt (vā 3.) / aprāptir iti [na] ṣaṣṭhyā evāprāptiḥ / kiṃ tarhi ? niyamasyāprāptir iti / kathaṃ yad etat bhavatā pratipādyate ‘ṣaṣṭhyā vacanaṃ niyamārtham’ iti ? yatrānekārthaḥ saṃbhavati tatra niyamo 'nena kriyate /
analyzed: avayava ṣaṣṭhī ādīnām ca aprāptiḥ yogasya asaṃdigdha tvāt vā aprāptiḥ iti na ṣaṣṭhyāḥ eva aprāptiḥ kim tarhi niyamasya aprāptiḥ iti katham yat etat bhavatā pratipādyate ṣaṣṭhyāḥ vacanam niyama artham iti yatra aneka arthaḥ saṃbhavati tatra niyamaḥ nena kriyate

original: yatra cānyo 'rtho nirdiṣṭas tatra ca tannivṛttiṃ sthāneyogatvaṃ kalpayati ity etan na yuktam / yadi hi mayā yathā pratijñātaṃ tathā pratipadyase, niyamasyānekārthasaṃbhave pratipattir yuktā / na tv arthāntaraṃ nivartya tatra vidheyaṃ sthāneyogatvam iti /

analyzed: i kaḥ ya ṇ a ci dadhi atra madhu atra ubhaya upādānam udāhriyate yasmin asya saṃyogaḥ tat ca udāharaṇam yat artham ca udāhriyate tat ca udāharaṇam praśnaḥ tu lakṣaṇa antareṇa api siddha tvāt anarthakam etat iti ayam tu vaiṣamya mātram paśyan upanyasyati i kaḥ ya ṇ a ci iti evam manyate ikaḥ iti bahavaḥ

original: sthānino bhavanti / ikārokārau pranyekam aṣṭādaśadhābhedāt ṣaṭtriṃśat / ṛkāra[ḷkā]reṇa saha triṃśad ity evaṃ ṣaṭṣaṣṭir bhedāḥ / yaṇo 'pi sapteti / atha vā, lṛkārasya sthānitvaṃ nāsti asaṃbhavād, iti sthānyādeśavaiṣamyam /
analyzed: sthāninaḥ bhavanti ikāra ukārau aṣṭādaśadhā bhedāt ṣaṭtriṃśat ṛkāra ḷkāreṇa saha triṃśat iti evam ṣaṭṣaṣṭiḥ bhedāḥ sapta iti atha vā sthāni tvam na asti asaṃbhavāt iti sthāni ādeśa vaiṣamyam

original: saṃkhyātānudeśenāpy etat [siddham] / [a]pūrvo 'yaṃ vaiṣamyaprakāraḥ / atra na vyaktibheda āśrīyate / kiṃ tarhi ? jātiḥ / igjātir yaṇjātiś ca / tāsāṃ cobhayataś catuṣṭayam / yad apy uktaṃ ḷkāro nāstīti / na prayogaviṣayaṃ yathāsaṃkhyam / kiṃ tarhi ? anudeśaviṣayam /
analyzed: saṃkhyāta anudeśena api etat siddham apūrvaḥ yam vaiṣamya prakāraḥ atra na vyakti bhedaḥ āśrīyate kim tarhi jātiḥ i k jātiḥ yaṇ jātiḥ ca tāsām ca ubhayatas catuṣṭayam yat api uktam ḷkāraḥ na asti iti na prayoga viṣayam yathāsaṃkhyam kim tarhi anudeśa viṣayam

original: [tasthasthamipāṃ tāṃ]taṃtāmaḥ (A 3.4.101) / ayam abhiprāyo---yadā svaritena cihnena yathāsaṃkhyaṃ pratipadyate, tadā ‘iko yaṇ aci’ iti ikārasya prayoge 'samavāyino 'narthakaṃ svaritakaraṇam / yaṇo 'py evam eva / yakārasyājguṇo nāstīti svaritakaraṇam anarthakaṃ manyamāno yathāsaṃkhyaṃ pratipadyate /
analyzed: tas thas tha mipām tām tam tāmaḥ ayam abhiprāyaḥ yadā svaritena cihnena yathāsaṃkhyam pratipadyate tadā i kaḥ ya ṇ a ci iti ikārasya prayoge samavāyinaḥ narthakam svarita karaṇam evam eva yakārasya a c guṇaḥ na asti iti svarita karaṇam anarthakam manyamānaḥ yathāsaṃkhyam pratipadyate

original: tāmādīnāṃ tu svaritakaraṇaṃ prayogasamavāyināṃ śrutyartham api syāt iti na yathāsaṃkhyaṃ pratipadyate / ekārthasyaikārtha iti / pradarśanamātram etat / evaṃ pratyantā(? -ktvā)parabhāvaḥ caitanyopādhir ity e[te] hy arthāḥ saṃbhavino, yeṣu ya[? sa]tsu vacanānāṃ vyatikaro na bhavati / na hi tāmādeśasthasaḥ sthāne pravartate /
analyzed: tāma ādīnām tu svarita karaṇam prayoga samavāyinām śruti artham api syāt iti na yathāsaṃkhyam pratipadyate ekārthasya ekārthaḥ iti pradarśana mātram etat evam pratyantā ktvā apara bhāvaḥ caitanya upādhiḥ iti ete hi arthāḥ saṃbhavinaḥ yeṣu satsu vacanānām vyatikaraḥ na bhavati na hi sthāne pravartate

original: nanu caitad api saṃkhyātānudeśenaiva siddham / śakyam etat vyākhyānāt pratipattuṃ hita(? svarita)karaṇam eṣāṃ yathāsaṃkhyārtham, na śravaṇārtham iti hy anayoḥ svaritakaraṇam adhikārārtham eva, na śravaṇārtham /
analyzed: nanu ca etat api saṃkhyāta anudeśena eva siddham śakyam etat vyākhyānāt pratipattum hita svarita karaṇam eṣām yathā saṃkhyā artham na śravaṇa artham iti hi anayoḥ svarita karaṇam adhikāra artham eva na śravaṇa artham

original: [1.2] yatrānekam āntaryaṃ tatreti / a[tra] svaritakaraṇāc chabāntaraṃ sūtrāntare anumīyate / anumīyamānaṃ cāntaratama ity etat apekṣamāṇaṃ vyāpriyate bhedena sthāne sthāna iti / tenāyam artho labhyate---sthāne 'ntaratamo bhavati, sthāne ca yo 'ntaratamaḥ sa bhavatīti /
analyzed: yatra anekam āntaryam tatra iti atra svarita karaṇāt śapa antaram sūtra antare anumīyate anumīyamānam ca antaratamaḥ iti etat apekṣamāṇam vyāpriyate bhedena sthāne sthāne iti tena ayam arthaḥ labhyate sthāne ntaratamaḥ bhavati sthāne ca yaḥ ntaratamaḥ sa bhavati iti

original: yatrāneko 'ntaratamaḥ saṃbhavati, sa cānekārtho bhinnena nimittena pravartate, tatra sthānāntaratamyaṃ balīya iti / itarathā hy ekakriyāsaṃnipāte ‘[sthāne] sthāne 'ntaratamo bhavatī’ti arthaguṇapramāṇāntaratamyaṃ nivartitam eva syāt / athāpy etāv iti vyāpriyate sthāne bhavatīty akiṃcitkaraṃ bhavatīti /
analyzed: yatra anekaḥ ntaratamaḥ saṃbhavati sa ca aneka arthaḥ bhinnena nimittena pravartate tatra sthāna āntaratamyam balīyaḥ iti itarathā hi eka kriyā saṃnipāte sthāne sthāne ntaratamaḥ bhavati iti artha guṇa pramāṇa āntaratamyam nivartitam eva syāt atha api etau iti vyāpriyate sthāne bhavati iti akiṃcitkaram bhavati iti

original: kaścid ekena nimittenāntaraḥ, kaścit bahubhiḥ / yo bahubhiḥ sa kathaṃ syād iti / yathā loke kaścid ekapitṛkaḥ nānāmātṛkaḥ, kaścid ekamātṛkaḥ nānāpitṛkaś ceti, kaścid ekapitṛkaḥ ekamātṛkaś ceti / yadi ca laukikīmayam avasthāṃ pratipadyate, tam agrahaṇam anarthakam / laukikyāṃ pratipattau sūtram eva pratyākhyāyate /
analyzed: kaścid ekena nimittena antaraḥ kaścid bahubhiḥ yaḥ bahubhiḥ sa katham syāt iti yathā loke kaścid eka pitṛkaḥ nānā mātṛkaḥ kaścid eka mātṛkaḥ nānā pitṛkaḥ ca iti kaścid eka pitṛkaḥ eka mātṛkaḥ ca iti yadi ca laukikīm ayam avasthām pratipadyate tam a grahaṇam anarthakam laukikyām pratipattau sūtram eva pratyākhyāyate

original: [2] kimarthaṃ punar idam ucyate / nanu ca prayojanam uktam, ‘akaḥ savarṇe dīrghaḥ’ (A 6.1.101) iti / ucyate / etad ayaṃ pṛcchati---yadīdaṃ nocyeta, kim aniṣṭaṃ syād iti / sthānina eka[tva]nirdeśāt / kathaṃ sthānī ekatvena nirdiśyate ? yadi tāvat saṃjñayā, ādeśo 'py eka eva dīrgha iti /
analyzed: kimartham punar idam ucyate nanu ca prayojanam uktam a kaḥ savarṇe dīrghaḥ iti ucyate etat ayam pṛcchati yadi idam na ucyeta kim aniṣṭam syāt iti sthāninaḥ eka tva nirdeśāt katham sthānī eka tvena nirdiśyate yadi tāvat saṃjñayā ekaḥ eva dīrghaḥ iti

original: atha saṃjñibhedād anekatvam ādeśa[sya], sthānino 'py anekatvam / tatra bhūtatvā[t] sthānī ekatvena nirdiśyata ity ucyate---‘akaḥ’ iti / bhūtavibhaktyā sthānī aci savarṇe nirdiśyamāno na saṃbhavati aneka iti bhedarūpatayā nocyate ‘akaḥ’ ity anena / ‘dīrghaḥ’ iti tu bhāvyamānatvāt bahurūpatayā saṃbhavatīti aneka iti [ni]rdiśyate /
analyzed: atha saṃjñi bhedāt aneka tvam ādeśasya sthāninaḥ u pi aneka tvam tatra bhūta tvāt sthānī eka tvena nirdiśyate iti ucyate akaḥ iti bhūta vibhaktyā sthānī a ci savarṇe nirdiśyamānaḥ na saṃbhavati anekaḥ iti bheda rūpatayā na ucyate akaḥ iti anena dīrghaḥ iti tu bhāvyamāna tvāt bahu rūpatayā saṃbhavati iti anekaḥ iti nirdiśyate

original: yathā loke ‘mṛtpiṇḍasya vikāraṃ kuru’ iti mṛtpiṇḍam ekatvena pratipadyate, vikāram eka(? -ramaneka)tvena / ātaś cānekatvena, yatra pratipadyate vikāraṃ karomīti / evam iha ‘dīrghaḥ’ iti bhāvyamānatvād ekaikasyākaḥ savarṇe paryāyeṇa savarṇadīrghāḥ prasaktā iti /
analyzed: yathā loke mṛd piṇḍasya vikāram kuru iti mṛd piṇḍam ekatvena pratipadyate vikāram ca anekatvena yatra pratipadyate vikāram karomi iti evam iha dīrghaḥ iti bhāvyamāna tvāt ekaikasya a kaḥ savarṇe paryāyeṇa savarṇa dīrghāḥ prasaktāḥ iti

original: apare varṇayanti / yathā saṃjñāsamāsanirdeśeṣu kramasyābhāvāt mithonirdeśe 'sati, sarvaprasaṅge yathāsaṃkhyam ārabhyeta, evam ihāpi ‘akaḥ’ iti saṃjñānirdeśe 'bhedarūpe, mithonirdeśe 'sati, ‘dīrghaḥ’ iti ca saṃjñānirdeśe sarvasyokālasyācaḥ pravṛttāv ayam artho 'śakyo 'syākaḥ ayaṃ dīrgho bhavatīti / kim arthaṃ punar mithonirdeśo na kṛta iti /
analyzed: apare varṇayanti yathā saṃjñā samāsa nirdeśeṣu kramasya abhāvāt mithas nirdeśe sati sarva prasaṅge yathāsaṃkhyam ārabhyeta evam iha api a kaḥ iti saṃjñā nirdeśe bheda rūpe mithas nirdeśe sati dīrghaḥ iti ca saṃjñā nirdeśe sarvasya u kālasya a caḥ pravṛttau ayam sya a kaḥ ayam dīrghaḥ bhavati iti kim artham punar mithas nirdeśaḥ na kṛtaḥ iti

original: laghvartham idam ata ārabhyate ‘sthāne 'ntaratamaḥ’ iti /
analyzed: laghu artham idam atas ārabhyate sthāne ntaratamaḥ iti

original: [3] yathā punar iyam antaratamanirvṛttiḥ / [yathā punar iti /] yena prakāreṇa / yaś ca saṃhitāpāṭhaḥ / saṃhitayā [pā]ṭhe ca viśevatā saṃhitāpyasvi (?) tatrānena saṃhitayā ye 'dhyetāras te praṣṭavyāḥ / tatredaṃ darśanam---padaprakṛtiḥ saṃhitā (ṚV 2.1) iti / saṃhitaiva hi satyā asatyānāṃ padānāṃ prakṛtiḥ /
analyzed: yathā punar iyam antaratama nirvṛttiḥ yathā punar iti yena prakāreṇa yaḥ ca saṃhitā pāṭhaḥ saṃhitayā pāṭhe ca viśevatā saṃhitā api asvi tatra anena saṃhitayā ye dhyetāraḥ te praṣṭavyāḥ tatra idam darśanampada prakṛtiḥ saṃhitā iti saṃhitā eva hi satyā asatyānām padānām prakṛtiḥ

original: tataḥ padānyapodghriyante kuryārthā (? kutaḥ ? artha)syācicchedā[t] śabdasyāpy avicchedaḥ / evaṃ ca kṛtvā ekapadenāsaṃhitā (?) / tatra ‘sthāne 'ntaratama uraṇ raparaḥ’ ity asya kiṃbhūtaṃ padam apoddhartavyam ity eta[d] atra pṛcchati / ‘sthāne ntara[ta]ma’ ity atra ‘ṣaṣṭhī’ [iti] vartate /

original: tenātrādeśasya yā prakṛtir antaratamā saiva ṣaṣṭhyā nirdiṣṭā, nā(? a)nyā naiva nirdiṣṭeti prakṛtiniyamo 'yaṃ vijñāyate / ādeśāntaratamye tu prakṛter aniyamāt sarvatra ṣaṣṭhī, ādeśas tu niyamayate---ayaṃ na [bha]vaty ayaṃ bhavatīti /
analyzed: tena atra ādeśasya yā prakṛtiḥ antaratamā sā eva ṣaṣṭhyā nirdiṣṭā na anyā na eva nirdiṣṭā iti prakṛti niyamaḥ yam vijñāyate ādeśa āntaratamye tu prakṛteḥ aniyamāt sarvatra ṣaṣṭhī ādeśaḥ tu niyamayate ayam na bhavati ayam bhavati iti

original: iko yaṇ acīti / kecid iko dūraviprakṛṣṭāḥ, arthamātrikebhyo dvimātrāḥ / mātrikās tv īṣatsaṃnikṛṣṭā iti hrasvair eva ṣaṣṭhī labdhā, [na] dīrghair iti /

original: nanu cānudāharaṇam etad ityādāv uktam / satyam, evam etat / yadādeśāntaryapakṣas tadānyena siddhatvāt anudāharaṇam / prakṛtyāntaryapalṣe sarvaprathamam idam eva prayojanam / katham ? dīrghā ikaḥ ṣaṣṭhī na pratipadyante iti / yac ca tad uktam---sthānāntaryaṃ balīya iti, tatrānekena nimittena dvau kaścit sthānena kaścit pramāṇenety evamuktam /
analyzed: nanu ca anudāharaṇam etat ityādau uktam satyam evam etat yadā ādeśa āntarya pakṣaḥ tadā anyena siddha tvāt anudāharaṇam prakṛtyā āntarya palṣe sarva prathamam idam eva prayojanam katham dīrghāḥ i kaḥ ṣaṣṭhī na pratipadyante iti yat ca tat uktam sthāna āntaryam balīyaḥ iti tatra anekena nimittena dvau kaścid sthānena kaścid pramāṇena iti evam uktam

original: ayaṃ ca yaṇaḥ sthānena pramāṇena cāntara iti /

original: nanu nāyako lāvakaḥ---‘acaḥ . . . (A 7.2.115)’ ity evaṃ vṛddhi[ḥ], na tv iglakṣaṇā / atrāpy aca iti cāntaratamā prakṛtir iti yohayitavyam /

original: tathā ṛvarṇasya guṇavṛddhiprasaṅge iti / kimarthaṃ punar idam ucyate ? ‘iko guṇavṛddhī’ ity anenaiva coditaṃ syāt / eṣa viśeṣaḥ---guṇo mātrike syāt, vṛddhimātre (? dvimātre) na syāt / vṛddhir astu dvimātre syāt, na mātrikasyeti / atra tv iko dīrghasyobhe api syātām iti /

original: ‘vānto yi pratyaye’ (A 6.1.79) / sthāninirdeśaḥ kartavyaḥ / sarvasyaico nirdiṣṭatvāt sarvasya vānta ādeśaḥ syāt / prakṛtipakṣe tu saṃśli(? -śri)te vāntasyāntaratamā prakṛtirokāraukārāv iti nārthaḥ sthāni[ni]rdeśena / atra vṛttisūtre katham avasthitam ? bhūtāpekṣāyāṃ pravartitavyam / tarhi ‘ecaḥ’ ity etad anuvartate ‘vānto yi’ ity atra /
analyzed: sthāni nirdeśaḥ kartavyaḥ sarvasya e caḥ nirdiṣṭa tvāt sarvasya vāntaḥ ādeśaḥ syāt prakṛti pakṣe tu śrite vāntasya antaratamā prakṛtiḥ okāra aukārau iti na arthaḥ sthāni nirdeśena atra vṛtti sūtre katham avasthitam bhūta apekṣāyām pravartitavyam tarhi e caḥ iti etat anuvartate vāntaḥ y iti atra

original: kiṃ tu yo vānta ādeśo 'cy atra dṛṣṭaḥ, sa bhavati yi pratyaya iti / etāvad apekṣyate --- kasya vāsau dṛṣṭo 'ci parabhūte ? okāraukārayor iti /

original: tayos tarhi śakyārthād anyatreti / evaṃ manyate---śakyārtha ity asya parityāge kṣeyādayaḥ [na] śakyante nirvartayitum iti / ubhayato niyama iti / yogavibhāgo ['ya]m iti vyācaṣṭe / kṣayyajayyāv iti anena ceyādayo nirvartitāḥ / śakyārtha ity anenāpy etayor anyatrāprasaṅgaḥ /

original: tasmāt vikaraṇe kṛte tannimitte cettve sādhutvasyābhyanujñānāt nāsti avyavasthā / iha tu dvivacane ubhayaṃ nityam, āṅgaṃ vikaraṇaś ca / paratvāt āṅge kṛte paścāt vikaraṇa iti repho 'bhaktatvāt tatra [dhātvavayavo na] bhavatīti rephāt parasya vikaraṇasyāsādhutvaṃ prasaktam /

original: athāpi vikaraṇāt paro rephaḥ sa kalpate, aṇaḥ paro na bhavatīti rūpāprasiddhiś ceti dvivacane eva pratyayā[vya]vasthodāhriyate /

original: [4.2] pūrvānte rvavadhāraṇam / ‘roḥ supi’ (A 8.3.16) iti niyamārthaṃ kartavyam / gīrṣu, pūrṣu, ayaṃ hi supi padānta iti / parāditve sati tu subgrahaṇenaiva gṛhyante iti / abhakto 'pi tadādivacanāt prāpnoti iti kartavyaṃ rvavadhāraṇam / parādāv api yaḥ svābhāvikas tasya nivṛttyarthaṃ [karta]vyam, iha mā bhūt---caturṣv iti /

original: nārkalpir ityevamartham / kalpipadasaṃghā[ta]bhakto 'yaṃ notsahate 'vayavasya padāntatāṃ vihantum / nṛkalpaśabdād iñi vihite vṛddhau kriyamāṇāyāṃ rephaḥ parādiḥ kasya bhavat ? pratyayasamudāyasya kalpiśabdasya / samudāyaṃ prati tadavayavo repho na śakyate tasmin pūrva iti vyavacchettum /

analyzed: tātaṅi ṅ it karaṇasya sa avakāśa tvāt iti sthāna antara prāptyā bādhyate devadatta putraḥ iti samāsa anta udātta tvena kārakāt datta śrutayoḥ etat bādhyate evam ṅ it ca iti yadi api sarva anusaṃhārasya bādhakam evam api tātaṅaḥ yat ṅ it karaṇam tat anya artham api saṃbhavati iti ṅ it tva nimittam saṃdihyate

original: [te]na saṃdehāt saṃdigdhopasthāno yogaḥ, yathaiva utsargaḥ / saṃdigdhopasthāna ity apakṛṣyamāṇabalo nonsahate bādhitum iti vipratiṣedha ucyate /
analyzed: tena saṃdehāt saṃdigdha upasthānaḥ yogaḥ yathā eva utsargaḥ saṃdigdha upasthānaḥ iti apakṛṣyamāṇa balaḥ na unsahate bādhitum iti vipratiṣedhaḥ ucyate

original: [2] prayojanaṃ nāma . . . yan niyogata iti / na hi yathānyanirapekṣaṃ ṇiṅo ṅittvam ātamanepadārthaṃ sāmānyagrahaṇāvighātārthaṃ [ca] saṃbhavaty evaṃ ṇitkaraṇaṃ sāmānyagrahaṇārthaṃ saṃbhavatīti yuktaṃ ṇiṅi ṇi[t]karaṇasya sāvakāśatvād iti (? -tvam iti) / iha tu yadā sarvādeśatvaṃ labdhaṃ syāt syāt tadā guṇapratiṣedhārthaṃ bhavet ṅitkaraṇam /
analyzed: prayojanam nāma yat niyogataḥ iti na hi yathā anya nirapekṣam ṇiṅaḥ ṅ it tvam ātamanepada artham sāmānya grahaṇa avighāta artham ca saṃbhavati evam ṇit karaṇam sāmānya grahaṇa artham saṃbhavati iti yuktam ṇiṅi ṇit karaṇasya sa avakāśa tvāt iti tvam iti iha tu yadā sarva ādeśa tvam labdham syāt syāt tadā guṇa pratiṣedha artham bhavet ṅ it karaṇam

original: tad eva tu duḥsaṃpādam iti yad eva nimittaṃ saṃdigdhopasthānatāyās tad eva nāstīti svanimittaprayuktaṃ ṅidyo 'ntyasyety etat kim iti na pravartiṣyate ?
analyzed: tat eva tu duḥsaṃpādam iti yat eva nimittam saṃdigdha upasthāna tāyāḥ tat eva na asti iti sva nimitta prayuktam etat kim iti na pravartiṣyate

original: [3] evaṃ tarhi . . . yad etaṃ ṅitaṃ karotīti / ṅitkaraṇād evāyaṃ sarvādeśaḥ syād ity evaṃ pratipādayati / katham ? etat ṅitkaraṇaṃ guṇavṛddhiniṣedhārtham evācāryasya / tac ca nāsati sarvādeśatve saṃbhavatīti sarvādeśābhyupāya eva ṅitkaraṇam /
analyzed: evam tarhi yat etam ṅitam karoti iti ṅ it karaṇāt eva ayam sarva ādeśaḥ syāt iti evam pratipādayati katham etat ṅit karaṇam guṇa vṛddhi niṣedha artham eva ācāryasya tat ca na asati sarva ādeśa tve saṃbhavati iti sarva ādeśa abhyupāyaḥ eva ṅit karaṇam

original: yadi tv antyārthaṃ ṅitkaraṇaṃ saṃpadyate, śakyate hi prakārāntareṇāntādeśatvaṃ pratipattum iti idam āha---itarathā hi loṭa eruprakaraṇa eva brūyād iti /
analyzed: yadi tu antya artham ṅit karaṇam saṃpadyate śakyate hi prakāra antareṇa anta ādeśa tvam pratipattum iti idam āha etarathā hi loṭe eru prakaraṇe eva brūyāt iti

original: anekāl [śit sarvasya] // 1.1.55 //
analyzed: anekāt ś it sarvasya 1155

original: naitad asti / śitkaraṇād eva sarvādeśo bhaviṣya[tī]ti / anekāltvād ity arthaḥ / nanu ca śakārasya śravaṇaṃ prāpnoti / naiṣa doṣaḥ / e × × × × vā × kā × × nanyārtho lopa iti / tatra śakārasyedaṃ prayojanaṃ samudāyo nivartayitavya iti / samudāye ca nivartita kāryārtham upātto nivartiṣyate /
analyzed: na etat asti ś it karaṇāt eva sarva ādeśaḥ bhaviṣyati iti aneka a l tvāt iti arthaḥ nanu ca śakārasya śravaṇam prāpnoti na eṣa doṣaḥ vā lopaḥ iti tatra śakārasya idam prayojanam samudāyaḥ nivartayitavyaḥ iti samudāye ca nivartita kārya artham upāttaḥ nivartiṣyate

original: idaṃ tarhi ‘aṣṭābhya auś’ (A 7.1.21) iti / pūrvatra ‘alo 'ntyasya’ iti darśitam / idānīm ‘ādeḥ parasya’ (A 1.1.54) iti prāptiḥ pradarśyate iti / evamarthe vopādānam / atha vodāharaṇasaṃbhavaḥ pratipādyate / viśeṣaṇārthaḥ śakāraḥ / anyacchakārasya prayojanam iti sarvādeśārthaṃ na bhaviṣyati / [aṃ]tyasyāyaṃ sthāne bhavann iti /
analyzed: idam tarhi iti pūrvatra a laḥ ntyasya iti darśitam idānīm ādeḥ parasya iti prāptiḥ pradarśyate iti evam arthe vā upādānam atha vā udāharaṇa saṃbhavaḥ pratipādyate viśeṣaṇa arthaḥ śakāraḥ anyat śakārasya prayojanam iti sarva ādeśa artham na bhaviṣyati antyasya ayam sthāne bhavan iti

original: katham antyasya śibhāvaḥ śībhāvo vā, yāvatā ‘sarvanāmno’, ‘napuṃsakāt’ itīyaṃ pañcamī ? tatra ‘ādeḥ parasya’ iti prabhavitavyam / evaṃ manyate / ‘sarvanāmnaḥ’ iti iyaṃ saṃbandhaṣaṣṭhī / ‘napuṃsakāt’ iti ca vihitaviśeṣaṇa[m] /
analyzed: katham antyasya śi bhāvaḥ śī bhāvaḥ vā yāvatā sarvanāmnaḥ napuṃsakāt iti iyam pañcamī tatra ādeḥ parasya iti prabhavitavyam evam manyate sarvanāmnaḥ iti iyam saṃbandha ṣaṣṭhī napuṃsakāt iti ca vihita viśeṣaṇam
